<file path=".github/workflows/cd.yml">
name: "CD — Continuous Delivery"

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ["v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+"]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      environment:
        description: "Target environment"
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, staging, production]
      service:
        description: "Service to deploy (leave empty for all)"
        required: false
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write   # OIDC for keyless AWS auth
  packages: write   # Push to GHCR (optional fallback)

concurrency:
  group: cd-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false   # Never cancel a running deployment

env:
  DOTNET_VERSION: "10.0.x"
  AWS_REGION: "us-east-1"
  ECR_REGISTRY: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCOUNT_ID }}.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
  IMAGE_TAG: ${{ github.sha }}

jobs:
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # JOB 1: Determine which services changed (smart matrix)
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  detect-changes:
    name: "🔍 Detect Changed Services"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      services: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.services }}
      matrix: ${{ steps.set-matrix.outputs.matrix }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4.4.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2

      - name: Detect changed service directories
        id: filter
        uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        with:
          filters: |
            identity:      ['services/identity/**']
            customs:       ['services/customs/**']
            shipping:      ['services/shipping/**']
            payment:       ['services/payment/**']
            notification:  ['services/notification/**']
            fleet:         ['services/fleet/**']
            gps:           ['services/gps/**']
            gps-telematics:['services/gps-telematics/**']
            audit:         ['services/audit/**']
            declaration:   ['services/declaration/**']
            analytics:     ['services/analytics/**']
            corridor:      ['services/corridor/**']
            dryport:       ['services/dryport/**']
            ectn:          ['services/ectn/**']
            anpr-gate:     ['services/anpr-gate/**']
            ais-vessel:    ['services/ais-vessel/**']
            integration:   ['services/integration/**']

      - name: Build service matrix
        id: set-matrix
        run: |
          SERVICES=()
          for svc in identity customs shipping payment notification fleet gps gps-telematics audit declaration analytics corridor dryport ectn anpr-gate ais-vessel integration; do
            if [ "${{ steps.filter.outputs[svc] }}" == "true" ] || [ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
              SERVICES+=("{\"service\":\"${svc}\"}")
            fi
          done
          # Force rebuild all on tag push
          if [[ "${{ github.ref }}" == refs/tags/* ]]; then
            SERVICES=()
            for svc in identity customs shipping payment notification fleet gps gps-telematics audit declaration analytics corridor dryport ectn anpr-gate ais-vessel integration; do
              SERVICES+=("{\"service\":\"${svc}\"}")
            done
          fi
          MATRIX=$(echo "[$(IFS=','; echo "${SERVICES[*]}")]")
          echo "matrix={\"include\":${MATRIX}}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # JOB 2: Build, Sign & Push Docker images
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  build-push:
    name: "🐳 Build & Push — ${{ matrix.include.service }}"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: detect-changes
    if: ${{ needs.detect-changes.outputs.matrix != '{"include":[]}' }}
    strategy:
      matrix: ${{ fromJson(needs.detect-changes.outputs.matrix) }}
      fail-fast: false
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4.4.0

      - name: Configure AWS credentials (OIDC — no static keys)
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.AWS_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN }}
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
          role-session-name: GitHubActions-CD-${{ github.run_id }}

      - name: Login to Amazon ECR
        id: login-ecr
        uses: aws-actions/amazon-ecr-login@v2

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx (multi-platform)
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
        with:
          platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64

      - name: Extract Docker metadata
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/smart-trade/${{ matrix.include.service }}
          tags: |
            type=sha,prefix=sha-,format=short
            type=semver,pattern={{version}}
            type=semver,pattern={{major}}.{{minor}}
            type=raw,value=latest,enable={{is_default_branch}}
            type=ref,event=branch

      - name: Build and push multi-arch image
        id: build-push
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .
          file: services/${{ matrix.include.service }}/Dockerfile
          platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64
          push: true
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
          cache-from: type=gha,scope=${{ matrix.include.service }}
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max,scope=${{ matrix.include.service }}
          build-args: |
            BUILD_VERSION=${{ github.ref_name }}
            BUILD_COMMIT=${{ github.sha }}
            BUILD_DATE=${{ github.event.head_commit.timestamp }}

      - name: Install Cosign (keyless image signing)
        uses: sigstore/cosign-installer@v3

      - name: Sign image with Cosign (OIDC keyless)
        run: |
          cosign sign --yes \
            "${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/smart-trade/${{ matrix.include.service }}@${{ steps.build-push.outputs.digest }}"

      - name: Run Trivy on pushed image
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@0.28.0
        with:
          image-ref: "${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/smart-trade/${{ matrix.include.service }}@${{ steps.build-push.outputs.digest }}"
          format: table
          severity: CRITICAL
          exit-code: "1"
          ignore-unfixed: true

      - name: Store image digest for GitOps update
        run: |
          echo "${{ matrix.include.service }}=${{ steps.build-push.outputs.digest }}" \
            >> /tmp/image-digests.txt

      - name: Upload image digests
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: digest-${{ matrix.include.service }}
          path: /tmp/image-digests.txt

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # JOB 3: Update ArgoCD image tags in Git (GitOps)
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  gitops-update:
    name: "🔄 GitOps Image Tag Update"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build-push
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4.4.0
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITOPS_PAT }}  # PAT with repo write

      - name: Download all image digests
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          pattern: digest-*
          merge-multiple: true
          path: /tmp/digests

      - name: Update Helm values with new image tags
        run: |
          for file in /tmp/digests/*.txt; do
            while IFS= read -r line; do
              SVC=$(echo "$line" | cut -d= -f1)
              DIGEST=$(echo "$line" | cut -d= -f2)
              VALUES_FILE="infrastructure/helm/environments/production/values-${SVC}.yaml"
              if [ -f "$VALUES_FILE" ]; then
                sed -i "s|tag:.*|tag: \"sha-${GITHUB_SHA:0:7}\"|" "$VALUES_FILE"
                echo "Updated ${VALUES_FILE} to sha-${GITHUB_SHA:0:7}"
              fi
            done < "$file"
          done

      - name: Commit and push image tag updates
        uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@v5
        with:
          commit_message: "chore(gitops): update image tags to sha-${{ github.sha }}"
          commit_author: "GitHub Actions <actions@github.com>"
          branch: main
          push_options: "--force-with-lease"

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # JOB 4: Deploy to DEV (auto)
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  deploy-dev:
    name: "🚀 Deploy — dev"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: gitops-update
    environment:
      name: dev
      url: https://dev.smart-trade.io
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4.4.0

      - name: Configure AWS credentials (OIDC)
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.AWS_DEV_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN }}
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}

      - name: Sync ArgoCD — dev apps
        uses: clowdhaus/argo-cd-action@v2
        with:
          command: app sync smart-trade-dev
          options: --timeout 300 --health

      - name: Wait for ArgoCD health
        uses: clowdhaus/argo-cd-action@v2
        with:
          command: app wait smart-trade-dev
          options: --health --timeout 300

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # JOB 5: Deploy to STAGING (auto after dev passes)
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  deploy-staging:
    name: "🚀 Deploy — staging"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: deploy-dev
    environment:
      name: staging
      url: https://staging.smart-trade.io
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4.4.0

      - name: Configure AWS credentials (OIDC)
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.AWS_STAGING_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN }}
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}

      - name: Sync ArgoCD — staging apps
        uses: clowdhaus/argo-cd-action@v2
        with:
          command: app sync smart-trade-staging
          options: --timeout 600 --health

      - name: Run smoke tests against staging
        run: |
          echo "Running smoke tests against https://staging.smart-trade.io ..."
          # Add k6 / Playwright / curl health checks here
          curl --retry 5 --retry-delay 10 --fail \
            https://staging.smart-trade.io/health/live || exit 1

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # JOB 6: Deploy to PRODUCTION (manual approval required)
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  deploy-production:
    name: "🚀 Deploy — production (requires approval)"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: deploy-staging
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
    environment:
      name: production
      url: https://api.smart-trade.io
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4.4.0

      - name: Configure AWS credentials (OIDC)
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.AWS_PROD_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN }}
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}

      - name: Verify image signatures before production deploy
        run: |
          for svc in identity customs shipping payment notification fleet; do
            IMAGE="${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/smart-trade/${svc}:sha-${GITHUB_SHA:0:7}"
            echo "Verifying signature for ${IMAGE}..."
            cosign verify \
              --certificate-identity-regexp="https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/.github/workflows/cd.yml" \
              --certificate-oidc-issuer="https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com" \
              "${IMAGE}"
          done

      - name: Sync ArgoCD — production apps
        uses: clowdhaus/argo-cd-action@v2
        with:
          command: app sync smart-trade-production
          options: --timeout 900 --health --prune

      - name: Wait for production health
        uses: clowdhaus/argo-cd-action@v2
        with:
          command: app wait smart-trade-production
          options: --health --timeout 900

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          generate_release_notes: true
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # JOB 7: Notify team on completion
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  notify:
    name: "📣 Notify"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [deploy-dev, deploy-staging, deploy-production]
    if: always()
    steps:
      - name: Slack notification
        uses: rtCamp/action-slack-notify@v2.4.0
        env:
          SLACK_WEBHOOK: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
          SLACK_CHANNEL: "#deployments"
          SLACK_COLOR: ${{ (contains(needs.*.result, 'failure') || contains(needs.*.result, 'cancelled')) && 'danger' || 'good' }}
          SLACK_ICON_EMOJI: ":rocket:"
          SLACK_USERNAME: "Smart Trade CD Bot"
          SLACK_TITLE: "Deployment — ${{ github.ref_name }}"
          SLACK_MESSAGE: |
            *Commit:* `${{ github.sha }}`
            *Triggered by:* ${{ github.actor }}
            *Dev:* ${{ needs.deploy-dev.result }}
            *Staging:* ${{ needs.deploy-staging.result }}
            *Production:* ${{ needs.deploy-production.result }}
          SLACK_FOOTER: "<${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}|View Run>"

<file path=".github/workflows/ci-cd.yml">
name: CI/CD Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

# A08/A05: least-privilege token. No job in this workflow writes to the repository, so every job
# only ever receives read access to the checked out code.
permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4.4.0

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4.3.1
        with:
          dotnet-version: '10.0.x'

      - name: Restore all projects
        run: |
          find . -name '*.csproj' -not -path '*/obj/*' -not -path '*/bin/*' | \
          xargs -I {} dotnet restore {}

      - name: Build all projects
        run: |
          find . -name '*.csproj' -not -path '*/obj/*' -not -path '*/bin/*' | \
          xargs -I {} dotnet build {} --no-restore --configuration Release


      # Runs every test project in the repo (services/**/X.Tests, tests/**, integration tests),
      # not just those under a literal "tests" directory. --configuration must match the Release
      # build above, otherwise --no-build finds no binaries.
      - name: Test all projects
        run: |
          find . -name '*.csproj' -not -path '*/obj/*' -not -path '*/bin/*' \
          | grep -Ei 'Tests\.csproj$' \
          | xargs -I {} dotnet test {} --no-build --configuration Release --verbosity normal --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage"

  docker-build-push:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4.4.0

      - name: Log in to Docker Hub
        uses: docker/login-action@v3.7.0
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_PASSWORD }}

      - name: Build Docker image
        run: docker build -t ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}/smart-trade-app:latest .

      - name: Push Docker image
        run: docker push ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}/smart-trade-app:latest

  terraform-deploy:
    needs: docker-build-push
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4.4.0

      - name: Setup Terraform
        uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v3.1.2
        with:
          terraform_version: 1.5.0

      - name: Terraform Init
        run: terraform init
        working-directory: ./infrastructure/terraform

      - name: Terraform Apply
        run: terraform apply -auto-approve
        working-directory: ./infrastructure/terraform
        env:
          AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}

  kubernetes-deploy:
    needs: terraform-deploy
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4.4.0

      - name: Configure kubectl
        uses: azure/k8s-set-context@v3.1
        with:
          kubeconfig: ${{ secrets.KUBECONFIG }}

      - name: Deploy to Kubernetes
        run: |
          kubectl apply -f ./k8s/deployment.yaml
          kubectl apply -f ./infrastructure/monitoring/prometheus-grafana.yaml

  notify-slack:
    needs: [build-and-test, docker-build-push, terraform-deploy, kubernetes-deploy]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    steps:
      - name: Send Slack Notification
        uses: rtCamp/action-slack-notify@v2.4.0
        env:
          SLACK_WEBHOOK: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
          SLACK_CHANNEL: '#deployments'
          SLACK_COLOR: ${{ job.status == 'success' && 'good' || 'danger' }}
          SLACK_TITLE: "Deployment Status: ${{ job.status }}"
          SLACK_MESSAGE: "Smart Trade Platform CI/CD pipeline completed for branch ${{ github.ref }}"
          SLACK_USERNAME: "GitHub Actions Bot"
</file>

<file path=".github/workflows/ci.yml">
name: "CI — Continuous Integration"

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, develop, "release/**"]
  push:
    branches: [develop]

# Least-privilege: read-only by default; individual jobs declare what they need
permissions:
  contents: read
  security-events: write   # CodeQL SARIF upload
  pull-requests: write     # PR comments (coverage, scan results)

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  DOTNET_VERSION: "10.0.x"
  DOTNET_SKIP_FIRST_TIME_EXPERIENCE: 1
  DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT: 1
  NUGET_PACKAGES: ${{ github.workspace }}/.nuget/packages

jobs:
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # JOB 1: Lint & Format Check
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  lint:
    name: "🔍 Lint & Format"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4.4.0

      - name: Setup .NET ${{ env.DOTNET_VERSION }}
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4.3.1
        with:
          dotnet-version: ${{ env.DOTNET_VERSION }}

      - name: Restore NuGet packages
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ${{ env.NUGET_PACKAGES }}
          key: nuget-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/*.csproj', '**/packages.lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: nuget-${{ runner.os }}-

      - name: Restore projects
        run: dotnet restore smart-trade.sln

      - name: Check formatting (dotnet format)
        run: dotnet format smart-trade.sln --verify-no-changes --no-restore
        continue-on-error: true  # Report but don't block; enforce via pre-commit

      - name: Lint YAML files
        uses: ibiqlik/action-yamllint@v3
        with:
          config_data: |
            extends: default
            rules:
              line-length:
                max: 120

      - name: Lint Dockerfiles
        uses: hadolint/hadolint-action@v3.1.0
        with:
          recursive: true
          failure-threshold: error

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # JOB 2: Build & Unit Tests
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  build-and-test:
    name: "🏗️ Build & Test"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: lint
    strategy:
      matrix:
        service:
          - identity
          - customs
          - shipping
          - payment
          - notification
          - fleet
          - gps
          - audit
          - declaration
          - analytics
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4.4.0

      - name: Setup .NET ${{ env.DOTNET_VERSION }}
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4.3.1
        with:
          dotnet-version: ${{ env.DOTNET_VERSION }}

      - name: Cache NuGet packages
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ${{ env.NUGET_PACKAGES }}
          key: nuget-${{ runner.os }}-${{ matrix.service }}-${{ hashFiles(format('services/{0}/**/*.csproj', matrix.service)) }}
          restore-keys: nuget-${{ runner.os }}-

      - name: Restore ${{ matrix.service }}
        run: |
          find services/${{ matrix.service }} -name '*.csproj' -not -path '*/obj/*' | \
          xargs -I {} dotnet restore {}

      - name: Build ${{ matrix.service }}
        run: |
          find services/${{ matrix.service }} -name '*.csproj' -not -path '*/obj/*' -not -name '*.Tests*' | \
          xargs -I {} dotnet build {} --no-restore --configuration Release

      - name: Test ${{ matrix.service }}
        run: |
          find services/${{ matrix.service }} -name '*.Tests.csproj' -not -path '*/obj/*' | \
          xargs -I {} dotnet test {} \
            --no-build \
            --configuration Release \
            --logger "trx;LogFileName=test-results-${{ matrix.service }}.trx" \
            --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage" \
            --results-directory ./test-results/${{ matrix.service }}

      - name: Upload test results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: test-results-${{ matrix.service }}
          path: ./test-results/${{ matrix.service }}
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Upload coverage report
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          directory: ./test-results/${{ matrix.service }}
          flags: ${{ matrix.service }}
          fail_ci_if_error: false

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # JOB 3: SAST — Static Application Security Testing (CodeQL)
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  sast:
    name: "🛡️ SAST (CodeQL)"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      security-events: write
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        language: [csharp]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4.4.0

      - name: Initialize CodeQL
        uses: github/codeql-action/init@v3
        with:
          languages: ${{ matrix.language }}
          queries: security-and-quality

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4.3.1
        with:
          dotnet-version: ${{ env.DOTNET_VERSION }}

      - name: Build for CodeQL analysis
        run: |
          find . -name '*.csproj' -not -path '*/obj/*' -not -name '*.Tests*' | \
          xargs -I {} dotnet build {} --configuration Release

      - name: Perform CodeQL Analysis
        uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v3
        with:
          category: "/language:${{ matrix.language }}"
          upload: true

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # JOB 4: Secret Scanning (Gitleaks)
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  secret-scan:
    name: "🔐 Secret Scanning (Gitleaks)"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4.4.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0  # Full history for git log scanning

      - name: Gitleaks — detect secrets
        uses: gitleaks/gitleaks-action@v2
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          GITLEAKS_LICENSE: ${{ secrets.GITLEAKS_LICENSE }}  # Optional: for teams

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # JOB 5: Container Image Security Scan (Trivy)
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  trivy-scan:
    name: "🐳 Container Scan (Trivy)"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build-and-test
    permissions:
      security-events: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4.4.0

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Build image for scanning (Identity as representative)
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .
          file: services/identity/Identity.Api/Dockerfile
          push: false
          tags: smart-trade/identity:scan
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max
          load: true

      - name: Trivy vulnerability scan
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@0.28.0
        with:
          image-ref: smart-trade/identity:scan
          format: sarif
          output: trivy-results.sarif
          severity: CRITICAL,HIGH
          exit-code: "1"
          ignore-unfixed: true

      - name: Upload Trivy results to Security tab
        uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v3
        if: always()
        with:
          sarif_file: trivy-results.sarif
          category: trivy

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # JOB 6: Infrastructure-as-Code Scan (Checkov)
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  iac-scan:
    name: "🏛️ IaC Security Scan (Checkov)"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      security-events: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4.4.0

      - name: Checkov — Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm
        uses: bridgecrewio/checkov-action@v12
        with:
          directory: infrastructure/
          framework: terraform,kubernetes,helm
          output_format: sarif
          output_file_path: checkov-results.sarif
          soft_fail: false

      - name: Upload Checkov results
        uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v3
        if: always()
        with:
          sarif_file: checkov-results.sarif
          category: checkov

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # JOB 7: CI Gate — All checks must pass before merge
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ci-gate:
    name: "✅ CI Gate"
    needs: [lint, build-and-test, sast, secret-scan, trivy-scan, iac-scan]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    steps:
      - name: Evaluate CI result
        run: |
          echo "Lint: ${{ needs.lint.result }}"
          echo "Build & Test: ${{ needs.build-and-test.result }}"
          echo "SAST: ${{ needs.sast.result }}"
          echo "Secret Scan: ${{ needs.secret-scan.result }}"
          echo "Trivy: ${{ needs.trivy-scan.result }}"
          echo "IaC Scan: ${{ needs.iac-scan.result }}"

          if [[ "${{ needs.lint.result }}" != "success" ]] || \
             [[ "${{ needs.build-and-test.result }}" != "success" ]] || \
             [[ "${{ needs.sast.result }}" != "success" ]] || \
             [[ "${{ needs.secret-scan.result }}" != "success" ]] || \
             [[ "${{ needs.trivy-scan.result }}" != "success" ]] || \
             [[ "${{ needs.iac-scan.result }}" != "success" ]]; then
            echo "❌ One or more CI checks failed. Blocking merge."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "✅ All CI checks passed."
</file>

<file path=".github/workflows/security-audit.yml">
name: "🔒 Weekly Security Audit"

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 2 * * 1"   # Every Monday at 02:00 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  security-events: write
  issues: write

jobs:
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # JOB 1: Scan all ECR images with Trivy
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  trivy-all-images:
    name: "🐳 Scan ECR Images"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        service: [identity, customs, shipping, payment, notification, fleet, gps, audit, declaration, analytics, corridor, dryport, ectn, anpr-gate, ais-vessel, integration]
      fail-fast: false
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4.4.0

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.AWS_READONLY_ROLE_ARN }}
          aws-region: us-east-1

      - name: Login to ECR
        uses: aws-actions/amazon-ecr-login@v2

      - name: Run Trivy on ${{ matrix.service }}
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@0.28.0
        with:
          image-ref: "${{ secrets.AWS_ACCOUNT_ID }}.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/smart-trade/${{ matrix.service }}:latest"
          format: sarif
          output: trivy-${{ matrix.service }}.sarif
          severity: CRITICAL,HIGH
          exit-code: "0"  # Weekly audit — don't fail, report instead

      - name: Upload scan results
        uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v3
        if: always()
        with:
          sarif_file: trivy-${{ matrix.service }}.sarif
          category: trivy-${{ matrix.service }}

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # JOB 2: Full repo secret scan
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  gitleaks-full:
    name: "🔐 Full Repo Secret Scan"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4.4.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Gitleaks full scan
        uses: gitleaks/gitleaks-action@v2
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # JOB 3: Dependency vulnerability check (OWASP)
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  dependency-check:
    name: "📦 OWASP Dependency Check"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4.4.0

      - name: OWASP Dependency Check
        uses: dependency-check/Dependency-Check_Action@main
        with:
          project: "smart-trade-logistics-platform"
          path: "."
          format: "HTML"
          out: "dependency-check-report"
          args: >
            --failOnCVSS 7
            --enableRetired

      - name: Upload dependency check report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dependency-check-report
          path: dependency-check-report/
          retention-days: 30

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # JOB 4: Terraform Security Scan (tfsec)
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  tfsec:
    name: "🏛️ Terraform Security (tfsec)"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4.4.0

      - name: tfsec scan
        uses: aquasecurity/tfsec-sarif-action@v0.1.4
        with:
          sarif_file: tfsec.sarif
          working_directory: infrastructure/terraform

      - name: Upload tfsec results
        uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v3
        if: always()
        with:
          sarif_file: tfsec.sarif
          category: tfsec

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # JOB 5: Create summary issue if vulnerabilities found
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  security-report:
    name: "📊 Security Report Issue"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [trivy-all-images, gitleaks-full, dependency-check, tfsec]
    if: always()
    steps:
      - name: Create security summary issue
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const date = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
            const results = {
              trivy:      '${{ needs.trivy-all-images.result }}',
              gitleaks:   '${{ needs.gitleaks-full.result }}',
              depcheck:   '${{ needs.dependency-check.result }}',
              tfsec:      '${{ needs.tfsec.result }}'
            };
            const hasFailure = Object.values(results).includes('failure');
            if (!hasFailure) return;

            const body = `## 🔒 Weekly Security Audit — ${date}

            | Tool | Result |
            |------|--------|
            | Trivy (ECR Images) | ${results.trivy} |
            | Gitleaks (Secrets) | ${results.gitleaks} |
            | OWASP Dep Check   | ${results.depcheck} |
            | tfsec (Terraform) | ${results.tfsec} |

            [View Security Alerts](${context.serverUrl}/${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.repo}/security)
            [View Run](${context.serverUrl}/${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.repo}/actions/runs/${context.runId})

            @${context.repo.owner}/security-team please review and address the above.`;

            await github.rest.issues.create({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              title: `🔒 Security Audit Findings — ${date}`,
              body: body,
              labels: ['security', 'automated']
            });

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:

    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "infrastructure/terraform/**"

      environment:
        description: "Target environment"
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, staging, production]
      action:
        description: "Terraform action"
        required: true
        type: choice

  contents: read

env:

  # JOB 1: Terraform Format Check

    name: "📐 Terraform Format"

      - uses: actions/checkout@v4.4.0

      - uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v3.1.2
        with:

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  terraform-plan:
    name: "📋 Terraform Plan — ${{ matrix.environment }}"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: terraform-fmt
    strategy:
      matrix:
        environment: [dev, staging, production]
      fail-fast: false
    environment: ${{ matrix.environment }}
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: infrastructure/terraform/environments/${{ matrix.environment }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4.4.0

        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets[format('AWS_{0}_TERRAFORM_ROLE_ARN', upper(matrix.environment))] }}
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
          role-session-name: Terraform-${{ matrix.environment }}-${{ github.run_id }}

      - uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v3.1.2
        with:
          terraform_version: ${{ env.TF_VERSION }}

      - name: Terraform Init
        id: init
        run: |
          terraform init \
            -backend-config="bucket=smart-trade-tfstate-${{ matrix.environment }}" \
            -backend-config="key=${{ matrix.environment }}/terraform.tfstate" \
            -backend-config="region=${{ env.AWS_REGION }}" \
            -backend-config="dynamodb_table=smart-trade-tfstate-lock-${{ matrix.environment }}" \
            -backend-config="encrypt=true"

      - name: Terraform Validate
        id: validate
        run: terraform validate -no-color

      - name: Terraform Plan
        id: plan
        run: |
          terraform plan \
            -var-file="terraform.tfvars" \
            -out=tfplan-${{ matrix.environment }}.binary \

      - name: Convert plan to JSON for audit
        run: terraform show -json tfplan-${{ matrix.environment }}.binary > tfplan-${{ matrix.environment }}.json

            ${truncated}
            \`\`\`

            </details>

              owner: context.repo.owner,

<file path="apps/web/src/contexts/__tests/AuthContext.test.tsx">
import React from 'react';
import { render, screen, act } from '@testing-library/react';
import { AuthProvider, useAuth } from '../AuthContext';
import '@testing-library/jest-dom';

// Test component that allows us to trigger login and check permissions
const TestUserSession = ({ permissionToTest }: { permissionToTest: string }) => {
  const { login, hasPermission, isAuthenticated } = useAuth();

  return (
    <div>
      <div data-testid="auth-status">{isAuthenticated ? 'true' : 'false'}</div>
      <div data-testid="perm-status">{hasPermission(permissionToTest) ? 'true' : 'false'}</div>
      <button
        data-testid="login-btn"
        onClick={() => login('TENT001', ['users.read', 'customs.read'])}
      >
        Login
      </button>
    </div>
  );
};

describe('AuthContext Security Suite', () => {
  test('Initial State: Should be unauthenticated and have no permissions', () => {
    render(
      <AuthProvider>
        <TestUserSession permissionToTest="users.read" />
      </AuthProvider>
    );

    expect(screen.getByTestId('auth-status').textContent).toBe('false');
    expect(screen.getByTestId('perm-status').textContent).toBe('false');
  });

  test('Post-Login: Should grant specific permissions and deny others', async () => {
    render(
      <AuthProvider>
        <TestUserSession permissionToTest="users.read" />
      </AuthProvider>
    );

    // Trigger login
    const loginBtn = screen.getByTestId('login-btn');
    act(() => {
      loginBtn.click();
    });

    // Verify authentication status
    expect(screen.getByTestId('auth-status').textContent).toBe('true');

    // Verify granted permission
    expect(screen.getByTestId('perm-status').textContent).toBe('true');
  });

  test('Security Boundary: Should deny permissions not present in token', () => {
    render(
      <AuthProvider>
        <TestUserSession permissionToTest="admin.all" />
      </AuthProvider>
    );

    const loginBtn = screen.getByTestId('login-btn');
    act(() => {
      loginBtn.click();
    });

    // Authenticated, but should NOT have admin.all permission
    expect(screen.getByTestId('auth-status').textContent).toBe('true');
    expect(screen.getByTestId('perm-status').textContent).toBe('false');
  });
});

<file path="apps/web/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx">
import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect } from 'react';

interface AuthState {
  isAuthenticated: boolean;
  tenantCode: string | null;
  permissions: string[];
}

interface AuthContextType extends AuthState {
  login: (tenant: string, perms: string[]) => void;
  logout: () => void;
  hasPermission: (permission: string) => boolean;
}

const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export const AuthProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [authState, setAuthState] = useState<AuthState>({
    isAuthenticated: false,
    tenantCode: null,
    permissions: [],
  });

  const login = (tenant: string, perms: string[]) => {
    // Tokens are now handled by the backend via Secure, HttpOnly cookies.
    // The frontend only maintains the session state and user identity.
    setAuthState({
      isAuthenticated: true,
      tenantCode: tenant,
      permissions: perms,
    });
  };

  const logout = async () => {
    try {
      // Call backend to clear the HttpOnly cookie
      await fetch('/api/v1/identity/auth/logout', { method: 'POST' });
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Logout request failed', e);
    } finally {
      setAuthState({
        isAuthenticated: false,
        tenantCode: null,
        permissions: [],
      });
    }
  };

  const hasPermission = (permission: string) => {
    return authState.permissions.includes(permission);
  };

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider value={{ ...authState, login, logout, hasPermission }}>
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useAuth = () => {
  const context = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (context === undefined) {
    throw new Error('useAuth must be used within an AuthProvider');
  }
  return context;
};
</file>

// Since the current LoginPage has a simulated call, we can test the UI behavior.

describe('LoginPage Functional & Security Tests', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
  });

  const renderLoginPage = () => {
    return render(
      <AuthProvider>
        <LoginPage />
      </AuthProvider>
    );
  };

  test('should render all required input fields', () => {
    renderLoginPage();

    expect(screen.getByLabelText(/tenant code/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(/email/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(/password/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /sign in/i })).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  test('should show validation error when fields are empty', async () => {
    renderLoginPage();

    const submitBtn = screen.getByRole('button', { name: /sign in/i });
    fireEvent.click(submitBtn);

    // HTML5 validation usually handles this, but we check if our logic handles it
    // In the current implementation, it uses 'required' attributes
    expect(submitBtn).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  test('should handle successful login flow', async () => {
    renderLoginPage();

    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/tenant code/i), { target: { value: 'TENT001' } });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/email/i), { target: { value: 'user@example.com' } });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/password/i), { target: { value: 'Password123!' } });

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /sign in/i }));

    // In the current mock implementation, it just logs to console and calls login()
    // We verify that the "Invalid credentials" error does NOT appear
    expect(screen.queryByText(/invalid credentials/i)).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  test('should protect against basic XSS in input fields', () => {
    renderLoginPage();

    const emailInput = screen.getByLabelText(/email/i);
    const xssPayload = '<script>alert("xss")</script>';

    fireEvent.change(emailInput, { target: { value: xssPayload } });

    // Verify the input value is set but not executed (React handles this by default)
    expect(emailInput.value).toBe(xssPayload);
  });

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../../contexts/AuthContext';

export const LoginPage: React.FC = () => {
  const { login } = useAuth();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [tenantCode, setTenantCode] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  const handleLogin = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      // Simulate API call to POST /api/v1/identity/auth/login
      console.log('Logging in with', { email, tenantCode });
      
      // Simulate successful response
      // The backend now sets a Secure, HttpOnly cookie.
      // The frontend no longer receives the token in the response body.
      login(tenantCode, ['users.read', 'customs.read']);

      
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Invalid credentials or tenant code');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ maxWidth: '400px', margin: '100px auto', fontFamily: 'sans-serif' }}>
      <h2>Sign in to Smart Trade Platform</h2>
      {error && <p style={{ color: 'red' }}>{error}</p>}
      <form onSubmit={handleLogin} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '15px' }}>
        <div>
          <label>Tenant Code</label>
          <input 
            type="text" 
            value={tenantCode} 
            onChange={(e) => setTenantCode(e.target.value)} 
            required 
            style={{ width: '100%', padding: '8px' }}
          />
        </div>
        <div>
          <label>Email</label>
          <input 
            type="email" 
            value={email} 
            onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)} 
            required 
            style={{ width: '100%', padding: '8px' }}
          />
        </div>
        <div>
          <label>Password</label>
          <input 
            type="password" 
            value={password} 
            onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)} 
            required 
            style={{ width: '100%', padding: '8px' }}
          />
        </div>
        <button type="submit" style={{ padding: '10px', background: '#0056b3', color: 'white', border: 'none' }}>
          Sign In
        </button>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
};

<file path="building-blocks/persistence/HealthChecks/HealthCheckExtensions.cs">
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Diagnostics.HealthChecks;

namespace BuildingBlocks.Persistence.HealthChecks;

public static class HealthCheckExtensions
{
    public static IHealthChecksBuilder AddDatabaseHealthChecks(
        this IServiceCollection services, 
        string postgresConnectionString, 
        string mongoConnectionString, 
        string redisConnectionString)
    {
        var builder = services.AddHealthChecks();

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(postgresConnectionString))
        {
            // Requires: AspNetCore.HealthChecks.Npgsql
            builder.AddNpgSql(
                postgresConnectionString,
                name: "postgresql",
                tags: new[] { "db", "sql", "ready" });
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(mongoConnectionString))
        {
            // Requires: AspNetCore.HealthChecks.MongoDb
            builder.AddMongoDb(
                mongoConnectionString,
                name: "mongodb",
                tags: new[] { "db", "nosql", "ready" });
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(redisConnectionString))
        {
            // Requires: AspNetCore.HealthChecks.Redis
            builder.AddRedis(
                redisConnectionString,
                name: "redis",
                tags: new[] { "cache", "ready" });
        }

        return builder;
    }
}

public static class PaginationConstants

    public const int MaxPageSize = 1000;

public class KeysetPaginationRequest
{
    private int _limit = PaginationConstants.DefaultPageSize;

    {
        get => _limit;

<file path="building-blocks/persistence/SmartDbContext.cs">
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using System;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace BuildingBlocks.Persistence;

public abstract class SmartDbContext<TContext> : DbContext
    where TContext : DbContext
{
    protected SmartDbContext(DbContextOptions<TContext> options) : base(options)
    {
    }

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);
        
        // Enforce Snake Case convention globally if needed
        // For Postgres, it is standard. Npgsql provides a method for this, 
        // typically configured via options.UseSnakeCaseNamingConvention() in Program.cs.
    }

    public override int SaveChanges()
    {
        UpdateAuditFields();
        return base.SaveChanges();
    }

    public override Task<int> SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        UpdateAuditFields();
        return base.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
    }

    private void UpdateAuditFields()
    {
        var entries = ChangeTracker.Entries()
            .Where(e => e.State == EntityState.Added || e.State == EntityState.Modified);

        foreach (var entry in entries)
        {
            var utcNow = DateTime.UtcNow;

            var createdAtProp = entry.Properties.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Metadata.Name == "CreatedAtUtc" || p.Metadata.Name == "created_at_utc");
            if (createdAtProp != null && entry.State == EntityState.Added)
            {
                createdAtProp.CurrentValue = utcNow;
            }

            var updatedAtProp = entry.Properties.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Metadata.Name == "UpdatedAtUtc" || p.Metadata.Name == "updated_at_utc");
            if (updatedAtProp != null)
            {
                updatedAtProp.CurrentValue = utcNow;
            }
        }
    }
}
</file>

<file path="building-blocks/web/PlatformAuthenticationExtensions.cs">
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;
using System.Text;

namespace BuildingBlocks.Web;

public static class PlatformAuthenticationExtensions
{
    public static IServiceCollection AddPlatformJwtAuthentication(this IServiceCollection services, IConfiguration configuration)
    {
        var secret = configuration["Jwt:Secret"];
        var issuer = configuration["Jwt:Issuer"];
        var audience = configuration["Jwt:Audience"];
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(secret) || Encoding.UTF8.GetByteCount(secret) < 32 ||
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(issuer) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(audience))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Configure Jwt:Secret (at least 32 UTF-8 bytes), Jwt:Issuer and Jwt:Audience.");

        services.AddAuthentication(JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme)
            .AddJwtBearer(options =>
            {
                options.MapInboundClaims = false;
                options.TokenValidationParameters = new TokenValidationParameters
                {
                    ValidateIssuerSigningKey = true,
                    IssuerSigningKey = new SymmetricSecurityKey(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(secret)),
                    ValidateIssuer = true,
                    ValidIssuer = issuer,
                    ValidateAudience = true,
                    ValidAudience = audience,
                    ValidateLifetime = true,
                    ClockSkew = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30)
                };

                // A09: record authentication failures, rejected authorizations and token errors so
                // brute force and token misuse attempts are visible to monitoring. Token material is
                // never logged.
                options.Events = new JwtBearerEvents
                {
                    OnAuthenticationFailed = context =>
                    {
                        Log(context.HttpContext, LogLevel.Warning,
                            "Token validation failed for {Method} {Path}: {Error}",
                            context.HttpContext.Request.Method, context.HttpContext.Request.Path,
                            context.Exception?.Message ?? "unknown error");
                        return Task.CompletedTask;
                    },
                    OnChallenge = context =>
                    {
                        Log(context.HttpContext, LogLevel.Information,
                            "Authentication challenge for {Method} {Path} from {RemoteIp}: {Reason}",
                            context.HttpContext.Request.Method, context.HttpContext.Request.Path,
                            context.HttpContext.Connection.RemoteIpAddress,
                            context.ErrorDescription ?? "missing or invalid credentials");
                        return Task.CompletedTask;
                    },
                    OnForbidden = context =>
                    {
                        var user = context.HttpContext.User;
                        // MapInboundClaims is disabled, so Identity.Name may be unset; fall back to
                        // the raw subject claim so the audit entry still identifies the caller.
                        var name = user?.Identity?.Name
                            ?? user?.FindFirst("unique_name")?.Value
                            ?? user?.FindFirst("sub")?.Value
                            ?? "unknown";
                        Log(context.HttpContext, LogLevel.Information,
                            "Access forbidden for user {User} on {Method} {Path}",
                            name,
                            context.HttpContext.Request.Method, context.HttpContext.Request.Path);
                        return Task.CompletedTask;
                    }
                };
            });
        return services;
    }

    private static void Log(HttpContext context, LogLevel level, string message, params object?[] args)
    {
        var logger = context.RequestServices
            .GetRequiredService<ILoggerFactory>()
            .CreateLogger("Platform.Authentication");
        logger.Log(level, message, args);
    }
}

<file path="building-blocks/web/PlatformExceptionHandler.cs">
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Diagnostics;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace BuildingBlocks.Web;

/// <summary>
/// A05/A09: turns unhandled exceptions into a generic RFC 9457 style problem response so stack
/// traces, connection strings and SQL never reach the client, while still recording the full
/// exception in the service log for monitoring and incident response.
/// </summary>
public sealed class PlatformExceptionHandler : IExceptionHandler
{
    private readonly ILogger<PlatformExceptionHandler> _logger;

    public PlatformExceptionHandler(ILogger<PlatformExceptionHandler> logger) => _logger = logger;

    public async ValueTask<bool> TryHandleAsync(HttpContext httpContext, Exception exception, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        _logger.LogError(
            exception,
            "Unhandled exception while processing {Method} {Path} for {RemoteIp}",
            httpContext.Request.Method,
            httpContext.Request.Path,
            httpContext.Connection.RemoteIpAddress);

        if (httpContext.Response.HasStarted) return true;

        httpContext.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError;
        await httpContext.Response.WriteAsJsonAsync(new
        {
            type = "https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc9457#section-15.6.1",
            title = "An unexpected error occurred.",
            status = StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError
        }, cancellationToken);

        return true;
    }
}

<file path="building-blocks/web/PlatformSecurityExtensions.cs">
using System.Threading.RateLimiting;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.RateLimiting;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace BuildingBlocks.Web;

/// <summary>
/// Cross-cutting OWASP Top 10 hardening applied by every HTTP service:
/// <list type="bullet">
///   <item>A01 Broken Access Control - deny-by-default fallback authorization policy.</item>
///   <item>A05 Security Misconfiguration - security headers, HSTS, config-driven CORS (never AllowAnyOrigin), ProblemDetails instead of stack traces.</item>
///   <item>A07 Identification and Authentication Failures - per-IP rate limiting with a stricter partition for sensitive endpoints.</item>
///   <item>A09 Logging and Monitoring Failures - rate-limit rejections and unhandled exceptions are logged.</item>
/// </list>
/// </summary>
public static class PlatformSecurityExtensions
{
    /// <summary>Name of the CORS policy built from the <c>Cors:AllowedOrigins</c> configuration key.</summary>
    public const string CorsPolicyName = "PlatformCors";

    /// <summary>Rate limit policy for sensitive endpoints (login, verification, machine ingestion).</summary>
    public const string SensitiveRateLimitPolicy = "platform-sensitive";

    /// <summary>
    /// Registers the platform-wide security defaults. Services keep calling
    /// <c>AddAuthorization(...)</c> themselves to declare their permission policies; the fallback
    /// policy registered here guarantees that any endpoint without explicit metadata requires an
    /// authenticated caller (A01).
    /// </summary>
    public static IServiceCollection AddPlatformSecurity(this IServiceCollection services, IConfiguration configuration)
    {
        services.AddPlatformAuthorization();
        services.AddPlatformRateLimiting(configuration);
        services.AddPlatformCors(configuration);
        services.AddProblemDetails();
        services.AddExceptionHandler<PlatformExceptionHandler>();
        return services;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// A01: deny-by-default. Any endpoint that does not carry <c>[Authorize]</c> or
    /// <c>[AllowAnonymous]</c> requires a valid, authenticated JWT.
    /// </summary>
    public static IServiceCollection AddPlatformAuthorization(this IServiceCollection services)
    {
        services.AddAuthorization(options =>
        {
            options.FallbackPolicy = new AuthorizationPolicyBuilder()
                .RequireAuthenticatedUser()
                .Build();
        });
        return services;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// A04/A07: global per-IP rate limit plus a stricter named policy
    /// (<see cref="SensitiveRateLimitPolicy"/>) for brute-forceable endpoints. Rejections are
    /// logged (A09) and answered with a generic 429 body.
    /// </summary>
    public static IServiceCollection AddPlatformRateLimiting(this IServiceCollection services, IConfiguration configuration)
    {
        var globalPermits = configuration.GetValue("RateLimit:GlobalPermitsPerMinute", 120);
        var sensitivePermits = configuration.GetValue("RateLimit:SensitivePermitsPerMinute", 10);

        services.AddRateLimiter(options =>
        {
            options.RejectionStatusCode = StatusCodes.Status429TooManyRequests;

            options.GlobalLimiter = PartitionedRateLimiter.Create<HttpContext, string>(context =>
                RateLimitPartition.GetFixedWindowLimiter(
                    partitionKey: context.Connection.RemoteIpAddress?.ToString() ?? "unknown",
                    factory: _ => new FixedWindowRateLimiterOptions
                    {
                        PermitLimit = globalPermits,
                        Window = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1),
                        QueueLimit = 0,
                        AutoReplenishment = true
                    }));

            options.AddPolicy(SensitiveRateLimitPolicy, context =>
                RateLimitPartition.GetFixedWindowLimiter(
                    context.Connection.RemoteIpAddress?.ToString() ?? "unknown",
                    _ => new FixedWindowRateLimiterOptions
                    {
                        PermitLimit = sensitivePermits,
                        Window = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1),
                        QueueLimit = 0,
                        AutoReplenishment = true
                    }));

            options.OnRejected = async (context, cancellationToken) =>
            {
                var logger = context.HttpContext.RequestServices
                    .GetRequiredService<ILoggerFactory>()
                    .CreateLogger("PlatformSecurity");
                logger.LogWarning(
                    "Rate limit rejected {Method} {Path} from {RemoteIp}",
                    context.HttpContext.Request.Method,
                    context.HttpContext.Request.Path,
                    context.HttpContext.Connection.RemoteIpAddress);

                if (context.HttpContext.Response.HasStarted) return;

                context.HttpContext.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status429TooManyRequests;
                await context.HttpContext.Response.WriteAsJsonAsync(
                    new { error = "Too many requests. Please retry later." }, cancellationToken);
            };
        });

        return services;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// A05: CORS is opt-in and restricted to explicitly configured origins. There is deliberately
    /// no <c>AllowAnyOrigin</c> fallback; when <c>Cors:AllowedOrigins</c> is absent the policy is
    /// not registered at all and the service stays same-origin only.
    /// </summary>
    public static IServiceCollection AddPlatformCors(this IServiceCollection services, IConfiguration configuration)
    {
        var origins = ParseAllowedOrigins(configuration);
        if (origins.Length == 0) return services;

        services.AddCors(options => options.AddPolicy(CorsPolicyName, policyBuilder => policyBuilder
            .WithOrigins(origins)
            .AllowAnyHeader()
            .AllowAnyMethod()
            .AllowCredentials()
            .SetPreflightMaxAge(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5))));

        return services;
    }

    /// <summary>Applies the configured CORS policy. No-op when no origins are configured.</summary>
    public static WebApplication UsePlatformCors(this WebApplication app)
    {
        if (ParseAllowedOrigins(app.Configuration).Length == 0) return app;
        app.UseCors(CorsPolicyName);
        return app;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// A05: exception handling (generic ProblemDetails, full error logged server-side only) plus
    /// hardening response headers. Must be the first middleware of the pipeline.
    /// </summary>
    public static WebApplication UsePlatformSecurity(this WebApplication app)
    {
        app.UseExceptionHandler();

        app.Use(async (context, next) =>
        {
            var headers = context.Response.Headers;
            headers["X-Content-Type-Options"] = "nosniff";
            headers["X-Frame-Options"] = "DENY";
            headers["Referrer-Policy"] = "no-referrer";
            headers["Permissions-Policy"] = "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=()";
            headers["Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy"] = "same-origin";
            headers.Remove("X-Powered-By");
            await next();
        });

        if (!app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
        {
            app.UseHsts();
        }

        return app;
    }

    private static string[] ParseAllowedOrigins(IConfiguration configuration)
    {
        var configured = configuration["Cors:AllowedOrigins"];
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(configured)) return Array.Empty<string>();

        return configured.Split(',', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries | StringSplitOptions.TrimEntries);
    }
}

<file path="building-blocks/web/PlatformUrlGuard.cs">
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Sockets;

namespace BuildingBlocks.Web;

/// <summary>
/// A10 (SSRF) guard for any URL that originates from a partner, tenant or end user - for example
/// the outbound delivery address of a <c>WebhookSubscription.TargetUrl</c> or a partner-provided
/// callback.
///
/// Operator supplied configuration (<c>ConnectionStrings</c>, internal service base URLs) is
/// trusted and must not go through this guard, otherwise in-cluster HTTP calls would be blocked.
///
/// The check fails closed: an unparsable URL, a non-HTTPS scheme, a URL that carries credentials,
/// a host resolving to loopback/private/link-local/metadata space, or an unresolvable host are all
/// treated as unsafe. DNS is resolved at validation time; callers that are rate sensitive should
/// still pin the resolved address for the actual request to fully eliminate DNS rebinding.
/// </summary>
public static class PlatformUrlGuard
{
    /// <summary>Returns <c>true</c> when <paramref name="candidate"/> is safe to request from the server.</summary>
    public static bool IsSafe(string candidate) => TryValidate(candidate, out _);

    /// <summary>Returns <c>true</c> when <paramref name="candidate"/> is unsafe, with the reason.</summary>
    public static bool TryGetRejectionReason(string candidate, out string reason) => !TryValidate(candidate, out reason);

    /// <summary>Throws when <paramref name="candidate"/> is not a safe outbound URL.</summary>
    public static Uri EnsureSafe(string candidate, string parameterName = "url")
    {
        if (!TryValidate(candidate, out var reason))
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"{parameterName} was rejected by the outbound URL guard: {reason}");

        return new Uri(candidate, UriKind.Absolute);
    }

    private static bool TryValidate(string candidate, out string reason)
    {
        reason = string.Empty;

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(candidate))
        {
            reason = "value is empty";
            return false;
        }

        if (!Uri.TryCreate(candidate, UriKind.Absolute, out var uri))
        {
            reason = "value is not an absolute URI";
            return false;
        }

        if (!string.Equals(uri.Scheme, Uri.UriSchemeHttps, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            reason = "only https URLs are allowed";
            return false;
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(uri.UserInfo))
        {
            reason = "embedded credentials are not allowed";
            return false;
        }

        if (uri.Port <= 0)
        {
            reason = "invalid port";
            return false;
        }

        IPAddress[] addresses;
        try
        {
            addresses = Dns.GetHostAddresses(uri.DnsSafeHost);
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is SocketException or ArgumentException or InvalidOperationException)
        {
            reason = "host could not be resolved";
            return false;
        }

        if (addresses.Length == 0)
        {
            reason = "host did not resolve to any address";
            return false;
        }

        foreach (var address in addresses)
        {
            if (IsBlockedAddress(address))
            {
                reason = $"host resolves to a blocked address range ({address})";
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private static bool IsBlockedAddress(IPAddress address)
    {
        if (address.IsIPv4MappedToIPv6) address = address.MapToIPv4();

        if (IPAddress.IsLoopback(address)) return true;

        if (address.AddressFamily == AddressFamily.InterNetwork)
        {
            var octets = address.GetAddressBytes();
            return octets[0] switch
            {
                0 => true,                                  // 0.0.0.0/8
                10 => true,                                 // RFC1918
                100 when (octets[1] & 0xC0) == 64 => true,  // CGNAT 100.64/10
                127 => true,                                // loopback
                169 when octets[1] == 254 => true,          // link-local / cloud metadata
                172 when octets[1] >= 16 && octets[1] <= 31 => true, // RFC1918
                192 when octets[1] == 168 => true,          // RFC1918
                >= 224 => true,                             // multicast, reserved, broadcast
                _ => false
            };
        }

        if (address.AddressFamily == AddressFamily.InterNetworkV6)
        {
            if (address.IsIPv6LinkLocal || address.IsIPv6SiteLocal ||
                address.IsIPv6Multicast || address.IsIPv6UniqueLocal)
                return true;

            return address.Equals(IPAddress.IPv6Loopback) || address.Equals(IPAddress.IPv6Any);
        }

        // Unknown address family: fail closed.
        return true;
    }
}

# AIS MongoDB Documentation

This directory tracks the retention and schemas for the `smart_ais_raw` database.

## Architecture
- **Purpose**: A high-volume, flexible datastore capable of capturing massive provider payloads (e.g. NMEA strings, JSON feeds, XML bursts).
- **Indexing**: Designed for time-series extraction and incident reprocessing.
- **Payload Security**: No raw payloads are executed.

## Security
- Store MongoDB connection strings strictly in Vault (`secret/platform/mongodb/ais`).
- Never expose telemetry databases to the public web directly.

<file path="database/mongodb/telemetry/README.md">
# Telemetry MongoDB Documentation

This directory tracks the retention and schemas for the `smart_telemetry` database.

## Architecture
- **Purpose**: A high-volume, flexible datastore capable of capturing diverse IoT sensors (Odometer, Fuel, Engine, Temperature).
- **Indexing**: Designed for time-series extraction. Ensure indexes are mapped by `tenantId`, `vehicleReference`, and `timestampUtc`.
- **Schema Mapping**: While EF Core structurally maps the strict SQL queryable properties, the firehose of unstructured GPS tracking payloads and IoT metrics land directly here.

## Security
- Store MongoDB connection strings strictly in Vault (`secret/platform/mongodb/telemetry`).
- Never expose telemetry databases to the public web directly.
</file>

# AIS PostgreSQL Documentation

This directory tracks the migrations and EF Core PostgreSQL mappings for the `smart_ais` database.

## Architecture
- **PostGIS Extensions**: Enabled via `modelBuilder.HasPostgresExtension("postgis");`.
- **GiST Indexing**: Natively implemented on spatial properties across Ports, Berths, Anchorage Areas, and Vessel Positions.
- **Optimistic Concurrency**: Enforced on all configuration elements utilizing `byte[] Version` mapped to RowVersion limits.

## Migrations
Run `dotnet ef migrations add InitialAisSchema` manually in an environment that has the .NET SDK installed. The mappings defined in `AisDbContext.cs` natively bind `NetTopologySuite` objects to their PostgreSQL representations.
</file>

# ANPR / Gate / Border Operations PostgreSQL Documentation

This directory encapsulates schema documentation, ERDs, and migration standards for the `smart_anpr` database.

## Critical Security Principle
The primary architectural design rule of this database is:
**ANPR RECOGNITION IS EVIDENCE. ANPR RECOGNITION IS NOT AUTHORIZATION.**

Gates never open directly due to an `AnprRecognitionEvent`. They open exclusively via a `GateAuthorizationDecision`.

## PostGIS Initialization
The database requires `postgis` to be active. `AnprDbContext` initializes this dependency programmatically (`modelBuilder.HasPostgresExtension("postgis");`). 

## Spatial Configurations
- All coordinates must use standard SRID `4326` (WGS 84).
- Point locations utilize `geography` types mapping accurately over Earth's curvature.

## Execution
Run `dotnet ef migrations add InitialAnprSchema` manually from a host containing the .NET 10 SDK, as the target execution environment may not possess full SDK binaries.
</file>

<file path="database/postgresql/audit/README.md">
# Enterprise Audit PostgreSQL Documentation

This directory encapsulates schema documentation, ERDs, and migration standards for the `smart_audit` database.

## Critical Ownership Principle
The Audit Service is the centralized platform audit and security-traceability service. **IT DOES NOT OWN THE BUSINESS DOMAIN.**
There are no User, Role, Declaration, Vehicle, or Payment core records here. The audit ledger exclusively holds serialized snapshots and immutable reference states (`ActorReference`, `ResourceReference`).

## Immutability
All core tables (`AuditEvent`, `AuditChange`, `AuditSecurityEvent`) are strictly append-only. 
The application MUST NOT be granted `UPDATE` or `DELETE` roles over these structures at runtime. Revisions to audits are captured via CORRECTION event insertions.

## Hash Chain
Tamper evidence is calculated continuously. Records insert a SHA-256 `IntegrityHash` derived from canonical event states and chained using `PreviousIntegrityHash`. `AuditIntegrityRecord` chunks these bounds for background validation.

## Execution
Run `dotnet ef migrations add InitialAuditSchema` manually from a host containing the .NET 10 SDK.
</file>

<file path="database/postgresql/customs/README.md">
# Customs Database Schema & Configurations

This directory manages the PostgreSQL schema definitions and migrations for the `smart_customs` database.

## Principles
- **No Hardcoded Tax Rates**: The system relies entirely on `TariffScheduleVersion`, `TariffItem`, and `CustomsRateVersion` to calculate duties. No `.NET` or `SQL` code contains "if VAT == 10%". 
- **No Siloed Data**: Domestic taxes (VAT, GST) are not automatically applied unless explicitly inserted by government configuration into the `CustomsChargeType` mapping.
- **Idempotent Operations**: The use of `IdempotencyRecord` prevents a system error or timeout from mistakenly re-charging an importer or duplicating an assessment line.

## Migration Structure
Entity Framework Migrations belong to `/src/services/Customs/Customs.Infrastructure`. Do not create raw `.sql` upgrade scripts in this folder outside of specialized tuning (like partition tuning for high-volume logs).

## Tenancy
Multi-tenant scoping ensures `TenantId` blocks cross-talk between different port systems or government instances using the platform.

## Backups
Follow the global `database/scripts/backup` standard for continuous WAL archiving and daily snapshotting to S3.
</file>

<file path="database/postgresql/declaration/README.md">
# Smart Platform Declaration Database

This directory contains the database structures, configurations, and definitions specific to the **Cargo & Customs Declaration Microservice** (`smart_declaration`).

## Governance
- **Owner:** Declaration Microservice
- **Direct Access:** Strictly forbidden from external services (e.g. Customs Assessment, Fleet, Payment, ECTN). All interactions must be through approved REST API endpoints or asynchronous Events.

## Schema Highlights
- Relies on `SmartDbContext` for centralized UTC timestamp tracking (`CreatedAtUtc`, `UpdatedAtUtc`) and auditing.
- Robust usage of PostgreSQL `NUMERIC(19,4)` for precise weight and monetary calculations.
- PostgreSQL `JSONB` applied exclusively to telemetry/extensible logging (`DetailsJson`, `ChangeSummaryJson`, `AuditEntry`).

## Versioning & Amendment Policies
- The `CustomsDeclaration` contains the mutable metadata of the transaction (Status, Dates).
- The `DeclarationVersion` acts as the root of the substantive content of the declaration. Once a version is Submitted/Accepted, it is treated as an immutable legal record. 
- Revisions are enforced via `DeclarationAmendment`, which generates a new `DeclarationVersion` rather than overwriting historical evidence.

## Deletion Policy
- `DeleteBehavior.Cascade` is used internally within the core version aggregate (e.g. Version -> Cargo -> Item).
- `DeleteBehavior.Restrict` is strictly enforced from `CustomsDeclaration` to prevent orphaned versions, decisions, submissions, and status histories.
</file>

<file path="database/postgresql/fleet/README.md">
# Fleet Database Schema & Configurations

This directory manages the PostgreSQL schema definitions and migrations for the `smart_fleet` database.

## Principles
- **Authoritative Assets Only**: Fleet creates, owns, and manages Vehicles, Trailers, and Drivers. It explicitly does **not** manage external domains (GPS pings, Customs tariffs, Payments). 
- **Assignment Concurrency**: `VehicleAssignment`, `DriverAssignment`, and `TrailerAssignment` are configured with optimistic concurrency and indexing (`StartAtUtc`, `EndAtUtc`, `Status`) to prevent double-booking physical assets.
- **Dispatch Readiness**: Dispatches are blocked by `FleetHold` active records. A Dispatch transitions to `Ready` only after all its `DispatchRequirement` entities (including external Customs Release flags sent via event) are satisfied.

## Migration Structure
Entity Framework Migrations belong to `/src/services/Fleet/Fleet.Infrastructure`. 
- No raw SQL logic is permitted to bypass EF tracking unless specifically annotated for performance index tuning.

## Backups
Standard backup rotation must apply here. Operations heavily depend on the continuity of driver credentials, active compliance metrics, and dispatch orders.
</file>

# GPS PostgreSQL Documentation
