<file path="frontend/web/src/features/controlTower/hooks/useControlTowerOverview.ts">
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { api } from '../../../api/client';

interface ControlTowerOverview {
  activeTrips: number;
  vehiclesLive: number;
  vehiclesStale: number;
  pendingCustoms: number;
  openAlerts: number;
}

export const useControlTowerOverview = () => {
  return useQuery<ControlTowerOverview>({
    queryKey: ['control-tower', 'overview'],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const response = await api.get('/control-tower/overview');
      return response.data;
    },
    // The query is refreshed when a specific SignalR event arrives (in a separate hook), 
    // but we can also set a slow polling interval as a fallback
    refetchInterval: 30000, 
  });
};

<file path="frontend/web/src/features/dryport/AddContainerModal.tsx">
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import './AddContainerModal.css';

interface AddContainerModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSubmit: (containerData: any) => void;
}

export const AddContainerModal: React.FC<AddContainerModalProps> = ({ isOpen, onClose, onSubmit }) => {
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    containerNumber: '',
    size: '20',
    type: 'Dry',
    demurrageRuleId: 'RULE-001'
  });

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement | HTMLSelectElement>) => {
    const { name, value } = e.target;
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: value }));
  };

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault(); 
    
    onSubmit(formData);
    
    setFormData({ containerNumber: '', size: '20', type: 'Dry', demurrageRuleId: 'RULE-001' });
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={onClose}>
      <div className="modal-content" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div className="modal-header">
          <h2>Diiwaangeli Kunteenar Cusub</h2>
          <button className="close-button" onClick={onClose}>&times;</button>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
          <div className="form-group">
            <label htmlFor="containerNumber">Numbarka Kunteenarka</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              id="containerNumber"
              name="containerNumber"
              className="form-control"
              placeholder="Tusaale: MSCU1234567"
              value={formData.containerNumber}
              onChange={handleChange}
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div className="form-group">
            <label htmlFor="size">Cabbirka (Size)</label>
            <select
              id="size"
              name="size"
              className="form-control"
              value={formData.size}
              onChange={handleChange}
            >
              <option value="20">20 ft (Cag)</option>
              <option value="40">40 ft (Cag)</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="form-group">
            <label htmlFor="type">Nuuca (Type)</label>
            <select
              id="type"
              name="type"
              className="form-control"
              value={formData.type}
              onChange={handleChange}
            >
              <option value="Dry">Dry (Qallalan)</option>
              <option value="Reefer">Reefer (Qaboojiye)</option>
              <option value="Open Top">Open Top</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="modal-actions">
            <button type="button" className="btn-cancel" onClick={onClose}>
              Jooji (Cancel)
            </button>
            <button type="submit" className="btn-submit">
              Kaydi (Save)
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

<file path="frontend/web/src/features/dryport/DryportDashboard.tsx">
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import './DryportDashboard.css';
import { AddContainerModal } from './AddContainerModal';

interface ContainerDemurrage {
  containerId: string;
  containerNumber: string;
  status: string;
  daysInPort: number;
  freeDays: number;
  accruedDemurrage: number;
  currency: string;
}

export const DryportDashboard: React.FC = () => {
  const [containers, setContainers] = useState<ContainerDemurrage[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchDemurrageData = async () => {
      try {
        // Demo Data
        const demoData: ContainerDemurrage[] = [
          { containerId: '1', containerNumber: 'MSCU1234567', status: 'InStorage', daysInPort: 12, freeDays: 7, accruedDemurrage: 250.00, currency: 'USD' },
          { containerId: '2', containerNumber: 'CMAU9876543', status: 'InStorage', daysInPort: 6, freeDays: 7, accruedDemurrage: 0, currency: 'USD' },
          { containerId: '3', containerNumber: 'MAEU4445556', status: 'Arrived', daysInPort: 8, freeDays: 7, accruedDemurrage: 50.00, currency: 'USD' }
        ];
        
        setContainers(demoData);
        setLoading(false);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("Waxaa dhacday cilad:", error);
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    fetchDemurrageData();
  }, []);

  const totalContainers = containers.length;
  const criticalContainers = containers.filter(c => c.accruedDemurrage > 0).length;
  const warningContainers = containers.filter(c => c.daysInPort === c.freeDays || c.daysInPort === c.freeDays - 1).length;
  const totalAccrued = containers.reduce((sum, current) => sum + current.accruedDemurrage, 0);

  const getBadgeClass = (daysInPort: number, freeDays: number) => {
    if (daysInPort > freeDays) return 'badge badge-critical';
    if (daysInPort >= freeDays - 1) return 'badge badge-warning';
    return 'badge badge-safe';
  };

  const getStatusText = (daysInPort: number, freeDays: number) => {
    if (daysInPort > freeDays) return 'Demurrage (Waaseegay)';
    if (daysInPort >= freeDays - 1) return 'Warning (Wuu dhow yahay)';
    return 'Safe (Waqti baa haray)';
  };

  const handleContainerSubmit = (data: any) => {
    console.log("Kunteenar cusub ayaa la diiwaangeliyay:", data);
    // Add logic here to POST to backend
  };

  if (loading) return <div className="dryport-container"><h2>Xogta waa la soo duba-ridayaa... (Loading...)</h2></div>;

  return (
    <div className="dryport-container">
      <div className="dashboard-header">
        <h1 className="dashboard-title">Dryport Demurrage Dashboard</h1>
        <button onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(true)} className="btn-primary" style={{ padding: '0.75rem 1.5rem', background: '#0f172a', color: 'white', border: 'none', borderRadius: '8px', cursor: 'pointer' }}>
          + Diiwaangeli Kunteenar
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="stats-grid">
        <div className="stat-card">
          <div className="stat-title">Kunteenarada Dekedda Ku Jira</div>
          <div className="stat-value">{totalContainers}</div>
        </div>
        <div className="stat-card warning">
          <div className="stat-title">Kunteenarada Digniinta Ku Jira</div>
          <div className="stat-value">{warningContainers}</div>
        </div>
        <div className="stat-card critical">
          <div className="stat-title">Kuwa Galay Demurrage</div>
          <div className="stat-value">{criticalContainers}</div>
        </div>
        <div className="stat-card">
          <div className="stat-title">Lacagta Demurrage ee Uruurtay</div>
          <div className="stat-value" style={{ color: '#ef4444' }}>
            ${totalAccrued.toLocaleString()}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="table-container">
        <table className="modern-table">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Numbarka Kunteenarka</th>
              <th>Xaaladda (Status)</th>
              <th>Maalmaha Dekedda</th>
              <th>Maalmaha Bilaashka</th>
              <th>Lacagta Demurrage</th>
              <th>Heerka Khatarta</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {containers.map((container) => (
              <tr key={container.containerId}>
                <td style={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>{container.containerNumber}</td>
                <td>{container.status}</td>
                <td>{container.daysInPort} Maalmood</td>
                <td>{container.freeDays} Maalmood</td>
                <td style={{ fontWeight: 600, color: container.accruedDemurrage > 0 ? '#ef4444' : '#334155' }}>
                  {container.currency} {container.accruedDemurrage.toLocaleString()}
                </td>
                <td>
                  <span className={getBadgeClass(container.daysInPort, container.freeDays)}>
                    {getStatusText(container.daysInPort, container.freeDays)}
                  </span>
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      <AddContainerModal 
        isOpen={isModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsModalOpen(false)}
        onSubmit={handleContainerSubmit}
      />
    </div>
  );
};
</file>

<file path="frontend/web/src/services/api/apiClient.test.ts">
import axios from 'axios';
import { setAccessToken } from './apiClient';

// ─── Mock axios entirely ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// `create` and `default.create` reference the SAME mock function so both
// `import axios from 'axios'` (esModule interop) and direct `.create` usage
// resolve to the instance that apiClient.ts actually configures.
jest.mock('axios', () => {
  const mockAxiosInstance = {
    interceptors: {
      request: { use: jest.fn() },
      response: { use: jest.fn() },
    },
    post: jest.fn(),
    get: jest.fn(),
    defaults: { headers: { common: {} } },
  };
  const create = jest.fn(() => mockAxiosInstance);
  return { create, default: { create } };
});

// ─── Capture interceptor callbacks ONCE at module load ────────────────────────
// apiClient.ts registers the interceptors when it is imported (above). We grab
// the callbacks here, before any test runs, because jest.clearAllMocks() wipes
// mock.calls/results between tests.
const mockInstance = (axios.create as jest.Mock).mock.results[0].value as {
  interceptors: {
    request: { use: jest.Mock };
    response: { use: jest.Mock };
  };
};

const requestInterceptor = mockInstance.interceptors.request.use.mock.calls[0][0] as (
  config: { headers: Record<string, string> },
) => { headers: Record<string, string> };

const [responseSuccess] = mockInstance.interceptors.response.use.mock.calls[0] as [
  (response: unknown) => unknown,
  (error: unknown) => unknown,
];

// ─── Tests ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
describe('apiClient request interceptor', () => {
  afterEach(() => setAccessToken(null)); // isolate the module-level token

  it('should add an Authorization header when an access token is set', () => {
    setAccessToken('my-token');

    const config = { headers: {} as Record<string, string> };
    const result = requestInterceptor(config);

    expect(result.headers.Authorization ?? config.headers.Authorization).toBe('Bearer my-token');
  });

  it('should NOT add an Authorization header when the token is null', () => {
    setAccessToken(null);

    const config = { headers: {} as Record<string, string> };
    const result = requestInterceptor(config);

    expect(result.headers.Authorization).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('should overwrite a previously set token', () => {
    setAccessToken('first-token');
    setAccessToken('second-token');

    const config = { headers: {} as Record<string, string> };
    const result = requestInterceptor(config);

    expect(result.headers.Authorization).toBe('Bearer second-token');
  });
});

describe('apiClient response interceptor (success path)', () => {
  it('should pass through successful responses unchanged', () => {
    const fakeResponse = { status: 200, data: { ok: true } };
    expect(responseSuccess(fakeResponse)).toBe(fakeResponse);
  });
});

describe('setAccessToken', () => {
  afterEach(() => setAccessToken(null));

  it('should be callable with a string token without throwing', () => {
    expect(() => setAccessToken('some-jwt')).not.toThrow();
  });

  it('should be callable with null without throwing', () => {
    expect(() => setAccessToken(null)).not.toThrow();
  });
});

<file path="frontend/web/src/services/api/apiClient.ts">
import axios from 'axios';

let accessToken: string | null = null;

export const setAccessToken = (token: string | null) => {
  accessToken = token;
};

export const apiClient = axios.create({
  baseURL: import.meta.env.VITE_API_GATEWAY_URL || '/api/v1',
  timeout: 10000,
  withCredentials: true,
});

apiClient.interceptors.request.use((config) => {
  if (accessToken) {
    config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${accessToken}`;
  }
  return config;
});

type RetryableRequest = NonNullable<import('axios').AxiosError['config']> & { _authRetry?: boolean };
let refreshRequest: Promise<string> | null = null;

apiClient.interceptors.response.use((response) => response, async (error: import('axios').AxiosError) => {
  const request = error.config as RetryableRequest | undefined;
  const isAuthEndpoint = request?.url?.includes('/identity/auth/');
  if (error.response?.status !== 401 || !request || request._authRetry || isAuthEndpoint || !accessToken) {
    return Promise.reject(error);
  }

  request._authRetry = true;
  try {
    refreshRequest ??= apiClient.post('/identity/auth/refresh')
      .then(({ data }) => {
        if (typeof data.accessToken !== 'string') throw new Error('Invalid refresh response');
        setAccessToken(data.accessToken);
        return data.accessToken as string;
      })
      .finally(() => { refreshRequest = null; });
    const newToken = await refreshRequest;
    request.headers.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${newToken}`);
    return apiClient(request);
  } catch (refreshError) {
    setAccessToken(null);
    window.location.href = '/login';
    return Promise.reject(refreshError);
  }
});

import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';

import * as AuthContextModule from './app/auth/AuthContext';

  tenantCode: 'TEST',
  permissions: ['control-tower.read'],
  roles: ['admin'],
  tenantType: 'logistics',
};

const mockUseAuth = (override: Partial<ReturnType<typeof AuthContextModule.useAuth>>) => {
  jest.spyOn(AuthContextModule, 'useAuth').mockReturnValue({
    session: null,
    isInitializing: false,
    login: jest.fn(),
    logout: jest.fn(),
    ...override,
  });

// Lazy import App so mocks are registered first
let App: typeof import('./App').default;
beforeAll(async () => {
  App = (await import('./App')).default;
});

describe('App routing', () => {
  afterEach(() => jest.restoreAllMocks());

  // BrowserRouter mutates window.history, which persists between tests in the
  // same file — reset it so each test starts from the root route.
  beforeEach(() => {
    window.history.pushState({}, '', '/');
  });

  it('should render Sign in page at /login', async () => {
    mockUseAuth({ isInitializing: false, session: null });
    render(<App />);
    expect(await screen.findByRole('heading', { name: /sign in/i })).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('should render 403 Forbidden page at /403', async () => {
    mockUseAuth({ isInitializing: false, session: baseSession });
    render(
      <MemoryRouter initialEntries={['/403']}>
        <div>403 Forbidden</div>
      </MemoryRouter>,
    );
    expect(screen.getByText('403 Forbidden')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('should redirect unauthenticated user to /login from protected route', async () => {
    mockUseAuth({ isInitializing: false, session: null });
    render(<App />);
    // App root redirects to /logistics/dashboard → RequireAuth → /login
    expect(await screen.findByRole('heading', { name: /sign in/i })).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('should show loading indicator while session is initializing', async () => {
    mockUseAuth({ isInitializing: true, session: null });
    render(<App />);
    expect(await screen.findByRole('status')).toHaveTextContent('Restoring session…');
  });
});

<file path="frontend/web/src/App.tsx">
import { BrowserRouter, Routes, Route, Navigate, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { FormEvent, useState } from 'react';
import { QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { queryClient } from './api/queryClient';
import { RequireAuth, RequirePermission } from './app/RequireAuth';
import { AuthProvider } from './app/auth/AuthContext';
import { useAuth } from './app/auth/AuthContext';

const Login = () => {
  const { login } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);

  const submit = async (event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setPending(true);
    setError('');
    const form = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/v1/identity/auth/login', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ tenantCode: form.get('tenantCode'), email: form.get('email'), password: form.get('password') }),
      });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Sign in failed');
      const result = await response.json();
      if (typeof result.accessToken !== 'string' || !Array.isArray(result.permissions)) throw new Error('Invalid sign in response');
      login({
        accessToken: result.accessToken,
        tenantCode: String(form.get('tenantCode')),
        permissions: result.permissions,
        roles: Array.isArray(result.roles) ? result.roles : [],
        tenantType: typeof result.tenantType === 'string' ? result.tenantType : '',
      });
      navigate('/', { replace: true });
    } catch {
      setError('Unable to sign in. Check your credentials and try again.');
    } finally {
      setPending(false);
    }
  };

  return <main>
    <h1>Sign in</h1>
    {error && <p role="alert">{error}</p>}
    <form onSubmit={submit}>
      <label>Tenant code<input name="tenantCode" autoComplete="organization" required /></label>
      <label>Email<input name="email" type="email" autoComplete="username" required /></label>
      <label>Password<input name="password" type="password" autoComplete="current-password" required /></label>
      <button type="submit" disabled={pending}>{pending ? 'Signing in…' : 'Sign in'}</button>
    </form>
  </main>;
};
const Forbidden = () => <div>403 Forbidden</div>;
const LogisticsDashboard = () => <div>Logistics Company Dashboard</div>;
const GovernmentDashboard = () => <div>Government Operations Dashboard</div>;
const ControlTower = () => <div>Enterprise Control Tower (Map + Alerts)</div>;

const App = () => {
  return (
    <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
      <AuthProvider>
      <BrowserRouter>
        <Routes>
          <Route path="/login" element={<Login />} />
          <Route path="/403" element={<Forbidden />} />

          {/* Secure Routes */}
          <Route element={<RequireAuth />}>
            
            <Route path="/" element={<Navigate to="/logistics/dashboard" replace />} />
            
            {/* Logistics Portal */}
            <Route path="/logistics">
              <Route path="dashboard" element={<LogisticsDashboard />} />
              {/* Other logistics routes... */}
            </Route>

            {/* Government Portal */}
            <Route path="/government">
              <Route path="dashboard" element={<GovernmentDashboard />} />
              {/* Other gov routes... */}
            </Route>

            {/* Control Tower - Protected by specific permission */}
            <Route element={<RequirePermission permission="control-tower.read" />}>
              <Route path="/control-tower" element={<ControlTower />} />
            </Route>

          </Route>
        </Routes>
      </BrowserRouter>
      </AuthProvider>
    </QueryClientProvider>
  );
};

export default App;
</file>

FROM node:18-alpine AS build
WORKDIR /app

RUN npm install

<file path="infrastructure/argocd/notifications.yaml">
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: argocd-notifications-cm
  namespace: argocd
data:
  service.slack: |
    token: $slack-token
  template.app-deployed: |
    message: |
      :white_check_mark: Application {{.app.metadata.name}} has been successfully synced to {{.app.status.sync.revision}}.
      Health Status: {{.app.status.health.status}}
  template.app-health-degraded: |
    message: |
      :rotating_light: Application {{.app.metadata.name}} health is degraded!
      Reason: {{.app.status.operationState.message}}
  trigger.on-deployed: |
    - description: Application is synced and healthy
      send: [app-deployed]
      when: app.status.operationState != nil and app.status.operationState.phase in ['Succeeded'] and app.status.health.status == 'Healthy'
  trigger.on-health-degraded: |
    - description: Application health degraded
      send: [app-health-degraded]
      when: app.status.health.status == 'Degraded'
  subscriptions: |
    - recipients: [slack:deployments-alerts]
      triggers: [on-deployed, on-health-degraded]
</file>

version: '3.8'

services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: smart-postgres
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-postgres}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-postgres}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-smart_platform}
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - ./init/postgres:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d
    networks:
      - database-network
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U ${POSTGRES_USER:-postgres} -d ${POSTGRES_DB:-smart_platform}"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  postgis:
    image: postgis/postgis:16-3.4-alpine
    container_name: smart-postgis
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGIS_USER:-postgres}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGIS_PASSWORD:-postgres}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGIS_DB:-smart_gis}
    ports:
      - "5433:5432"
    volumes:
      - postgis_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - ./init/postgis:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d
    networks:
      - database-network
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U ${POSTGIS_USER:-postgres} -d ${POSTGIS_DB:-smart_gis}"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  mongodb:
    image: mongo:7.0
    container_name: smart-mongodb
    environment:
      MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_USERNAME: ${MONGO_USER:-root}
      MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${MONGO_PASSWORD:-example}
    ports:
      - "27017:27017"
    volumes:
      - mongodb_data:/data/db
      - ./init/mongo:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d
    networks:
      - database-network
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD","mongosh", "--eval", "db.adminCommand('ping')"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  redis:
    image: redis:7.2-alpine
    container_name: smart-redis
    command: redis-server --requirepass ${REDIS_PASSWORD:-redispassword}
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
    volumes:
      - redis_data:/data
    networks:
      - database-network
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "-a", "${REDIS_PASSWORD:-redispassword}", "ping"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

volumes:
  postgres_data:
  postgis_data:
  mongodb_data:
  redis_data:

    name: database-network

            send_resolved: true
      - name: "pagerduty-critical"
        pagerduty_configs:

<file path="infrastructure/helm/smart-trade-service/templates/_helpers.tpl">
{{/*
Expand the name of the chart.
*/}}
{{- define "smart-trade-service.name" -}}
{{- default .Chart.Name .Values.nameOverride | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- end }}

{{/*
Create a default fully qualified app name.
*/}}
{{- define "smart-trade-service.fullname" -}}
{{- if .Values.fullnameOverride }}
{{- .Values.fullnameOverride | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- else }}
{{- $name := default .Chart.Name .Values.nameOverride }}
{{- if contains $name .Release.Name }}
{{- .Release.Name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- else }}
{{- printf "%s-%s" .Release.Name $name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}
</file>

        {{- end }}
        {{- with .Values.podAnnotations }}
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
        {{- end }}
    spec:
      # ─── Service Account ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

      securityContext:

          type: RuntimeDefault

        - maxSkew: 1
          topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
          whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
          labelSelector:
            matchLabels:
              {{- include "smart-trade-service.selectorLabels" . | nindent 14 }}

      {{- if .Values.initContainers }}

{{/*
Horizontal Pod Autoscaler — scales based on CPU + memory + custom metrics
*/}}

apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: {{ include "smart-trade-service.fullname" . }}
  namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
  labels:
    {{- include "smart-trade-service.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: {{ include "smart-trade-service.fullname" . }}
  minReplicas: {{ .Values.autoscaling.minReplicas }}
  maxReplicas: {{ .Values.autoscaling.maxReplicas }}
  metrics:
    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: cpu
        target:
          type: Utilization
          averageUtilization: {{ .Values.autoscaling.targetCPUUtilizationPercentage | default 70 }}
    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: memory
        target:
          type: Utilization
          averageUtilization: {{ .Values.autoscaling.targetMemoryUtilizationPercentage | default 80 }}
  behavior:
    scaleUp:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 60
      policies:
        - type: Pods
          value: 4
          periodSeconds: 60
        - type: Percent
          value: 100
          periodSeconds: 60
      selectPolicy: Max
    scaleDown:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300   # Wait 5 min before scaling down
      policies:
        - type: Pods
          value: 1
          periodSeconds: 60
      selectPolicy: Min
{{- end }}

<file path="infrastructure/helm/smart-trade-service/templates/networkpolicy.yaml">
{{/*
NetworkPolicy — zero-trust: deny all by default, allow only what's needed
*/}}
{{- if .Values.networkPolicy.enabled }}
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: {{ include "smart-trade-service.fullname" . }}
  namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
  labels:
    {{- include "smart-trade-service.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      {{- include "smart-trade-service.selectorLabels" . | nindent 6 }}
  policyTypes:
    - Ingress
    - Egress

  # ─── INGRESS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ingress:
    # Allow traffic from the API Gateway / Ingress controller namespace
    - from:
        - namespaceSelector:
            matchLabels:
              kubernetes.io/metadata.name: ingress-nginx
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: {{ .Values.containerPort }}

    # Allow traffic from services in the same namespace (inter-service)
    - from:
        - podSelector: {}   # Any pod in same namespace
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: {{ .Values.containerPort }}

    # Allow Prometheus scraping from monitoring namespace
    {{- if .Values.metrics.enabled }}
    - from:
        - namespaceSelector:
            matchLabels:
              kubernetes.io/metadata.name: monitoring
          podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app.kubernetes.io/name: prometheus
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: {{ .Values.metrics.port | default 9090 }}
    {{- end }}

    # Allow Vault agent injection from vault namespace
    {{- if .Values.vault.enabled }}
    - from:
        - namespaceSelector:
            matchLabels:
              kubernetes.io/metadata.name: vault
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 8200
    {{- end }}

  # ─── EGRESS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  egress:
    # Allow DNS resolution (CoreDNS)
    - to:
        - namespaceSelector:
            matchLabels:
              kubernetes.io/metadata.name: kube-system
          podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              k8s-app: kube-dns
      ports:
        - protocol: UDP
          port: 53
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 53

    # Allow access to other services in the same namespace
    - to:
        - podSelector: {}
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: {{ .Values.containerPort }}

    # Allow access to PostgreSQL (RDS via in-cluster or service)
    - to:
        - namespaceSelector:
            matchLabels:
              kubernetes.io/metadata.name: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 5432

    # Allow access to Redis
    - to:
        - namespaceSelector:
            matchLabels:
              kubernetes.io/metadata.name: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 6379

    # Allow access to RabbitMQ
    - to:
        - namespaceSelector:
            matchLabels:
              kubernetes.io/metadata.name: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 5672

    # Allow HTTPS egress (for external APIs, AWS SDK calls)
    - to:
        - ipBlock:
            cidr: 0.0.0.0/0
            except:
              - 169.254.0.0/16   # Block IMDS except via IRSA
              - 10.0.0.0/8
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 443

    # Allow access to Vault
    {{- if .Values.vault.enabled }}
    - to:
        - namespaceSelector:
            matchLabels:
              kubernetes.io/metadata.name: vault
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 8200
    {{- end }}
{{- end }}
</file>

global:
  enabled: true
  tlsDisable: false

server:
  # Enterprise HA Deployment using Raft Consensus Algorithm
  ha:
    enabled: true
    replicas: 3
    raft:
      enabled: true
      setNodeId: true
      config: |
        ui = true
        listener "tcp" {
          tls_disable = 1 # Nolosha dhabta ah kani waa inuu yahay 0 oo TLS la isticmaalo
          address = "[::]:8200"
          cluster_address = "[::]:8201"
        }
        storage "raft" {
          path = "/vault/data"
        }
        disable_mlock = true
  
  # Kordhinta qiyaasta memory-ga ee Node kasta
  resources:
    requests:
      memory: 256Mi
      cpu: 250m
    limits:
      memory: 512Mi
      cpu: 500m

  # Oggolow UI-ga si loo galo browser-ka
  ui:
    enabled: true

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: ais-vessel-api
  namespace: smart-trade-platform
  labels:
    app: ais-vessel-api
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ais-vessel-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ais-vessel-api
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        fsGroup: 2000
      serviceAccountName: ais-vessel-sa
      containers:
        - name: ais-vessel-api
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          image: smarttrade/ais-vessel-api:latest
          imagePullPolicy: Always
          ports:
            - containerPort: 80
          envFrom:
            - secretRef:
                name: ais-vessel-vault-secrets
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "256Mi"
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health/ready
              port: 80
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 10
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health/live
              port: 80
            initialDelaySeconds: 15
            periodSeconds: 20

  name: ais-vessel-api-service

<file path="infrastructure/kubernetes/kyverno-policies.yaml">
apiVersion: kyverno.io/v1
kind: ClusterPolicy
metadata:
  name: disallow-root-and-privileged-containers
  annotations:
    policies.kyverno.io/title: Disallow Root and Privileged Containers
    policies.kyverno.io/category: Pod Security Standards (Restricted)
    policies.kyverno.io/severity: high
    policies.kyverno.io/description: >-
      Containers must run as non-root users, drop all root Linux capabilities,
      and prohibit privilege escalation to enforce Zero-Trust and CIS benchmarks.
spec:
  validationFailureAction: Enforce
  background: true
  rules:
    - name: check-runAsNonRoot
      match:
        any:
          - resources:
              kinds:
                - Pod
              namespaces:
                - dev
                - staging
                - production
      validate:
        message: "Running containers as root is disallowed in enterprise namespaces."
        pattern:
          spec:
            =(securityContext):
              runAsNonRoot: true
            containers:
              - =(securityContext):
                  runAsNonRoot: true
                  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
                  capabilities:
                    drop:
                      - ALL
</file>

<file path="infrastructure/terraform/modules/ecr/main.tf">
variable "environment"             { type = string }
variable "services"                { type = list(string) }
variable "image_tag_mutability"    { type = string default = "IMMUTABLE" }
variable "scan_on_push"            { type = bool default = true }

resource "aws_ecr_repository" "repos" {
  for_each             = toset(var.services)
  name                 = "smart-trade/${each.value}"
  image_tag_mutability = var.image_tag_mutability

  image_scanning_configuration {
    scan_on_push = var.scan_on_push
  }

  encryption_configuration {
    encryption_type = "KMS"
  }

  tags = {
    Environment = var.environment
    Service     = each.value
  }
}

resource "aws_ecr_lifecycle_policy" "repo_policy" {
  for_each   = aws_ecr_repository.repos
  repository = each.value.name

  policy = jsonencode({
    rules = [
      {
        rulePriority = 1
        description  = "Expire untagged images older than 7 days"
        selection = {
          tagStatus   = "untagged"
          countType   = "sinceImagePushed"
          countUnit   = "days"
          countNumber = 7
        }
        action = {
          type = "expire"
        }
      },
      {
        rulePriority = 2
        description  = "Keep last 30 tagged production images"
        selection = {
          tagStatus     = "tagged"
          tagPrefixList = ["sha-", "v"]
          countType     = "imageCount"
          countNumber   = 30
        }
        action = {
          type = "expire"
        }
      }
    ]
  })
}

output "repository_urls" {
  value = { for k, v in aws_ecr_repository.repos : k => v.repository_url }
}
</file>

<file path="infrastructure/terraform/modules/eks/main.tf">
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Reusable EKS Module
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

variable "environment"        { type = string }
variable "cluster_name"       { type = string }
variable "cluster_version"    { type = string  default = "1.30" }
variable "vpc_id"             { type = string }
variable "private_subnet_ids" { type = list(string) }
variable "public_subnet_ids"  { type = list(string) }
variable "node_groups"        { type = any }
variable "enable_cluster_autoscaler"              { type = bool  default = true }
variable "enable_karpenter"                       { type = bool  default = false }
variable "enable_aws_load_balancer_controller"    { type = bool  default = true }
variable "enable_external_dns"                    { type = bool  default = true }
variable "enable_cert_manager"                    { type = bool  default = true }
variable "enable_metrics_server"                  { type = bool  default = true }
variable "enable_aws_ebs_csi_driver"              { type = bool  default = true }
variable "cluster_endpoint_private_access"        { type = bool  default = true }
variable "cluster_endpoint_public_access"         { type = bool  default = false }
variable "enable_irsa"                            { type = bool  default = true }

module "eks" {
  source  = "terraform-aws-modules/eks/aws"
  version = "~> 20.0"

  cluster_name    = var.cluster_name
  cluster_version = var.cluster_version

  vpc_id                   = var.vpc_id
  subnet_ids               = var.private_subnet_ids
  control_plane_subnet_ids = var.public_subnet_ids

  cluster_endpoint_private_access = var.cluster_endpoint_private_access
  cluster_endpoint_public_access  = var.cluster_endpoint_public_access

  # Enable IRSA (IAM Roles for Service Accounts)
  enable_irsa = var.enable_irsa

  # Encryption config — all secrets at rest
  cluster_encryption_config = {
    provider_key_arn = aws_kms_key.eks.arn
    resources        = ["secrets"]
  }

  # EKS Managed Node Groups
  eks_managed_node_groups = var.node_groups

  # Cluster add-ons
  cluster_addons = {
    coredns = {
      addon_version = "v1.11.1-eksbuild.4"
      resolve_conflicts_on_update = "OVERWRITE"
    }
    kube-proxy = {
      addon_version = "v1.30.0-eksbuild.3"
    }
    vpc-cni = {
      addon_version = "v1.18.1-eksbuild.3"
      resolve_conflicts_on_update = "OVERWRITE"
    }
    aws-ebs-csi-driver = {
      addon_version = "v1.31.0-eksbuild.1"
      service_account_role_arn = var.enable_aws_ebs_csi_driver ? aws_iam_role.ebs_csi[0].arn : null
    }
  }

  # Node security group rules
  node_security_group_additional_rules = {
    ingress_allow_access_from_control_plane = {
      type                          = "ingress"
      protocol                      = "tcp"
      from_port                     = 9443
      to_port                       = 9443
      source_cluster_security_group = true
      description                   = "Allow access from control plane to webhook port"
    }
  }

  tags = {
    Environment = var.environment
  }
}

# KMS key for EKS secrets encryption
resource "aws_kms_key" "eks" {
  description             = "EKS secrets encryption — ${var.cluster_name}"
  deletion_window_in_days = 7
  enable_key_rotation     = true

  tags = {
    Name        = "${var.cluster_name}-eks-kms"
    Environment = var.environment
  }
}

resource "aws_kms_alias" "eks" {
  name          = "alias/${var.cluster_name}-eks"
  target_key_id = aws_kms_key.eks.key_id
}

# EBS CSI Driver IAM role
resource "aws_iam_role" "ebs_csi" {
  count = var.enable_aws_ebs_csi_driver ? 1 : 0
  name  = "${var.cluster_name}-ebs-csi-driver"

  assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [{
      Effect = "Allow"
      Principal = {
        Federated = module.eks.oidc_provider_arn
      }
      Action = "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity"
      Condition = {
        StringEquals = {
          "${module.eks.oidc_provider}:aud" = "sts.amazonaws.com"
          "${module.eks.oidc_provider}:sub" = "system:serviceaccount:kube-system:ebs-csi-controller-sa"
        }
      }
    }]
  })
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "ebs_csi" {
  count      = var.enable_aws_ebs_csi_driver ? 1 : 0
  role       = aws_iam_role.ebs_csi[0].name
  policy_arn = "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonEBSCSIDriverPolicy"
}

<file path="infrastructure/terraform/bootstrap-state.sh">
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Bootstrap script: creates S3 bucket + DynamoDB table for Terraform remote state
# Run ONCE manually before first `terraform init`
# Usage: bash bootstrap-state.sh <environment>
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

ENVIRONMENT="${1:-dev}"
AWS_REGION="${AWS_REGION:-us-east-1}"
ACCOUNT_ID=$(aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text)
BUCKET_NAME="smart-trade-tfstate-${ENVIRONMENT}"
TABLE_NAME="smart-trade-tfstate-lock-${ENVIRONMENT}"

echo "🔧 Bootstrapping Terraform state for environment: ${ENVIRONMENT}"
echo "   Account: ${ACCOUNT_ID}"
echo "   Region:  ${AWS_REGION}"
echo "   Bucket:  ${BUCKET_NAME}"
echo "   Table:   ${TABLE_NAME}"

# Create S3 bucket
if ! aws s3api head-bucket --bucket "${BUCKET_NAME}" 2>/dev/null; then
  aws s3api create-bucket \
    --bucket "${BUCKET_NAME}" \
    --region "${AWS_REGION}" \
    $([[ "${AWS_REGION}" != "us-east-1" ]] && echo "--create-bucket-configuration LocationConstraint=${AWS_REGION}" || echo "")

  # Enable versioning
  aws s3api put-bucket-versioning \
    --bucket "${BUCKET_NAME}" \
    --versioning-configuration Status=Enabled

  # Enable server-side encryption (AES-256)
  aws s3api put-bucket-encryption \
    --bucket "${BUCKET_NAME}" \
    --server-side-encryption-configuration '{
      "Rules": [{
        "ApplyServerSideEncryptionByDefault": {
          "SSEAlgorithm": "aws:kms"
        },
        "BucketKeyEnabled": true
      }]
    }'

  # Block all public access
  aws s3api put-public-access-block \
    --bucket "${BUCKET_NAME}" \
    --public-access-block-configuration \
      "BlockPublicAcls=true,IgnorePublicAcls=true,BlockPublicPolicy=true,RestrictPublicBuckets=true"

  # Enable object lock (prevent accidental deletion of state files)
  aws s3api put-bucket-policy \
    --bucket "${BUCKET_NAME}" \
    --policy "{
      \"Version\": \"2012-10-17\",
      \"Statement\": [{
        \"Effect\": \"Deny\",
        \"Principal\": \"*\",
        \"Action\": \"s3:DeleteObject\",
        \"Resource\": \"arn:aws:s3:::${BUCKET_NAME}/*\",
        \"Condition\": {
          \"StringNotEquals\": {
            \"aws:PrincipalArn\": \"arn:aws:iam::${ACCOUNT_ID}:root\"
          }
        }
      }]
    }"

  echo "✅ S3 bucket created: ${BUCKET_NAME}"
else
  echo "ℹ️  S3 bucket already exists: ${BUCKET_NAME}"
fi

# Create DynamoDB table for state locking
if ! aws dynamodb describe-table --table-name "${TABLE_NAME}" 2>/dev/null; then
  aws dynamodb create-table \
    --table-name "${TABLE_NAME}" \
    --attribute-definitions AttributeName=LockID,AttributeType=S \
    --key-schema AttributeName=LockID,KeyType=HASH \
    --billing-mode PAY_PER_REQUEST \
    --region "${AWS_REGION}"

  # Enable point-in-time recovery
  aws dynamodb update-continuous-backups \
    --table-name "${TABLE_NAME}" \
    --point-in-time-recovery-specification PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled=true

  echo "✅ DynamoDB table created: ${TABLE_NAME}"
else
  echo "ℹ️  DynamoDB table already exists: ${TABLE_NAME}"
fi

echo ""
echo "✅ Bootstrap complete. You can now run:"
echo "   terraform init \\"
echo "     -backend-config=\"bucket=${BUCKET_NAME}\" \\"
echo "     -backend-config=\"key=${ENVIRONMENT}/terraform.tfstate\" \\"
echo "     -backend-config=\"region=${AWS_REGION}\" \\"
echo "     -backend-config=\"dynamodb_table=${TABLE_NAME}\" \\"
echo "     -backend-config=\"encrypt=true\""
</file>

<file path="infrastructure/vault/setup-vault.sh">
#!/bin/bash
# Kani waa Script u qaabaysan Enterprise oo lagu rakibayo Policies, 
# Kubernetes Auth (bedelka AppRole ee k8s), iyo Dynamic Database Credentials.

# 1. Samaynta Vault Policies
echo "Abuurista Vault Policies..."
vault policy write customs-api-policy - <<EOF
# Oggolow in la aqriyo siraha rasmiga ah (Static Secrets)
path "secret/data/customs-api/*" {
  capabilities = ["read"]
}
# Oggolow in la aqriyo Dynamic Database Credentials
path "database/creds/customs-db-role" {
  capabilities = ["read"]
}
EOF

# 2. Shidida Kubernetes Auth Method (Waa kan ugu fiican Kubernetes, bedel u ah AppRole)
echo "Shidida Kubernetes Authentication..."
vault auth enable kubernetes

# Isku xirka Vault iyo Kubernetes API-ga
vault write auth/kubernetes/config \
    kubernetes_host="https://\$KUBERNETES_PORT_443_TCP_ADDR:443"

# Abuurista Role-ka u oggolaanaya 'customs-api' Service Account inuu soo qaato sirta
vault write auth/kubernetes/role/customs-api-role \
    bound_service_account_names=customs-api-sa \
    bound_service_account_namespaces=default \
    policies=customs-api-policy \
    ttl=1h

# (Ikhtiyaari) 3. Haddii aad dhab ahaan u baahan tahay AppRole adeegyada dibadda ah (External Services)
echo "Shidida AppRole ee adeegyada ka baxsan Kubernetes..."
vault auth enable approle
vault write auth/approle/role/external-api-role \
    token_policies="customs-api-policy" \
    secret_id_ttl=10m \
    token_ttl=20m

# 4. Habaynta Dynamic Database Credentials (PostgreSQL tusaale ahaan)
echo "Shidida Dynamic Database Secrets Engine..."
vault secrets enable database

# Isku xirka Vault iyo Database-ka
vault write database/config/my-postgresql-database \
    plugin_name=postgresql-database-plugin \
    allowed_roles="customs-db-role" \
    connection_url="postgresql://{{username}}:{{password}}@prod-db.smart-trade.com:5432/postgres" \
    username="admin" \
    password="SuperSecretPassword"

# Abuurista Role u qaabilsan inuu abuuro Dynamic Credentials oo dhacaya (Expire) 1 saac kadib
vault write database/roles/customs-db-role \
    db_name=my-postgresql-database \
    creation_statements="CREATE ROLE \"{{name}}\" WITH LOGIN PASSWORD '{{password}}' VALID UNTIL '{{expiration}}'; GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO \"{{name}}\";" \
    default_ttl="1h" \
    max_ttl="24h"

echo "Hambalyo! Vault Policy, Kubernetes Auth, AppRole, iyo Dynamic Database Credentials si buuxda ayaa loo habeeyay."
</file>

  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: customs-api

      labels:
        app: customs-api
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: customs-api
        image: smart-trade-customs:latest
        imagePullPolicy: Always
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8080
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: customs-api-config

        - name: ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: customs-api-secrets
              key: default-connection
        resources:
          requests:
            memory: "128Mi"
            cpu: "100m"
          limits:
            memory: "256Mi"
            cpu: "250m"
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health/live
            port: 8080
          initialDelaySeconds: 15
          periodSeconds: 10
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health/ready
            port: 8080

          periodSeconds: 10

apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: smart-postgres-logical-backup
  namespace: smart-db
spec:
  # Schedule: Run daily at 02:00 AM UTC
  schedule: "0 2 * * *"
  successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 3
  failedJobsHistoryLimit: 3
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        spec:
          serviceAccountName: backup-operator
          containers:
          - name: postgres-backup
            image: postgres:15-alpine
            command:
            - /bin/sh
            - -c
            - /scripts/backup_postgres.sh
            env:
            # Vault injector would typically populate these from annotations
            - name: PGHOST
              value: "smart-postgres-primary.smart-db.svc.cluster.local"
            - name: PGUSER
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: postgres-backup-credentials
                  key: username
            - name: PGPASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: postgres-backup-credentials
                  key: password
            - name: S3_BUCKET
              value: "smart-trade-backups-bucket"
            - name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: s3-backup-credentials
                  key: access_key
            - name: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: s3-backup-credentials
                  key: secret_key
            volumeMounts:
            - name: backup-scripts
              mountPath: /scripts
            - name: backup-storage
              mountPath: /backups
          volumes:
          - name: backup-scripts
            configMap:
              name: postgres-backup-scripts
              defaultMode: 0777
          - name: backup-storage
            emptyDir: {}
          restartPolicy: OnFailure

<file path="k8s/database/security/db-network-policy.yaml">
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: restrict-postgres-access
  namespace: smart-db
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: postgres-cluster
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  ingress:
  # Allow connections ONLY from authorized service pods in the prod namespace
  - from:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          name: smart-trade-prod
      podSelector:
        matchExpressions:
          - key: app
            operator: In
            values:
              - identity-api
              - payment-api
              - customs-api
              - fleet-api
              - ectn-api
              - declaration-api
              - gps-api
              - anpr-api
              - corridor-api
              - integration-api
              - audit-api
              - notification-api
              - analytics-api
    # Restrict to port 5432
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 5432
  # Allow connections from the backup cronjob inside the same namespace
  - from:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: postgres-backup
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 5432

  override func application(
    _ application: UIApplication,

    GeneratedPluginRegistrant.register(with: engineBridge.pluginRegistry)

<file path="mobile/driver/lib/api/api_client.dart">
// lib/api/api_client.dart
import 'package:dio/dio.dart';
import 'package:dio_cookie_manager/dio_cookie_manager.dart';
import 'package:cookie_jar/cookie_jar.dart';
import 'package:flutter_secure_storage/flutter_secure_storage.dart';

class ApiClient {
  final Dio _dio;
  final FlutterSecureStorage _secureStorage;

  ApiClient({required String baseUrl})
      : _dio = Dio(BaseOptions(baseUrl: baseUrl, connectTimeout: const Duration(seconds: 15), receiveTimeout: const Duration(seconds: 15))),
        _secureStorage = const FlutterSecureStorage() {
    // Persist cookies (e.g., HttpOnly refresh token)
    final cookieJar = PersistCookieJar();
    _dio.interceptors.add(CookieManager(cookieJar));

    // Inject JWT access token into each request
    _dio.interceptors.add(InterceptorsWrapper(onRequest: (options, handler) async {
      final token = await _secureStorage.read(key: 'access_token');
      if (token != null && token.isNotEmpty) {
        options.headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer $token';
      }
      return handler.next(options);
    }));
  }

  Dio get client => _dio;

  // Refresh token endpoint – backend should set new access token in the response body
  Future<bool> refreshToken() async {
    try {
      final response = await _dio.get('/api/auth/refresh');
      if (response.statusCode == 200) {
        final newToken = response.data['accessToken'] as String?;
        if (newToken != null) {
          await _secureStorage.write(key: 'access_token', value: newToken);
          return true;
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    return false;
  }
}
</file>

<file path="mobile/driver/lib/core/networking/api_client.dart">
import 'package:dio/dio.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter_secure_storage/flutter_secure_storage.dart';
import 'package:uuid/uuid.dart';

class ApiClient {
  final Dio _dio;
  final FlutterSecureStorage _secureStorage;
  static const String _tokenKey = 'access_token';
  static const String _refreshTokenKey = 'refresh_token';

  ApiClient({required String baseUrl, required FlutterSecureStorage secureStorage})
      : _secureStorage = secureStorage,
        _dio = Dio(BaseOptions(
          baseUrl: baseUrl,
          connectTimeout: const Duration(seconds: 15),
          receiveTimeout: const Duration(seconds: 15),
        )) {
    _dio.interceptors.add(_createAuthInterceptor());
    _dio.interceptors.add(_createRetryInterceptor());
  }

  /// The configured [Dio] instance, exposed for tests so they can attach a
  /// mock [HttpClientAdapter] (http_mock_adapter) and observe the real
  /// interceptor pipeline without a live backend.
  @visibleForTesting
  Dio get dio => _dio;

  Interceptor _createAuthInterceptor() {
    return InterceptorsWrapper(
      onRequest: (options, handler) async {
        final token = await _secureStorage.read(key: _tokenKey);
        if (token != null) {
          options.headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer $token';
        }
        
        // Inject Idempotency-Key for POST/PUT requests
        if (options.method == 'POST' || options.method == 'PUT') {
          options.headers['Idempotency-Key'] = const Uuid().v4();
        }
        
        // Inject CorrelationId
        options.headers['X-Correlation-ID'] = const Uuid().v4();
        
        return handler.next(options);
      },
      onError: (DioException e, handler) async {
        if (e.response?.statusCode == 401) {
          // Attempt token refresh logic here
          // If refresh fails, clear session and throw specific AuthException
          await _secureStorage.delete(key: _tokenKey);
          await _secureStorage.delete(key: _refreshTokenKey);
          // throw AuthException('Session expired');
        }
        return handler.next(e);
      },
    );
  }

  Interceptor _createRetryInterceptor() {
    return InterceptorsWrapper(
      onError: (DioException e, handler) {
        // Implement exponential backoff for 5xx and 429
        if (e.response?.statusCode == 429 || (e.response?.statusCode ?? 0) >= 500) {
           // Queue for retry logic
        }
        return handler.next(e);
      }
    );
  }
}
</file>

<file path="mobile/driver/lib/core/synchronization/offline_queue.dart">
import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:uuid/uuid.dart';

enum OfflineEventStatus { Pending, Sending, Succeeded, Failed, DeadLetter }

class OfflineEvent {
  final String localId;
  final String eventType;
  final String aggregateType;
  final String aggregateId;
  final DateTime createdAtUtc;
  final Map<String, dynamic> payload;
  int retryCount;
  OfflineEventStatus status;
  String? errorCode;

  OfflineEvent({
    required this.eventType,
    required this.aggregateType,
    required this.aggregateId,
    required this.payload,
  })  : localId = const Uuid().v4(),
        createdAtUtc = DateTime.now().toUtc(),
        retryCount = 0,
        status = OfflineEventStatus.Pending;
}

abstract class IOfflineQueueRepository {
  Future<void> enqueue(OfflineEvent event);
  Future<List<OfflineEvent>> getPendingEvents();
  Future<void> updateEventStatus(String localId, OfflineEventStatus status);
  Future<void> incrementRetry(String localId);
}

class OfflineSyncEngine {
  final IOfflineQueueRepository _repository;
  // final ApiClient _apiClient;

  OfflineSyncEngine(this._repository);

  Future<void> syncPendingEvents() async {
    final pending = await _repository.getPendingEvents();
    for (var event in pending) {
      try {
        await _repository.updateEventStatus(event.localId, OfflineEventStatus.Sending);
        // Simulate API call using ApiClient
        // await _apiClient.post('/api/sync', data: event.payload);
        await _repository.updateEventStatus(event.localId, OfflineEventStatus.Succeeded);
      } catch (e) {
        // Handle permanent vs transient errors
        await _repository.incrementRetry(event.localId);
        // If max retries, move to DeadLetter
      }
    }
  }
}
</file>

        // state is not lost during the reload. To reset the state, use hot
        // restart instead.
        //
        // This works for code too, not just values: Most code changes can be
        // tested with just a hot reload.
        colorScheme: .fromSeed(seedColor: Colors.deepPurple),
      ),
      home: const MyHomePage(title: 'Flutter Demo Home Page'),
    );
  }
}

class MyHomePage extends StatefulWidget {
  const MyHomePage({super.key, required this.title});

  // This widget is the home page of your application. It is stateful, meaning
  // that it has a State object (defined below) that contains fields that affect
  // how it looks.

  // This class is the configuration for the state. It holds the values (in this
  // case the title) provided by the parent (in this case the App widget) and
  // used by the build method of the State. Fields in a Widget subclass are
  // always marked "final".

  final String title;

  @override
  State<MyHomePage> createState() => _MyHomePageState();
}

class _MyHomePageState extends State<MyHomePage> {
  int _counter = 0;

  void _incrementCounter() {
    setState(() {
      // This call to setState tells the Flutter framework that something has
      // changed in this State, which causes it to rerun the build method below
      // so that the display can reflect the updated values. If we changed
      // _counter without calling setState(), then the build method would not be
      // called again, and so nothing would appear to happen.
      _counter++;
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    // This method is rerun every time setState is called, for instance as done
    // by the _incrementCounter method above.
    //
    // The Flutter framework has been optimized to make rerunning build methods
    // fast, so that you can just rebuild anything that needs updating rather
    // than having to individually change instances of widgets.
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        // TRY THIS: Try changing the color here to a specific color (to
        // Colors.amber, perhaps?) and trigger a hot reload to see the AppBar
        // change color while the other colors stay the same.
        backgroundColor: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.inversePrimary,
        // Here we take the value from the MyHomePage object that was created by
        // the App.build method, and use it to set our appbar title.
        title: Text(widget.title),
      ),
      body: Center(
        // Center is a layout widget. It takes a single child and positions it
        // in the middle of the parent.
        child: Column(
          // Column is also a layout widget. It takes a list of children and
          // arranges them vertically. By default, it sizes itself to fit its
          // children horizontally, and tries to be as tall as its parent.
          //
          // Column has various properties to control how it sizes itself and
          // how it positions its children. Here we use mainAxisAlignment to
          // center the children vertically; the main axis here is the vertical
          // axis because Columns are vertical (the cross axis would be
          // horizontal).
          //
          // TRY THIS: Invoke "debug painting" (choose the "Toggle Debug Paint"
          // action in the IDE, or press "p" in the console), to see the
          // wireframe for each widget.
          mainAxisAlignment: .center,
          children: [
            const Text('You have pushed the button this many times:'),
            Text(
              '$_counter',
              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineMedium,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
      floatingActionButton: FloatingActionButton(
        onPressed: _incrementCounter,
        tooltip: 'Increment',
        child: const Icon(Icons.add),
      ),
    );
  }
}

<file path="mobile/driver/test/core/networking/api_client_test.dart">
/// Unit tests for the [ApiClient] interceptor pipeline.
///
/// Requests are served by `http_mock_adapter`, so the real interceptors
/// (bearer auth, idempotency/correlation ids, 401 session cleanup, 5xx
/// pass-through) run against a mock adapter instead of a live backend.
library;

import 'package:dio/dio.dart';
import 'package:flutter_secure_storage/flutter_secure_storage.dart';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:http_mock_adapter/http_mock_adapter.dart';
import 'package:smart_trade_driver/core/networking/api_client.dart';

/// Canonical RFC-4122 v4 UUID, as produced by `package:uuid`.
final RegExp _uuidV4 = RegExp(
  r'^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$',
  caseSensitive: false,
);

/// In-memory [FlutterSecureStorage] so tests never reach the platform
/// keychain, and so token deletions can be asserted directly.
class _FakeSecureStorage extends FlutterSecureStorage {
  final Map<String, String> store = {};
  final List<String> deletedKeys = [];

  @override
  Future<String?> read({
    required String key,
    IOSOptions? iOptions,
    AndroidOptions? aOptions,
    LinuxOptions? lOptions,
    WebOptions? webOptions,
    MacOsOptions? mOptions,
    WindowsOptions? wOptions,
  }) async =>
      store[key];

  @override
  Future<void> delete({
    required String key,
    IOSOptions? iOptions,
    AndroidOptions? aOptions,
    LinuxOptions? lOptions,
    WebOptions? webOptions,
    MacOsOptions? mOptions,
    WindowsOptions? wOptions,
  }) async {
    deletedKeys.add(key);
    store.remove(key);
  }
}

/// Case-insensitive header lookup — Dio keeps the casing given by the
/// interceptor but adapters may normalise it, so never rely on it.
String? _header(Map<String, dynamic> headers, String name) {
  for (final entry in headers.entries) {
    if (entry.key.toLowerCase() == name.toLowerCase()) {
      return entry.value?.toString();
    }
  }
  return null;
}

void main() {
  const baseUrl = 'https://api.smarttrade.test';

  late _FakeSecureStorage storage;
  late ApiClient client;
  late DioAdapter adapter;

  /// Options of the last request that reached the (mock) adapter.
  RequestOptions? lastRequest;

  setUp(() {
    storage = _FakeSecureStorage();
    client = ApiClient(baseUrl: baseUrl, secureStorage: storage);
    adapter = DioAdapter(dio: client.dio);
    lastRequest = null;
  });

  /// Registers a GET [route] and records the request seen by the adapter.
  void mockGet(String route, {int statusCode = 200, Object? body}) {
    adapter.onGet(
      route,
      (server) => server.replyCallback(statusCode, (options) {
        lastRequest = options;
        return body ?? <String, dynamic>{};
      }),
    );
  }

  /// Registers a POST [route] (any body) and records the request seen.
  void mockPost(String route, {int statusCode = 201}) {
    adapter.onPost(
      route,
      (server) => server.replyCallback(statusCode, (options) {
        lastRequest = options;
        return <String, dynamic>{'ok': true};
      }),
      data: Matchers.any,
    );
  }

  group('request headers', () {
    test('adds "Authorization: Bearer" when an access token is stored',
        () async {
      storage.store['access_token'] = 'token-abc';
      mockGet('/api/jobs');

      final response = await client.dio.get<Map<String, dynamic>>('/api/jobs');

      expect(response.statusCode, 200);
      expect(_header(lastRequest!.headers, 'Authorization'), 'Bearer token-abc');
    });

    test('omits "Authorization" when no access token is stored', () async {
      mockGet('/api/jobs');

      await client.dio.get<Map<String, dynamic>>('/api/jobs');

      expect(_header(lastRequest!.headers, 'Authorization'), isNull);
    });

    test('adds a valid UUIDv4 "X-Correlation-ID" to every request', () async {
      mockGet('/api/jobs');

      await client.dio.get<Map<String, dynamic>>('/api/jobs');

      final correlationId = _header(lastRequest!.headers, 'X-Correlation-ID');
      expect(correlationId, isNotNull);
      expect(correlationId, matches(_uuidV4));
    });

    test('generates a fresh correlation id per request', () async {
      mockGet('/api/jobs');
      final seen = <String?>[];

      await client.dio.get<Map<String, dynamic>>('/api/jobs');
      seen.add(_header(lastRequest!.headers, 'X-Correlation-ID'));
      await client.dio.get<Map<String, dynamic>>('/api/jobs');
      seen.add(_header(lastRequest!.headers, 'X-Correlation-ID'));

      expect(seen[0], isNot(equals(seen[1])));
    });

    test('adds an "Idempotency-Key" (UUIDv4) to POST but not to GET',
        () async {
      mockPost('/api/sync');
      mockGet('/api/jobs');

      await client.dio.get<Map<String, dynamic>>('/api/jobs');
      expect(_header(lastRequest!.headers, 'Idempotency-Key'), isNull);

      await client.dio.post<Map<String, dynamic>>(
        '/api/sync',
        data: {'deliveryId': 'd-1'},
      );
      final idempotencyKey = _header(lastRequest!.headers, 'Idempotency-Key');
      expect(idempotencyKey, matches(_uuidV4));
    });

    test('POST carries both correlation and idempotency ids', () async {
      mockPost('/api/sync');

      await client.dio.post<Map<String, dynamic>>(
        '/api/sync',
        data: {'deliveryId': 'd-1'},
      );

      expect(
        _header(lastRequest!.headers, 'X-Correlation-ID'),
        matches(_uuidV4),
      );
      expect(
        _header(lastRequest!.headers, 'Idempotency-Key'),
        matches(_uuidV4),
      );
    });
  });

  group('request target', () {
    test('resolves the route against the configured base url', () async {
      mockGet('/api/jobs');

      await client.dio.get<Map<String, dynamic>>('/api/jobs');

      expect(lastRequest!.uri.toString(), '$baseUrl/api/jobs');
    });
  });

  group('401 handling', () {
    test('clears access and refresh tokens and surfaces a DioException',
        () async {
      storage.store['access_token'] = 'stale-token';
      storage.store['refresh_token'] = 'stale-refresh';
      adapter.onGet('/api/secure', (server) {
        server.reply(401, {'error': 'expired'});
      });

      await expectLater(
        client.dio.get<Map<String, dynamic>>('/api/secure'),
        throwsA(isA<DioException>()),
      );

      expect(
        storage.deletedKeys,
        containsAll(<String>['access_token', 'refresh_token']),
      );
      expect(storage.store, isEmpty);
    });

    test('leaves stored tokens untouched when the request succeeds', () async {
      storage.store['access_token'] = 'fresh-token';
      storage.store['refresh_token'] = 'fresh-refresh';
      mockGet('/api/jobs');

      await client.dio.get<Map<String, dynamic>>('/api/jobs');

      expect(storage.deletedKeys, isEmpty);
      expect(storage.store['access_token'], 'fresh-token');
    });
  });

  group('5xx handling', () {
    test('propagates 500 to the caller without wiping the session', () async {
      storage.store['access_token'] = 'keep-me';
      adapter.onGet('/api/reports', (server) {
        server.reply(500, {'error': 'boom'});
      });

      await expectLater(
        client.dio.get<Map<String, dynamic>>('/api/reports'),
        throwsA(
          isA<DioException>().having(
            (e) => e.response?.statusCode,
            'response.statusCode',
            500,
          ),
        ),
      );

      // The retry interceptor must not swallow the error, and a server
      // fault is not an auth failure — the session survives.
      expect(storage.deletedKeys, isEmpty);
      expect(storage.store['access_token'], 'keep-me');
    });
  });
}

<file path="mobile/driver/test/core/synchronization/offline_queue_test.dart">
/// Unit tests for the offline synchronization engine.
///
/// The repository is replaced by an in-memory fake so each event's
/// status transitions can be asserted without storage or a backend.
library;

import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:smart_trade_driver/core/synchronization/offline_queue.dart';

/// In-memory [IOfflineQueueRepository] that records every mutation and can
/// be told to fail the "Succeeded" transition for specific events, which is
/// how a rejected API call surfaces in [OfflineSyncEngine.syncPendingEvents].
class _InMemoryQueueRepository implements IOfflineQueueRepository {
  _InMemoryQueueRepository([List<OfflineEvent>? seed])
      : events = List.of(seed ?? const <OfflineEvent>[]);

  final List<OfflineEvent> events;

  /// `'localId:Status.name'` entries in the order they were applied.
  final List<String> transitions = [];

  /// localIds whose "Succeeded" update should throw, as if the API failed.
  final Set<String> failSucceededFor = {};

  @override
  Future<void> enqueue(OfflineEvent event) async => events.add(event);

  @override
  Future<List<OfflineEvent>> getPendingEvents() async =>
      events.where((e) => e.status == OfflineEventStatus.Pending).toList();

  @override
  Future<void> updateEventStatus(
    String localId,
    OfflineEventStatus status,
  ) async {
    if (status == OfflineEventStatus.Succeeded &&
        failSucceededFor.contains(localId)) {
      throw StateError('simulated API rejection for $localId');
    }
    _find(localId).status = status;
    transitions.add('$localId:${status.name}');
  }

  @override
  Future<void> incrementRetry(String localId) async {
    _find(localId).retryCount += 1;
  }

  OfflineEvent _find(String localId) =>
      events.firstWhere((e) => e.localId == localId);
}

OfflineEvent _event({String eventType = 'delivery.picked_up'}) =>
    OfflineEvent(
      eventType: eventType,
      aggregateType: 'Delivery',
      aggregateId: 'delivery-1',
      payload: {'at': '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'},
    );

void main() {
  group('OfflineEvent', () {
    test('starts Pending with zero retries and a UTC timestamp', () {
      final event = _event();

      expect(event.status, OfflineEventStatus.Pending);
      expect(event.retryCount, 0);
      expect(event.errorCode, isNull);
      expect(event.createdAtUtc.isUtc, isTrue);
      expect(event.payload['at'], '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z');
      expect(event.eventType, 'delivery.picked_up');
      expect(event.aggregateType, 'Delivery');
      expect(event.aggregateId, 'delivery-1');
    });

    test('assigns every event a unique local id', () {
      final ids = <String>{for (var i = 0; i < 25; i++) _event().localId};

      expect(ids.length, 25);
      expect(ids.every((id) => id.isNotEmpty), isTrue);
    });
  });

  group('OfflineSyncEngine.syncPendingEvents', () {
    test('marks each pending event Sending then Succeeded', () async {
      final first = _event();
      final second = _event(eventType: 'delivery.delivered');
      final repo = _InMemoryQueueRepository([first, second]);

      await OfflineSyncEngine(repo).syncPendingEvents();

      expect(first.status, OfflineEventStatus.Succeeded);
      expect(second.status, OfflineEventStatus.Succeeded);
      expect(first.retryCount, 0);
      expect(second.retryCount, 0);
      expect(repo.transitions, <String>[
        '${first.localId}:Sending',
        '${first.localId}:Succeeded',
        '${second.localId}:Sending',
        '${second.localId}:Succeeded',
      ]);
    });

    test('increments the retry count for a failing event and keeps going',
        () async {
      final failing = _event();
      final healthy = _event(eventType: 'delivery.delivered');
      final repo = _InMemoryQueueRepository([failing, healthy]);
      repo.failSucceededFor.add(failing.localId);

      await OfflineSyncEngine(repo).syncPendingEvents();

      // The failed event never reaches Succeeded and gets one retry logged…
      expect(failing.retryCount, 1);
      expect(failing.status, OfflineEventStatus.Sending);
      // …while the engine still processes the remaining events.
      expect(healthy.status, OfflineEventStatus.Succeeded);
      expect(healthy.retryCount, 0);
    });

    test('does nothing when the queue is empty', () async {
      final repo = _InMemoryQueueRepository();

      await OfflineSyncEngine(repo).syncPendingEvents();

      expect(repo.transitions, isEmpty);
      expect(repo.events, isEmpty);
    });

    test('skips events that are not Pending', () async {
      final alreadySucceeded = _event()
        ..status = OfflineEventStatus.Succeeded;
      final pending = _event(eventType: 'delivery.delivered');
      final repo = _InMemoryQueueRepository([alreadySucceeded, pending]);

      await OfflineSyncEngine(repo).syncPendingEvents();

      expect(repo.transitions, <String>[
        '${pending.localId}:Sending',
        '${pending.localId}:Succeeded',
      ]);
      // The already-completed event was never touched.
      expect(alreadySucceeded.status, OfflineEventStatus.Succeeded);
      expect(alreadySucceeded.retryCount, 0);
    });

    test('documents current behaviour: a failed event stays in Sending '
        'and is not re-picked by the next pass', () async {
      final failing = _event();
      final repo = _InMemoryQueueRepository([failing]);
      repo.failSucceededFor.add(failing.localId);

      final engine = OfflineSyncEngine(repo);
      await engine.syncPendingEvents();
      await engine.syncPendingEvents();

      // Second pass: only Pending events are fetched, and the failed one
      // is stuck in Sending, so it is neither retried nor transitioned.
      expect(failing.retryCount, 1);
      expect(failing.status, OfflineEventStatus.Sending);
      expect(repo.transitions, <String>['${failing.localId}:Sending']);
    });
  });
}

// This is a basic Flutter widget test.
//
// To perform an interaction with a widget in your test, use the WidgetTester
// utility in the flutter_test package. For example, you can send tap and scroll
// gestures. You can also use WidgetTester to find child widgets in the widget
// tree, read text, and verify that the values of widget properties are correct.

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';

import 'package:smart_trade_driver/main.dart';

void main() {
  testWidgets('Counter increments smoke test', (WidgetTester tester) async {
    // Build our app and trigger a frame.
    await tester.pumpWidget(const MyApp());

    // Verify that our counter starts at 0.
    expect(find.text('0'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.text('1'), findsNothing);

    // Tap the '+' icon and trigger a frame.
    await tester.tap(find.byIcon(Icons.add));
    await tester.pump();

    // Verify that our counter has incremented.
    expect(find.text('0'), findsNothing);
    expect(find.text('1'), findsOneWidget);
  });

<file path="scripts/database/backup_postgres.sh">
#!/bin/bash
set -eo pipefail

echo "Starting logical backup of all databases..."
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
BACKUP_DIR="/backups"
DB_LIST="smart_identity smart_ectn smart_declaration smart_customs smart_payment smart_fleet smart_gps smart_corridor smart_anpr smart_integration smart_notification smart_audit smart_analytics"

# Requires aws-cli to be installed in the pod/container running this
for DB in $DB_LIST; do
  echo "Backing up $DB..."
  DUMP_FILE="${BACKUP_DIR}/${DB}_${TIMESTAMP}.sql.gz"
  
  # Perform logical backup
  pg_dump -h $PGHOST -U $PGUSER -d $DB | gzip > $DUMP_FILE
  
  # Generate checksum
  CHECKSUM=$(sha256sum $DUMP_FILE | awk '{print $1}')
  echo "$CHECKSUM" > "${DUMP_FILE}.sha256"
  
  # Upload to S3
  echo "Uploading $DB backup to S3..."
  aws s3 cp $DUMP_FILE s3://${S3_BUCKET}/postgres/${DB}/${TIMESTAMP}/
  aws s3 cp "${DUMP_FILE}.sha256" s3://${S3_BUCKET}/postgres/${DB}/${TIMESTAMP}/
  
  echo "Completed backup for $DB (Checksum: $CHECKSUM)"
done

echo "All logical backups completed successfully."

<file path="services/ais-vessel/AisVessel.Api/Controllers/BerthAllocationsController.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using MediatR;
using AisVessel.Application.Commands;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;

namespace AisVessel.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/ais/berth-allocations")]
[Authorize]
public class BerthAllocationsController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;

    public BerthAllocationsController(IMediator mediator)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
    }

    [HttpPost]
    [Authorize(Policy = "ais.berth.allocate")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> AllocateBerth([FromBody] AllocateBerthCommand command)
    {
        if (!Guid.TryParse(User.FindFirst("tenant_id")?.Value, out var tenantId)) return Forbid();
        command.TenantId = tenantId;

        var portCallId = await _mediator.Send(command);
        return Ok(new { PortCallId = portCallId, Status = "BerthAllocated" });
    }
}

using AisVessel.Application.Commands;
using AisVessel.Application.Interfaces;
using AisVessel.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using AisVessel.Infrastructure.Repositories;
using BuildingBlocks.Web;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

builder.Services.AddControllers();
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
builder.Services.AddSwaggerGen();

builder.Services.AddPlatformJwtAuthentication(builder.Configuration);

// Platform-wide security defaults: deny-by-default fallback policy (A01), rate limiting (A07),
// config-driven CORS, ProblemDetails exception handling and security headers (A05/A09).
builder.Services.AddPlatformSecurity(builder.Configuration);

builder.Services.AddAuthorization(options =>
{
    options.AddPolicy("ais.berth.allocate", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "ais.berth.allocate"));
});

var connectionString = builder.Configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection");
if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionString))
    throw new InvalidOperationException("ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection is required.");

builder.Services.AddMediatR(cfg => cfg.RegisterServicesFromAssembly(typeof(AllocateBerthCommand).Assembly));

builder.Services.AddDbContext<AisDbContext>(options => options.UseNpgsql(connectionString));

builder.Services.AddScoped<IBerthAllocationRepository, BerthAllocationRepository>();

var app = builder.Build();

app.UsePlatformSecurity();
if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
{
    app.UseSwagger();
    app.UseSwaggerUI();
}
app.UseHttpsRedirection();
app.UseRouting();
app.UsePlatformCors();
app.UseRateLimiter();
app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseAuthorization();
app.MapControllers();

app.MapGet("/health/live", () => "Alive").AllowAnonymous();
app.MapGet("/health/ready", async (AisDbContext db, CancellationToken ct) =>
{
    try
    {
        if (await db.Database.CanConnectAsync(ct)) return (IResult)Results.Ok(new { status = "ready" });
        return Results.Problem(statusCode: StatusCodes.Status503ServiceUnavailable, title: "Database unavailable");
    }
    catch
    {
        return Results.Problem(statusCode: StatusCodes.Status503ServiceUnavailable, title: "Database unavailable");
    }
}).AllowAnonymous();

app.Run();
