<file path="services/ais-vessel/AisVessel.Application/Commands/AllocateBerthCommand.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using MediatR;
using AisVessel.Application.Interfaces;
using AisVessel.Domain.Enums;

namespace AisVessel.Application.Commands;

public class AllocateBerthCommand : IRequest<Guid>
{
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public Guid PortCallId { get; set; }
    public Guid BerthId { get; set; }
}

public class AllocateBerthCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<AllocateBerthCommand, Guid>
{
    private readonly IBerthAllocationRepository _repository;

    public AllocateBerthCommandHandler(IBerthAllocationRepository repository)
    {
        _repository = repository;
    }

    public async Task<Guid> Handle(AllocateBerthCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var portCall = await _repository.GetPortCallAsync(request.PortCallId, request.TenantId, cancellationToken);

        if (portCall == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("PortCall not found.");

        var berth = await _repository.GetBerthAsync(request.BerthId, request.TenantId, cancellationToken);

        if (berth == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("Berth not found.");

        if (portCall.Status != nameof(PortCallStatus.AwaitingBerth))
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("PortCall must be AwaitingBerth to allocate a berth.");
        }

        portCall.AdvanceState(PortCallStatus.BerthAllocated);

        // Example: in full implementation, we'd add the BerthAllocation entity here,
        // evaluate the IBerthAllocationService rules to ensure Length/Draft match,
        // and raise a BerthAllocatedIntegrationEvent via Outbox.

        await _repository.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

        return portCall.Id;
    }
}
</file>

using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using AisVessel.Domain.Entities;

namespace AisVessel.Application.Interfaces;

/// <summary>
/// Read/write access for the berth allocation workflow. Implemented in
/// Infrastructure so the Application layer never depends on Entity Framework
/// or a concrete DbContext.
/// </summary>
public interface IBerthAllocationRepository
{
    Task<PortCall?> GetPortCallAsync(Guid portCallId, Guid tenantId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    Task<Berth?> GetBerthAsync(Guid berthId, Guid tenantId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    Task SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
}

    public DateTime? ActualBerthAtUtc { get; set; }

    public DateTime? EstimatedDepartureAtUtc { get; set; }

    public Port Port { get; set; } = null!;
    public Vessel Vessel { get; set; } = null!;
    public Voyage? Voyage { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Moves the port call to the given lifecycle state. The status is stored as
    /// the enum name so it matches the values already persisted as strings.
    /// </summary>
    public void AdvanceState(PortCallStatus status)
    {
        Status = status.ToString();
        UpdatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

<file path="services/ais-vessel/AisVessel.Domain/Entities/PortZone.cs">
using System;
using NetTopologySuite.Geometries;
using AisVessel.Domain.Enums;

namespace AisVessel.Domain.Entities;

public class PortZone
{
    public Guid Id { get; private set; }
    public Guid TenantId { get; private set; }
    public string PortCode { get; private set; }
    public PortZoneType Type { get; private set; }
    public string Name { get; private set; }
    
    // PostGIS Geometry for Polygon/MultiPolygon
    public Geometry Boundary { get; private set; }
    
    public bool Active { get; private set; }
    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? UpdatedAt { get; private set; }
    public byte[] Version { get; private set; }

    protected PortZone() { }

    public PortZone(
        Guid tenantId,
        string portCode,
        string name,
        PortZoneType type,
        Geometry boundary)
    {
        if (boundary == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(boundary));
        
        // Ensure SRID is set
        if (boundary.SRID == 0) boundary.SRID = 4326;

        Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        TenantId = tenantId;
        PortCode = portCode;
        Name = name;
        Type = type;
        Boundary = boundary;
        Active = true;
        CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }
}
</file>

using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using AisVessel.Domain.Entities;

namespace AisVessel.Infrastructure.Persistence;

public class AisDbContext : DbContext
{
    // 1. Core Vessel Entities
    public DbSet<Vessel> Vessels { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<VesselIdentifier> VesselIdentifiers { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<VesselCharacteristic> VesselCharacteristics { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<VesselNavigationStatus> VesselNavigationStatuses { get; set; } = null!;

    // 2. AIS Tracking & Devices
    public DbSet<AisDevice> AisDevices { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<AisProvider> AisProviders { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<AisDeviceAssignment> AisDeviceAssignments { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<AisPosition> AisPositions { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<VesselTrackingSession> VesselTrackingSessions { get; set; } = null!;

    // 3. Voyage & Port Call
    public DbSet<Voyage> Voyages { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<PortCall> PortCalls { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<Port> Ports { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<PortFacility> PortFacilities { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<Berth> Berths { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<AnchorageArea> AnchorageAreas { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<BerthAssignment> BerthAssignments { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<VesselPortEvent> VesselPortEvents { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<PortOperationalStatus> PortOperationalStatuses { get; set; } = null!;

    // 4. ETA & Delays
    public DbSet<VesselEtaRecord> VesselEtaRecords { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<VesselDelay> VesselDelays { get; set; } = null!;

    // 5. Alerts & Quality
    public DbSet<AisAlert> AisAlerts { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<AisDataQualityEvent> AisDataQualityEvents { get; set; } = null!;

    // 6. Integration Boundaries
    public DbSet<AisExternalReference> AisExternalReferences { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<AisIntegrationRecord> AisIntegrationRecords { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<AisAuditEntry> AisAuditEntries { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<OutboxMessage> OutboxMessages { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<InboxMessage> InboxMessages { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IdempotencyRecord> IdempotencyRecords { get; set; } = null!;

    public AisDbContext(DbContextOptions<AisDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);
        
        // Setup PostGIS extension
        modelBuilder.HasPostgresExtension("postgis");

        modelBuilder.Entity<Vessel>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.VesselReference }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => x.ImoNumber);
            e.HasIndex(x => x.MmsiNumber);
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Status);
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<VesselIdentifier>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.VesselId });
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<VesselCharacteristic>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.VesselId });
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<VesselNavigationStatus>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.VesselId });
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<AisDevice>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.DeviceReference }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<AisProvider>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.ProviderReference }).IsUnique();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<AisDeviceAssignment>(e =>

            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.VesselId, x.AisDeviceId, x.Status });
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.VesselId, x.AisDeviceId, x.TimestampUtc, x.MmsiNumber });
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Position).HasMethod("GIST"); // Spatial Index
            e.Property(x => x.Position).HasColumnType("geography(Point,4326)");

            e.Property(x => x.EndPosition).HasColumnType("geography(Point,4326)");

<file path="services/ais-vessel/AisVessel.Infrastructure/Repositories/AisVesselRepository.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using AisVessel.Domain.Entities;
using AisVessel.Domain.Repositories;
using AisVessel.Infrastructure.Persistence;

namespace AisVessel.Infrastructure.Repositories;

public class AisVesselRepository : IAisVesselRepository
{
    private readonly AisDbContext _context;

    public AisVesselRepository(AisDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public async Task<Vessel> GetByIdAsync(Guid id, Guid tenantId)
    {
        return await _context.Vessels.FirstOrDefaultAsync(v => v.Id == id && v.TenantId == tenantId);
    }

    public async Task<PortCall> GetPortCallByIdAsync(Guid id, Guid tenantId)
    {
        return await _context.PortCalls.FirstOrDefaultAsync(p => p.Id == id && p.TenantId == tenantId);
    }

    public async Task<bool> BerthExistsAsync(Guid berthId, Guid tenantId)
    {
        return await _context.Berths.AnyAsync(b => b.Id == berthId && b.TenantId == tenantId);
    }

    public async Task AddAsync(object entity)
    {
        await _context.AddAsync(entity);
    }

    public async Task UpdateAsync(object entity)
    {
        _context.Update(entity);
        await Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    public async Task SaveChangesAsync()
    {
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
    }
}

public class BerthAllocationRepository : IBerthAllocationRepository
{
    private readonly AisDbContext _context;

    public BerthAllocationRepository(AisDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public async Task<PortCall?> GetPortCallAsync(Guid portCallId, Guid tenantId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        return await _context.PortCalls
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(p => p.Id == portCallId && p.TenantId == tenantId, cancellationToken);
    }

    public async Task<Berth?> GetBerthAsync(Guid berthId, Guid tenantId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        return await _context.Berths
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(b => b.Id == berthId && b.TenantId == tenantId, cancellationToken);
    }

    public async Task SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
    }

<file path="services/ais-vessel/AisVessel.Tests/Api/Controllers/BerthAllocationsControllerTests.cs">
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using AisVessel.Api.Controllers;
using AisVessel.Application.Commands;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Moq;

namespace AisVessel.Tests.Api.Controllers;

public class BerthAllocationsControllerTests
{
    private readonly Mock<IMediator> _mediator = new();
    private readonly BerthAllocationsController _controller;

    public BerthAllocationsControllerTests()
    {
        _controller = new BerthAllocationsController(_mediator.Object)
        {
            ControllerContext = new ControllerContext { HttpContext = new DefaultHttpContext() }
        };
    }

    private void SetUser(string? tenantId = null)
    {
        var claims = new List<Claim>();
        if (tenantId is not null) claims.Add(new Claim("tenant_id", tenantId));

        _controller.ControllerContext.HttpContext.User =
            new ClaimsPrincipal(new ClaimsIdentity(claims, "TestAuth"));
    }

    private static AllocateBerthCommand BuildCommand() => new()
    {
        // Deliberately wrong tenant: the controller must overwrite it from the token
        TenantId = Guid.Empty,
        PortCallId = Guid.NewGuid(),
        BerthId = Guid.NewGuid()
    };

    [Fact]
    public async Task AllocateBerth_WithTenantClaim_ShouldReturnOkWithPortCallId()
    {
        // Arrange
        var portCallId = Guid.NewGuid();
        SetUser(Guid.NewGuid().ToString());
        _mediator
            .Setup(m => m.Send(It.IsAny<AllocateBerthCommand>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .ReturnsAsync(portCallId);

        // Act
        var result = await _controller.AllocateBerth(BuildCommand());

        // Assert
        var ok = Assert.IsType<OkObjectResult>(result);
        Assert.Equal(StatusCodes.Status200OK, ok.StatusCode);

        var payload = ok.Value!;
        var status = payload.GetType().GetProperty("Status")?.GetValue(payload);
        var returnedId = payload.GetType().GetProperty("PortCallId")?.GetValue(payload);
        Assert.Equal("BerthAllocated", status);
        Assert.Equal(portCallId, returnedId);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task AllocateBerth_ShouldOverrideTenantFromTheToken()
    {
        // Arrange: clients must never allocate on behalf of another tenant
        var tenantId = Guid.NewGuid();
        SetUser(tenantId.ToString());

        AllocateBerthCommand? sent = null;
        _mediator
            .Setup(m => m.Send(It.IsAny<AllocateBerthCommand>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .Callback<IRequest<Guid>, CancellationToken>((c, _) => sent = (AllocateBerthCommand)c)
            .ReturnsAsync(Guid.NewGuid());

        // Act
        await _controller.AllocateBerth(BuildCommand());

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(sent);
        Assert.Equal(tenantId, sent!.TenantId);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task AllocateBerth_WithoutTenantClaim_ShouldForbid_AndNotCallMediator()
    {
        // Arrange
        SetUser();

        // Act
        var result = await _controller.AllocateBerth(BuildCommand());

        // Assert
        Assert.IsType<ForbidResult>(result);
        _mediator.Verify(m => m.Send(It.IsAny<AllocateBerthCommand>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()), Times.Never);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task AllocateBerth_WithNonGuidTenantClaim_ShouldForbid()
    {
        // Arrange
        SetUser(tenantId: "not-a-guid");

        // Act
        var result = await _controller.AllocateBerth(BuildCommand());

        // Assert
        Assert.IsType<ForbidResult>(result);
        _mediator.Verify(m => m.Send(It.IsAny<AllocateBerthCommand>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()), Times.Never);
    }
}

<file path="services/ais-vessel/AisVessel.Tests/Application/Commands/AllocateBerthCommandHandlerTests.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using AisVessel.Application.Commands;
using AisVessel.Application.Interfaces;
using AisVessel.Domain.Entities;
using AisVessel.Domain.Enums;
using Moq;

namespace AisVessel.Tests.Application.Commands;

public class AllocateBerthCommandHandlerTests
{
    private readonly Mock<IBerthAllocationRepository> _repository = new();
    private readonly AllocateBerthCommandHandler _handler;

    public AllocateBerthCommandHandlerTests()
    {
        _handler = new AllocateBerthCommandHandler(_repository.Object);
    }

    private static AllocateBerthCommand BuildCommand(Guid? tenantId = null, Guid? portCallId = null, Guid? berthId = null)
    {
        return new AllocateBerthCommand
        {
            TenantId = tenantId ?? Guid.NewGuid(),
            PortCallId = portCallId ?? Guid.NewGuid(),
            BerthId = berthId ?? Guid.NewGuid()
        };
    }

    private void SetupRepository(PortCall? portCall, Berth? berth)
    {
        _repository
            .Setup(r => r.GetPortCallAsync(It.IsAny<Guid>(), It.IsAny<Guid>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .ReturnsAsync(portCall);
        _repository
            .Setup(r => r.GetBerthAsync(It.IsAny<Guid>(), It.IsAny<Guid>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .ReturnsAsync(berth);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_WhenPortCallIsAwaitingBerth_ShouldAllocateAndReturnPortCallId()
    {
        // Arrange
        var command = BuildCommand();
        var portCall = new PortCall
        {
            Id = command.PortCallId,
            TenantId = command.TenantId,
            Status = nameof(PortCallStatus.AwaitingBerth)
        };
        var berth = new Berth { Id = command.BerthId, TenantId = command.TenantId };
        SetupRepository(portCall, berth);

        // Act
        var result = await _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        Assert.Equal(portCall.Id, result);
        Assert.Equal(nameof(PortCallStatus.BerthAllocated), portCall.Status);
        _repository.Verify(r => r.SaveChangesAsync(It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()), Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_ShouldScopeLookupsToTheCallerTenant()
    {
        // Arrange: a tenant must only ever see its own port calls and berths
        var command = BuildCommand();
        SetupRepository(
            new PortCall { Id = command.PortCallId, TenantId = command.TenantId, Status = nameof(PortCallStatus.AwaitingBerth) },
            new Berth { Id = command.BerthId, TenantId = command.TenantId });

        // Act
        await _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        _repository.Verify(r => r.GetPortCallAsync(command.PortCallId, command.TenantId, It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()), Times.Once);
        _repository.Verify(r => r.GetBerthAsync(command.BerthId, command.TenantId, It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()), Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_WhenPortCallDoesNotExist_ShouldThrow_AndNotSave()
    {
        // Arrange
        var command = BuildCommand();
        SetupRepository(portCall: null, berth: new Berth { Id = Guid.NewGuid() });

        // Act & Assert
        var ex = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(() => _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None));
        Assert.Equal("PortCall not found.", ex.Message);
        _repository.Verify(r => r.SaveChangesAsync(It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()), Times.Never);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_WhenBerthDoesNotExist_ShouldThrow_AndNotSave()
    {
        // Arrange
        var command = BuildCommand();
        SetupRepository(
            new PortCall { Id = command.PortCallId, TenantId = command.TenantId, Status = nameof(PortCallStatus.AwaitingBerth) },
            berth: null);

        // Act & Assert
        var ex = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(() => _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None));
        Assert.Equal("Berth not found.", ex.Message);
        _repository.Verify(r => r.SaveChangesAsync(It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()), Times.Never);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(nameof(PortCallStatus.Planned))]
    [InlineData(nameof(PortCallStatus.ArrivedAnchorage))]
    [InlineData(nameof(PortCallStatus.Berthed))]
    [InlineData(nameof(PortCallStatus.Departed))]
    [InlineData(nameof(PortCallStatus.Cancelled))]
    public async Task Handle_WhenPortCallIsNotAwaitingBerth_ShouldThrow_AndNotSave(string currentStatus)
    {
        // Arrange: only port calls actually waiting for a berth may be allocated
        var command = BuildCommand();
        var portCall = new PortCall { Id = command.PortCallId, TenantId = command.TenantId, Status = currentStatus };
        SetupRepository(portCall, new Berth { Id = command.BerthId, TenantId = command.TenantId });

        // Act & Assert
        var ex = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(() => _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None));
        Assert.Equal("PortCall must be AwaitingBerth to allocate a berth.", ex.Message);
        Assert.Equal(currentStatus, portCall.Status); // status must be untouched after the failure
        _repository.Verify(r => r.SaveChangesAsync(It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()), Times.Never);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_ShouldForwardTheCancellationToken()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        CancellationToken receivedToken = CancellationToken.None;
        var command = BuildCommand();
        _repository
            .Setup(r => r.GetPortCallAsync(It.IsAny<Guid>(), It.IsAny<Guid>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .Callback<Guid, Guid, CancellationToken>((_, _, token) => receivedToken = token)
            .ReturnsAsync(new PortCall { Id = command.PortCallId, TenantId = command.TenantId, Status = nameof(PortCallStatus.AwaitingBerth) });
        _repository
            .Setup(r => r.GetBerthAsync(It.IsAny<Guid>(), It.IsAny<Guid>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .ReturnsAsync(new Berth { Id = command.BerthId, TenantId = command.TenantId });

        // Act
        await _handler.Handle(command, cts.Token);

        // Assert
        Assert.Equal(cts.Token, receivedToken);
        _repository.Verify(r => r.SaveChangesAsync(cts.Token), Times.Once);
    }
}

        // Act
        portCall.AdvanceState(PortCallStatus.BerthAllocated);

        // Assert
        Assert.True(portCall.UpdatedAtUtc > new DateTime(2020, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc));
        Assert.Equal(DateTimeKind.Utc, portCall.UpdatedAtUtc.Kind);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AdvanceState_CanWalkTheFullBerthLifecycle()
    {
        // Arrange
        var portCall = new PortCall();

        // Act & Assert: each hop stores the matching enum name
        portCall.AdvanceState(PortCallStatus.Expected);
        Assert.Equal("Expected", portCall.Status);

        portCall.AdvanceState(PortCallStatus.ArrivedAnchorage);
        Assert.Equal("ArrivedAnchorage", portCall.Status);

        portCall.AdvanceState(PortCallStatus.AwaitingBerth);
        Assert.Equal("AwaitingBerth", portCall.Status);

        portCall.AdvanceState(PortCallStatus.BerthAllocated);
        Assert.Equal("BerthAllocated", portCall.Status);

        portCall.AdvanceState(PortCallStatus.Berthed);
        Assert.Equal("Berthed", portCall.Status);

<file path="services/ais-vessel/AisVessel.Tests/Infrastructure/Repositories/BerthAllocationRepositoryTests.cs">
using System;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using AisVessel.Domain.Entities;
using AisVessel.Domain.Enums;
using AisVessel.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using AisVessel.Infrastructure.Repositories;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace AisVessel.Tests.Infrastructure.Repositories;

public class BerthAllocationRepositoryTests : IDisposable
{
    private readonly AisDbContext _context;
    private readonly BerthAllocationRepository _repository;

    public BerthAllocationRepositoryTests()
    {
        var options = new DbContextOptionsBuilder<AisDbContext>()
            .UseInMemoryDatabase($"ais-berthallocation-tests-{Guid.NewGuid()}")
            .Options;

        _context = new AisDbContext(options);
        _repository = new BerthAllocationRepository(_context);
    }

    public void Dispose() => _context.Dispose();

    private async Task<PortCall> SeedPortCallAsync(Guid tenantId, PortCallStatus status = PortCallStatus.AwaitingBerth)
    {
        var portCall = new PortCall
        {
            TenantId = tenantId,
            PortId = Guid.NewGuid(),
            VesselId = Guid.NewGuid(),
            PortCallReference = $"PC-{Guid.NewGuid():N}",
            Status = status.ToString()
        };

        _context.PortCalls.Add(portCall);
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
        return portCall;
    }

    private async Task<Berth> SeedBerthAsync(Guid tenantId)
    {
        var berth = new Berth
        {
            TenantId = tenantId,
            PortId = Guid.NewGuid(),
            BerthReference = $"B-{Guid.NewGuid():N}",
            Name = "Berth 1"
        };

        _context.Berths.Add(berth);
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
        return berth;
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task GetPortCallAsync_WhenPortCallBelongsToTheTenant_ShouldReturnIt()
    {
        // Arrange
        var tenantId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var portCall = await SeedPortCallAsync(tenantId);

        // Act
        var result = await _repository.GetPortCallAsync(portCall.Id, tenantId);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(result);
        Assert.Equal(portCall.Id, result!.Id);
        Assert.Equal(tenantId, result.TenantId);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task GetPortCallAsync_WhenPortCallBelongsToAnotherTenant_ShouldReturnNull()
    {
        // Arrange: tenant isolation must be enforced by the query itself
        var portCall = await SeedPortCallAsync(Guid.NewGuid());

        // Act
        var result = await _repository.GetPortCallAsync(portCall.Id, Guid.NewGuid());

        // Assert
        Assert.Null(result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task GetPortCallAsync_WhenPortCallDoesNotExist_ShouldReturnNull()
    {
        // Arrange & Act
        var result = await _repository.GetPortCallAsync(Guid.NewGuid(), Guid.NewGuid());

        // Assert
        Assert.Null(result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task GetBerthAsync_WhenBerthBelongsToTheTenant_ShouldReturnIt()
    {
        // Arrange
        var tenantId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var berth = await SeedBerthAsync(tenantId);

        // Act
        var result = await _repository.GetBerthAsync(berth.Id, tenantId);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(result);
        Assert.Equal(berth.Id, result!.Id);
        Assert.Equal(tenantId, result.TenantId);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task GetBerthAsync_WhenBerthBelongsToAnotherTenant_ShouldReturnNull()
    {
        // Arrange
        var berth = await SeedBerthAsync(Guid.NewGuid());

        // Act
        var result = await _repository.GetBerthAsync(berth.Id, Guid.NewGuid());

        // Assert
        Assert.Null(result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task SaveChangesAsync_ShouldPersistStatusChangesMadeToAPortCall()
    {
        // Arrange: mirrors the AllocateBerthCommandHandler flow
        var tenantId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var portCall = await SeedPortCallAsync(tenantId);
        var loaded = await _repository.GetPortCallAsync(portCall.Id, tenantId);

        // Act
        loaded!.AdvanceState(PortCallStatus.BerthAllocated);
        await _repository.SaveChangesAsync();

        // Assert: clear the tracker so the assertion reads from the store, not the cache
        _context.ChangeTracker.Clear();
        var persisted = await _context.PortCalls.AsNoTracking().SingleOrDefaultAsync(p => p.Id == portCall.Id);

        Assert.NotNull(persisted);
        Assert.Equal(nameof(PortCallStatus.BerthAllocated), persisted!.Status);
        Assert.Equal(tenantId, persisted.TenantId);
    }
}

<file path="services/analytics/Analytics.Api/Controllers/KpiController.cs">
using System;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Analytics.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;

namespace Analytics.Api.Controllers;

/// <summary>
/// A01: reads the tenant exclusively from the JWT (<c>tenant_id</c> claim). The previous version
/// silently fell back to the caller supplied <c>tenantId</c> query value whenever the claim name
/// did not match, which allowed any authenticated user to read another tenant's KPI.
/// </summary>
[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/analytics/kpis")]
[Authorize(Policy = "analytics.kpi.read")]
public class KpiController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly AnalyticsDbContext _context;

    public KpiController(AnalyticsDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    [HttpGet("transit-time")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetTransitTimeKpi([FromQuery] Guid? tenantId)
    {
        if (!Guid.TryParse(User.FindFirst("tenant_id")?.Value, out var userTenantId)) return Forbid();

        // A requested tenant may only be the caller's own tenant (or empty, meaning "mine").
        if (tenantId.HasValue && tenantId.Value != userTenantId && tenantId.Value != Guid.Empty) return Forbid();

        var baseQuery = _context.FactTripMilestones.AsQueryable();

        if (userTenantId != Guid.Empty)
        {
            baseQuery = baseQuery.Where(f => f.TenantId == userTenantId);
        }

        var avgDuration = await baseQuery
            .Where(f => f.ActualDurationFromStart.HasValue)
            .AverageAsync(f => f.ActualDurationFromStart.Value.TotalHours);

        return Ok(new
        {
            Code = "avg-transit-time",
            Name = "Average Transit Time",
            Value = avgDuration,
            Unit = "Hours"
        });
    }
}

<file path="services/analytics/Analytics.Api/Controllers/KpisController.cs">
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace SmartTrade.Analytics.Api.Controllers;

/// <summary>
/// A01: KPI definitions are tenant data. The endpoint is authenticated, requires the
/// <c>analytics.kpi.read</c> permission and always evaluates the tenant taken from the JWT -
/// a tenantId supplied in the query string can only confirm, never widen, the caller's scope.
/// </summary>
[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/analytics/[controller]")]
[Authorize(Policy = "analytics.kpi.read")]
public class KpisController : ControllerBase
{
    [HttpGet]
    public IActionResult GetKpis([FromQuery] Guid? tenantId, [FromQuery] string category = null)
    {
        if (!TryResolveTenant(tenantId, out var effectiveTenantId)) return Forbid();

        // 1. Fetch KPI definitions scoped to effectiveTenantId
        // 2. Return DTOs
        return Ok(new[]
        {
            new { Id = Guid.NewGuid(), KpiCode = "TRANSIT_TIME", Category = "Logistics", Status = "Active", TenantId = effectiveTenantId }
        });
    }

    [HttpGet("{code}")]
    public IActionResult GetKpiResult(string code, [FromQuery] Guid? tenantId, [FromQuery] DateTimeOffset start, [FromQuery] DateTimeOffset end)
    {
        if (!TryResolveTenant(tenantId, out var effectiveTenantId)) return Forbid();

        // 1. Fetch KPI result from Redis Cache or PostgreSQL, scoped to effectiveTenantId
        return Ok(new
        {
            KpiCode = code,
            TenantId = effectiveTenantId,
            Value = 120.5m,
            Target = 100.0m,
            Status = "Warning",
            DataFreshness = "Fresh"
        });
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Resolves the tenant from the <c>tenant_id</c> claim and rejects any request that asks for
    /// another tenant's data.
    /// </summary>
    private bool TryResolveTenant(Guid? requestedTenantId, out Guid effectiveTenantId)
    {
        effectiveTenantId = Guid.Empty;

        var claim = User.FindFirst("tenant_id")?.Value;
        if (!Guid.TryParse(claim, out var callerTenantId)) return false;

        if (requestedTenantId.HasValue && requestedTenantId.Value != callerTenantId &&
            requestedTenantId.Value != Guid.Empty)
        {
            // Explicit cross-tenant request from a non-platform caller.
            return false;
        }

        effectiveTenantId = callerTenantId;
        return true;
    }
}

<file path="services/analytics/Analytics.Api/Program.cs">
using Analytics.Application.Interfaces;
using Analytics.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using BuildingBlocks.Web;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

builder.Services.AddControllers();
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
builder.Services.AddSwaggerGen();

// A01: this service had no host at all, and both KPI controllers accepted a tenantId straight
// from the query string. JWT validation, permission policies and the deny-by-default fallback
// policy are now enforced before any KPI data can be read.
builder.Services.AddPlatformJwtAuthentication(builder.Configuration);
builder.Services.AddPlatformSecurity(builder.Configuration);

builder.Services.AddAuthorization(options =>
{
    options.AddPolicy("analytics.kpi.read", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "analytics.kpi.read"));
});

var connectionString = builder.Configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection");
if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionString))
    throw new InvalidOperationException("ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection is required.");

builder.Services.AddDbContext<AnalyticsDbContext>(options => options.UseNpgsql(connectionString));
builder.Services.AddScoped<IAnalyticsDbContext>(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<AnalyticsDbContext>());

var app = builder.Build();

app.UsePlatformSecurity();
if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
{
    app.UseSwagger();
    app.UseSwaggerUI();
}

app.UseHttpsRedirection();
app.UseRouting();
app.UsePlatformCors();
app.UseRateLimiter();
app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseAuthorization();
app.MapControllers();

app.MapGet("/health/live", () => Results.Ok(new { status = "alive" })).AllowAnonymous();
app.MapGet("/health/ready", async (AnalyticsDbContext db, CancellationToken ct) =>
{
    try
    {
        if (await db.Database.CanConnectAsync(ct)) return (IResult)Results.Ok(new { status = "ready" });
        return Results.Problem(statusCode: StatusCodes.Status503ServiceUnavailable, title: "Database unavailable");
    }
    catch
    {
        return Results.Problem(statusCode: StatusCodes.Status503ServiceUnavailable, title: "Database unavailable");
    }
}).AllowAnonymous();

app.Run();

public partial class Program { }

<file path="services/analytics/Analytics.Application/Commands/GenerateReportCommand.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using MediatR;
using Analytics.Application.Interfaces;

namespace Analytics.Application.Commands;

public class GenerateReportCommand : IRequest<string> // Returns Signed URL of the generated report
{
    public Guid ReportDefinitionId { get; set; }
    public Guid? RequestingTenantId { get; set; } // Enforce Security
}

public class GenerateReportCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<GenerateReportCommand, string>
{
    private readonly IAnalyticsDbContext _context;

    public GenerateReportCommandHandler(IAnalyticsDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public async Task<string> Handle(GenerateReportCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        // 1. Fetch ReportDefinition
        var def = await _context.FindReportDefinitionAsync(request.ReportDefinitionId, cancellationToken);
        if (def == null) throw new Exception("Report Definition not found.");
        
        // 2. Validate Security (Tenant Isolation)
        if (def.TenantId.HasValue && def.TenantId != request.RequestingTenantId)
        {
            throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("Cannot generate a report for a different tenant.");
        }
        
        // 3. Generate Report Data based on the Definition (e.g. querying Fact tables)
        // 4. Generate PDF/Excel payload
        // 5. Save to MinIO/S3
        // 6. Generate presigned URL
        
        return await Task.FromResult("https://storage.smartcorridor.com/reports/xyz-123.pdf?signature=xxx");
    }
}

<file path="services/analytics/Analytics.Application/Consumers/TripMilestoneConsumer.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Analytics.Application.Interfaces;
using Analytics.Domain.Entities;
using MassTransit;

namespace Analytics.Application.Consumers;

public class TripMilestoneEvent
{
    public Guid EventId { get; set; }
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public Guid TripId { get; set; }
    public Guid VehicleId { get; set; }
    public Guid CorridorId { get; set; }
    public string MilestoneType { get; set; }
    public string LocationName { get; set; }
    public DateTime OccurredAt { get; set; }
    public TimeSpan? ExpectedDuration { get; set; }
    public TimeSpan? ActualDuration { get; set; }
    public TimeSpan? DelayDuration { get; set; }
}

public class TripMilestoneConsumer : IConsumer<TripMilestoneEvent>
{
    private readonly IAnalyticsDbContext _context;

    public TripMilestoneConsumer(IAnalyticsDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public async Task Consume(ConsumeContext<TripMilestoneEvent> context)
    {
        var msg = context.Message;
        var cancellationToken = context.CancellationToken;

        // Idempotency Check: Don't ingest the same event twice
        var exists = await _context.FactTripMilestoneExistsAsync(msg.EventId, cancellationToken);
        if (exists) return;

        // Data Quality Rule: Log and skip negative durations
        if (msg.ActualDuration.HasValue && msg.ActualDuration.Value.TotalSeconds < 0)
        {
            // Ideally, we'd log this into a DataQualityIssue table
            return;
        }

        var fact = new FactTripMilestone(
            msg.TenantId,
            msg.TripId,
            msg.VehicleId,
            msg.CorridorId,
            msg.MilestoneType,
            msg.LocationName,
            msg.OccurredAt,
            msg.ExpectedDuration,
            msg.ActualDuration,
            msg.DelayDuration,
            msg.EventId
        );

        _context.AddFactTripMilestone(fact);
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
    }
}

<file path="services/analytics/Analytics.Application/Interfaces/IAnalyticsDbContext.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Analytics.Domain.Entities;

namespace Analytics.Application.Interfaces;

/// <summary>
/// Persistence abstraction for the Analytics Application layer.
///
/// Declared here (and implemented by <c>Analytics.Infrastructure.Persistence.AnalyticsDbContext</c>)
/// so the Application layer never takes a dependency on Infrastructure or EF Core,
/// which would otherwise create a circular project reference.
/// </summary>
public interface IAnalyticsDbContext
{
    /// <summary>Loads a report definition by its identifier, or <c>null</c> when it does not exist.</summary>
    Task<ReportDefinition?> FindReportDefinitionAsync(Guid id, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);

    /// <summary>Idempotency probe: has this operational event already been ingested?</summary>
    Task<bool> FactTripMilestoneExistsAsync(Guid sourceEventId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);

    /// <summary>Stages a trip milestone fact for persistence.</summary>
    void AddFactTripMilestone(FactTripMilestone fact);

    Task<int> SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
}

public class FactTripMilestone

    public Guid Id { get; private set; }

    // Dimension References
    public Guid VehicleId { get; private set; }
    public Guid CorridorId { get; private set; }

    public string MilestoneType { get; private set; } // e.g., "PortExit", "BorderCrossing", "DryPortArrival"
    public string LocationName { get; private set; }
    
    // Analytics Metrics
    public DateTime OccurredAt { get; private set; }
    public TimeSpan? ExpectedDurationFromStart { get; private set; }
    public TimeSpan? ActualDurationFromStart { get; private set; }
    public TimeSpan? DelayDuration { get; private set; }
    
    // Data Lineage
    public Guid SourceEventId { get; private set; }
    public DateTime ProcessedAt { get; private set; }

    protected FactTripMilestone() { }

    public FactTripMilestone(
        Guid tenantId,
        Guid tripId,
        Guid vehicleId,
        Guid corridorId,
        string milestoneType,
        string locationName,
        DateTime occurredAt,
        TimeSpan? expectedDuration,
        TimeSpan? actualDuration,
        TimeSpan? delayDuration,
        Guid sourceEventId)
    {
        Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        TenantId = tenantId;
        TripId = tripId;
        VehicleId = vehicleId;
        CorridorId = corridorId;
        MilestoneType = milestoneType;
        LocationName = locationName;
        OccurredAt = occurredAt;
        ExpectedDurationFromStart = expectedDuration;
        ActualDurationFromStart = actualDuration;
        DelayDuration = delayDuration;
        SourceEventId = sourceEventId;
        ProcessedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }
}

<file path="services/analytics/Analytics.Infrastructure/Consumers/TripCompletedConsumer.cs">
using MassTransit;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using SmartTrade.Analytics.Infrastructure.Data;
using SmartTrade.Analytics.Domain.Entities;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace SmartTrade.Analytics.Infrastructure.Consumers;

public record TripCompletedEvent(Guid TripId, Guid TenantId, decimal ActualDistance, decimal ActualDuration, decimal DelayMinutes, DateTimeOffset CompletedAt);

public class TripCompletedConsumer : IConsumer<TripCompletedEvent>
{
    private readonly AnalyticsDbContext _dbContext;
    private readonly ILogger<TripCompletedConsumer> _logger;

    public TripCompletedConsumer(AnalyticsDbContext dbContext, ILogger<TripCompletedConsumer> logger)
    {
        _dbContext = dbContext;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task Consume(ConsumeContext<TripCompletedEvent> context)
    {
        var msg = context.Message;
        _logger.LogInformation("Processing TripCompletedEvent for Analytics: {TripId}", msg.TripId);

        // Idempotency Check
        var exists = await _dbContext.FactTrips.AnyAsync(x => x.TripId == msg.TripId);
        if (exists)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Trip {TripId} already recorded in analytics fact table. Skipping duplicate.", msg.TripId);
            return;
        }

        var fact = new FactTrip
        {
            TripKey = Guid.NewGuid(),
            TripId = msg.TripId,
            TenantKey = msg.TenantId,
            DateKey = int.Parse(msg.CompletedAt.ToString("yyyyMMdd")),
            ActualDistance = msg.ActualDistance,
            ActualDuration = msg.ActualDuration,
            DelayMinutes = msg.DelayMinutes,
            Status = "COMPLETED",
            Completed = true,
            CreatedAt = msg.CompletedAt
        };

        _dbContext.FactTrips.Add(fact);
        await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
    }
}

<file path="services/analytics/Analytics.Infrastructure/Data/AnalyticsDbContext.cs">
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using SmartTrade.Analytics.Domain.Entities;

namespace SmartTrade.Analytics.Infrastructure.Data;

public class AnalyticsDbContext : DbContext
{
    public AnalyticsDbContext(DbContextOptions<AnalyticsDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

    public DbSet<DimTenant> DimTenants => Set<DimTenant>();
    public DbSet<DimDate> DimDates => Set<DimDate>();
    public DbSet<DimVehicle> DimVehicles => Set<DimVehicle>();
    public DbSet<DimCorridor> DimCorridors => Set<DimCorridor>();

    public DbSet<FactTrip> FactTrips => Set<FactTrip>();
    public DbSet<FactPaymentOperational> FactPayments => Set<FactPaymentOperational>();

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);
        
        modelBuilder.HasDefaultSchema("smart_analytics");

        // DimTenant
        modelBuilder.Entity<DimTenant>().HasKey(x => x.TenantKey);
        modelBuilder.Entity<DimTenant>().HasIndex(x => x.TenantId);

        // FactTrip
        modelBuilder.Entity<FactTrip>().HasKey(x => x.TripKey);
        modelBuilder.Entity<FactTrip>().Property(x => x.PlannedDistance).HasColumnType("numeric(18,2)");
        modelBuilder.Entity<FactTrip>().Property(x => x.ActualDistance).HasColumnType("numeric(18,2)");
        modelBuilder.Entity<FactTrip>().Property(x => x.PlannedDuration).HasColumnType("numeric(18,2)");
        modelBuilder.Entity<FactTrip>().Property(x => x.ActualDuration).HasColumnType("numeric(18,2)");
        modelBuilder.Entity<FactTrip>().Property(x => x.DelayMinutes).HasColumnType("numeric(18,2)");
        
        modelBuilder.Entity<FactTrip>()
            .HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantKey, x.DateKey });

        // FactPaymentOperational
        modelBuilder.Entity<FactPaymentOperational>().HasKey(x => x.PaymentKey);
        modelBuilder.Entity<FactPaymentOperational>().Property(x => x.TotalAmount).HasColumnType("numeric(18,4)");
        modelBuilder.Entity<FactPaymentOperational>().Property(x => x.RefundAmount).HasColumnType("numeric(18,4)");
        modelBuilder.Entity<FactPaymentOperational>().Property(x => x.SettlementAmount).HasColumnType("numeric(18,4)");
    }
}

<file path="services/analytics/Analytics.Infrastructure/Persistence/AnalyticsDbContext.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Analytics.Application.Interfaces;
using Analytics.Domain.Entities;

namespace Analytics.Infrastructure.Persistence;

public class AnalyticsDbContext : DbContext, IAnalyticsDbContext
{
    public DbSet<DimTenant> DimTenants { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<FactTripMilestone> FactTripMilestones { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<KpiDefinition> KpiDefinitions { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<ReportDefinition> ReportDefinitions { get; set; } = null!;

    public AnalyticsDbContext(DbContextOptions<AnalyticsDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

    // ── IAnalyticsDbContext (Application-layer abstraction) ───────────────────

    public Task<ReportDefinition?> FindReportDefinitionAsync(Guid id, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        => ReportDefinitions.FindAsync(new object[] { id }, cancellationToken).AsTask();

    public Task<bool> FactTripMilestoneExistsAsync(Guid sourceEventId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        => FactTripMilestones.AnyAsync(f => f.SourceEventId == sourceEventId, cancellationToken);

    public void AddFactTripMilestone(FactTripMilestone fact)
        => FactTripMilestones.Add(fact);

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);
        
        // PostGIS setup would normally happen here if we had spatial entities in this snippet (e.g. FactGpsEvent with Point geography)
        // modelBuilder.HasPostgresExtension("postgis");

        modelBuilder.Entity<FactTripMilestone>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.HasIndex(e => new { e.TenantId, e.OccurredAt }); // Frequent filtering pattern
            entity.HasIndex(e => e.SourceEventId).IsUnique(); // Idempotency check against double ingestion
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<KpiDefinition>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Code); // Code is the primary identifier for KPIs
        });
        
        modelBuilder.Entity<ReportDefinition>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            // Global reports + Tenant specific ones
        });
    }
}

using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Analytics.Domain.Entities;
using Analytics.Domain.Repositories;
using Analytics.Infrastructure.Persistence;

namespace Analytics.Infrastructure.Repositories;

public class AnalyticsRepository : IAnalyticsRepository
{
    private readonly AnalyticsDbContext _context;

    public AnalyticsRepository(AnalyticsDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public async Task<KpiDefinition> GetKpiByIdAsync(Guid id)
    {
        return await _context.KpiDefinitions.FindAsync(id);
    }

    public async Task<bool> FactExistsAsync(Guid eventId)
    {
        return await _context.FactTripMilestones.AnyAsync(f => f.SourceEventId == eventId);
    }

    public async Task AddFactAsync(FactTripMilestone fact)
    {
        await _context.FactTripMilestones.AddAsync(fact);
    }

    public async Task SaveChangesAsync()
    {
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
    }
}

<file path="services/anpr-gate/AnprGate.Api/Controllers/AnprIngestionController.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using MediatR;
using AnprGate.Application.Commands;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;

namespace AnprGate.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/anpr/ingest")]
// Note: Normally machine-to-machine APIs use a different policy (e.g. certificate auth or custom device tokens)
[Authorize]
public class AnprIngestionController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;

    public AnprIngestionController(IMediator mediator)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
    }

    [HttpPost]
    [Authorize(Policy = "anpr.camera.machine")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Ingest([FromBody] IngestRecognitionCommand command)
    {
        if (!Guid.TryParse(User.FindFirst("tenant_id")?.Value, out var tenantId) ||
            !Guid.TryParse(User.FindFirst("camera_id")?.Value, out var cameraId)) return Forbid();
        command.TenantId = tenantId;
        command.CameraId = cameraId;

        var recognitionId = await _mediator.Send(command);
        return Accepted(new { RecognitionEventId = recognitionId, Status = "Processing" });
    }
}

<file path="services/anpr-gate/AnprGate.Api/Program.cs">
using AnprGate.Application.Commands;
using BuildingBlocks.Web;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

builder.Services.AddControllers();
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
builder.Services.AddSwaggerGen();

builder.Services.AddMediatR(cfg => cfg.RegisterServicesFromAssembly(typeof(IngestRecognitionCommand).Assembly));

// A01/A07: the pipeline used to call UseAuthentication/UseAuthorization without registering an
// authentication scheme or the "anpr.camera.machine" policy, so [Authorize] could never succeed.
// JWT validation and the deny-by-default fallback policy are now provided by the platform.
builder.Services.AddPlatformJwtAuthentication(builder.Configuration);
builder.Services.AddPlatformSecurity(builder.Configuration);

builder.Services.AddAuthorization(options =>
{
    options.AddPolicy("anpr.camera.machine", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "anpr.camera.machine"));
});

var app = builder.Build();

app.UsePlatformSecurity();
if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
{
    app.UseSwagger();
    app.UseSwaggerUI();
}

app.UseHttpsRedirection();
app.UseRouting();
app.UsePlatformCors();
app.UseRateLimiter();
app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseAuthorization();
app.MapControllers();

app.MapGet("/health/live", () => Results.Ok(new { status = "alive" })).AllowAnonymous();

app.Run();

public partial class Program { }

<file path="services/anpr-gate/AnprGate.Domain/Entities/Camera.cs">
using System;
using NetTopologySuite.Geometries;
using AnprGate.Domain.Enums;

namespace AnprGate.Domain.Entities;

public class Camera
{
    public Guid Id { get; private set; }
    public Guid TenantId { get; private set; }
    public string CameraCode { get; private set; }
    public string Name { get; private set; }
    public string Description { get; private set; }
    
    // PostGIS location
    public Geometry Location { get; private set; }
    
    public string PortOrBorderReference { get; private set; }
    public Guid? GateId { get; private set; }
    public Guid? LaneId { get; private set; }
    
    public Direction Direction { get; private set; }
    public CameraType CameraType { get; private set; }
    
    public string Manufacturer { get; private set; }
    public string Model { get; private set; }
    public string SerialNumber { get; private set; }
    public string FirmwareVersion { get; private set; }
    
    public CameraStatus Status { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? LastHeartbeatAt { get; private set; }
    
    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? UpdatedAt { get; private set; }
    public byte[] Version { get; private set; }

    protected Camera() { }

    public Camera(Guid tenantId, string cameraCode, string name, CameraType type, Geometry location)
    {
        Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        TenantId = tenantId;
        CameraCode = cameraCode;
        Name = name;
        CameraType = type;
        
        if (location != null && location.SRID == 0) location.SRID = 4326;
        Location = location;
        
        Status = CameraStatus.Provisioning;
        CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

    public void UpdateHeartbeat()
    {
        LastHeartbeatAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        if (Status == CameraStatus.Offline)
        {
            Status = CameraStatus.Active;
        }
    }
}

<file path="services/anpr-gate/AnprGate.Domain/Entities/RecognitionEvent.cs">
using System;
using AnprGate.Domain.Enums;

namespace AnprGate.Domain.Entities;

public class RecognitionEvent
{
    public Guid Id { get; private set; }
    public Guid TenantId { get; private set; }
    public Guid CameraId { get; private set; }
    public Guid? GateId { get; private set; }
    public Guid? LaneId { get; private set; }
    
    public DateTime ObservedAt { get; private set; }
    public DateTime ReceivedAt { get; private set; }
    
    public string PlateText { get; private set; }
    public string NormalizedPlateText { get; private set; }
    public string CountryCode { get; private set; }
    
    public double Confidence { get; private set; }
    public Direction Direction { get; private set; }
    
    public RecognitionStatus Status { get; private set; }
    public string ProviderEventId { get; private set; }
    public Guid? ImageEvidenceReferenceId { get; private set; }
    
    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; private set; }

    protected RecognitionEvent() { }

    public RecognitionEvent(
        Guid tenantId,
        Guid cameraId,
        string plateText,
        string normalizedPlateText,
        double confidence,
        DateTime observedAt,
        string providerEventId)
    {
        Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        TenantId = tenantId;
        CameraId = cameraId;
        PlateText = plateText;
        NormalizedPlateText = normalizedPlateText;
        Confidence = confidence;
        ObservedAt = observedAt;
        ReceivedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        ProviderEventId = providerEventId;
        Status = RecognitionStatus.Detected;
        CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }
}

<file path="services/anpr-gate/AnprGate.Infrastructure/Persistence/AnprDbContext.cs">
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using AnprGate.Domain.Entities;

namespace AnprGate.Infrastructure.Persistence;

public class AnprDbContext : DbContext
{
    // 1. Camera
    public DbSet<AnprCamera> Cameras { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<CameraConfiguration> CameraConfigurations { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<CameraHealthRecord> CameraHealthRecords { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<CameraCommand> CameraCommands { get; set; } = null!;

    // 2. Gate & Border
    public DbSet<Gate> Gates { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<GateLane> GateLanes { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<GateCameraAssignment> GateCameraAssignments { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<BorderCheckpoint> BorderCheckpoints { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<GateEvent> GateEvents { get; set; } = null!;

    // 3. Recognition & Observation
    public DbSet<AnprRecognitionEvent> RecognitionEvents { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<PlateObservation> PlateObservations { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<AnprVehicleMatch> VehicleMatches { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<AnprTripMatch> TripMatches { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<RecognitionEvidence> Evidences { get; set; } = null!;

    // 4. Authorization
    public DbSet<GateAuthorizationRequest> AuthorizationRequests { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<GateAuthorizationDecision> AuthorizationDecisions { get; set; } = null!;

    // 5. Passage & Border Crossing
    public DbSet<GatePassage> GatePassages { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<BorderCrossing> BorderCrossings { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<BorderCrossingEvent> BorderCrossingEvents { get; set; } = null!;

    // 6. Operations & Alerts
    public DbSet<ManualVerification> ManualVerifications { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<AnprManualOverride> ManualOverrides { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<AnprAlert> Alerts { get; set; } = null!;

    // 7. Integrations & Platform Base
    public DbSet<AnprExternalReference> ExternalReferences { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<AnprIntegrationRecord> IntegrationRecords { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<AnprAuditEntry> AuditEntries { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<OutboxMessage> OutboxMessages { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<InboxMessage> InboxMessages { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IdempotencyRecord> IdempotencyRecords { get; set; } = null!;

    public AnprDbContext(DbContextOptions<AnprDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);
        
        modelBuilder.HasPostgresExtension("postgis");

        modelBuilder.Entity<AnprCamera>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.CameraReference }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(x => x.Position).HasColumnType("geography(Point,4326)");
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Position).HasMethod("GIST");
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<CameraConfiguration>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.CameraId, x.ConfigurationVersion }).IsUnique();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<CameraHealthRecord>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.CameraId, x.RecordedAtUtc });
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<CameraCommand>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.CameraId, x.Status });
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<Gate>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.GateReference }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(x => x.Location).HasColumnType("geography(Point,4326)");
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Location).HasMethod("GIST");
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<GateLane>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.GateId, x.LaneReference }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(x => x.Position).HasColumnType("geography(Point,4326)");
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Position).HasMethod("GIST");
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<GateCameraAssignment>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.GateId, x.CameraId, x.LaneId });
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<BorderCheckpoint>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.BorderReference }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(x => x.Location).HasColumnType("geography(Point,4326)");
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Location).HasMethod("GIST");
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<GateEvent>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.GateId, x.OccurredAtUtc });
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<AnprRecognitionEvent>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.CameraId, x.ProviderEventId }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.NormalizedPlateText, x.RecognizedAtUtc });
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.Status });
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<PlateObservation>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.NormalizedPlateText, x.ObservedAtUtc });
            e.Property(x => x.Position).HasColumnType("geography(Point,4326)");
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Position).HasMethod("GIST");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<AnprVehicleMatch>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.RecognitionEventId, x.VehicleReference });
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<AnprTripMatch>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.RecognitionEventId, x.TripReference });
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<RecognitionEvidence>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.RecognitionEventId });
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<GateAuthorizationRequest>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.AuthorizationReference }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.VehicleReference, x.Status });
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.TripReference, x.Status });
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.GateId, x.Status, x.RequestedAtUtc });
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<GateAuthorizationDecision>(e =>
        {

using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using AnprGate.Domain.Entities;
using AnprGate.Domain.Repositories;
using AnprGate.Infrastructure.Persistence;

namespace AnprGate.Infrastructure.Repositories;

public class AnprGateRepository : IAnprGateRepository
{
    private readonly AnprDbContext _context;

    public AnprGateRepository(AnprDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public async Task<RecognitionEvent> GetRecognitionByIdAsync(Guid id)
    {
        return await _context.RecognitionEvents.FindAsync(id);
    }

    public async Task AddRecognitionAsync(RecognitionEvent recognition)
    {
        await _context.RecognitionEvents.AddAsync(recognition);
    }

    public async Task SaveChangesAsync()
    {
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
    }
}

<file path="services/anpr-gate/AnprGate.Tests/Api/Controllers/AnprIngestionControllerTests.cs">
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using AnprGate.Api.Controllers;
using AnprGate.Application.Commands;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Moq;

namespace AnprGate.Tests.Api.Controllers;

public class AnprIngestionControllerTests
{
    private readonly Mock<IMediator> _mediator = new();
    private readonly AnprIngestionController _controller;

    public AnprIngestionControllerTests()
    {
        _controller = new AnprIngestionController(_mediator.Object)
        {
            ControllerContext = new ControllerContext { HttpContext = new DefaultHttpContext() }
        };
    }

    private void SetUser(string? tenantId = null, string? cameraId = null)
    {
        var claims = new List<Claim>();
        if (tenantId is not null) claims.Add(new Claim("tenant_id", tenantId));
        if (cameraId is not null) claims.Add(new Claim("camera_id", cameraId));

        _controller.ControllerContext.HttpContext.User =
            new ClaimsPrincipal(new ClaimsIdentity(claims, "TestAuth"));
    }

    private static IngestRecognitionCommand BuildCommand() => new()
    {
        // Deliberately wrong values: the controller must overwrite them from the token
        TenantId = Guid.Empty,
        CameraId = Guid.Empty,
        PlateText = "AB-123-CD",
        Confidence = 0.97,
        ObservedAt = new DateTime(2026, 2, 1, 8, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc),
        ProviderEventId = "prov-evt-1"
    };

    [Fact]
    public async Task Ingest_WithValidClaims_ShouldReturnAccepted()
    {
        // Arrange
        var recognitionId = Guid.NewGuid();
        SetUser(Guid.NewGuid().ToString(), Guid.NewGuid().ToString());
        _mediator
            .Setup(m => m.Send(It.IsAny<IngestRecognitionCommand>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .ReturnsAsync(recognitionId);

        // Act
        var result = await _controller.Ingest(BuildCommand());

        // Assert
        var accepted = Assert.IsType<AcceptedResult>(result);
        Assert.Equal(StatusCodes.Status202Accepted, accepted.StatusCode);

        var payload = accepted.Value!;
        var status = payload.GetType().GetProperty("Status")?.GetValue(payload);
        var returnedId = payload.GetType().GetProperty("RecognitionEventId")?.GetValue(payload);
        Assert.Equal("Processing", status);
        Assert.Equal(recognitionId, returnedId);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Ingest_ShouldOverrideTenantAndCameraFromTheToken()
    {
        // Arrange: cameras must never be able to claim another tenant's identity
        var tenantId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var cameraId = Guid.NewGuid();
        SetUser(tenantId.ToString(), cameraId.ToString());

        IngestRecognitionCommand? sent = null;
        _mediator
            .Setup(m => m.Send(It.IsAny<IngestRecognitionCommand>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .Callback<IRequest<Guid>, CancellationToken>((c, _) => sent = (IngestRecognitionCommand)c)
            .ReturnsAsync(Guid.NewGuid());

        // Act
        await _controller.Ingest(BuildCommand());

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(sent);
        Assert.Equal(tenantId, sent!.TenantId);
        Assert.Equal(cameraId, sent.CameraId);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Ingest_ShouldForwardTheCommandPayloadToMediator()
    {
        // Arrange
        SetUser(Guid.NewGuid().ToString(), Guid.NewGuid().ToString());
        var command = BuildCommand();

        IngestRecognitionCommand? sent = null;
        _mediator
            .Setup(m => m.Send(It.IsAny<IngestRecognitionCommand>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .Callback<IRequest<Guid>, CancellationToken>((c, _) => sent = (IngestRecognitionCommand)c)
            .ReturnsAsync(Guid.NewGuid());

        // Act
        await _controller.Ingest(command);

        // Assert: business fields must pass through untouched
        Assert.NotNull(sent);
        Assert.Equal("AB-123-CD", sent!.PlateText);
        Assert.Equal(0.97, sent.Confidence);
        Assert.Equal(command.ObservedAt, sent.ObservedAt);
        Assert.Equal("prov-evt-1", sent.ProviderEventId);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Ingest_WithoutClaims_ShouldForbid_AndNotCallMediator()
    {
        // Arrange
        SetUser();

        // Act
        var result = await _controller.Ingest(BuildCommand());

        // Assert
        Assert.IsType<ForbidResult>(result);
        _mediator.Verify(m => m.Send(It.IsAny<IngestRecognitionCommand>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()), Times.Never);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Ingest_WithOnlyTenantClaim_ShouldForbid()
    {
        // Arrange: both tenant_id and camera_id are required for ingestion
        SetUser(tenantId: Guid.NewGuid().ToString(), cameraId: null);

        // Act
        var result = await _controller.Ingest(BuildCommand());

        // Assert
        Assert.IsType<ForbidResult>(result);
        _mediator.Verify(m => m.Send(It.IsAny<IngestRecognitionCommand>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()), Times.Never);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Ingest_WithNonGuidClaims_ShouldForbid()
    {
        // Arrange
        SetUser(tenantId: "not-a-guid", cameraId: Guid.NewGuid().ToString());

        // Act
        var result = await _controller.Ingest(BuildCommand());

        // Assert
        Assert.IsType<ForbidResult>(result);
        _mediator.Verify(m => m.Send(It.IsAny<IngestRecognitionCommand>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()), Times.Never);
    }
}

<file path="services/anpr-gate/AnprGate.Tests/Application/Commands/IngestRecognitionCommandHandlerTests.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using AnprGate.Application.Commands;

namespace AnprGate.Tests.Application.Commands;

public class IngestRecognitionCommandHandlerTests
{
    private readonly IngestRecognitionCommandHandler _handler = new();

    private static IngestRecognitionCommand BuildCommand(
        Guid? tenantId = null,
        Guid? cameraId = null,
        string plateText = "AB-123-CD",
        double confidence = 0.97,
        DateTime? observedAt = null,
        string providerEventId = "prov-evt-1")
    {
        return new IngestRecognitionCommand
        {
            TenantId = tenantId ?? Guid.NewGuid(),
            CameraId = cameraId ?? Guid.NewGuid(),
            PlateText = plateText,
            Confidence = confidence,
            ObservedAt = observedAt ?? new DateTime(2026, 1, 15, 10, 30, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc),
            ProviderEventId = providerEventId
        };
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_ShouldReturnANonEmptyRecognitionEventId()
    {
        // Arrange
        var command = BuildCommand();

        // Act
        var recognitionId = await _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotEqual(Guid.Empty, recognitionId);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_CalledTwice_ShouldReturnDistinctIds()
    {
        // Arrange: each ingested frame is its own recognition event
        // Act
        var first = await _handler.Handle(BuildCommand(), CancellationToken.None);
        var second = await _handler.Handle(BuildCommand(), CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotEqual(first, second);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_WithLowConfidenceRecognition_ShouldStillAcceptIt()
    {
        // Arrange: confidence triage happens downstream, ingestion itself must not fail
        var command = BuildCommand(confidence: 0.1);

        // Act
        var recognitionId = await _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotEqual(Guid.Empty, recognitionId);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_WithEmptyPlateText_ShouldStillAcceptIt()
    {
        // Arrange: unreadable plates are a valid camera outcome to ingest
        var command = BuildCommand(plateText: string.Empty);

        // Act
        var recognitionId = await _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotEqual(Guid.Empty, recognitionId);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_ShouldNotMutateTheIncomingCommand()
    {
        // Arrange
        var command = BuildCommand();
        var originalTenant = command.TenantId;
        var originalCamera = command.CameraId;
        var originalPlate = command.PlateText;

        // Act
        await _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        Assert.Equal(originalTenant, command.TenantId);
        Assert.Equal(originalCamera, command.CameraId);
        Assert.Equal(originalPlate, command.PlateText);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_WithCancelledToken_ShouldNotThrow()
    {
        // Arrange: the current handler performs no I/O, so cancellation is a no-op
        using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        cts.Cancel();

        // Act
        var recognitionId = await _handler.Handle(BuildCommand(), cts.Token);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotEqual(Guid.Empty, recognitionId);
    }
}

using System;

        Assert.Equal("Unmatched", recognitionEvent.TripMatchStatus);
        Assert.Equal(string.Empty, recognitionEvent.RecognitionReference);
        Assert.Equal(string.Empty, recognitionEvent.NormalizedPlateText);
        Assert.Equal(string.Empty, recognitionEvent.Direction);
        Assert.Equal(string.Empty, recognitionEvent.Source);

        Assert.Null(recognitionEvent.OriginalPlateText);
        Assert.Null(recognitionEvent.Confidence);
        Assert.Null(recognitionEvent.GateId);
        Assert.Null(recognitionEvent.LaneId);
        Assert.Null(recognitionEvent.CountryCode);
        Assert.Null(recognitionEvent.EvidenceReference);
        Assert.Null(recognitionEvent.SequenceNumber);

    [Fact]
    public void NewRecognitionEvent_ShouldHaveEmptyChildCollections()
    {
        // Arrange & Act
        var recognitionEvent = new AnprRecognitionEvent();

        // Assert
        Assert.Empty(recognitionEvent.PlateObservations);
        Assert.Empty(recognitionEvent.VehicleMatches);
        Assert.Empty(recognitionEvent.TripMatches);
        Assert.Empty(recognitionEvent.Evidences);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void NewRecognitionEvent_ShouldHaveUniqueIdAndStampedTimestamps()
    {
        // Arrange
        var before = DateTime.UtcNow;

        // Act
        var recognitionEvent = new AnprRecognitionEvent();
        var after = DateTime.UtcNow;

        // Assert
        Assert.NotEqual(Guid.Empty, recognitionEvent.Id);
        Assert.InRange(recognitionEvent.ReceivedAtUtc, before, after);
        Assert.InRange(recognitionEvent.CreatedAtUtc, before, after);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void NewRecognitionEvents_ShouldHaveUniqueIds()
    {
        // Arrange & Act
        var first = new AnprRecognitionEvent();
        var second = new AnprRecognitionEvent();

        // Assert
        Assert.NotEqual(first.Id, second.Id);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void RecognitionEventProperties_ShouldBeSettable()
    {
        // Arrange
        var recognitionEvent = new AnprRecognitionEvent();
        var recognizedAt = new DateTime(2026, 3, 1, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

        // Act
        recognitionEvent.NormalizedPlateText = "AB123CD";
        recognitionEvent.OriginalPlateText = "AB-123-CD";
        recognitionEvent.Confidence = 0.94;
        recognitionEvent.RecognizedAtUtc = recognizedAt;
        recognitionEvent.Status = "Validated";
        recognitionEvent.VehicleMatchStatus = "Matched";

        // Assert
        Assert.Equal("AB123CD", recognitionEvent.NormalizedPlateText);
        Assert.Equal("AB-123-CD", recognitionEvent.OriginalPlateText);
        Assert.Equal(0.94, recognitionEvent.Confidence);
        Assert.Equal(recognizedAt, recognitionEvent.RecognizedAtUtc);
        Assert.Equal("Validated", recognitionEvent.Status);
        Assert.Equal("Matched", recognitionEvent.VehicleMatchStatus);
    }

<file path="services/anpr-gate/AnprGate.Tests/Domain/Enums/EnumsTests.cs">
using System;
using System.Linq;
using AnprGate.Domain.Enums;

namespace AnprGate.Tests.Domain.Enums;

public class EnumsTests
{
    [Theory]
    [InlineData(CameraStatus.Provisioning)]
    [InlineData(CameraStatus.Active)]
    [InlineData(CameraStatus.Offline)]
    [InlineData(CameraStatus.Degraded)]
    [InlineData(CameraStatus.Maintenance)]
    [InlineData(CameraStatus.Suspended)]
    [InlineData(CameraStatus.Retired)]
    public void CameraStatus_ShouldContainKnownStates(CameraStatus status)
    {
        Assert.True(Enum.IsDefined(status));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CameraStatus_Provisioning_ShouldBeTheDefaultZeroValue()
    {
        Assert.Equal(0, (int)CameraStatus.Provisioning);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(CameraType.ANPR)]
    [InlineData(CameraType.Overview)]
    [InlineData(CameraType.Lane)]
    [InlineData(CameraType.Entry)]
    [InlineData(CameraType.Exit)]
    [InlineData(CameraType.Border)]
    [InlineData(CameraType.PlateCapture)]
    [InlineData(CameraType.Other)]
    public void CameraType_ShouldContainKnownCameraKinds(CameraType cameraType)
    {
        Assert.True(Enum.IsDefined(cameraType));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void GateStatus_Active_ShouldBeTheDefaultZeroValue()
    {
        // Assert
        Assert.Equal(0, (int)GateStatus.Active);
        Assert.Equal(GateStatus.Closed, Enum.Parse<GateStatus>("Closed"));
        Assert.Equal(GateStatus.EmergencyClosed, Enum.Parse<GateStatus>("EmergencyClosed"));
        Assert.False(Enum.IsDefined(typeof(GateStatus), 99));
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(GateType.PortEntry)]
    [InlineData(GateType.PortExit)]
    [InlineData(GateType.BorderEntry)]
    [InlineData(GateType.BorderExit)]
    [InlineData(GateType.DryPortEntry)]
    [InlineData(GateType.Checkpoint)]
    [InlineData(GateType.Other)]
    public void GateType_ShouldContainKnownGateKinds(GateType gateType)
    {
        Assert.True(Enum.IsDefined(gateType));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void RecognitionStatus_ShouldCoverTheRecognitionLifecycle()
    {
        // Assert
        Assert.Equal(0, (int)RecognitionStatus.Detected);
        Assert.Equal(RecognitionStatus.Validated, Enum.Parse<RecognitionStatus>("Validated"));
        Assert.Equal(RecognitionStatus.Matched, Enum.Parse<RecognitionStatus>("Matched"));
        Assert.Equal(RecognitionStatus.Unmatched, Enum.Parse<RecognitionStatus>("Unmatched"));
        Assert.Equal(RecognitionStatus.ManualReview, Enum.Parse<RecognitionStatus>("ManualReview"));
        Assert.Equal(RecognitionStatus.Expired, Enum.Parse<RecognitionStatus>("Expired"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AuthorizationStatus_ShouldCoverTheAuthorizationLifecycle()
    {
        // Assert
        Assert.Equal(0, (int)AuthorizationStatus.Requested);
        Assert.Equal(AuthorizationStatus.Evaluating, Enum.Parse<AuthorizationStatus>("Evaluating"));
        Assert.Equal(AuthorizationStatus.Authorized, Enum.Parse<AuthorizationStatus>("Authorized"));
        Assert.Equal(AuthorizationStatus.Denied, Enum.Parse<AuthorizationStatus>("Denied"));
        Assert.Equal(AuthorizationStatus.Expired, Enum.Parse<AuthorizationStatus>("Expired"));
        Assert.Equal(AuthorizationStatus.Cancelled, Enum.Parse<AuthorizationStatus>("Cancelled"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void PassageStatus_ShouldContainEightStates()
    {
        Assert.Equal(8, Enum.GetValues<PassageStatus>().Length);
        Assert.Equal(PassageStatus.PendingAuthorization, Enum.Parse<PassageStatus>("PendingAuthorization"));
        Assert.Equal(PassageStatus.Exception, Enum.Parse<PassageStatus>("Exception"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void BorderCrossingStatus_ShouldCoverTheCrossingLifecycle()
    {
        // Assert
        Assert.Equal(0, (int)BorderCrossingStatus.Approaching);
        Assert.Equal(BorderCrossingStatus.EntryDetected, Enum.Parse<BorderCrossingStatus>("EntryDetected"));
        Assert.Equal(BorderCrossingStatus.ExitDetected, Enum.Parse<BorderCrossingStatus>("ExitDetected"));
        Assert.Equal(BorderCrossingStatus.Completed, Enum.Parse<BorderCrossingStatus>("Completed"));
        Assert.Equal(BorderCrossingStatus.Denied, Enum.Parse<BorderCrossingStatus>("Denied"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Direction_ShouldHaveInboundAsZeroAndContainFourStates()
    {
        // Assert: direction drives lane/flow logic, ordering of Inbound first is relied upon
        Assert.Equal(0, (int)Direction.Inbound);
        Assert.Equal(4, Enum.GetValues<Direction>().Length);
        Assert.Equal(Direction.Outbound, Enum.Parse<Direction>("Outbound"));
        Assert.Equal(Direction.Bidirectional, Enum.Parse<Direction>("Bidirectional"));
        Assert.Equal(Direction.Unknown, Enum.Parse<Direction>("Unknown"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AllEnums_ShouldHaveNoDuplicateNames()
    {
        // Assert: duplicate names would break string-based persistence/serialization
        AssertNoDuplicateNames<CameraStatus>();
        AssertNoDuplicateNames<CameraType>();
        AssertNoDuplicateNames<GateStatus>();
        AssertNoDuplicateNames<GateType>();
        AssertNoDuplicateNames<RecognitionStatus>();
        AssertNoDuplicateNames<AuthorizationStatus>();
        AssertNoDuplicateNames<PassageStatus>();
        AssertNoDuplicateNames<BorderCrossingStatus>();
        AssertNoDuplicateNames<Direction>();
    }

    private static void AssertNoDuplicateNames<T>() where T : struct, Enum
    {
        var names = Enum.GetNames<T>();
        Assert.Equal(names.Length, names.Distinct().Count());
    }
}
