<file path="services/audit/Audit.Infrastructure/Persistence/AuditDbContext.cs">
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Audit.Domain.Entities;

namespace Audit.Infrastructure.Persistence;

public class AuditDbContext : DbContext
{
    // 1. Base Audit Ledger & Actors
    public DbSet<AuditEvent> AuditEvents { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<AuditActor> Actors { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<AuditResourceReference> ResourceReferences { get; set; } = null!;

    // 2. Deep Audit Types
    public DbSet<AuditChange> DataChanges { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<AuditApiRequest> ApiRequests { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<AuditDataAccess> DataAccessEvents { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<AuditSecurityEvent> SecurityEvents { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<AuditAccessEvent> AccessEvents { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<AuditConfigurationChange> ConfigurationChanges { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<AuditApproval> Approvals { get; set; } = null!;

    // 3. State & Alerts
    public DbSet<AuditStatusHistory> StatusHistories { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<AuditAlert> Alerts { get; set; } = null!;

    // 4. Cryptographic Hash Chain
    public DbSet<AuditIntegrityRecord> IntegrityRecords { get; set; } = null!;

    // 5. Lifecycle & Compliance
    public DbSet<AuditRetentionPolicy> RetentionPolicies { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<AuditLegalHold> LegalHolds { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<AuditArchive> Archives { get; set; } = null!;

    // 6. Export Mechanism
    public DbSet<AuditExport> Exports { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<AuditExportItem> ExportItems { get; set; } = null!;

    // 7. Resiliency & Messaging
    public DbSet<IdempotencyRecord> IdempotencyRecords { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<OutboxMessage> OutboxMessages { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<InboxMessage> InboxMessages { get; set; } = null!;

    public AuditDbContext(DbContextOptions<AuditDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);

        // 1. Base Audit Ledger
        modelBuilder.Entity<AuditEvent>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.OccurredAtUtc });
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.AuditReference }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => x.CorrelationId);
            e.HasIndex(x => x.TraceId);
            e.HasIndex(x => x.PreviousIntegrityHash); // Crucial for chaining
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<AuditActor>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.ActorType, x.ActorReference });
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<AuditResourceReference>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.ResourceType, x.ResourceId });
            e.HasIndex(x => x.AuditEventId);
        });

        // 2. Deep Audit Types
        modelBuilder.Entity<AuditChange>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.ResourceType, x.ResourceId });
            e.HasIndex(x => x.AuditEventId).IsUnique(); // 1:1 or 1:Many depending on event size, assuming 1:1 for data changes
            e.Property(x => x.BeforeSnapshotJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.Property(x => x.AfterSnapshotJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.Property(x => x.ChangedFieldsJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<AuditApiRequest>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.Route, x.StatusCode });
            e.HasIndex(x => x.AuditEventId).IsUnique();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<AuditDataAccess>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.ResourceType, x.ResourceId });
            e.HasIndex(x => x.AuditEventId).IsUnique();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<AuditSecurityEvent>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.SecurityEventType, x.DetectedAtUtc });
            e.HasIndex(x => x.AuditEventId).IsUnique();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<AuditAccessEvent>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.UserReference, x.ResourceType });
            e.HasIndex(x => x.AuditEventId).IsUnique();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<AuditConfigurationChange>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.ConfigurationType, x.ConfigurationReference });
            e.HasIndex(x => x.AuditEventId).IsUnique();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<AuditApproval>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.ResourceType, x.ResourceId });
            e.HasIndex(x => x.AuditEventId).IsUnique();
        });

        // 3. State & Alerts
        modelBuilder.Entity<AuditStatusHistory>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => x.AuditEventId);
            e.HasIndex(x => x.OccurredAtUtc);
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<AuditAlert>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.AlertReference }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.Status, x.DetectedAtUtc });
            e.HasIndex(x => x.SourceAuditEventId);
        });

        // 4. Cryptographic Hash Chain
        modelBuilder.Entity<AuditIntegrityRecord>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.CalculatedAtUtc });
            e.HasIndex(x => x.FirstAuditEventId);
            e.HasIndex(x => x.LastAuditEventId);
        });

        // 5. Lifecycle & Compliance
        modelBuilder.Entity<AuditRetentionPolicy>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.Category }).IsUnique();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<AuditLegalHold>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.Reference }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Status);
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<AuditArchive>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.ArchiveReference }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => x.PeriodStartUtc);
        });

        // 6. Export Mechanism
        modelBuilder.Entity<AuditExport>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.ExportReference }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Status);
            e.Property(x => x.FilterJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<AuditExportItem>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.ExportId, x.AuditEventId }).IsUnique();
        });

        // 7. Resiliency & Messaging
        modelBuilder.Entity<IdempotencyRecord>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.IdempotencyKey, x.Operation }).IsUnique();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<InboxMessage>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.MessageId, x.Consumer }).IsUnique();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<OutboxMessage>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Status);
            e.HasIndex(x => x.OccurredAtUtc);
            e.Property(x => x.PayloadJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });
    }
}

<file path="services/corridor/Corridor.Api/Controllers/TripsController.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using MediatR;
using Corridor.Application.Commands;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;

namespace Corridor.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/corridor/trips")]
[Authorize]
public class TripsController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;

    public TripsController(IMediator mediator)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
    }

    [HttpPost("{tripId}/deviations/detect")]
    [Authorize(Policy = "corridor.trip.manage")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> DetectDeviation(Guid tripId, [FromBody] DetectRouteDeviationCommand command)
    {
        if (!Guid.TryParse(User.FindFirst("tenant_id")?.Value, out var tenantId)) return Forbid();
        command.TenantId = tenantId;

        command.TripId = tripId;

        var deviated = await _mediator.Send(command);
        return Ok(new { TripId = tripId, Deviated = deviated });
    }
}

using BuildingBlocks.Web;
using Corridor.Application.Commands;
using Corridor.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

builder.Services.AddControllers();
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
builder.Services.AddSwaggerGen();

builder.Services.AddMediatR(cfg => cfg.RegisterServicesFromAssembly(typeof(DetectRouteDeviationCommand).Assembly));

// A01/A07: this service had no host, no authentication scheme and no authorization middleware.
builder.Services.AddPlatformJwtAuthentication(builder.Configuration);
builder.Services.AddPlatformSecurity(builder.Configuration);

builder.Services.AddAuthorization(options =>
{
    options.AddPolicy("corridor.trip.manage", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "corridor.trip.manage"));
});

var connectionString = builder.Configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection");
if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionString))
    throw new InvalidOperationException("ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection is required.");

builder.Services.AddDbContext<CorridorDbContext>(options => options.UseNpgsql(connectionString));
builder.Services.AddScoped<ICorridorDbContext>(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<CorridorDbContext>());

var app = builder.Build();

app.UsePlatformSecurity();
if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
{
    app.UseSwagger();
    app.UseSwaggerUI();
}

app.UseHttpsRedirection();
app.UseRouting();
app.UsePlatformCors();
app.UseRateLimiter();
app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseAuthorization();
app.MapControllers();

app.MapGet("/health/live", () => Results.Ok(new { status = "alive" })).AllowAnonymous();

app.Run();

public partial class Program { }

<file path="services/corridor/Corridor.Application/Commands/DetectRouteDeviationCommand.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using MediatR;
using Corridor.Domain.Entities;
using Corridor.Domain.Enums;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace Corridor.Application.Commands;

public class DetectRouteDeviationCommand : IRequest<bool>
{
    public Guid TenantId  { get; set; }
    public Guid TripId    { get; set; }
    public double Latitude  { get; set; }
    public double Longitude { get; set; }
}

/// <summary>
/// Application-layer abstraction over the Corridor persistence context.
/// Keeps Application free of any Infrastructure / EF dependency.
/// </summary>
public interface ICorridorDbContext
{
    IQueryable<Trip>         Trips        { get; }
    IQueryable<RouteVersion> RouteVersions { get; }
    Task<int> SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken);
}

public class DetectRouteDeviationCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<DetectRouteDeviationCommand, bool>
{
    private readonly ICorridorDbContext _context;

    public DetectRouteDeviationCommandHandler(ICorridorDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public async Task<bool> Handle(DetectRouteDeviationCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var trip = await _context.Trips
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(t => t.Id == request.TripId && t.TenantId == request.TenantId, cancellationToken);

        if (trip == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("Trip not found.");

        var routeVersion = await _context.RouteVersions
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(r => r.Id == trip.RouteVersionId, cancellationToken);

        if (routeVersion == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("RouteVersion not found.");

        // Create a PostGIS Point from the incoming GPS coordinates
        var point = new NetTopologySuite.Geometries.Point(request.Longitude, request.Latitude) { SRID = 4326 };

        // PostGIS distance check (simplified threshold comparison)
        var distance  = routeVersion.Geometry.Distance(point);
        var threshold = 0.005; // approx ~500m depending on projection

        if (distance > threshold)
        {
            // Route Deviation Detected — raise event / create RouteDeviation entity etc.
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }
}

{
    public Guid Id { get; set; } = Guid.NewGuid();

<file path="services/corridor/Corridor.Infrastructure/Persistence/CorridorDbContext.cs">
using System.Linq;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Corridor.Application.Commands;
using Corridor.Domain.Entities;

namespace Corridor.Infrastructure.Persistence;

public class CorridorDbContext : DbContext, ICorridorDbContext
{
    // 1. Corridor & Routes
    public DbSet<Domain.Entities.Corridor> Corridors { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<CorridorVersion> CorridorVersions { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<CorridorSegment> CorridorSegments { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<CorridorSegmentRule> CorridorSegmentRules { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<Route> Routes { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<RouteVersion> RouteVersions { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<RouteWaypoint> RouteWaypoints { get; set; } = null!;

    // 2. Checkpoints
    public DbSet<Checkpoint> Checkpoints { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<RouteCheckpoint> RouteCheckpoints { get; set; } = null!;

    // 3. Trip Lifecycle & Events
    public DbSet<Trip> Trips { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<TripVersion> TripVersions { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<TripMilestone> TripMilestones { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<TripCheckpointEvent> TripCheckpointEvents { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<TripEvent> TripEvents { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<TripStatusHistory> TripStatusHistories { get; set; } = null!;

    // 4. Eta & Delays
    public DbSet<TripEtaRecord> TripEtaRecords { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<TripDelay> TripDelays { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<RouteDeviation> RouteDeviations { get; set; } = null!;

    // 5. Incidents, Holds & Alerts
    public DbSet<TripIncident> TripIncidents { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<CorridorAlert> CorridorAlerts { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<TripHold> TripHolds { get; set; } = null!;

    // 6. Integrations & Platform Base
    public DbSet<CorridorExternalReference> CorridorExternalReferences { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<CorridorIntegrationRecord> CorridorIntegrationRecords { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<CorridorAuditEntry> CorridorAuditEntries { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<OutboxMessage> OutboxMessages { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<InboxMessage> InboxMessages { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IdempotencyRecord> IdempotencyRecords { get; set; } = null!;

    public CorridorDbContext(DbContextOptions<CorridorDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

    // ── ICorridorDbContext (Application-layer abstraction) ───────────────────
    IQueryable<Domain.Entities.Trip> ICorridorDbContext.Trips => Trips;
    IQueryable<RouteVersion> ICorridorDbContext.RouteVersions => RouteVersions;

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);
        
        // Ensure PostGIS is enabled
        modelBuilder.HasPostgresExtension("postgis");

        modelBuilder.Entity<Domain.Entities.Corridor>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.CorridorReference }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Status);
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<CorridorVersion>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.CorridorId, x.VersionNumber }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Status);
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<CorridorSegment>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.CorridorVersionId, x.SequenceNumber }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(x => x.Geometry).HasColumnType("geometry(LineString,4326)");
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Geometry).HasMethod("GIST");
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<CorridorSegmentRule>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.CorridorSegmentId, x.Status });
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<Route>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.RouteReference }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<RouteVersion>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.RouteId, x.VersionNumber }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Status);
            e.Property(x => x.Geometry).HasColumnType("geometry(LineString,4326)");
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Geometry).HasMethod("GIST");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<RouteWaypoint>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.RouteVersionId, x.SequenceNumber }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(x => x.Position).HasColumnType("geography(Point,4326)");
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Position).HasMethod("GIST");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<Checkpoint>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.CheckpointReference }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Status);
            e.Property(x => x.Position).HasColumnType("geography(Point,4326)");
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Position).HasMethod("GIST");
            e.Property(x => x.Geometry).HasColumnType("geometry(Geometry,4326)");
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Geometry).HasMethod("GIST");
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<RouteCheckpoint>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.RouteVersionId, x.SequenceNumber }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.CheckpointId });
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<Trip>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.TripReference }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.DispatchReference });
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.VehicleReference, x.Status });
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.DriverReference, x.Status });
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.CorridorId, x.RouteId });

<file path="services/corridor/Corridor.Infrastructure/Repositories/CorridorRepository.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Corridor.Domain.Entities;
using Corridor.Domain.Repositories;
using Corridor.Infrastructure.Persistence;

namespace Corridor.Infrastructure.Repositories;

public class CorridorRepository : ICorridorRepository
{
    private readonly CorridorDbContext _context;

    public CorridorRepository(CorridorDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public async Task<Trip> GetTripByIdAsync(Guid id, Guid tenantId)
    {
        return await _context.Trips.FirstOrDefaultAsync(t => t.Id == id && t.TenantId == tenantId);
    }

    public async Task<RouteVersion> GetRouteVersionByIdAsync(Guid id)
    {
        return await _context.RouteVersions.FindAsync(id);
    }

    public async Task AddAsync(object entity)
    {
        await _context.AddAsync(entity);
    }

    public async Task UpdateAsync(object entity)
    {
        _context.Update(entity);
        await Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    public async Task SaveChangesAsync()
    {
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
    }
}

<file path="services/customs/Customs.Api/Controllers/CustomsCasesController.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using MediatR;
using Customs.Application.Commands;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;

namespace Customs.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/[controller]")]
[Authorize]
public class CustomsCasesController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;

    public CustomsCasesController(IMediator mediator)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
    }

    [HttpPost]
    [Authorize(Policy = "customs.case.create")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> CreateCase([FromBody] ReceiveDeclarationCommand command)
    {
        if (!Guid.TryParse(User.FindFirst("tenant_id")?.Value, out var tenantId)) return Forbid();
        command.TenantId = tenantId;

        // UserId from claims
        if (User.HasClaim(c => c.Type == "sub"))
        {
            command.UserId = Guid.Parse(User.FindFirst("sub").Value);
        }

        var caseId = await _mediator.Send(command);
        return CreatedAtAction(nameof(GetCase), new { id = caseId }, new { CaseId = caseId });
    }

    [HttpGet("{id}")]
    [Authorize(Policy = "customs.case.read")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetCase(Guid id)
    {
        return Problem(statusCode: StatusCodes.Status501NotImplemented, title: "Case lookup is not implemented.");
    }

    [HttpPost("{id}/risk-assessment")]
    [Authorize(Policy = "customs.risk.assess")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> StartRiskAssessment(Guid id)
    {
        return Problem(statusCode: StatusCodes.Status501NotImplemented, title: "Risk assessment is not implemented.");
    }
}

<file path="services/customs/Customs.Api/Program.cs">
using Customs.Application.Commands;
using BuildingBlocks.Web;
using Serilog;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

builder.Host.UseSerilog((ctx, cfg) =>
    cfg.ReadFrom.Configuration(ctx.Configuration));

builder.Services.AddControllers();
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
builder.Services.AddSwaggerGen();

builder.Services.AddMediatR(cfg =>
    cfg.RegisterServicesFromAssembly(typeof(ReceiveDeclarationCommand).Assembly));

// A05/A07: the previous AddJwtBearer() call had no signing key, issuer or audience configured, so
// it could neither authenticate nor validate anything. JWT validation is now shared with the other
// services through the platform building block (32-byte HS256 key, issuer/audience/lifetime checks).
builder.Services.AddPlatformJwtAuthentication(builder.Configuration);

// Platform-wide security defaults: deny-by-default fallback policy (A01), rate limiting (A07),
// config-driven CORS, ProblemDetails exception handling and security headers (A05/A09).
builder.Services.AddPlatformSecurity(builder.Configuration);

builder.Services.AddAuthorization(opts =>
{
    opts.AddPolicy("customs.case.create", p => p.RequireClaim("permissions", "customs.case.create"));
    opts.AddPolicy("customs.case.read",   p => p.RequireClaim("permissions", "customs.case.read"));
    opts.AddPolicy("customs.risk.assess", p => p.RequireClaim("permissions", "customs.risk.assess"));
});

var app = builder.Build();

app.UsePlatformSecurity();
if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
{
    app.UseSwagger();
    app.UseSwaggerUI();
}

app.UseHttpsRedirection();
app.UseRouting();
app.UsePlatformCors();
app.UseRateLimiter();
app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseAuthorization();

app.MapControllers();
app.MapGet("/health/live", () => Results.Ok(new { status = "alive" })).AllowAnonymous();

app.Run();
</file>

<file path="services/customs/Customs.Application/Commands/ReceiveDeclarationCommand.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using MediatR;
using Customs.Domain.Entities;
using FluentValidation;

namespace Customs.Application.Commands;

public class ReceiveDeclarationCommand : IRequest<Guid>
{
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public string DeclarationExternalId { get; set; }
    public string DeclarationNumber { get; set; }
    public string ECTNExternalId { get; set; }
    public string ECTNNumber { get; set; }
    public string ProcedureCode { get; set; }
    public string ImporterReference { get; set; }
    public string ExporterReference { get; set; }
    public string DeclarantReference { get; set; }
    public string PortOfEntry { get; set; }
    public string PortOfExit { get; set; }
    public string CountryOfOrigin { get; set; }
    public string CountryOfDestination { get; set; }
    public Guid UserId { get; set; }
}

public class ReceiveDeclarationCommandValidator : AbstractValidator<ReceiveDeclarationCommand>
{
    public ReceiveDeclarationCommandValidator()
    {
        RuleFor(x => x.TenantId).NotEmpty();
        RuleFor(x => x.DeclarationExternalId).NotEmpty();
        RuleFor(x => x.DeclarationNumber).NotEmpty();
        RuleFor(x => x.ProcedureCode).NotEmpty();
        RuleFor(x => x.UserId).NotEmpty();
    }
}

public interface ICustomsCaseNumberGenerator
{
    string Generate(Guid tenantId);
}

public interface ICustomsDbContext
{
    // DbSet for Entities (To be implemented by EF Core DbContext)
    Task<int> SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken);
    void AddCustomsCase(CustomsCase customsCase);
}

public class ReceiveDeclarationCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<ReceiveDeclarationCommand, Guid>
{
    private readonly ICustomsDbContext _context;
    private readonly ICustomsCaseNumberGenerator _numberGenerator;

    public ReceiveDeclarationCommandHandler(ICustomsDbContext context, ICustomsCaseNumberGenerator numberGenerator)
    {
        _context = context;
        _numberGenerator = numberGenerator;
    }

    public async Task<Guid> Handle(ReceiveDeclarationCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var caseNumber = _numberGenerator.Generate(request.TenantId);

        var customsCase = new CustomsCase(
            request.TenantId,
            request.DeclarationExternalId,
            request.DeclarationNumber,
            request.ECTNExternalId,
            request.ECTNNumber,
            caseNumber,
            request.ProcedureCode,
            request.ImporterReference,
            request.ExporterReference,
            request.DeclarantReference,
            request.PortOfEntry,
            request.PortOfExit,
            request.CountryOfOrigin,
            request.CountryOfDestination,
            request.UserId
        );

        _context.AddCustomsCase(customsCase);
        
        // Outbox event could be published here
        
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

        return customsCase.Id;
    }
}

<file path="services/customs/Customs.Domain/Entities/CustomsCase.cs">
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Customs.Domain.Entities;

public class CustomsCase
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; } = Guid.NewGuid();
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public Guid? OrganizationId { get; set; }
    
    public string CaseNumber { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public Guid DeclarationId { get; set; }
    public string DeclarationExternalId { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string DeclarationNumber { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public int DeclarationVersionNumber { get; set; }
    public string? ECTNExternalId { get; set; }
    public string? EctnNumber { get; set; }
    
    public string ProcedureCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string CaseType { get; set; } = "Import"; // Import, Export, Transit, ReExport, TemporaryImport, TemporaryExport, FreeZone, Warehousing, Other
    
    public string ImporterReference { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string ExporterReference { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string DeclarantReference { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string PortOfEntry { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string PortOfExit { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string CountryOfOrigin { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string CountryOfDestination { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    public string Status { get; set; } = "Received"; // Received, ValidationPending, RiskAssessment, Assessment, InspectionPending, Inspection, DutyAssessed, PaymentPending, PaymentConfirmed, ClearanceReview, Cleared, ReleaseAuthorized, Released, Held, Rejected, Cancelled, Reassessment
    
    public DateTime OpenedAtUtc { get; set; } = DateTime.UtcNow;
    public DateTime? ClosedAtUtc { get; set; }
    
    public DateTime CreatedAtUtc { get; set; } = DateTime.UtcNow;
    public DateTime UpdatedAtUtc { get; set; } = DateTime.UtcNow;
    public Guid CreatedBy { get; set; }
    public Guid? UpdatedBy { get; set; }
    
    public byte[] Version { get; set; } = Array.Empty<byte>();

    public ICollection<CustomsReference> References { get; set; } = new List<CustomsReference>();
    public ICollection<CustomsAssessment> Assessments { get; set; } = new List<CustomsAssessment>();
    public ICollection<CustomsValuation> Valuations { get; set; } = new List<CustomsValuation>();
    public ICollection<CustomsHold> Holds { get; set; } = new List<CustomsHold>();
    public ICollection<CustomsDiscrepancy> Discrepancies { get; set; } = new List<CustomsDiscrepancy>();
    public ICollection<CustomsDecision> Decisions { get; set; } = new List<CustomsDecision>();
    public ICollection<CustomsStatusHistory> StatusHistories { get; set; } = new List<CustomsStatusHistory>();

    public CustomsCase() { }

    public CustomsCase(
        Guid tenantId,
        string declarationExternalId,
        string declarationNumber,
        string ectnExternalId,
        string ectnNumber,
        string caseNumber,
        string procedureCode,
        string importerReference,
        string exporterReference,
        string declarantReference,
        string portOfEntry,
        string portOfExit,
        string countryOfOrigin,
        string countryOfDestination,
        Guid userId)
    {
        TenantId = tenantId;
        DeclarationExternalId = declarationExternalId ?? string.Empty;
        DeclarationNumber = declarationNumber ?? string.Empty;
        ECTNExternalId = ectnExternalId;
        EctnNumber = ectnNumber;
        CaseNumber = caseNumber ?? string.Empty;
        ProcedureCode = procedureCode ?? string.Empty;
        ImporterReference = importerReference ?? string.Empty;
        ExporterReference = exporterReference ?? string.Empty;
        DeclarantReference = declarantReference ?? string.Empty;
        PortOfEntry = portOfEntry ?? string.Empty;
        PortOfExit = portOfExit ?? string.Empty;
        CountryOfOrigin = countryOfOrigin ?? string.Empty;
        CountryOfDestination = countryOfDestination ?? string.Empty;
        CreatedBy = userId;
        Status = "Received";
        OpenedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        CreatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        UpdatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }
}
</file>

<file path="services/customs/Customs.Domain/Policies/CustomsStateTransitionPolicy.cs">
using System;
using Customs.Domain.Enums;
using Customs.Domain.Entities;

namespace Customs.Domain.Policies;

public interface ICustomsStateTransitionPolicy
{
    bool CanTransition(CustomsStatus currentStatus, CustomsStatus targetStatus);
    void EnforceTransitionRules(CustomsCase customsCase, CustomsStatus targetStatus);
}

public class CustomsStateTransitionPolicy : ICustomsStateTransitionPolicy
{
    public bool CanTransition(CustomsStatus currentStatus, CustomsStatus targetStatus)
    {
        return (currentStatus, targetStatus) switch
        {
            (CustomsStatus.Received, CustomsStatus.ValidationPending) => true,
            (CustomsStatus.ValidationPending, CustomsStatus.RiskAssessment) => true,
            (CustomsStatus.ValidationPending, CustomsStatus.Rejected) => true,
            (CustomsStatus.RiskAssessment, CustomsStatus.Assessment) => true,
            (CustomsStatus.RiskAssessment, CustomsStatus.InspectionPending) => true,
            (CustomsStatus.RiskAssessment, CustomsStatus.NoInspection) => true,
            (CustomsStatus.InspectionPending, CustomsStatus.Assessment) => true,
            (CustomsStatus.NoInspection, CustomsStatus.Assessment) => true,
            (CustomsStatus.Assessment, CustomsStatus.DutyAssessed) => true,
            (CustomsStatus.DutyAssessed, CustomsStatus.PaymentPending) => true,
            (CustomsStatus.DutyAssessed, CustomsStatus.ClearanceReview) => true, // if no payment required (e.g. exempt)
            (CustomsStatus.PaymentPending, CustomsStatus.PaymentConfirmed) => true,
            (CustomsStatus.PaymentConfirmed, CustomsStatus.ClearanceReview) => true,
            (CustomsStatus.ClearanceReview, CustomsStatus.Cleared) => true,
            (CustomsStatus.ClearanceReview, CustomsStatus.Rejected) => true,
            (CustomsStatus.Cleared, CustomsStatus.ReleaseAuthorized) => true,
            (CustomsStatus.ReleaseAuthorized, CustomsStatus.Released) => true,
            // Allow hold from any active processing state
            (CustomsStatus.Assessment, CustomsStatus.Held) => true,
            (CustomsStatus.PaymentPending, CustomsStatus.Held) => true,
            (CustomsStatus.ClearanceReview, CustomsStatus.Held) => true,
            _ => false
        };
    }

    public void EnforceTransitionRules(CustomsCase customsCase, CustomsStatus targetStatus)
    {
        if (!Enum.TryParse<CustomsStatus>(customsCase.Status, true, out var currentStatus))
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Invalid or unrecognized current status: '{customsCase.Status}'");
        }

        if (!CanTransition(currentStatus, targetStatus))
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Invalid state transition from {currentStatus} to {targetStatus}");
        }
    }
}
</file>

<file path="services/customs/Customs.Domain/Policies/DomainPolicies.cs">
using System;
using Customs.Domain.Entities;
using Customs.Domain.Enums;

namespace Customs.Domain.Policies;

public interface IRiskRuleEngine
{
    RiskResult Evaluate(CustomsCase customsCase);
}

public class RiskResult
{
    public RiskLevel Level { get; set; } = RiskLevel.Low;
    public string[] MatchedRules { get; set; } = Array.Empty<string>();
    public string[] Reasons { get; set; } = Array.Empty<string>();
    public decimal RiskScore { get; set; }
}

public interface ICustomsValuationPolicy
{
    decimal CalculateCustomsValue(CustomsValuation valuation);
}

public class CustomsValuationPolicy : ICustomsValuationPolicy
{
    public decimal CalculateCustomsValue(CustomsValuation valuation)
    {
        var rate = valuation.ExchangeRate <= 0 ? 1m : valuation.ExchangeRate;

        if (string.Equals(valuation.ValuationMethod, nameof(ValuationMethod.TransactionValue), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
            string.Equals(valuation.ValuationMethod, "TransactionValue", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            var cif = valuation.InvoiceValue + valuation.FreightValue + valuation.InsuranceValue + valuation.Additions - valuation.Deductions;
            return Math.Max(0, cif * rate);
        }
        
        // Default calculation for other methods until explicitly implemented
        return Math.Max(0, valuation.InvoiceValue * rate);
    }
}

using BuildingBlocks.Persistence; // Assuming SmartDbContext is located here

namespace Customs.Infrastructure.Persistence;

public class CustomsDbContext : SmartDbContext<CustomsDbContext>
{
    public CustomsDbContext(DbContextOptions<CustomsDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

    // Core Case & Assessment
    public DbSet<CustomsCase> CustomsCases => Set<CustomsCase>();
    public DbSet<CustomsReference> CustomsReferences => Set<CustomsReference>();
    
    public DbSet<CustomsAssessment> CustomsAssessments => Set<CustomsAssessment>();

    public DbSet<CustomsValuationComponent> CustomsValuationComponents => Set<CustomsValuationComponent>();
    
    public DbSet<CustomsReassessment> CustomsReassessments => Set<CustomsReassessment>();

    // Risk, Inspection, Holds, and Decisions

    public DbSet<TariffItem> TariffItems => Set<TariffItem>();

    public DbSet<CustomsConfigurationApproval> CustomsConfigurationApprovals => Set<CustomsConfigurationApproval>();
    public DbSet<CustomsConfigurationAudit> CustomsConfigurationAudits => Set<CustomsConfigurationAudit>();

    // Integration
    public DbSet<OutboxMessage> OutboxMessages => Set<OutboxMessage>();
    public DbSet<InboxMessage> InboxMessages => Set<InboxMessage>();
    public DbSet<IdempotencyRecord> IdempotencyRecords => Set<IdempotencyRecord>();

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder builder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(builder);

        // Core Aggregate
        builder.Entity<CustomsCase>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(c => new { c.TenantId, c.CaseNumber }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(c => c.OrganizationId);
            e.HasIndex(c => new { c.TenantId, c.Status });
            e.HasIndex(c => new { c.TenantId, c.CreatedAtUtc });
            e.HasIndex(c => c.DeclarationId);
            e.HasIndex(c => c.EctnNumber);
            e.Property(c => c.Version).IsRowVersion();
            
            // Restrict cascading delete from Case
            e.HasMany(c => c.Assessments).WithOne(a => a.CustomsCase).HasForeignKey(a => a.CustomsCaseId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
            e.HasMany(c => c.Valuations).WithOne(v => v.CustomsCase).HasForeignKey(v => v.CustomsCaseId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
            e.HasMany(c => c.Holds).WithOne(h => h.CustomsCase).HasForeignKey(h => h.CustomsCaseId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
            e.HasMany(c => c.Discrepancies).WithOne(d => d.CustomsCase).HasForeignKey(d => d.CustomsCaseId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
            e.HasMany(c => c.Decisions).WithOne(d => d.CustomsCase).HasForeignKey(d => d.CustomsCaseId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
            e.HasMany(c => c.StatusHistories).WithOne(sh => sh.CustomsCase).HasForeignKey(sh => sh.CustomsCaseId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
            e.HasMany(c => c.References).WithOne(r => r.CustomsCase).HasForeignKey(r => r.CustomsCaseId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        // Assessment
        builder.Entity<CustomsAssessment>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(a => new { a.CustomsCaseId, a.AssessmentVersion }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(a => a.DeclarationId);
            e.HasIndex(a => a.AssessmentNumber);
            e.HasIndex(a => a.Status);
            e.HasIndex(a => a.CalculatedAtUtc);
            
            e.Property(a => a.CustomsValue).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(a => a.DutyAmount).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(a => a.CustomsChargesAmount).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(a => a.TotalAmount).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(a => a.Version).IsRowVersion();

            e.HasMany(a => a.DutyAssessments).WithOne(da => da.CustomsAssessment).HasForeignKey(da => da.CustomsAssessmentId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
            e.HasMany(a => a.TaxAssessments).WithOne(ta => ta.CustomsAssessment).HasForeignKey(ta => ta.CustomsAssessmentId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
            e.HasMany(a => a.Lines).WithOne(al => al.CustomsAssessment).HasForeignKey(al => al.CustomsAssessmentId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        // Duty Assessment
        builder.Entity<DutyAssessment>(e =>
        {
            e.Property(da => da.Rate).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(da => da.TaxableBase).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(da => da.Quantity).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(da => da.CalculatedAmount).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(da => da.CalculationTraceJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        // Tax Assessment
        builder.Entity<TaxAssessment>(e =>
        {
            e.Property(ta => ta.TaxableBase).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(ta => ta.Rate).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(ta => ta.Amount).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(ta => ta.CalculationTraceJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });
        
        // Customs Assessment Line
        builder.Entity<CustomsAssessmentLine>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(l => new { l.CustomsAssessmentId, l.LineNumber }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(l => l.TaxableBase).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(l => l.Rate).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(l => l.Quantity).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(l => l.Amount).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(l => l.CalculationTraceJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        // Valuation
        builder.Entity<CustomsValuation>(e =>
        {
            e.Property(v => v.InvoiceValue).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(v => v.FreightValue).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(v => v.InsuranceValue).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(v => v.Additions).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(v => v.Deductions).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(v => v.ExchangeRate).HasColumnType("numeric(19,6)"); // Standard for exchange rates
            e.Property(v => v.ConvertedValue).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(v => v.Version).IsRowVersion();

            e.HasMany(v => v.Components).WithOne(c => c.CustomsValuation).HasForeignKey(c => c.CustomsValuationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        builder.Entity<CustomsValuationComponent>(e =>
        {
            e.Property(c => c.Amount).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
        });

        // Configuration - Tariff Schedule
        builder.Entity<TariffScheduleVersion>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(tsv => new { tsv.TariffScheduleId, tsv.VersionNumber }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(tsv => tsv.Version).IsRowVersion();
            
            e.HasMany(tsv => tsv.TariffItems).WithOne(ti => ti.TariffScheduleVersion).HasForeignKey(ti => ti.TariffScheduleVersionId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });
        
        builder.Entity<TariffItem>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(ti => ti.HsCode);
            e.HasIndex(ti => ti.ProcedureCode);
            e.HasIndex(ti => ti.OriginCountryCode);
            e.HasIndex(ti => ti.EffectiveFromUtc);
            e.HasIndex(ti => ti.EffectiveToUtc);
            e.HasIndex(ti => ti.Status);
            
            e.Property(ti => ti.Rate).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(ti => ti.SecondaryRate).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(ti => ti.MinimumAmount).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(ti => ti.MaximumAmount).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(ti => ti.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        // Configuration - Rates
        builder.Entity<CustomsRateVersion>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(crv => new { crv.CustomsRateId, crv.VersionNumber }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(crv => crv.Rate).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(crv => crv.MinimumAmount).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(crv => crv.MaximumAmount).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(crv => crv.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        // Configuration - Rules
        builder.Entity<CustomsRuleVersion>(e =>
        {
            e.Property(crv => crv.RuleDefinitionJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });
        
        builder.Entity<RiskRule>(e =>
        {
            e.Property(rr => rr.RuleDefinitionJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.Property(rr => rr.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });
        
        builder.Entity<ExemptionRule>(e =>
        {
            e.Property(er => er.EligibilityDefinitionJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.Property(er => er.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        builder.Entity<ExchangeRateConfiguration>(e =>
        {
            e.Property(erc => erc.Rate).HasColumnType("numeric(19,6)");
        });

        builder.Entity<CustomsConfigurationAudit>(e =>
        {
            e.Property(cca => cca.BeforeJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.Property(cca => cca.AfterJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        // Customs Reference
        builder.Entity<CustomsReference>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(r => new { r.TenantId, r.ReferenceType, r.NormalizedValue });
        });

        // Clearance
        builder.Entity<CustomsClearance>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(c => new { c.CustomsCaseId, c.Status });
            e.HasIndex(c => c.ClearanceNumber);
            e.Property(c => c.Version).IsRowVersion();
            
            e.HasMany(c => c.ReleaseAuthorizations).WithOne(ra => ra.Clearance).HasForeignKey(ra => ra.ClearanceId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
        });

        builder.Entity<ReleaseAuthorization>(e =>

            e.HasIndex(ra => new { ra.CustomsCaseId, ra.Status });
            e.HasIndex(ra => ra.AuthorizationNumber);
            e.HasIndex(ra => ra.ExpiresAtUtc);
            e.Property(ra => ra.ConditionsJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.Property(ra => ra.Version).IsRowVersion();

            e.HasIndex(h => new { h.CustomsCaseId, h.Status, h.HoldType });
        });

        // Inspection
        builder.Entity<InspectionOrder>(e =>

            e.HasIndex(i => new { i.CustomsCaseId, i.Status });
            e.HasIndex(i => i.ScheduledAtUtc);
            e.Property(i => i.Version).IsRowVersion();
            
            e.HasMany(io => io.Results).WithOne(ir => ir.InspectionOrder).HasForeignKey(ir => ir.InspectionOrderId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);

        builder.Entity<InspectionResult>(e =>

<file path="services/customs/Customs.Infrastructure/Repositories/CustomsRepository.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Customs.Domain.Entities;
using Customs.Domain.Repositories;
using Customs.Infrastructure.Persistence;

namespace Customs.Infrastructure.Repositories;

public class CustomsRepository : ICustomsRepository
{
    private readonly CustomsDbContext _context;

    public CustomsRepository(CustomsDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public async Task<CustomsCase> GetCaseByIdAsync(Guid id, Guid tenantId)
    {
        return await _context.CustomsCases.FirstOrDefaultAsync(c => c.Id == id && c.TenantId == tenantId);
    }

    public async Task AddAsync(CustomsCase customsCase)
    {
        await _context.CustomsCases.AddAsync(customsCase);
    }

    public async Task UpdateAsync(CustomsCase customsCase)
    {
        _context.CustomsCases.Update(customsCase);
        await Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    public async Task SaveChangesAsync()
    {
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
    }
}

<file path="services/customs/Customs.Tests/Api/Controllers/CustomsCasesControllerTests.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Customs.Api.Controllers;
using Customs.Application.Commands;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Moq;
using System.Security.Claims;
using Xunit;

namespace Customs.Tests.Api.Controllers;

public class CustomsCasesControllerTests
{
    private readonly Mock<IMediator> _mockMediator;
    private readonly CustomsCasesController _controller;

    public CustomsCasesControllerTests()
    {
        _mockMediator = new Mock<IMediator>();
        _controller = new CustomsCasesController(_mockMediator.Object);
    }

    private void SetUserClaims(Guid tenantId, Guid userId)
    {
        var claims = new[]
        {
            new Claim("tenant_id", tenantId.ToString()),
            new Claim("sub", userId.ToString())
        };
        var identity = new ClaimsIdentity(claims, "TestAuth");
        var user = new ClaimsPrincipal(identity);

        _controller.ControllerContext = new ControllerContext
        {
            HttpContext = new DefaultHttpContext { User = user }
        };
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task CreateCase_Should_Return_201_Created_With_CaseId()
    {
        // Arrange
        var tenantId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var userId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var newCaseId = Guid.NewGuid();

        SetUserClaims(tenantId, userId);

        _mockMediator
            .Setup(m => m.Send(It.IsAny<ReceiveDeclarationCommand>(), default))
            .ReturnsAsync(newCaseId);

        var command = new ReceiveDeclarationCommand
        {
            DeclarationExternalId = "DEC-EXT-001",
            DeclarationNumber = "1000001",
            ProcedureCode = "IM4",
            PortOfEntry = "GEN",
            CountryOfOrigin = "CN",
            CountryOfDestination = "SO"
        };

        // Act
        var result = await _controller.CreateCase(command);

        // Assert
        var createdResult = Assert.IsType<CreatedAtActionResult>(result);
        Assert.Equal(201, createdResult.StatusCode);
        Assert.NotNull(createdResult.Value);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task CreateCase_Should_Set_TenantId_From_Claims()
    {
        // Arrange
        var tenantId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var userId = Guid.NewGuid();

        SetUserClaims(tenantId, userId);

        ReceiveDeclarationCommand? capturedCommand = null;
        _mockMediator
            .Setup(m => m.Send(It.IsAny<ReceiveDeclarationCommand>(), default))
            .Callback<IRequest<Guid>, System.Threading.CancellationToken>((cmd, _) =>
                capturedCommand = cmd as ReceiveDeclarationCommand)
            .ReturnsAsync(Guid.NewGuid());

        var command = new ReceiveDeclarationCommand
        {
            DeclarationExternalId = "DEC-EXT-002",
            DeclarationNumber = "2000002",
            ProcedureCode = "EX3"
        };

        // Act
        await _controller.CreateCase(command);

        // Assert: TenantId was populated from JWT claims
        Assert.NotNull(capturedCommand);
        Assert.Equal(tenantId, capturedCommand!.TenantId);
        Assert.Equal(userId, capturedCommand.UserId);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task CreateCase_Should_Return_Forbid_When_TenantId_Claim_Missing()
    {
        // Arrange - No claims set (no tenant_id claim)
        _controller.ControllerContext = new ControllerContext
        {
            HttpContext = new DefaultHttpContext { User = new ClaimsPrincipal() }
        };

        var command = new ReceiveDeclarationCommand
        {
            DeclarationNumber = "3000003"
        };

        // Act
        var result = await _controller.CreateCase(command);

        // Assert
        Assert.IsType<ForbidResult>(result);

        // Mediator should NOT have been called
        _mockMediator.Verify(m => m.Send(It.IsAny<ReceiveDeclarationCommand>(), default), Times.Never);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task GetCase_Should_Return_501_NotImplemented()
    {
        // Arrange
        var caseId = Guid.NewGuid();

        // Act
        var result = await _controller.GetCase(caseId);

        // Assert
        var problemResult = Assert.IsType<ObjectResult>(result);
        Assert.Equal(501, problemResult.StatusCode);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task StartRiskAssessment_Should_Return_501_NotImplemented()
    {
        // Arrange
        var caseId = Guid.NewGuid();

        // Act
        var result = await _controller.StartRiskAssessment(caseId);

        // Assert
        var problemResult = Assert.IsType<ObjectResult>(result);
        Assert.Equal(501, problemResult.StatusCode);
    }
}

using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Customs.Application.Commands;
using Customs.Domain.Entities;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Customs.Tests.Application.Commands;

public class ReceiveDeclarationCommandHandlerTests
{
    private readonly Mock<ICustomsDbContext> _mockContext;
    private readonly Mock<ICustomsCaseNumberGenerator> _mockNumberGenerator;
    private readonly ReceiveDeclarationCommandHandler _handler;

    public ReceiveDeclarationCommandHandlerTests()
    {
        _mockContext = new Mock<ICustomsDbContext>();
        _mockNumberGenerator = new Mock<ICustomsCaseNumberGenerator>();
        _handler = new ReceiveDeclarationCommandHandler(_mockContext.Object, _mockNumberGenerator.Object);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_Should_Create_CustomsCase_And_Return_Id()
    {
        // Arrange
        var tenantId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var userId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var generatedCaseNumber = "CASE-2026-001";

        _mockNumberGenerator
            .Setup(g => g.Generate(tenantId))
            .Returns(generatedCaseNumber);

        _mockContext
            .Setup(c => c.SaveChangesAsync(It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .ReturnsAsync(1);

        var command = new ReceiveDeclarationCommand
        {
            TenantId = tenantId,
            DeclarationExternalId = "DEC-EXT-001",
            DeclarationNumber = "1000001",
            ECTNExternalId = "ECTN-EXT-001",
            ECTNNumber = "ECTN-2026-GEN-001",
            ProcedureCode = "IM4",
            ImporterReference = "IMP-001",
            ExporterReference = "EXP-002",
            DeclarantReference = "DCL-003",
            PortOfEntry = "GEN",
            PortOfExit = "SHA",
            CountryOfOrigin = "CN",
            CountryOfDestination = "SO",
            UserId = userId
        };

        // Act
        var resultId = await _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotEqual(Guid.Empty, resultId);

        // Verify AddCustomsCase was called once
        _mockContext.Verify(c => c.AddCustomsCase(It.Is<CustomsCase>(cc =>
            cc.TenantId == tenantId &&
            cc.DeclarationNumber == "1000001" &&
            cc.CaseNumber == generatedCaseNumber &&
            cc.Status == "Received" &&
            cc.CreatedBy == userId
        )), Times.Once);

        // Verify SaveChangesAsync was called once
        _mockContext.Verify(c => c.SaveChangesAsync(It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()), Times.Once);

        // Verify case number generator was called
        _mockNumberGenerator.Verify(g => g.Generate(tenantId), Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_Should_Use_Generated_CaseNumber()
    {
        // Arrange
        var tenantId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var expectedCaseNumber = "CASE-2026-XYZ-999";

        _mockNumberGenerator
            .Setup(g => g.Generate(tenantId))
            .Returns(expectedCaseNumber);

        _mockContext
            .Setup(c => c.SaveChangesAsync(It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .ReturnsAsync(1);

        var command = new ReceiveDeclarationCommand
        {
            TenantId = tenantId,
            DeclarationExternalId = "DEC-EXT-002",
            DeclarationNumber = "2000002",
            ProcedureCode = "IM4",
            UserId = Guid.NewGuid()
        };

        // Act
        await _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert: case number came from generator
        _mockContext.Verify(c => c.AddCustomsCase(It.Is<CustomsCase>(cc =>
            cc.CaseNumber == expectedCaseNumber
        )), Times.Once);
    }
}

        Assert.Empty(assessment.TaxAssessments);

        Assert.Empty(assessment.Lines);

using System;
using Customs.Domain.Entities;
using Xunit;

namespace Customs.Tests.Entities;

public class CustomsValuationTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void CustomsValuation_Should_Initialize_With_Correct_Defaults()
    {
        // Arrange
        var caseId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var declarationId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var calculatedBy = Guid.NewGuid();

        // Act
        var valuation = new CustomsValuation
        {
            CustomsCaseId = caseId,
            DeclarationId = declarationId,
            ValuationMethod = "TransactionValue",
            InvoiceValue = 8000m,
            FreightValue = 300m,
            InsuranceValue = 100m,
            Additions = 50m,
            Deductions = 0m,
            ExchangeRate = 1.0m,
            ConvertedValue = 8450m,
            CurrencyCode = "USD",
            BaseCurrencyCode = "USD",
            CalculatedBy = calculatedBy
        };

        // Assert
        Assert.NotEqual(Guid.Empty, valuation.Id);
        Assert.Equal(caseId, valuation.CustomsCaseId);
        Assert.Equal("TransactionValue", valuation.ValuationMethod);
        Assert.Equal("Calculated", valuation.Status);
        Assert.Equal(8000m, valuation.InvoiceValue);
        Assert.Equal(300m, valuation.FreightValue);
        Assert.Equal(100m, valuation.InsuranceValue);
        Assert.Equal(8450m, valuation.ConvertedValue);
        Assert.Equal("USD", valuation.CurrencyCode);
        Assert.Equal("USD", valuation.BaseCurrencyCode);
        
        // Collections should be initialized and empty
        Assert.NotNull(valuation.Components);
        Assert.Empty(valuation.Components);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CustomsValuation_CIF_Value_Should_Equal_Sum_Of_Invoice_Freight_Insurance()
    {
        // Arrange - CIF = Cost + Insurance + Freight
        var invoice  = 10000m;
        var freight  = 500m;
        var insurance = 200m;
        var expectedCIF = invoice + freight + insurance; // 10700m

        // Act
        var valuation = new CustomsValuation
        {
            InvoiceValue  = invoice,
            FreightValue  = freight,
            InsuranceValue = insurance,
            ConvertedValue = expectedCIF,
            ExchangeRate = 1.0m
        };

        // Assert
        Assert.Equal(expectedCIF, valuation.ConvertedValue);
        Assert.Equal(10700m, valuation.ConvertedValue);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CustomsValuation_With_ExchangeRate_Should_Convert_Correctly()
    {
        // Arrange - USD to SOS (Somalia Shilling) conversion
        var invoiceUSD   = 5000m;
        var exchangeRate = 570m;  // 1 USD = 570 SOS
        var expectedConverted = invoiceUSD * exchangeRate; // 2,850,000 SOS

        // Act
        var valuation = new CustomsValuation
        {
            InvoiceValue    = invoiceUSD,
            ExchangeRate    = exchangeRate,
            ConvertedValue  = invoiceUSD * exchangeRate,
            CurrencyCode    = "USD",
            BaseCurrencyCode = "SOS"
        };

        // Assert
        Assert.Equal(expectedConverted, valuation.ConvertedValue);
        Assert.Equal("USD", valuation.CurrencyCode);
        Assert.Equal("SOS", valuation.BaseCurrencyCode);
    }
}

<file path="services/declaration/Declaration.Api/Controllers/DeclarationsController.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using MediatR;
using Declaration.Application.Commands;

namespace Declaration.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/declarations")]
// A01: deny-by-default at controller level; individual actions add their permission policies.
[Authorize]
public class DeclarationsController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;

    public DeclarationsController(IMediator mediator)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
    }

    [HttpPost]
    [Authorize(Policy = "declaration.create")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Create([FromBody] CreateDeclarationCommand command)
    {
        // Enforce tenant isolation
        if (!TryGetActor(out var tenantId, out var userId)) return Forbid();
        command.TenantId = tenantId;
        command.CreatedBy = userId;

        var result = await _mediator.Send(command);
        return CreatedAtAction(nameof(Get), new { id = result }, result);
    }

    [HttpGet("{id}")]
    [Authorize(Policy = "declaration.read")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Get(Guid id)
    {
        return Problem(statusCode: StatusCodes.Status501NotImplemented, title: "Declaration lookup is not implemented.");
    }

    [HttpPost("{id}/submit")]
    [Authorize(Policy = "declaration.submit")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Submit(Guid id, [FromBody] SubmitDeclarationCommand command)
    {
        if (!TryGetActor(out var tenantId, out _)) return Forbid();
        command.TenantId = tenantId;
        command.DeclarationId = id;

        var result = await _mediator.Send(command);
        return Ok(result);
    }
    
    [HttpPost("{id}/review/start")]
    [Authorize(Policy = "declaration.review")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> StartReview(Guid id)
    {
        return Problem(statusCode: StatusCodes.Status501NotImplemented, title: "Declaration review is not implemented.");
    }
    
    [HttpPost("{id}/accept")]
    [Authorize(Policy = "declaration.accept")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Accept(Guid id, [FromBody] AcceptDeclarationCommand command)
    {
        if (!TryGetActor(out var tenantId, out var userId)) return Forbid();
        command.TenantId = tenantId;
        command.DeclarationId = id;
        command.UserId = userId;
        var result = await _mediator.Send(command);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    [HttpPost("{id}/reject")]
    [Authorize(Policy = "declaration.reject")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Reject(Guid id, [FromBody] RejectDeclarationCommand command)
    {
        if (!TryGetActor(out var tenantId, out var userId)) return Forbid();
        command.TenantId = tenantId;
        command.DeclarationId = id;
        command.UserId = userId;
        var result = await _mediator.Send(command);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    private bool TryGetActor(out Guid tenantId, out Guid userId)
    {
        var hasTenant = Guid.TryParse(User.FindFirst("tenant_id")?.Value, out tenantId);
        var hasUser = Guid.TryParse(User.FindFirst("sub")?.Value, out userId);
        return hasTenant && hasUser;
    }
}

using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using BuildingBlocks.Web;
using MediatR;
using FluentValidation;
using Declaration.Application.Commands;
using Declaration.Application.Interfaces;
using Declaration.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using Declaration.Infrastructure.Repositories;
using Declaration.Infrastructure.Services;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

builder.Services.AddControllers();
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
builder.Services.AddSwaggerGen();

builder.Services.AddPlatformJwtAuthentication(builder.Configuration);

// Platform-wide security defaults: deny-by-default fallback policy (A01), rate limiting (A07),
// config-driven CORS, ProblemDetails exception handling and security headers (A05/A09).
builder.Services.AddPlatformSecurity(builder.Configuration);

builder.Services.AddAuthorization(options =>
{
    options.AddPolicy("declaration.create", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "declaration.create"));
    options.AddPolicy("declaration.read", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "declaration.read"));
    options.AddPolicy("declaration.submit", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "declaration.submit"));
    options.AddPolicy("declaration.review", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "declaration.review"));
    options.AddPolicy("declaration.accept", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "declaration.accept"));
    options.AddPolicy("declaration.reject", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "declaration.reject"));
});

var connectionString = builder.Configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection");
if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionString))
    throw new InvalidOperationException("ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection is required.");

builder.Services.AddMediatR(cfg => cfg.RegisterServicesFromAssembly(typeof(CreateDeclarationCommand).Assembly));
builder.Services.AddValidatorsFromAssembly(typeof(CreateDeclarationCommandValidator).Assembly);

builder.Services.AddDbContext<DeclarationDbContext>(options =>
    options.UseNpgsql(connectionString));

builder.Services.AddScoped<ICustomsDeclarationRepository, CustomsDeclarationRepository>();
builder.Services.AddHttpClient<IEctnServiceClient, EctnServiceClient>();

var app = builder.Build();

app.UsePlatformSecurity();
if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
{
    app.UseSwagger();
    app.UseSwaggerUI();
}
app.UseHttpsRedirection();
app.UseRouting();
app.UsePlatformCors();
app.UseRateLimiter();
app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseAuthorization();
app.MapControllers();

app.MapGet("/health/live", () => "Alive").AllowAnonymous();
app.MapGet("/health/ready", async (DeclarationDbContext db, CancellationToken ct) =>
{
    try
    {
        if (await db.Database.CanConnectAsync(ct)) return (IResult)Results.Ok(new { status = "ready" });
        return Results.Problem(statusCode: StatusCodes.Status503ServiceUnavailable, title: "Database unavailable");
    }
    catch
    {
        return Results.Problem(statusCode: StatusCodes.Status503ServiceUnavailable, title: "Database unavailable");
    }
}).AllowAnonymous();

app.Run();

<file path="services/declaration/Declaration.Application/Commands/AcceptDeclarationCommandHandler.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using MediatR;
using Declaration.Application.Interfaces;
using Declaration.Domain.Enums;

namespace Declaration.Application.Commands;

public class AcceptDeclarationCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<AcceptDeclarationCommand, bool>
{
    private readonly ICustomsDeclarationRepository _repository;

    public AcceptDeclarationCommandHandler(ICustomsDeclarationRepository repository)
    {
        _repository = repository;
    }

    public async Task<bool> Handle(AcceptDeclarationCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var declaration = await _repository.GetByIdAndTenantAsync(request.DeclarationId, request.TenantId);
        
        if (declaration == null)
            throw new Exception("DECLARATION_NOT_FOUND");

        declaration.Accept(request.DeclarationNumber, request.UserId);
        
        await _repository.UpdateAsync(declaration);
        return true;
    }
}

<file path="services/declaration/Declaration.Application/Commands/SubmitDeclarationCommandHandler.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using MediatR;
using Declaration.Application.Interfaces;

namespace Declaration.Application.Commands;

public class SubmitDeclarationCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<SubmitDeclarationCommand, bool>
{
    private readonly ICustomsDeclarationRepository _repository;
    private readonly IEctnServiceClient _ectnClient;

    public SubmitDeclarationCommandHandler(ICustomsDeclarationRepository repository, IEctnServiceClient ectnClient)
    {
        _repository = repository;
        _ectnClient = ectnClient;
    }

    public async Task<bool> Handle(SubmitDeclarationCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var declaration = await _repository.GetByIdAndTenantAsync(request.DeclarationId, request.TenantId);
        
        if (declaration == null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("DECLARATION_NOT_FOUND");

        // Validate ECTN
        var ectnValid = await _ectnClient.ValidateEctnAsync(request.EctnReference, request.TenantId);
        if (!ectnValid)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("DECLARATION_ECTN_INVALID");

        declaration.AssignEctnReference(request.EctnReference);
        declaration.Submit(request.UserId);

        await _repository.UpdateAsync(declaration);
        
        return true;
    }
}

<file path="services/declaration/Declaration.Domain/Entities/CustomsDeclaration.cs">
namespace Declaration.Domain.Entities;

public class CustomsDeclaration
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; } = Guid.NewGuid();
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public Guid? OrganizationId { get; set; }
    
    public string DeclarationNumber { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string ApplicationReference { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string EctnReference { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string DeclarationType { get; set; } = string.Empty; // Import, Export, Transit, etc.
    public string ProcedureCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string Status { get; set; } = "Draft"; // Draft, ValidationPending, Submitted, UnderReview, Accepted, Rejected, etc.
    
    public int CurrentVersionNumber { get; set; } = 1;
    
    public DateTime? SubmittedAtUtc { get; set; }
    public DateTime? AcceptedAtUtc { get; set; }
    public DateTime? RejectedAtUtc { get; set; }
    public DateTime? CancelledAtUtc { get; set; }
    
    public DateTime CreatedAtUtc { get; set; } = DateTime.UtcNow;
    public DateTime UpdatedAtUtc { get; set; } = DateTime.UtcNow;
    
    public Guid CreatedBy { get; set; }
    public Guid? UpdatedBy { get; set; }
    
    public byte[] Version { get; set; } = Array.Empty<byte>();
    
    public ICollection<DeclarationVersion> Versions { get; set; } = new List<DeclarationVersion>();
    public ICollection<DeclarationReference> References { get; set; } = new List<DeclarationReference>();
    public ICollection<DeclarationValidation> Validations { get; set; } = new List<DeclarationValidation>();
    public ICollection<DeclarationSubmission> Submissions { get; set; } = new List<DeclarationSubmission>();
    public ICollection<DeclarationDecision> Decisions { get; set; } = new List<DeclarationDecision>();
    public ICollection<DeclarationAmendment> Amendments { get; set; } = new List<DeclarationAmendment>();
    public ICollection<DeclarationStatusHistory> StatusHistories { get; set; } = new List<DeclarationStatusHistory>();
    public ICollection<DeclarationExternalReference> ExternalReferences { get; set; } = new List<DeclarationExternalReference>();
    public ICollection<DeclarationIntegrationRecord> IntegrationRecords { get; set; } = new List<DeclarationIntegrationRecord>();

    public CustomsDeclaration() { }

    public CustomsDeclaration(
        Guid tenantId,
        string applicationReference,
        Declaration.Domain.Enums.DeclarationType declarationType,
        string procedureCode,
        Guid createdBy)
    {
        TenantId = tenantId;
        ApplicationReference = applicationReference ?? string.Empty;
        DeclarationType = declarationType.ToString();
        ProcedureCode = procedureCode ?? string.Empty;
        CreatedBy = createdBy;
        Status = Declaration.Domain.Enums.DeclarationStatus.Draft.ToString();
        CreatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        UpdatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

    public void AssignEctnReference(string ectnReference)
    {
        EctnReference = ectnReference ?? string.Empty;
        UpdatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

    public void Submit(Guid userId)
    {
        Status = Declaration.Domain.Enums.DeclarationStatus.Submitted.ToString();
        SubmittedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        UpdatedBy = userId;
        UpdatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

    public void Accept(string declarationNumber, Guid userId)
    {
        DeclarationNumber = declarationNumber ?? string.Empty;
        Status = Declaration.Domain.Enums.DeclarationStatus.Accepted.ToString();
        AcceptedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        UpdatedBy = userId;
        UpdatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

    public void Reject(string reasonCode, string reason, Guid userId)
    {
        Status = Declaration.Domain.Enums.DeclarationStatus.Rejected.ToString();
        RejectedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        UpdatedBy = userId;
        UpdatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }
}

<file path="services/declaration/Declaration.Domain/Policies/DeclarationStateTransitionPolicy.cs">
using Declaration.Domain.Entities;
using Declaration.Domain.Enums;
using System;

namespace Declaration.Domain.Policies;

public class DeclarationStateTransitionPolicy : IDeclarationStateTransitionPolicy
{
    public bool CanTransition(DeclarationStatus currentStatus, DeclarationStatus targetStatus)
    {
        return (currentStatus, targetStatus) switch
        {
            (DeclarationStatus.Draft, DeclarationStatus.Submitted) => true,
            (DeclarationStatus.Draft, DeclarationStatus.Cancelled) => true,
            (DeclarationStatus.Submitted, DeclarationStatus.Validation) => true,
            (DeclarationStatus.Submitted, DeclarationStatus.UnderReview) => true,
            (DeclarationStatus.Submitted, DeclarationStatus.Rejected) => true,
            (DeclarationStatus.Submitted, DeclarationStatus.Cancelled) => true,
            (DeclarationStatus.Validation, DeclarationStatus.UnderReview) => true,
            (DeclarationStatus.Validation, DeclarationStatus.Rejected) => true,
            (DeclarationStatus.UnderReview, DeclarationStatus.Accepted) => true,
            (DeclarationStatus.UnderReview, DeclarationStatus.Rejected) => true,
            (DeclarationStatus.Rejected, DeclarationStatus.Draft) => true, // Resubmission
            (DeclarationStatus.Accepted, DeclarationStatus.AssessmentPending) => true,
            (DeclarationStatus.Accepted, DeclarationStatus.AmendmentRequested) => true,
            (DeclarationStatus.AmendmentRequested, DeclarationStatus.UnderReview) => true,
            (DeclarationStatus.AssessmentPending, DeclarationStatus.Cleared) => true,
            (DeclarationStatus.Cleared, DeclarationStatus.Released) => true,
            _ => false
        };
    }

    public void EnforceTransitionRules(CustomsDeclaration declaration, DeclarationStatus targetStatus)
    {
        if (!Enum.TryParse<DeclarationStatus>(declaration.Status, true, out var currentStatus))
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Invalid or unrecognized current status: '{declaration.Status}'");
        }

        if (!CanTransition(currentStatus, targetStatus))
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Invalid state transition from {currentStatus} to {targetStatus}");
        }
    }
}
</file>
