using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Declaration.Domain.Entities;
using BuildingBlocks.Persistence; // Ensure SmartDbContext is accessible

namespace Declaration.Infrastructure.Persistence;

public class DeclarationDbContext : SmartDbContext<DeclarationDbContext>
{
    public DeclarationDbContext(DbContextOptions<DeclarationDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

    public DbSet<CustomsDeclaration> CustomsDeclarations => Set<CustomsDeclaration>();
    public DbSet<DeclarationVersion> DeclarationVersions => Set<DeclarationVersion>();
    public DbSet<DeclarationReference> DeclarationReferences => Set<DeclarationReference>();
    public DbSet<DeclarationParty> DeclarationParties => Set<DeclarationParty>();
    public DbSet<DeclarationPartyRole> DeclarationPartyRoles => Set<DeclarationPartyRole>();
    
    public DbSet<DeclarationCargo> DeclarationCargos => Set<DeclarationCargo>();
    public DbSet<DeclarationCargoItem> DeclarationCargoItems => Set<DeclarationCargoItem>();
    public DbSet<DeclarationContainer> DeclarationContainers => Set<DeclarationContainer>();
    public DbSet<DeclarationTransport> DeclarationTransports => Set<DeclarationTransport>();
    public DbSet<DeclarationRoute> DeclarationRoutes => Set<DeclarationRoute>();
    
    public DbSet<DeclarationDocument> DeclarationDocuments => Set<DeclarationDocument>();
    public DbSet<DeclarationDocumentVersion> DeclarationDocumentVersions => Set<DeclarationDocumentVersion>();
    
    public DbSet<DeclarationValidation> DeclarationValidations => Set<DeclarationValidation>();
    public DbSet<DeclarationAmendment> DeclarationAmendments => Set<DeclarationAmendment>();
    public DbSet<DeclarationSubmission> DeclarationSubmissions => Set<DeclarationSubmission>();
    public DbSet<DeclarationDecision> DeclarationDecisions => Set<DeclarationDecision>();
    public DbSet<DeclarationStatusHistory> DeclarationStatusHistories => Set<DeclarationStatusHistory>();
    
    public DbSet<DeclarationExternalReference> DeclarationExternalReferences => Set<DeclarationExternalReference>();
    public DbSet<DeclarationIntegrationRecord> DeclarationIntegrationRecords => Set<DeclarationIntegrationRecord>();
    public DbSet<DeclarationAuditEntry> DeclarationAuditEntries => Set<DeclarationAuditEntry>();
    
    public DbSet<OutboxMessage> OutboxMessages => Set<OutboxMessage>();
    public DbSet<InboxMessage> InboxMessages => Set<InboxMessage>();
    public DbSet<IdempotencyRecord> IdempotencyRecords => Set<IdempotencyRecord>();

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder builder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(builder);

        // Core Aggregate
        builder.Entity<CustomsDeclaration>(e => 
        {
            e.HasIndex(d => new { d.TenantId, d.DeclarationNumber }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(d => d.OrganizationId);
            e.HasIndex(d => new { d.TenantId, d.Status });
            e.HasIndex(d => new { d.TenantId, d.CreatedAtUtc });
            e.HasIndex(d => d.CurrentVersionNumber);
            e.Property(d => d.Version).IsRowVersion();
            
            // Restrict Cascade Delete
            e.HasMany(d => d.Versions).WithOne(v => v.CustomsDeclaration).HasForeignKey(v => v.DeclarationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
            e.HasMany(d => d.Validations).WithOne(v => v.CustomsDeclaration).HasForeignKey(v => v.DeclarationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
            e.HasMany(d => d.Submissions).WithOne(s => s.CustomsDeclaration).HasForeignKey(s => s.DeclarationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
            e.HasMany(d => d.Decisions).WithOne(dec => dec.CustomsDeclaration).HasForeignKey(dec => dec.DeclarationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
            e.HasMany(d => d.Amendments).WithOne(a => a.CustomsDeclaration).HasForeignKey(a => a.DeclarationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
            e.HasMany(d => d.StatusHistories).WithOne(sh => sh.CustomsDeclaration).HasForeignKey(sh => sh.DeclarationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
            e.HasMany(d => d.References).WithOne(r => r.CustomsDeclaration).HasForeignKey(r => r.DeclarationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
        });

        // Declaration Version
        builder.Entity<DeclarationVersion>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(v => new { v.DeclarationId, v.VersionNumber }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(v => v.VersionStatus);
            e.Property(v => v.Version).IsRowVersion();
            
            e.Property(v => v.TotalDeclaredValue).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(v => v.TotalGrossWeight).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(v => v.TotalNetWeight).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            
            e.HasMany(v => v.Parties).WithOne(p => p.DeclarationVersion).HasForeignKey(p => p.DeclarationVersionId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
            e.HasMany(v => v.Cargos).WithOne(c => c.DeclarationVersion).HasForeignKey(c => c.DeclarationVersionId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
            e.HasMany(v => v.Containers).WithOne(c => c.DeclarationVersion).HasForeignKey(c => c.DeclarationVersionId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
            e.HasMany(v => v.Transports).WithOne(t => t.DeclarationVersion).HasForeignKey(t => t.DeclarationVersionId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
            e.HasMany(v => v.Routes).WithOne(r => r.DeclarationVersion).HasForeignKey(r => r.DeclarationVersionId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
            e.HasMany(v => v.Documents).WithOne(d => d.DeclarationVersion).HasForeignKey(d => d.DeclarationVersionId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        // References
        builder.Entity<DeclarationReference>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(r => new { r.DeclarationId, r.ReferenceType, r.NormalizedValue });
            e.HasIndex(r => r.TenantId);
        });

        // Cargo
        builder.Entity<DeclarationCargo>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(c => c.CommodityCode);
            e.Property(c => c.GrossWeight).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(c => c.NetWeight).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(c => c.Volume).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(c => c.DeclaredValue).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            
            e.HasMany(c => c.Items).WithOne(i => i.DeclarationCargo).HasForeignKey(i => i.DeclarationCargoId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        // Cargo Item
        builder.Entity<DeclarationCargoItem>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(i => new { i.DeclarationCargoId, i.LineNumber }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(i => i.HsCodeDeclared);
            e.HasIndex(i => i.CommodityCode);
            e.HasIndex(i => i.CountryOfOrigin);
            
            e.Property(i => i.Quantity).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(i => i.GrossWeight).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(i => i.NetWeight).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(i => i.UnitPrice).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(i => i.TotalValue).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
        });

        // Container
        builder.Entity<DeclarationContainer>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(c => new { c.DeclarationVersionId, c.NormalizedContainerNumber }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(c => c.GrossWeight).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
        });

        // Party
        builder.Entity<DeclarationParty>(e =>
        {
            e.HasMany(p => p.Roles).WithOne(r => r.DeclarationParty).HasForeignKey(r => r.DeclarationPartyId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        // Document
        builder.Entity<DeclarationDocument>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(d => d.DocumentType);
            e.HasIndex(d => d.Status);
            e.Property(d => d.Version).IsRowVersion();
            
            e.HasMany(d => d.DocumentVersions).WithOne(v => v.DeclarationDocument).HasForeignKey(v => v.DeclarationDocumentId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        // Submissions
        builder.Entity<DeclarationSubmission>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(s => s.SubmissionReference);
            e.HasIndex(s => s.SubmittedAtUtc);
        });

        // Amendments
        builder.Entity<DeclarationAmendment>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(a => a.Status);
            e.HasIndex(a => a.RequestedAtUtc);
            e.Property(a => a.ChangeSummaryJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.Property(a => a.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        // Validation
        builder.Entity<DeclarationValidation>(e =>
        {
            e.Property(v => v.DetailsJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        // Audit
        builder.Entity<DeclarationAuditEntry>(e =>
        {
            e.Property(a => a.BeforeJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.Property(a => a.AfterJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        // External Reference
        builder.Entity<DeclarationExternalReference>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(er => new { er.ExternalSystem, er.ExternalReference });
        });

        // Idempotency
        builder.Entity<IdempotencyRecord>(e =>

        });

        // Inbox / Outbox
        builder.Entity<InboxMessage>(e =>

        builder.Entity<OutboxMessage>(e =>

            e.HasIndex(o => o.OccurredAtUtc);

    }

using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Declaration.Domain.Entities;
using Declaration.Application.Interfaces;
using Declaration.Infrastructure.Persistence;

namespace Declaration.Infrastructure.Repositories;

public class CustomsDeclarationRepository : ICustomsDeclarationRepository
{
    private readonly DeclarationDbContext _context;

    public CustomsDeclarationRepository(DeclarationDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public async Task<CustomsDeclaration> GetByIdAsync(Guid id)
    {
        return await _context.CustomsDeclarations.FindAsync(id);
    }

    public async Task<CustomsDeclaration> GetByIdAndTenantAsync(Guid id, Guid tenantId)
    {
        return await _context.CustomsDeclarations
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(d => d.Id == id && d.TenantId == tenantId);
    }

    public async Task AddAsync(CustomsDeclaration declaration)
    {
        await _context.CustomsDeclarations.AddAsync(declaration);
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
    }

    public async Task UpdateAsync(CustomsDeclaration declaration)
    {
        _context.CustomsDeclarations.Update(declaration);
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
    }
}

using System;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Declaration.Application.Interfaces;
using Polly;
using Polly.CircuitBreaker;
using Polly.Retry;

namespace Declaration.Infrastructure.Services;

public class EctnServiceClient : IEctnServiceClient
{
    private readonly HttpClient _httpClient;
    private readonly AsyncRetryPolicy<HttpResponseMessage> _retryPolicy;

    public EctnServiceClient(HttpClient httpClient)
    {
        _httpClient = httpClient;
        
        // Resilience policies (Rule 63)
        _retryPolicy = Policy
            .HandleResult<HttpResponseMessage>(r => !r.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            .WaitAndRetryAsync(3, retryAttempt => TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Math.Pow(2, retryAttempt)));
    }

    public async Task<bool> ValidateEctnAsync(string ectnReference, Guid tenantId)
    {
        // In a real implementation, this would make an actual HTTP call to the ECTN Service.
        // It should NOT access the ECTN database directly (Rule 11).
        
        // Dummy implementation for now:
        return await Task.FromResult(true); 
    }
}

namespace Declaration.Tests.Application.Commands;

public class AcceptDeclarationCommandHandlerTests
{
    private readonly Mock<ICustomsDeclarationRepository> _repository = new();

    private static CustomsDeclaration NewDeclaration(Guid tenantId) =>
        new(tenantId, "APP-REF-1", DeclarationType.Import, "PROC-1", Guid.NewGuid());

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_AcceptsDeclarationAndPersists()
    {
        var tenantId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var declaration = NewDeclaration(tenantId);
        _repository.Setup(r => r.GetByIdAndTenantAsync(declaration.Id, tenantId)).ReturnsAsync(declaration);

        var command = new AcceptDeclarationCommand
        {
            TenantId = tenantId,
            DeclarationId = declaration.Id,
            UserId = Guid.NewGuid(),
            DeclarationNumber = "DEC-2026-0001"
        };

        var handler = new AcceptDeclarationCommandHandler(_repository.Object);
        var result = await handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        Assert.True(result);
        Assert.Equal(DeclarationStatus.Accepted.ToString(), declaration.Status);
        Assert.Equal("DEC-2026-0001", declaration.DeclarationNumber);
        _repository.Verify(r => r.UpdateAsync(declaration), Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_WhenDeclarationNotFound_Throws()
    {
        var tenantId = Guid.NewGuid();
        _repository
            .Setup(r => r.GetByIdAndTenantAsync(It.IsAny<Guid>(), tenantId))
            .ReturnsAsync((CustomsDeclaration)null!);

        var command = new AcceptDeclarationCommand
        {
            TenantId = tenantId,
            DeclarationId = Guid.NewGuid(),
            UserId = Guid.NewGuid(),
            DeclarationNumber = "DEC-2026-0002"
        };

        var handler = new AcceptDeclarationCommandHandler(_repository.Object);

        await Assert.ThrowsAsync<Exception>(() => handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None));
    }
}

<file path="services/declaration/Declaration.Tests/Domain/DeclarationStateTransitionPolicyTests.cs">
using System;
using Declaration.Domain.Entities;
using Declaration.Domain.Enums;
using Declaration.Domain.Policies;

namespace Declaration.Tests.Domain;

public class DeclarationStateTransitionPolicyTests
{
    private readonly DeclarationStateTransitionPolicy _policy = new();

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(DeclarationStatus.Draft, DeclarationStatus.Submitted)]
    [InlineData(DeclarationStatus.Draft, DeclarationStatus.Cancelled)]
    [InlineData(DeclarationStatus.Submitted, DeclarationStatus.Validation)]
    [InlineData(DeclarationStatus.Submitted, DeclarationStatus.UnderReview)]
    [InlineData(DeclarationStatus.UnderReview, DeclarationStatus.Accepted)]
    [InlineData(DeclarationStatus.Accepted, DeclarationStatus.AssessmentPending)]
    [InlineData(DeclarationStatus.Accepted, DeclarationStatus.AmendmentRequested)]
    [InlineData(DeclarationStatus.AssessmentPending, DeclarationStatus.Cleared)]
    [InlineData(DeclarationStatus.Cleared, DeclarationStatus.Released)]
    public void CanTransition_AllowsConfiguredTransitions(DeclarationStatus from, DeclarationStatus to)
    {
        Assert.True(_policy.CanTransition(from, to));
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(DeclarationStatus.Draft, DeclarationStatus.Accepted)]
    [InlineData(DeclarationStatus.Draft, DeclarationStatus.Released)]
    [InlineData(DeclarationStatus.Submitted, DeclarationStatus.Released)]
    [InlineData(DeclarationStatus.Cleared, DeclarationStatus.Draft)]
    [InlineData(DeclarationStatus.Released, DeclarationStatus.Draft)]
    public void CanTransition_RejectsIllegalTransitions(DeclarationStatus from, DeclarationStatus to)
    {
        Assert.False(_policy.CanTransition(from, to));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void EnforceTransitionRules_DoesNotThrow_OnValidTransition()
    {
        var declaration = new CustomsDeclaration { Status = DeclarationStatus.Draft.ToString() };

        var exception = Record.Exception(() =>
            _policy.EnforceTransitionRules(declaration, DeclarationStatus.Submitted));

        Assert.Null(exception);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void EnforceTransitionRules_Throws_OnInvalidTransition()
    {
        var declaration = new CustomsDeclaration { Status = DeclarationStatus.Draft.ToString() };

        Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() =>
            _policy.EnforceTransitionRules(declaration, DeclarationStatus.Released));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void EnforceTransitionRules_Throws_OnUnrecognizedCurrentStatus()
    {
        var declaration = new CustomsDeclaration { Status = "NotAStatus" };

        Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() =>
            _policy.EnforceTransitionRules(declaration, DeclarationStatus.Submitted));
    }
}

namespace Declaration.Tests.Entities;

public class CustomsDeclarationTests
{

    public void Constructor_WithValidArguments_SetsDraftStatusAndFields()

        var userId = Guid.NewGuid();

        var declaration = NewDraft();

        declaration.Submit(userId);

        Assert.Equal(DeclarationStatus.Submitted.ToString(), declaration.Status);
        Assert.NotNull(declaration.SubmittedAtUtc);
        Assert.Equal(userId, declaration.UpdatedBy);
    }

        new(Guid.NewGuid(), "APP-REF-1", DeclarationType.Export, "PROC-2", Guid.NewGuid());

using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Dryport.Application.Services;
using Dryport.Application.DTOs;
using Dryport.Domain.Entities;
using System;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

// Placeholder for EF DbContext to allow compilation of Controller concepts
namespace Dryport.Infrastructure.Persistence
{
    public interface IDryportDbContext
    {
        IQueryable<ContainerRecord> Containers { get; }
        IQueryable<DemurrageAlert> DemurrageAlerts { get; }
        IQueryable<DemurrageRule> DemurrageRules { get; }
        
        void Add<T>(T entity) where T : class;
        Task<int> SaveChangesAsync(System.Threading.CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    }
}

namespace Dryport.Api.Controllers
{
    using Dryport.Infrastructure.Persistence;

    [ApiController]
    [Route("api/v1/[controller]")]
    public class DryportController : ControllerBase
    {
        private readonly IDryportDbContext _dbContext;
        private readonly IDemurrageService _demurrageService;
        private readonly ILogger<DryportController> _logger;

        public DryportController(
            IDryportDbContext dbContext,
            IDemurrageService demurrageService,
            ILogger<DryportController> logger)
        {
            _dbContext = dbContext;
            _demurrageService = demurrageService;
            _logger = logger;
        }

        [HttpGet("containers/demurrage")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GetContainersDemurrageOverview()
        {
            try
            {
                var currentDate = DateTime.UtcNow;

                // In a real EF scenario, use .Include() and .ToListAsync()
                var containers = _dbContext.Containers
                    .Where(c => c.Status == ContainerStatus.Arrived || c.Status == ContainerStatus.InStorage)
                    .ToList();

                var response = containers.Select(c => new ContainerDemurrageDto
                {
                    ContainerId = c.Id,
                    ContainerNumber = c.ContainerNumber,
                    Status = c.Status.ToString(),
                    DaysInPort = (currentDate - c.ArrivalDate).Days,
                    FreeDays = c.DemurrageRule?.FreeDays ?? 0,
                    AccruedDemurrage = _demurrageService.CalculateDemurrage(c, currentDate),
                    Currency = c.DemurrageRule?.Currency ?? "USD"
                }).OrderByDescending(c => c.AccruedDemurrage).ToList();

                return Ok(response);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error getting demurrage data");
                return StatusCode(500, "Internal Server Error");
            }
        }

        [HttpPost("containers/receive")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> ReceiveContainer([FromBody] ReceiveContainerDto request)
        {
            try
            {
                var ruleExists = _dbContext.DemurrageRules.Any(r => r.Id == request.DemurrageRuleId);
                if (!ruleExists)
                {
                    return NotFound($"Rule ID {request.DemurrageRuleId} not found.");
                }

                var newContainer = new ContainerRecord
                {
                    Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                    ContainerNumber = request.ContainerNumber,
                    Size = request.Size,
                    Type = request.Type,
                    ArrivalDate = DateTime.UtcNow,
                    Status = ContainerStatus.Arrived,
                    ClientId = request.ClientId,
                    DemurrageRuleId = request.DemurrageRuleId,
                    AccruedDemurrage = 0
                };

                _dbContext.Add(newContainer);
                await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();

                _logger.LogInformation("New container registered: {ContainerNumber}", request.ContainerNumber);

                return CreatedAtAction(nameof(GetContainersDemurrageOverview), new { id = newContainer.Id }, newContainer);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error registering container");
                return StatusCode(500, "Internal Server Error");
            }
        }
    }
}

using System;
using Dryport.Domain.Entities;

namespace Dryport.Application.DTOs
{
    public class ContainerDemurrageDto
    {
        public Guid ContainerId { get; set; }
        public string ContainerNumber { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string Status { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public int DaysInPort { get; set; }
        public int FreeDays { get; set; }
        public decimal AccruedDemurrage { get; set; }
        public string Currency { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }

    public class ReceiveContainerDto
    {
        public string ContainerNumber { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public int Size { get; set; }
        public string Type { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public Guid ClientId { get; set; }
        public Guid DemurrageRuleId { get; set; }
    }
}

namespace Dryport.Application.Services
{
    public interface IDemurrageService
    {
        decimal CalculateDemurrage(ContainerRecord container, DateTime currentDate);
    }

    public class DemurrageService : IDemurrageService
    {
        public decimal CalculateDemurrage(ContainerRecord container, DateTime currentDate)
        {
            DateTime endDate = container.DepartureDate ?? currentDate;
            int totalDaysInPort = (endDate - container.ArrivalDate).Days;
            
            // Defend against null rule
            if (container.DemurrageRule == null) return 0;

            int chargeableDays = totalDaysInPort - container.DemurrageRule.FreeDays;
            
            if (chargeableDays > 0)
            {
                return chargeableDays * container.DemurrageRule.DailyRate;
            }
            return 0;
        }
    }
}

<file path="services/dryport/Dryport.Infrastructure/Workers/AlertProcessor.cs">
using System;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using MongoDB.Driver;
using RabbitMQ.Client;
using Dryport.Domain.Entities;
using Dryport.Application.Services;
using Dryport.Infrastructure.Persistence;

namespace Dryport.Infrastructure.Messaging
{
    // 1. Qaybta Fariimaha loo dirayo RabbitMQ (RabbitMQ Publisher)
    public interface IAlertMessagePublisher
    {
        void PublishAlertEvent(DemurrageAlert alert);
    }

    public class RabbitMqAlertPublisher : IAlertMessagePublisher
    {
        private readonly IConnection _connection;
        private readonly IModel _channel;

        public RabbitMqAlertPublisher(string hostName = "localhost")
        {
            var factory = new ConnectionFactory() { HostName = hostName };
            _connection = factory.CreateConnection();
            _channel = _connection.CreateModel();
            
            // Abuurista Exchange si fariintu ugu dhacdo nidaamyada ogeysiiska (Notification Service)
            _channel.ExchangeDeclare(exchange: "dryport_alerts_exchange", type: ExchangeType.Topic);
        }

        public void PublishAlertEvent(DemurrageAlert alert)
        {
            var routingKey = alert.Level == AlertLevel.Critical ? "alert.demurrage.critical" : "alert.demurrage.warning";
            var message = JsonSerializer.Serialize(alert);
            var body = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(message);

            _channel.BasicPublish(exchange: "dryport_alerts_exchange",
                                 routingKey: routingKey,
                                 basicProperties: null,
                                 body: body);
        }
    }
}

namespace Dryport.Infrastructure.Repositories
{
    // 2. Qaybta Xogta lagu kaydinayo MongoDB (MongoDB Repository)
    public interface IMongoAlertRepository
    {
        Task SaveAlertAsync(DemurrageAlert alert);
    }

    public class MongoDbAlertRepository : IMongoAlertRepository
    {
        private readonly IMongoCollection<DemurrageAlert> _alertsCollection;

        public MongoDbAlertRepository(IMongoDatabase mongoDatabase)
        {
            // Abuurista ururinta (Collection) ee MongoDB
            _alertsCollection = mongoDatabase.GetCollection<DemurrageAlert>("DemurrageAlerts");
        }

        public async Task SaveAlertAsync(DemurrageAlert alert)
        {
            await _alertsCollection.InsertOneAsync(alert);
        }
    }
}

namespace Dryport.Infrastructure.Workers
{
    using Dryport.Infrastructure.Messaging;
    using Dryport.Infrastructure.Repositories;
    using System.Linq;
    using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

    // 3. Qaybta Isku xiraysa Postgres, MongoDB iyo RabbitMQ (Background Worker)
    public class DemurrageAlertWorker : BackgroundService
    {
        private readonly IServiceProvider _serviceProvider;
        private readonly ILogger<DemurrageAlertWorker> _logger;

        public DemurrageAlertWorker(IServiceProvider serviceProvider, ILogger<DemurrageAlertWorker> logger)
        {
            _serviceProvider = serviceProvider;
            _logger = logger;
        }

        protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
        {
            _logger.LogInformation("Demurrage Alert Worker waa uu bilowday...");

            while (!stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                using (var scope = _serviceProvider.CreateScope())
                {
                    // 1. PostgreSQL - Kasoo qaado kunteenarada
                    var postgresDb = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IDryportDbContext>();
                    
                    // 2. MongoDB - Kaydi digniinaha
                    var mongoRepo = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IMongoAlertRepository>();
                    
                    // 3. RabbitMQ - U dir fariimaha
                    var rabbitMq = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IAlertMessagePublisher>();
                    var demurrageService = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IDemurrageService>();
                    
                    var currentDate = DateTime.UtcNow;

                    var activeContainers = postgresDb.Containers
                        .Where(c => c.Status == ContainerStatus.Arrived || c.Status == ContainerStatus.InStorage)
                        .ToList();

                    foreach (var container in activeContainers)
                    {
                        int daysInPort = (currentDate - container.ArrivalDate).Days;
                        int freeDays = container.DemurrageRule?.FreeDays ?? 0;
                        int daysRemaining = freeDays - daysInPort;

                        DemurrageAlert? newAlert = null;

                        if (daysRemaining > 0 && daysRemaining <= 2)
                        {
                            newAlert = new DemurrageAlert
                            {
                                Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                                ContainerRecordId = container.Id,
                                AlertDate = currentDate,
                                Level = AlertLevel.Warning,
                                Message = $"Kunteenarka {container.ContainerNumber} ayaa qarka u saaran Demurrage."
                            };
                        }
                        else if (daysRemaining <= 0)
                        {
                            newAlert = new DemurrageAlert
                            {
                                Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                                ContainerRecordId = container.Id,
                                AlertDate = currentDate,
                                Level = AlertLevel.Critical,
                                Message = $"Kunteenarka {container.ContainerNumber} Demurrage ayaa billowday!"
                            };
                        }

                        if (newAlert != null)
                        {
                            // A. Ku xafid MongoDB (Digniinta)
                            await mongoRepo.SaveAlertAsync(newAlert);

                            // B. Ku dhex dir RabbitMQ (Si Message Service-ku SMS/Email ugu diro)
                            rabbitMq.PublishAlertEvent(newAlert);
                            
                            _logger.LogInformation("Alert loo diray RabbitMQ lana kaydiyay MongoDB: {Container}", container.ContainerNumber);
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Seexo 24 saac (Worker-ku habeenkii buu shaqaynayaa)
                await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromHours(24), stoppingToken);
            }
        }
    }
}

[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/[controller]")]
[Authorize] // Requires JWT from Phase 02
public class EctnController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;

    public EctnController(IMediator mediator)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
    }

    [HttpPost]
    [Authorize(Policy = "ectn.create")] // Requires explicit permission
    public async Task<IActionResult> Create([FromBody] CreateEctnCommand command)
    {
        // Security Check: Ensure client cannot inject a different TenantId
        // The TenantId should be extracted from the authenticated user's JWT claims
        var tenantIdClaim = User.FindFirst("tenant_id")?.Value;
        if (Guid.TryParse(tenantIdClaim, out var tenantId))
        {
            command.TenantId = tenantId;
        }
        else
        {
            return Forbid("Tenant ID is missing from the authentication context.");
        }

        var actorIdClaim = User.FindFirst("sub")?.Value;
        if (Guid.TryParse(actorIdClaim, out var actorId))
        {
            command.CreatedBy = actorId;
        }

        var ectnId = await _mediator.Send(command);
        return CreatedAtAction(nameof(Get), new { id = ectnId }, new { Id = ectnId });
    }

    [HttpGet("{id}")]
    [Authorize(Policy = "ectn.read")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Get(Guid id)
    {
        // Implement GetQuery
        return Ok(new { Id = id, Status = "Draft" });
    }

<file path="services/ectn/Ectn.Api/Controllers/EctnDocumentsController.cs">
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace Ectn.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/ectn/{ectnId}/documents")]
[Authorize]
public class EctnDocumentsController : ControllerBase
{
    // A04/A05: documents are untrusted input. Only a small, known set of types is accepted, the
    // client supplied name is sanitised (no path separators, traversal sequences or control
    // characters) and the size is capped in addition to the request size limit.
    private static readonly string[] AllowedExtensions = { ".pdf", ".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg" };
    private static readonly string[] AllowedContentTypes = { "application/pdf", "image/png", "image/jpeg" };
    private static readonly Regex DocumentTypePattern = new("^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$", RegexOptions.Compiled);
    private const long MaxFileSizeBytes = 10 * 1024 * 1024;

    private readonly IMediator _mediator;
    private readonly ILogger<EctnDocumentsController> _logger;

    public EctnDocumentsController(IMediator mediator, ILogger<EctnDocumentsController> logger)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    [HttpPost]
    [Authorize(Policy = "ectn.documents.upload")]
    [RequestSizeLimit(MaxFileSizeBytes)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> UploadDocument(Guid ectnId, IFormFile file, [FromForm] string documentType)
    {
        if (file is null || file.Length == 0)
            return BadRequest(new { Error = "File is empty or missing." });

        if (file.Length > MaxFileSizeBytes)
            return BadRequest(new { Error = "File exceeds the maximum allowed size." });

        var fileName = file.FileName ?? string.Empty;
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(fileName) || fileName.Length > 255 ||
            fileName.Contains('/') || fileName.Contains('\\') || fileName.Contains("..") ||
            fileName.IndexOfAny(Path.GetInvalidFileNameChars()) >= 0)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Rejected document upload for ECTN {EctnId}: unsafe file name", ectnId);
            return BadRequest(new { Error = "Invalid file name." });
        }

        var extension = Path.GetExtension(fileName);
        if (!AllowedExtensions.Contains(extension, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Rejected document upload for ECTN {EctnId}: extension '{Extension}' not allowed", ectnId, extension);
            return BadRequest(new { Error = "File type is not allowed." });
        }

        var contentType = file.ContentType ?? string.Empty;
        if (!AllowedContentTypes.Contains(contentType, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Rejected document upload for ECTN {EctnId}: content type '{ContentType}' not allowed", ectnId, contentType);
            return BadRequest(new { Error = "Content type is not allowed." });
        }

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(documentType) || !DocumentTypePattern.IsMatch(documentType))
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Rejected document upload for ECTN {EctnId}: invalid document type", ectnId);
            return BadRequest(new { Error = "Invalid document type." });
        }

        // Pseudo-command: UploadDocumentCommand (storage key derived from server side identifiers
        // only - never from the client supplied name - followed by a malware scan).
        return Accepted(new { Message = "Document uploaded and pending malware scan." });
    }

    [HttpGet("{documentId}")]
    [Authorize(Policy = "ectn.documents.read")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> DownloadDocument(Guid ectnId, Guid documentId)
    {
        // Enforce tenant isolation by verifying EctnId -> TenantId
        return Ok(new { Url = "https://minio.local/signed-url-for-download" });
    }
}

<file path="services/ectn/Ectn.Api/Controllers/EctnVerificationController.cs">
using System;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.RateLimiting;
using BuildingBlocks.Web;

namespace Ectn.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/ectn/verify")]
// The verification code is a public proof-of-possession token, so the endpoint is intentionally
// anonymous - but it is covered by the deny-by-default fallback policy exception below and is
// rate limited so codes cannot be enumerated.
[AllowAnonymous]
public class EctnVerificationController : ControllerBase
{
    [HttpGet("{verificationCode}")]
    [EnableRateLimiting(PlatformSecurityExtensions.SensitiveRateLimitPolicy)]
    public IActionResult Verify(string verificationCode)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(verificationCode) || verificationCode.Length > 128)
            return BadRequest(new { Error = "A verification code is required." });

        // Public endpoint (rate limited, A04/A07).
        // Never expose internal IDs or audit details here.
        // Lookup by signed payload or verification string
        var verificationResult = new
        {
            Status = "Valid",
            PortOfLoading = "JED",
            PortOfDischarge = "BER",
            VerifiedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        return Ok(verificationResult);
    }
}

<file path="services/ectn/Ectn.Api/Program.cs">
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using BuildingBlocks.Web;
using Ectn.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);
var connectionString = builder.Configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection");
if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionString))
    throw new InvalidOperationException("ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection is required.");

// Add services to the container.
builder.Services.AddControllers();
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
builder.Services.AddSwaggerGen();

// Configure MediatR (CQRS)
builder.Services.AddMediatR(cfg => cfg.RegisterServicesFromAssembly(typeof(Ectn.Application.Commands.CreateEctnCommand).Assembly));

// Configure Database
builder.Services.AddDbContext<EctnDbContext>(options =>
    options.UseNpgsql(connectionString));

builder.Services.AddPlatformJwtAuthentication(builder.Configuration);

// Platform-wide security defaults: deny-by-default fallback policy (A01), rate limiting (A07),
// config-driven CORS, ProblemDetails exception handling and security headers (A05/A09).
builder.Services.AddPlatformSecurity(builder.Configuration);

// Configure Permission-Based Authorization
builder.Services.AddAuthorization(options =>
{
    options.AddPolicy("ectn.create", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "ectn.create"));
    options.AddPolicy("ectn.read", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "ectn.read"));
    options.AddPolicy("ectn.submit", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "ectn.submit"));
    options.AddPolicy("ectn.approve", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "ectn.approve"));
    options.AddPolicy("ectn.issue", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "ectn.issue"));
    options.AddPolicy("ectn.statistics.read", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "ectn.statistics.read"));
    options.AddPolicy("ectn.documents.upload", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "ectn.documents.upload"));
    options.AddPolicy("ectn.documents.read", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "ectn.documents.read"));
});

var app = builder.Build();

// Configure the HTTP request pipeline.
app.UsePlatformSecurity();
if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
{
    app.UseSwagger();
    app.UseSwaggerUI();
}

app.UseHttpsRedirection();

app.UseRouting();
app.UsePlatformCors();
app.UseRateLimiter();
app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseAuthorization();

app.MapControllers();
app.MapGet("/health/live", () => Results.Ok(new { status = "alive" })).AllowAnonymous();
app.MapGet("/health/ready", async (EctnDbContext db, CancellationToken ct) =>
{
    try
    {
        if (await db.Database.CanConnectAsync(ct)) return (IResult)Results.Ok(new { status = "ready" });
        return Results.Problem(statusCode: StatusCodes.Status503ServiceUnavailable, title: "Database unavailable");
    }
    catch
    {
        return Results.Problem(statusCode: StatusCodes.Status503ServiceUnavailable, title: "Database unavailable");
    }
}).AllowAnonymous();

app.Run();

using System;
using MediatR;
using Ectn.Domain.Enums;

namespace Ectn.Application.Commands;

public class CreateEctnCommand : IRequest<Guid>
{
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public string ApplicationReference { get; set; }
    public EctnType Type { get; set; }
    public Guid CreatedBy { get; set; }
}

public class CreateEctnCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<CreateEctnCommand, Guid>
{
    // Normally injected via DI: IEctnRepository, IUnitOfWork
    
    public async Task<Guid> Handle(CreateEctnCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        // 1. Validate (FluentValidation would intercept before this point)
        
        // 2. Map command to Domain Entity
        var ectn = new Domain.Entities.Ectn(
            request.TenantId,
            request.ApplicationReference,
            request.Type,
            request.CreatedBy
        );

        // 3. Save via Repository
        // await _repository.AddAsync(ectn, cancellationToken);
        // await _unitOfWork.CommitAsync(cancellationToken);

        // 4. Return the new ID
        return ectn.Id;
    }
}

<file path="services/ectn/Ectn.Domain/Entities/Ectn.cs">
using Ectn.Domain.Enums;

namespace Ectn.Domain.Entities;

/// <summary>
/// ECTN Aggregate Root – Electronic Cargo Tracking Note.
/// Encapsulates all domain invariants and state transitions.
/// </summary>
public class Ectn
{
    public Guid Id { get; private set; } = Guid.NewGuid();
    public Guid TenantId { get; private set; }
    public string ApplicationReference { get; private set; }
    public EctnType Type { get; private set; }
    public EctnStatus Status { get; private set; } = EctnStatus.Draft;

    public string? EctnNumber { get; private set; }
    public string? RejectionReason { get; private set; }
    public string? CancellationReason { get; private set; }

    public DateTime CreatedAtUtc { get; private set; } = DateTime.UtcNow;
    public Guid CreatedBy { get; private set; }

    public DateTime? SubmittedAt { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? ReviewedAt { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? ApprovedAt { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? IssuedAt { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? RejectedAt { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? CancelledAt { get; private set; }

    public ICollection<EctnParty> Parties { get; private set; } = new List<EctnParty>();
    public ICollection<EctnStatusHistory> StatusHistories { get; private set; } = new List<EctnStatusHistory>();
    public ICollection<EctnDocument> Documents { get; private set; } = new List<EctnDocument>();

    // Required by EF Core
    protected Ectn() { ApplicationReference = string.Empty; }

    public Ectn(Guid tenantId, string applicationReference, EctnType type, Guid createdBy)
    {
        if (tenantId == Guid.Empty) throw new ArgumentException("TenantId cannot be empty.", nameof(tenantId));
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(applicationReference)) throw new ArgumentException("ApplicationReference cannot be empty.", nameof(applicationReference));
        if (createdBy == Guid.Empty) throw new ArgumentException("CreatedBy cannot be empty.", nameof(createdBy));

        TenantId = tenantId;
        ApplicationReference = applicationReference;
        Type = type;
        CreatedBy = createdBy;

        AddStatusHistory(EctnStatus.Draft, createdBy);
    }

    // ─── Domain Behaviours ───────────────────────────────────────────

    public void Submit(Guid actorId)
    {
        if (Status != EctnStatus.Draft)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Only draft ECTNs can be submitted.");

        Status = EctnStatus.Submitted;
        SubmittedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        AddStatusHistory(EctnStatus.Submitted, actorId);
    }

    public void StartReview(Guid actorId)
    {
        if (Status != EctnStatus.Submitted)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Only submitted ECTNs can be placed under review.");

        Status = EctnStatus.UnderReview;
        ReviewedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        AddStatusHistory(EctnStatus.UnderReview, actorId);
    }

    public void Approve(Guid actorId)
    {
        if (Status != EctnStatus.Submitted && Status != EctnStatus.UnderReview)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("ECTN must be Submitted or Under Review to be approved.");

        Status = EctnStatus.Approved;
        ApprovedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        AddStatusHistory(EctnStatus.Approved, actorId);
    }

    public void Issue(string ectnNumber, Guid actorId)
    {
        if (Status != EctnStatus.Approved)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Only approved ECTNs can be issued.");
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ectnNumber))
            throw new ArgumentException("ECTN number is required for issuance.", nameof(ectnNumber));

        EctnNumber = ectnNumber;
        Status = EctnStatus.Issued;
        IssuedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        AddStatusHistory(EctnStatus.Issued, actorId);
    }

    public void Reject(string reason, Guid actorId)
    {
        if (Status == EctnStatus.Issued || Status == EctnStatus.Cancelled || Status == EctnStatus.Expired)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot reject an ECTN that is already Issued, Cancelled, or Expired.");
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(reason))
            throw new ArgumentException("Rejection reason is required.", nameof(reason));

        RejectionReason = reason;
        Status = EctnStatus.Rejected;
        RejectedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        AddStatusHistory(EctnStatus.Rejected, actorId);
    }

    public void Cancel(string reason, Guid actorId)
    {
        if (Status == EctnStatus.Cancelled || Status == EctnStatus.Expired)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("ECTN is already cancelled or expired.");
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(reason))
            throw new ArgumentException("Cancellation reason is required.", nameof(reason));

        CancellationReason = reason;
        Status = EctnStatus.Cancelled;
        CancelledAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        AddStatusHistory(EctnStatus.Cancelled, actorId);
    }

    public void AssignEctnNumber(string ectnNumber)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ectnNumber))
            throw new ArgumentException("ECTN number cannot be empty.", nameof(ectnNumber));

        EctnNumber = ectnNumber;
    }

    public void AddParty(EctnParty party)
    {
        if (party == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(party));
        Parties.Add(party);
    }

    // ─── Private Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────

    private void AddStatusHistory(EctnStatus status, Guid actorId)
    {
        StatusHistories.Add(new EctnStatusHistory
        {
            Status = status,
            ChangedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
            ChangedBy = actorId
        });
    }
}
</file>

<file path="services/ectn/Ectn.Domain/Services/EctnStateTransitionService.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Ectn.Domain.Entities;
using Ectn.Domain.Enums;

namespace Ectn.Domain.Services;

public interface IEctnStateTransitionService
{
    Task ValidateTransitionAsync(Domain.Entities.Ectn ectn, EctnStatus targetStatus, Guid actorId);
}

public class EctnStateTransitionService : IEctnStateTransitionService
{
    public Task ValidateTransitionAsync(Domain.Entities.Ectn ectn, EctnStatus targetStatus, Guid actorId)
    {
        // Enforce strict Domain Invariants (Rule 83)
        switch (targetStatus)
        {
            case EctnStatus.Submitted:
                if (ectn.Status != EctnStatus.Draft)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("ECTN must be in Draft state to be submitted.");
                if (ectn.Parties.Count == 0)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("ECTN must have at least one party defined before submission.");
                break;
                
            case EctnStatus.Approved:
                if (ectn.Status != EctnStatus.UnderReview && ectn.Status != EctnStatus.Submitted)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("ECTN must be Submitted or Under Review to be approved.");
                break;
                
            case EctnStatus.Issued:
                if (ectn.Status != EctnStatus.Approved)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("ECTN must be Approved before it can be Issued.");
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ectn.EctnNumber))
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("ECTN must have an official number assigned before issuance.");
                break;

            case EctnStatus.Rejected:
                if (ectn.Status == EctnStatus.Issued || ectn.Status == EctnStatus.Expired || ectn.Status == EctnStatus.Cancelled)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot reject an ECTN that is already Issued, Cancelled, or Expired.");
                break;
        }

        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }
}
</file>

<file path="services/ectn/Ectn.Infrastructure/Persistence/EctnDbContext.cs">
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Ectn.Domain.Entities;
using BuildingBlocks.Persistence; // Ensure SmartDbContext is accessible

namespace Ectn.Infrastructure.Persistence;

public class EctnDbContext : SmartDbContext<EctnDbContext>
{
    public EctnDbContext(DbContextOptions<EctnDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

    public DbSet<EctnApplication> EctnApplications => Set<EctnApplication>();
    public DbSet<EctnCertificate> EctnCertificates => Set<EctnCertificate>();
    public DbSet<EctnReference> EctnReferences => Set<EctnReference>();
    public DbSet<EctnParty> EctnParties => Set<EctnParty>();
    public DbSet<EctnPartyRole> EctnPartyRoles => Set<EctnPartyRole>();
    
    public DbSet<EctnShipment> EctnShipments => Set<EctnShipment>();
    public DbSet<EctnCargo> EctnCargos => Set<EctnCargo>();
    public DbSet<EctnCargoItem> EctnCargoItems => Set<EctnCargoItem>();
    public DbSet<EctnContainer> EctnContainers => Set<EctnContainer>();
    public DbSet<EctnBillOfLading> EctnBillOfLadings => Set<EctnBillOfLading>();
    public DbSet<EctnVesselReference> EctnVesselReferences => Set<EctnVesselReference>();
    public DbSet<EctnVoyageReference> EctnVoyageReferences => Set<EctnVoyageReference>();
    
    public DbSet<EctnValidation> EctnValidations => Set<EctnValidation>();
    public DbSet<EctnReview> EctnReviews => Set<EctnReview>();
    public DbSet<EctnDecision> EctnDecisions => Set<EctnDecision>();
    public DbSet<EctnAmendment> EctnAmendments => Set<EctnAmendment>();
    public DbSet<EctnStatusHistory> EctnStatusHistories => Set<EctnStatusHistory>();
    
    public DbSet<EctnDocument> EctnDocuments => Set<EctnDocument>();
    public DbSet<EctnDocumentVersion> EctnDocumentVersions => Set<EctnDocumentVersion>();
    public DbSet<EctnDocumentVerification> EctnDocumentVerifications => Set<EctnDocumentVerification>();
    
    public DbSet<EctnQrCode> EctnQrCodes => Set<EctnQrCode>();
    public DbSet<EctnVerification> EctnVerifications => Set<EctnVerification>();
    
    public DbSet<EctnExternalReference> EctnExternalReferences => Set<EctnExternalReference>();
    public DbSet<EctnIntegrationRecord> EctnIntegrationRecords => Set<EctnIntegrationRecord>();
    public DbSet<InboxMessage> InboxMessages => Set<InboxMessage>();
    public DbSet<IdempotencyRecord> IdempotencyRecords => Set<IdempotencyRecord>();
    public DbSet<OutboxMessage> OutboxMessages => Set<OutboxMessage>();
    public DbSet<EctnAuditEntry> EctnAuditEntries => Set<EctnAuditEntry>();

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder builder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(builder);

        // Core Aggregate
        builder.Entity<EctnApplication>(e => 
        {
            e.HasIndex(a => new { a.TenantId, a.ApplicationNumber }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(a => a.OrganizationId);
            e.HasIndex(a => a.Status);
            e.HasIndex(a => a.CreatedAtUtc);
            e.Property(a => a.Version).IsRowVersion();
            
            // Restrict Cascade Delete - historical ECTNs shouldn't be deleted implicitly
            e.HasMany(a => a.Certificates).WithOne(c => c.EctnApplication).HasForeignKey(c => c.EctnApplicationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
            e.HasMany(a => a.Shipments).WithOne(s => s.EctnApplication).HasForeignKey(s => s.EctnApplicationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
            e.HasMany(a => a.PartyRoles).WithOne(pr => pr.EctnApplication).HasForeignKey(pr => pr.EctnApplicationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
            e.HasMany(a => a.Documents).WithOne(d => d.EctnApplication).HasForeignKey(d => d.EctnApplicationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
            e.HasMany(a => a.StatusHistories).WithOne(sh => sh.EctnApplication).HasForeignKey(sh => sh.EctnApplicationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
        });

        // Certificate
        builder.Entity<EctnCertificate>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(c => c.EctnNumber).IsUnique(); // Policy rule
            e.HasIndex(c => c.CertificateNumber).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(c => c.Status);
            e.HasIndex(c => c.ExpiresAtUtc);
        });

        // References
        builder.Entity<EctnReference>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(r => new { r.TenantId, r.ReferenceType, r.NormalizedValue }).IsUnique();
            e.HasOne(r => r.EctnApplication).WithMany().HasForeignKey(r => r.EctnApplicationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        // Party Roles
        builder.Entity<EctnPartyRole>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(pr => new { pr.EctnApplicationId, pr.EctnPartyId, pr.RoleType }).IsUnique();
            e.HasOne(pr => pr.EctnParty).WithMany().HasForeignKey(pr => pr.EctnPartyId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
        });

        // Shipment
        builder.Entity<EctnShipment>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(s => s.ShipmentReference);
            
            // Numeric configurations
            e.Property(s => s.TotalGrossWeight).HasColumnType("numeric(18,2)");
            e.Property(s => s.TotalNetWeight).HasColumnType("numeric(18,2)");
            e.Property(s => s.TotalVolume).HasColumnType("numeric(18,2)");
            e.Property(s => s.DeclaredValue).HasColumnType("numeric(18,2)");
            e.Property(s => s.FreightValue).HasColumnType("numeric(18,2)");
            e.Property(s => s.InsuranceValue).HasColumnType("numeric(18,2)");
            
            e.HasMany(s => s.Cargos).WithOne(c => c.EctnShipment).HasForeignKey(c => c.EctnShipmentId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
            e.HasMany(s => s.Containers).WithOne(c => c.EctnShipment).HasForeignKey(c => c.EctnShipmentId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
            e.HasMany(s => s.BillOfLadings).WithOne(b => b.EctnShipment).HasForeignKey(b => b.EctnShipmentId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
            e.HasMany(s => s.VesselReferences).WithOne(v => v.EctnShipment).HasForeignKey(v => v.EctnShipmentId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
            e.HasMany(s => s.VoyageReferences).WithOne(v => v.EctnShipment).HasForeignKey(v => v.EctnShipmentId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        // Cargo
        builder.Entity<EctnCargo>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(c => c.HsCode);
            e.HasIndex(c => c.CommodityCode);
            
            e.Property(c => c.GrossWeight).HasColumnType("numeric(18,2)");
            e.Property(c => c.NetWeight).HasColumnType("numeric(18,2)");
            e.Property(c => c.Volume).HasColumnType("numeric(18,2)");
            e.Property(c => c.DeclaredValue).HasColumnType("numeric(18,2)");
            
            e.HasMany(c => c.Items).WithOne(i => i.EctnCargo).HasForeignKey(i => i.EctnCargoId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        // Cargo Item
        builder.Entity<EctnCargoItem>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(i => new { i.EctnCargoId, i.LineNumber }).IsUnique();
            
            e.Property(i => i.Quantity).HasColumnType("numeric(18,4)");
            e.Property(i => i.GrossWeight).HasColumnType("numeric(18,2)");
            e.Property(i => i.NetWeight).HasColumnType("numeric(18,2)");
            e.Property(i => i.UnitPrice).HasColumnType("numeric(18,2)");
            e.Property(i => i.TotalValue).HasColumnType("numeric(18,2)");
        });

        // Container
        builder.Entity<EctnContainer>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(c => c.NormalizedContainerNumber);
            e.Property(c => c.GrossWeight).HasColumnType("numeric(18,2)");
        });

        // Bill of Lading
        builder.Entity<EctnBillOfLading>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(b => new { b.EctnShipmentId, b.NormalizedBolNumber }).IsUnique();
        });

        // Validation
        builder.Entity<EctnValidation>(e =>
        {
            e.Property(v => v.ValidationDetailsJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.HasOne(v => v.EctnApplication).WithMany().HasForeignKey(v => v.EctnApplicationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        // Amendment
        builder.Entity<EctnAmendment>(e =>
        {
            e.Property(a => a.ChangeSummaryJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.Property(a => a.Version).IsRowVersion();
            e.HasOne(a => a.EctnApplication).WithMany().HasForeignKey(a => a.EctnApplicationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        // Documents
        builder.Entity<EctnDocument>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(d => d.Status);
            e.HasIndex(d => d.DocumentType);
            e.Property(d => d.Version).IsRowVersion();
            
            e.HasMany(d => d.DocumentVersions).WithOne(v => v.EctnDocument).HasForeignKey(v => v.EctnDocumentId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
            e.HasMany(d => d.Verifications).WithOne(v => v.EctnDocument).HasForeignKey(v => v.EctnDocumentId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        // Audit & Integration
        builder.Entity<EctnAuditEntry>(e =>
        {
            e.Property(a => a.BeforeJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.Property(a => a.AfterJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        builder.Entity<IdempotencyRecord>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(i => new { i.TenantId, i.IdempotencyKey, i.Operation }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(i => i.ResponseBodyJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        builder.Entity<InboxMessage>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(i => new { i.MessageId, i.Consumer }).IsUnique();
        });
        
        builder.Entity<OutboxMessage>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(o => o.Status);
            e.HasIndex(o => o.OccurredAtUtc);
            e.Property(o => o.PayloadJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });
        
        builder.Entity<EctnExternalReference>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(er => new { er.ExternalSystem, er.ExternalReference });
            e.HasIndex(er => er.ExternalStatus);
            e.HasOne(er => er.EctnApplication).WithMany().HasForeignKey(er => er.EctnApplicationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });
    }
}

<file path="services/ectn/Ectn.Infrastructure/Repositories/EctnRepository.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Ectn.Domain.Entities;
using Ectn.Domain.Repositories;
using Ectn.Infrastructure.Persistence;

namespace Ectn.Infrastructure.Repositories;

public class EctnRepository : IEctnRepository
{
    private readonly EctnDbContext _context;

    public EctnRepository(EctnDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public async Task<Ectn> GetByIdAsync(Guid id, Guid tenantId)
    {
        return await _context.Ectns
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(e => e.Id == id && e.TenantId == tenantId);
    }

    public async Task AddAsync(Ectn ectn)
    {
        await _context.Ectns.AddAsync(ectn);
    }

    public async Task UpdateAsync(Ectn ectn)
    {
        _context.Ectns.Update(ectn);
        await Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    public async Task SaveChangesAsync()
    {
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
    }
}

<file path="services/ectn/Ectn.Infrastructure/Services/EctnNumberGenerator.cs">
using System;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Ectn.Application.Interfaces;
using Ectn.Infrastructure.Persistence;

namespace Ectn.Infrastructure.Services;

public class EctnNumberGenerator : IEctnNumberGenerator
{
    private readonly EctnDbContext _dbContext;

    public EctnNumberGenerator(EctnDbContext dbContext)
    {
        _dbContext = dbContext;
    }

    public async Task<string> GenerateOfficialNumberAsync(Guid tenantId, string portOfLoading, DateTime issueDate)
    {
        // Enterprise ECTN number generation: ECTN-{YEAR}-{PORT}-{SEQUENCE}
        // Utilizing a database sequence for strict transaction-safe collision prevention
        var year = issueDate.Year;

        // A03: the port code is client supplied, so it is reduced to alphanumerics before it is
        // ever used - it must never carry quotes or SQL fragments into downstream storage.
        var rawPort = portOfLoading?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;
        var portCode = new string(rawPort.ToUpperInvariant()
            .Take(3)
            .Where(char.IsLetterOrDigit)
            .ToArray());
        if (portCode.Length == 0) portCode = "GEN";

        long sequenceValue;
        using (var command = _dbContext.Database.GetDbConnection().CreateCommand())
        {
            // A03: the sequence name is bound as a parameter instead of being interpolated into
            // the SQL statement, so no caller controlled value can reach the query text.
            command.CommandText = "SELECT nextval(@sequenceName::regclass)";
            var parameter = command.CreateParameter();
            parameter.ParameterName = "@sequenceName";
            parameter.Value = $"ectn_seq_{tenantId:N}";
            command.Parameters.Add(parameter);

            _dbContext.Database.OpenConnection();
            var result = await command.ExecuteScalarAsync();
            sequenceValue = result != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt64(result) : throw new InvalidOperationException("Sequence generation failed");
        }

        return $"ECTN-{year}-{portCode}-{sequenceValue}";
    }
}

using System;
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Moq;
using MediatR;
using Ectn.Api.Controllers;
using Ectn.Application.Commands;
using Xunit;

namespace Ectn.Tests.Api.Controllers;

public class EctnControllerTests
{
    [Fact]
    public async Task Get_Should_Return_Ok_With_Draft_Status()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mediatorMock = new Mock<IMediator>();
        var controller = new EctnController(mediatorMock.Object);
        var testId = Guid.NewGuid();

        // Act
        var result = await controller.Get(testId) as OkObjectResult;

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(result);
        Assert.Equal(200, result.StatusCode);
        
        // Use reflection or dynamic to check anonymous type properties
        var value = result.Value;
        var idProperty = value.GetType().GetProperty("Id")?.GetValue(value);
        var statusProperty = value.GetType().GetProperty("Status")?.GetValue(value);
        
        Assert.Equal(testId, idProperty);
        Assert.Equal("Draft", statusProperty);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Create_Should_Return_Forbid_If_TenantId_Is_Missing()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mediatorMock = new Mock<IMediator>();
        var controller = new EctnController(mediatorMock.Object);
        
        // Mock empty user context (no claims)
        controller.ControllerContext = new ControllerContext
        {
            HttpContext = new DefaultHttpContext
            {
                User = new ClaimsPrincipal(new ClaimsIdentity())
            }
        };

        var command = new CreateEctnCommand();

        // Act
        var result = await controller.Create(command) as ForbidResult;

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(result); // Should be forbid because tenant_id is missing
    }
}

using System;
using System.Linq;
using Ectn.Domain.Entities;
using Xunit;

namespace Ectn.Tests.Entities;

public class EctnApplicationTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void EctnApplication_Should_Initialize_With_Default_Values()
    {
        // Arrange & Act
        var application = new EctnApplication();

        // Assert
        Assert.NotEqual(Guid.Empty, application.Id);
        Assert.Equal("Draft", application.Status);
        Assert.Empty(application.ApplicationNumber);
        Assert.Empty(application.ApplicationType);
        
        // Assert dates are set
        Assert.True(application.CreatedAtUtc <= DateTime.UtcNow);
        Assert.True(application.UpdatedAtUtc <= DateTime.UtcNow);
        
        // Assert collections are initialized
        Assert.NotNull(application.Certificates);
        Assert.NotNull(application.Shipments);
        Assert.NotNull(application.PartyRoles);
        Assert.NotNull(application.Documents);
        Assert.NotNull(application.StatusHistories);
        
        Assert.Empty(application.Certificates);
        Assert.Empty(application.Shipments);
        Assert.Empty(application.PartyRoles);
        Assert.Empty(application.Documents);
        Assert.Empty(application.StatusHistories);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void EctnApplication_Can_Add_Status_History()
    {
        // Arrange
        var application = new EctnApplication();
        var statusHistory = new EctnStatusHistory
        {
            Status = Domain.Enums.EctnStatus.Submitted,
            FromStatus = "Draft",
            ToStatus = "Submitted",
            Reason = "User submitted the application"
        };

        // Act
        application.StatusHistories.Add(statusHistory);

        // Assert
        Assert.Single(application.StatusHistories);
        Assert.Equal("Submitted", application.StatusHistories.First().ToStatus);
    }
}

using System;
using Ectn.Domain.Entities;
using Ectn.Domain.Enums;
using Xunit;

namespace Ectn.Tests.Entities;

public class EctnStatusHistoryTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void EctnStatusHistory_Should_Initialize_With_New_Id_And_Current_Utc_Time()
    {
        // Arrange & Act
        var statusHistory = new EctnStatusHistory();

        // Assert
        Assert.NotEqual(Guid.Empty, statusHistory.Id);
        Assert.True(statusHistory.ChangedAtUtc <= DateTime.UtcNow);
        Assert.True(statusHistory.ChangedAtUtc >= DateTime.UtcNow.AddSeconds(-2));
        
        Assert.Equal(statusHistory.ChangedAt, statusHistory.ChangedAtUtc);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ChangedAt_Property_Should_Update_ChangedAtUtc()
    {
        // Arrange
        var statusHistory = new EctnStatusHistory();
        var newTime = new DateTime(2025, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

        // Act
        statusHistory.ChangedAt = newTime;

        // Assert
        Assert.Equal(newTime, statusHistory.ChangedAtUtc);
        Assert.Equal(newTime, statusHistory.ChangedAt);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void EctnStatusHistory_Should_Store_Status_Transitions_Correctly()
    {
        // Arrange
        var statusHistory = new EctnStatusHistory
        {
            Status = EctnStatus.Approved,
            FromStatus = "Pending",
            ToStatus = "Approved",
            Reason = "All documents verified"
        };

        // Assert
        Assert.Equal(EctnStatus.Approved, statusHistory.Status);
        Assert.Equal("Pending", statusHistory.FromStatus);
        Assert.Equal("Approved", statusHistory.ToStatus);
        Assert.Equal("All documents verified", statusHistory.Reason);
    }
}

FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:9.0 AS base
WORKDIR /app
ENV ASPNETCORE_HTTP_PORTS=8080
EXPOSE 8080

FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0 AS build
WORKDIR /src
COPY ["services/ectn/Ectn.Api/Ectn.Api.csproj", "services/ectn/Ectn.Api/"]
COPY ["services/ectn/Ectn.Application/Ectn.Application.csproj", "services/ectn/Ectn.Application/"]
COPY ["services/ectn/Ectn.Domain/Ectn.Domain.csproj", "services/ectn/Ectn.Domain/"]
COPY ["services/ectn/Ectn.Infrastructure/Ectn.Infrastructure.csproj", "services/ectn/Ectn.Infrastructure/"]
COPY ["services/ectn/Ectn.Contracts/Ectn.Contracts.csproj", "services/ectn/Ectn.Contracts/"]
RUN dotnet restore "services/ectn/Ectn.Api/Ectn.Api.csproj"

COPY . .
WORKDIR "/src/services/ectn/Ectn.Api"
RUN dotnet build "Ectn.Api.csproj" -c Release -o /app/build

FROM build AS publish
RUN dotnet publish "Ectn.Api.csproj" -c Release -o /app/publish /p:UseAppHost=false

FROM base AS final
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=publish /app/publish .
# Run as non-root user for security
RUN adduser --disabled-password --gecos "" appuser && chown -R appuser /app
USER appuser
ENTRYPOINT ["dotnet", "Ectn.Api.dll"]

pipeline {
    agent any
    
    environment {
        DOCKER_IMAGE = 'smarttrade/ectn-api'
        REGISTRY = 'registry.smarttrade.local'
    }

    stages {
        stage('Checkout') {
            steps {
                checkout scm
            }
        }
        
        stage('Restore & Build') {
            steps {
                sh 'dotnet restore services/ectn/Ectn.Api/Ectn.Api.csproj'
                sh 'dotnet build services/ectn/Ectn.Api/Ectn.Api.csproj -c Release --no-restore'
            }
        }

        stage('Unit & Architecture Tests') {
            steps {
                sh 'dotnet test tests/Ectn.UnitTests/Ectn.UnitTests.csproj -c Release --no-build --logger "trx;LogFileName=test_results.trx" /p:CollectCoverage=true /p:CoverletOutputFormat=cobertura'
            }
        }

        stage('Security & Secret Scan') {
            steps {
                sh 'trivy fs --exit-code 1 --severity CRITICAL,HIGH .'
                // sh 'gitleaks detect -v'
            }
        }

        stage('Container Build & Push') {
            steps {
                script {
                    docker.build("${REGISTRY}/${DOCKER_IMAGE}:${env.BUILD_ID}", "-f services/ectn/Dockerfile .")
                    docker.withRegistry("https://${REGISTRY}", 'registry-credentials-id') {
                        docker.image("${REGISTRY}/${DOCKER_IMAGE}:${env.BUILD_ID}").push()
                        docker.image("${REGISTRY}/${DOCKER_IMAGE}:${env.BUILD_ID}").push("latest")
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        stage('Update ArgoCD Manifests') {
            steps {
                // Update the image tag in the deployment yaml
                sh "sed -i 's|image: ${REGISTRY}/${DOCKER_IMAGE}:.*|image: ${REGISTRY}/${DOCKER_IMAGE}:${env.BUILD_ID}|g' infrastructure/k8s/ectn-api-deployment.yaml"
                // Commit and push back to git repo to trigger ArgoCD synchronization
            }
        }
    }
    
    post {
        always {
            junit 'tests/**/TestResults/*.trx'
        }
    }
}

<file path="services/fleet/Fleet.Api/Controllers/DispatchesController.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using MediatR;
using Fleet.Application.Commands;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;

namespace Fleet.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/dispatches")]
[Authorize]
public class DispatchesController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;

    public DispatchesController(IMediator mediator)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
    }

    [HttpPost]
    [Authorize(Policy = "fleet.dispatch.create")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> CreateDispatch([FromBody] CreateDispatchCommand command)
    {
        if (!Guid.TryParse(User.FindFirst("tenant_id")?.Value, out var tenantId)) return Forbid();
        command.TenantId = tenantId;

        var dispatchId = await _mediator.Send(command);
        return CreatedAtAction(nameof(GetDispatch), new { id = dispatchId }, new { DispatchId = dispatchId });
    }

    [HttpGet("{id}")]
    [Authorize(Policy = "fleet.dispatch.read")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetDispatch(Guid id)
    {
        return Problem(statusCode: StatusCodes.Status501NotImplemented, title: "Dispatch lookup is not implemented.");
    }
}

<file path="services/fleet/Fleet.Api/Program.cs">
using BuildingBlocks.Web;
using Fleet.Application.Commands;
using Fleet.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

builder.Services.AddControllers();
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
builder.Services.AddSwaggerGen();

builder.Services.AddMediatR(cfg => cfg.RegisterServicesFromAssembly(typeof(CreateDispatchCommand).Assembly));

// A01 (critical): this service previously mapped controllers without any authentication or
// authorization middleware, so every [Authorize] attribute on DispatchesController was silently
// ignored and the dispatch API was reachable anonymously. JWT validation, the deny-by-default
// fallback policy, rate limiting and ProblemDetails are now wired in.
builder.Services.AddPlatformJwtAuthentication(builder.Configuration);
builder.Services.AddPlatformSecurity(builder.Configuration);

builder.Services.AddAuthorization(options =>
{
    options.AddPolicy("fleet.dispatch.create", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "fleet.dispatch.create"));
    options.AddPolicy("fleet.dispatch.read", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "fleet.dispatch.read"));
});

var connectionString = builder.Configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection");
if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionString))
{
    builder.Services.AddDbContext<FleetDbContext>(options => options.UseNpgsql(connectionString));
    builder.Services.AddScoped<IFleetDbContext>(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<FleetDbContext>());
}

var app = builder.Build();

app.UsePlatformSecurity();
if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
{
    app.UseSwagger();
    app.UseSwaggerUI();
}

app.UseHttpsRedirection();
app.UseRouting();
app.UsePlatformCors();
app.UseRateLimiter();
app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseAuthorization();
app.MapControllers();

app.MapGet("/health/live", () => Results.Ok(new { status = "alive" })).AllowAnonymous();

app.Run();

public partial class Program { }
</file>

<file path="services/fleet/Fleet.Application/Commands/CreateDispatchCommand.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using MediatR;
using Fleet.Domain.Entities;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace Fleet.Application.Commands;

public class CreateDispatchCommand : IRequest<Guid>
{
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public Guid FleetCompanyId { get; set; }
    public Guid VehicleId { get; set; }
    public Guid DriverId { get; set; }
    public string? CargoReference { get; set; }
    public string? CustomsCaseReference { get; set; }
}

public interface IFleetDbContext
{
    DbSet<DispatchOrder> DispatchOrders { get; }
    Task<int> SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken);
}

public class CreateDispatchCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<CreateDispatchCommand, Guid>
{
    private readonly IFleetDbContext _context;

    public CreateDispatchCommandHandler(IFleetDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public async Task<Guid> Handle(CreateDispatchCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var dispatchNumber = $"DSP-{DateTime.UtcNow:yyyyMMdd}-{Guid.NewGuid().ToString().Substring(0, 8).ToUpper()}";
        
        var dispatch = new DispatchOrder
        {
            TenantId = request.TenantId,
            FleetCompanyId = request.FleetCompanyId,
            VehicleId = request.VehicleId,
            DriverId = request.DriverId,
            DispatchReference = dispatchNumber,
            CargoReference = request.CargoReference,
            CustomsReleaseReference = request.CustomsCaseReference,
            Status = "Draft",
            Priority = "Normal"
        };

        _context.DispatchOrders.Add(dispatch);
        
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

        return dispatch.Id;
    }
}
