<file path="services/fleet/Fleet.Infrastructure/Persistence/FleetDbContext.cs">
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Fleet.Domain.Entities;
using Fleet.Application.Commands;
using BuildingBlocks.Persistence;

namespace Fleet.Infrastructure.Persistence;

public class FleetDbContext : SmartDbContext<FleetDbContext>, IFleetDbContext
{
    public FleetDbContext(DbContextOptions<FleetDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

    // Core
    public DbSet<FleetCompany> FleetCompanies => Set<FleetCompany>();
    public DbSet<Vehicle> Vehicles => Set<Vehicle>();
    public DbSet<Truck> Trucks => Set<Truck>();
    public DbSet<Trailer> Trailers => Set<Trailer>();
    public DbSet<Driver> Drivers => Set<Driver>();

    // Compliance & Licensing
    public DbSet<VehicleRegistration> Registrations => Set<VehicleRegistration>();
    public DbSet<VehicleCompliance> VehicleCompliances => Set<VehicleCompliance>();
    public DbSet<DriverLicense> Licenses => Set<DriverLicense>();
    public DbSet<DriverQualification> Qualifications => Set<DriverQualification>();
    public DbSet<DriverCompliance> DriverCompliances => Set<DriverCompliance>();
    public DbSet<VehicleInspection> Inspections => Set<VehicleInspection>();
    public DbSet<DriverVerification> Verifications => Set<DriverVerification>();

    // Documents & Capabilities
    public DbSet<VehicleDocument> VehicleDocuments => Set<VehicleDocument>();
    public DbSet<DriverDocument> DriverDocuments => Set<DriverDocument>();
    public DbSet<FleetDocumentVersion> DocumentVersions => Set<FleetDocumentVersion>();
    public DbSet<VehicleCapability> VehicleCapabilities => Set<VehicleCapability>();
    public DbSet<DriverCapability> DriverCapabilities => Set<DriverCapability>();
    public DbSet<VehicleMaintenanceRecord> MaintenanceRecords => Set<VehicleMaintenanceRecord>();

    // Assignments & Dispatch
    public DbSet<VehicleAssignment> VehicleAssignments => Set<VehicleAssignment>();
    public DbSet<DriverAssignment> DriverAssignments => Set<DriverAssignment>();
    public DbSet<TrailerAssignment> TrailerAssignments => Set<TrailerAssignment>();
    public DbSet<DispatchOrder> DispatchOrders => Set<DispatchOrder>();
    public DbSet<DispatchRequirement> DispatchRequirements => Set<DispatchRequirement>();

    // History & Holds
    public DbSet<FleetHold> Holds => Set<FleetHold>();
    public DbSet<DispatchStatusHistory> DispatchStatusHistories => Set<DispatchStatusHistory>();
    public DbSet<VehicleStatusHistory> VehicleStatusHistories => Set<VehicleStatusHistory>();
    public DbSet<DriverStatusHistory> DriverStatusHistories => Set<DriverStatusHistory>();
    public DbSet<AssignmentHistory> AssignmentHistories => Set<AssignmentHistory>();

    // Integration & Audit
    public DbSet<FleetExternalReference> ExternalReferences => Set<FleetExternalReference>();
    public DbSet<FleetIntegrationRecord> IntegrationRecords => Set<FleetIntegrationRecord>();
    public DbSet<FleetAuditEntry> AuditEntries => Set<FleetAuditEntry>();
    public DbSet<OutboxMessage> OutboxMessages => Set<OutboxMessage>();
    public DbSet<InboxMessage> InboxMessages => Set<InboxMessage>();
    public DbSet<IdempotencyRecord> IdempotencyRecords => Set<IdempotencyRecord>();

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder builder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(builder);

        // Core
        builder.Entity<FleetCompany>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.OrganizationId }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.FleetCode }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        builder.Entity<Vehicle>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.VehicleReference }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.NormalizedLicensePlate }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => x.VIN);
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.FleetCompanyId, x.Status });
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();

            e.HasOne(x => x.Truck)
             .WithOne(t => t.Vehicle)
             .HasForeignKey<Truck>(t => t.VehicleId)
             .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        builder.Entity<Truck>(e =>
        {
            e.Property(x => x.GrossVehicleWeight).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(x => x.TareWeight).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(x => x.PayloadCapacity).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        builder.Entity<Trailer>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.TrailerReference }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.NormalizedLicensePlate }).IsUnique();
            
            e.Property(x => x.GrossVehicleWeight).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(x => x.TareWeight).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(x => x.PayloadCapacity).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        builder.Entity<Driver>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.DriverReference }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.UserId }); // UserId may be null for offline drivers
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.FleetCompanyId, x.Status });
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        // Assignments (Concurrency protected)
        builder.Entity<VehicleAssignment>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.VehicleId, x.Status, x.StartAtUtc, x.EndAtUtc });
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        builder.Entity<DriverAssignment>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.DriverId, x.Status, x.StartAtUtc, x.EndAtUtc });
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        builder.Entity<TrailerAssignment>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TrailerId, x.Status, x.StartAtUtc, x.EndAtUtc });
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        // Dispatch
        builder.Entity<DispatchOrder>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.FleetCompanyId, x.DispatchReference }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.VehicleId, x.DriverId, x.Status });
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
            
            e.HasMany(x => x.Requirements)
             .WithOne(r => r.DispatchOrder)
             .HasForeignKey(r => r.DispatchOrderId)
             .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
             
            e.HasMany(x => x.DriverAssignments).WithOne(a => a.DispatchOrder).HasForeignKey(a => a.DispatchOrderId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
            e.HasMany(x => x.TrailerAssignments).WithOne(a => a.DispatchOrder).HasForeignKey(a => a.DispatchOrderId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
        });

        // Compliance & Inspections
        builder.Entity<VehicleCompliance>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.VehicleId, x.Status });
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.VehicleId, x.ExpiryDateUtc });
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        builder.Entity<DriverCompliance>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.DriverId, x.Status });
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.DriverId, x.ExpiryDateUtc });
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });
        
        // Documents
        builder.Entity<VehicleDocument>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.VehicleId, x.DocumentType, x.Status });
        });

        // Integration / Idempotency / Audit / Inbox / Outbox
        builder.Entity<FleetAuditEntry>(e =>
        {
            e.Property(x => x.BeforeJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.Property(x => x.AfterJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.ResourceType, x.ResourceId });
        });

        builder.Entity<AssignmentHistory>(e =>
        {
            e.Property(x => x.PreviousValueJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.Property(x => x.NewValueJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        builder.Entity<IdempotencyRecord>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(i => new { i.TenantId, i.IdempotencyKey, i.Operation }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(i => i.ResponseBodyJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        builder.Entity<InboxMessage>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(i => new { i.MessageId, i.Consumer }).IsUnique();
        });
        
        builder.Entity<OutboxMessage>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(o => o.Status);
            e.HasIndex(o => o.OccurredAtUtc);
            e.Property(o => o.PayloadJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });
        
        builder.Entity<FleetHold>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.ResourceType, x.ResourceId, x.Status });
        });
        
        builder.Entity<FleetExternalReference>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.ResourceType, x.ResourceId });
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.ExternalSystem, x.ExternalReference });
        });
    }

<file path="services/fleet/Fleet.Infrastructure/Repositories/FleetRepository.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Fleet.Domain.Entities;
using Fleet.Domain.Repositories;
using Fleet.Infrastructure.Persistence;

namespace Fleet.Infrastructure.Repositories;

public class FleetRepository : IFleetRepository
{
    private readonly FleetDbContext _context;

    public FleetRepository(FleetDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public async Task<DispatchOrder> GetDispatchByIdAsync(Guid id, Guid tenantId)
    {
        return await _context.DispatchOrders.FirstOrDefaultAsync(d => d.Id == id && d.TenantId == tenantId);
    }

    public async Task AddAsync(DispatchOrder dispatch)
    {
        await _context.DispatchOrders.AddAsync(dispatch);
    }

    public async Task UpdateAsync(DispatchOrder dispatch)
    {
        _context.DispatchOrders.Update(dispatch);
        await Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    public async Task SaveChangesAsync()
    {
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
    }
}

<file path="services/fleet/Fleet.Tests/Api/Controllers/DispatchesControllerTests.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Fleet.Api.Controllers;
using Fleet.Application.Commands;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Moq;
using System.Security.Claims;
using Xunit;

namespace Fleet.Tests.Api.Controllers;

public class DispatchesControllerTests
{
    private readonly Mock<IMediator> _mockMediator;
    private readonly DispatchesController _controller;

    public DispatchesControllerTests()
    {
        _mockMediator = new Mock<IMediator>();
        _controller = new DispatchesController(_mockMediator.Object);
    }

    private void SetUserClaims(Guid tenantId)
    {
        var claims = new[] { new Claim("tenant_id", tenantId.ToString()) };
        var identity = new ClaimsIdentity(claims, "TestAuth");
        _controller.ControllerContext = new ControllerContext
        {
            HttpContext = new DefaultHttpContext { User = new ClaimsPrincipal(identity) }
        };
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task CreateDispatch_Should_Return_201_Created()
    {
        // Arrange
        var tenantId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var dispatchId = Guid.NewGuid();
        SetUserClaims(tenantId);

        _mockMediator
            .Setup(m => m.Send(It.IsAny<CreateDispatchCommand>(), default))
            .ReturnsAsync(dispatchId);

        var command = new CreateDispatchCommand
        {
            FleetCompanyId = Guid.NewGuid(),
            VehicleId = Guid.NewGuid(),
            DriverId = Guid.NewGuid(),
            CargoReference = "CARGO-2026-001"
        };

        // Act
        var result = await _controller.CreateDispatch(command);

        // Assert
        var createdResult = Assert.IsType<CreatedAtActionResult>(result);
        Assert.Equal(201, createdResult.StatusCode);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task CreateDispatch_Should_Set_TenantId_From_Claims()
    {
        // Arrange
        var tenantId = Guid.NewGuid();
        SetUserClaims(tenantId);

        CreateDispatchCommand? capturedCommand = null;
        _mockMediator
            .Setup(m => m.Send(It.IsAny<CreateDispatchCommand>(), default))
            .Callback<IRequest<Guid>, System.Threading.CancellationToken>((cmd, _) =>
                capturedCommand = cmd as CreateDispatchCommand)
            .ReturnsAsync(Guid.NewGuid());

        var command = new CreateDispatchCommand
        {
            VehicleId = Guid.NewGuid(),
            DriverId = Guid.NewGuid()
        };

        // Act
        await _controller.CreateDispatch(command);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(capturedCommand);
        Assert.Equal(tenantId, capturedCommand!.TenantId);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task CreateDispatch_Should_Return_Forbid_When_No_TenantId_Claim()
    {
        // Arrange - No claims
        _controller.ControllerContext = new ControllerContext
        {
            HttpContext = new DefaultHttpContext { User = new ClaimsPrincipal() }
        };

        // Act
        var result = await _controller.CreateDispatch(new CreateDispatchCommand());

        // Assert
        Assert.IsType<ForbidResult>(result);
        _mockMediator.Verify(m => m.Send(It.IsAny<CreateDispatchCommand>(), default), Times.Never);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task GetDispatch_Should_Return_501_NotImplemented()
    {
        // Act
        var result = await _controller.GetDispatch(Guid.NewGuid());

        // Assert
        var problemResult = Assert.IsType<ObjectResult>(result);
        Assert.Equal(501, problemResult.StatusCode);
    }
}

using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Fleet.Application.Commands;
using Fleet.Domain.Entities;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Fleet.Tests.Application.Commands;

public class CreateDispatchCommandHandlerTests
{
    private readonly Mock<IFleetDbContext> _mockContext;
    private readonly Mock<DbSet<DispatchOrder>> _mockDbSet;
    private readonly CreateDispatchCommandHandler _handler;

    public CreateDispatchCommandHandlerTests()
    {
        _mockDbSet = new Mock<DbSet<DispatchOrder>>();
        _mockContext = new Mock<IFleetDbContext>();
        _mockContext.Setup(c => c.DispatchOrders).Returns(_mockDbSet.Object);
        _mockContext.Setup(c => c.SaveChangesAsync(It.IsAny<CancellationToken>())).ReturnsAsync(1);
        _handler = new CreateDispatchCommandHandler(_mockContext.Object);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_Should_Create_DispatchOrder_And_Return_Id()
    {
        // Arrange
        var tenantId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var companyId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var vehicleId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var driverId = Guid.NewGuid();

        var command = new CreateDispatchCommand
        {
            TenantId = tenantId,
            FleetCompanyId = companyId,
            VehicleId = vehicleId,
            DriverId = driverId,
            CargoReference = "CARGO-2026-001",
            CustomsCaseReference = "CASE-2026-001"
        };

        // Act
        var resultId = await _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotEqual(Guid.Empty, resultId);

        // Verify Add and SaveChanges were called
        _mockDbSet.Verify(d => d.Add(It.Is<DispatchOrder>(o =>
            o.TenantId == tenantId &&
            o.VehicleId == vehicleId &&
            o.DriverId == driverId &&
            o.CargoReference == "CARGO-2026-001" &&
            o.Status == "Draft"
        )), Times.Once);

        _mockContext.Verify(c => c.SaveChangesAsync(It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()), Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_Should_Generate_DispatchReference_With_DSP_Prefix()
    {
        // Arrange
        var command = new CreateDispatchCommand
        {
            TenantId = Guid.NewGuid(),
            FleetCompanyId = Guid.NewGuid(),
            VehicleId = Guid.NewGuid(),
            DriverId = Guid.NewGuid()
        };

        DispatchOrder? capturedOrder = null;
        _mockDbSet
            .Setup(d => d.Add(It.IsAny<DispatchOrder>()))
            .Callback<DispatchOrder>(o => capturedOrder = o);

        // Act
        await _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert - DispatchReference starts with DSP-
        Assert.NotNull(capturedOrder);
        Assert.StartsWith("DSP-", capturedOrder!.DispatchReference);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_Should_Set_Default_Status_And_Priority()
    {
        // Arrange
        var command = new CreateDispatchCommand
        {
            TenantId = Guid.NewGuid(),
            FleetCompanyId = Guid.NewGuid(),
            VehicleId = Guid.NewGuid(),
            DriverId = Guid.NewGuid()
        };

        DispatchOrder? capturedOrder = null;
        _mockDbSet
            .Setup(d => d.Add(It.IsAny<DispatchOrder>()))
            .Callback<DispatchOrder>(o => capturedOrder = o);

        // Act
        await _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(capturedOrder);
        Assert.Equal("Draft", capturedOrder!.Status);
        Assert.Equal("Normal", capturedOrder.Priority);
    }

using System;

namespace Fleet.Tests.Entities;

public class DriverTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void Driver_Should_Initialize_With_Correct_Defaults()
    {
        // Arrange & Act
        var tenantId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var companyId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var createdBy = Guid.NewGuid();

        var driver = new Driver
        {
            TenantId = tenantId,
            FleetCompanyId = companyId,
            DriverReference = "DRV-2026-001",
            FirstName = "Axmed",
            LastName = "Cali",
            DisplayName = "Axmed Cali",
            PhoneNumber = "+252612345678",
            Email = "axmed.cali@example.so",
            DateOfBirth = new DateTime(1990, 5, 15),
            Nationality = "Somali",
            CountryCode = "SO",
            CreatedBy = createdBy
        };

        // Assert
        Assert.NotEqual(Guid.Empty, driver.Id);
        Assert.Equal("Pending", driver.Status);               // Default status
        Assert.Equal("Pending", driver.VerificationStatus);  // Default verification
        Assert.Equal(tenantId, driver.TenantId);
        Assert.Equal("Axmed", driver.FirstName);
        Assert.Equal("Cali", driver.LastName);
        Assert.Equal("SO", driver.CountryCode);
        Assert.Null(driver.UserId);      // No user linked by default
        Assert.Null(driver.EmployeeNumber);

        // Collections should be initialized and empty
        Assert.NotNull(driver.Licenses);
        Assert.Empty(driver.Licenses);
        Assert.NotNull(driver.Qualifications);
        Assert.Empty(driver.Qualifications);
        Assert.NotNull(driver.Compliances);
        Assert.Empty(driver.Compliances);
        Assert.NotNull(driver.Verifications);
        Assert.Empty(driver.Verifications);
        Assert.NotNull(driver.Documents);
        Assert.Empty(driver.Documents);
        Assert.NotNull(driver.Capabilities);
        Assert.Empty(driver.Capabilities);
        Assert.NotNull(driver.Assignments);
        Assert.Empty(driver.Assignments);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Driver_Status_Should_Default_To_Pending()
    {
        // Act
        var driver = new Driver();

        // Assert
        Assert.Equal("Pending", driver.Status);
        Assert.Equal("Pending", driver.VerificationStatus);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Driver_Should_Have_Unique_Id_Per_Instance()
    {
        // Arrange & Act
        var driver1 = new Driver();
        var driver2 = new Driver();

        // Assert
        Assert.NotEqual(driver1.Id, driver2.Id);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Driver_DateOfBirth_Should_Be_Stored_Correctly()
    {
        // Arrange
        var dob = new DateTime(1985, 3, 22);

        // Act
        var driver = new Driver { DateOfBirth = dob };

        // Assert
        Assert.Equal(1985, driver.DateOfBirth.Year);
        Assert.Equal(3, driver.DateOfBirth.Month);
        Assert.Equal(22, driver.DateOfBirth.Day);
    }
}

<file path="services/gps-telematics/GpsTelematics.Api/Controllers/TelemetryIngestionController.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using MediatR;
using GpsTelematics.Application.Commands;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;

namespace GpsTelematics.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/gps/ingest")]
public class TelemetryIngestionController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;

    public TelemetryIngestionController(IMediator mediator)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
    }

    [HttpPost]
    [Authorize(Policy = "gps.device.ingest")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> IngestTelemetry([FromBody] IngestTelemetryCommand command)
    {
        if (!Guid.TryParse(User.FindFirst("tenant_id")?.Value, out var tenantId) ||
            !Guid.TryParse(User.FindFirst("device_id")?.Value, out var deviceId)) return Forbid();
        command.TenantId = tenantId;
        command.DeviceId = deviceId;

        var positionId = await _mediator.Send(command);
        return Accepted(new { PositionId = positionId, Status = "Processed" });
    }
}

<file path="services/gps-telematics/GpsTelematics.Api/Program.cs">
using BuildingBlocks.Web;
using GpsTelematics.Application.Commands;
using GpsTelematics.Application.Interfaces;
using GpsTelematics.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using GpsTelematics.Infrastructure.Repositories;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

builder.Services.AddControllers();
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
builder.Services.AddSwaggerGen();

builder.Services.AddPlatformJwtAuthentication(builder.Configuration);

// Platform-wide security defaults: deny-by-default fallback policy (A01), rate limiting (A07),
// config-driven CORS, ProblemDetails exception handling and security headers (A05/A09).
builder.Services.AddPlatformSecurity(builder.Configuration);

builder.Services.AddAuthorization(options =>
{
    options.AddPolicy("gps.device.ingest", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "gps.device.ingest"));
});

var connectionString = builder.Configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection");
if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionString))
    throw new InvalidOperationException("ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection is required.");

builder.Services.AddMediatR(cfg => cfg.RegisterServicesFromAssembly(typeof(IngestTelemetryCommand).Assembly));

builder.Services.AddDbContext<GpsDbContext>(options => options.UseNpgsql(connectionString));

builder.Services.AddScoped<ITelemetryIngestionRepository, TelemetryIngestionRepository>();

var app = builder.Build();

app.UsePlatformSecurity();
if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
{
    app.UseSwagger();
    app.UseSwaggerUI();
}
app.UseHttpsRedirection();
app.UseRouting();
app.UsePlatformCors();
app.UseRateLimiter();
app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseAuthorization();
app.MapControllers();

app.MapGet("/health/live", () => "Alive").AllowAnonymous();
app.MapGet("/health/ready", async (GpsDbContext db, CancellationToken ct) =>
{
    try
    {
        if (await db.Database.CanConnectAsync(ct)) return (IResult)Results.Ok(new { status = "ready" });
        return Results.Problem(statusCode: StatusCodes.Status503ServiceUnavailable, title: "Database unavailable");
    }
    catch
    {
        return Results.Problem(statusCode: StatusCodes.Status503ServiceUnavailable, title: "Database unavailable");
    }
}).AllowAnonymous();

app.Run();

public partial class Program { }
</file>

<file path="services/gps-telematics/GpsTelematics.Application/Commands/IngestTelemetryCommand.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using MediatR;
using GpsTelematics.Application.Interfaces;
using GpsTelematics.Domain.Entities;

namespace GpsTelematics.Application.Commands;

public class IngestTelemetryCommand : IRequest<Guid>
{
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public Guid DeviceId { get; set; }
    public double Latitude { get; set; }
    public double Longitude { get; set; }
    public double Speed { get; set; }
    public double Heading { get; set; }
    public DateTime RecordedAt { get; set; }
    public long SequenceNumber { get; set; }
    // VehicleId is resolved during processing if device is actively assigned
    public Guid? VehicleId { get; set; } 
}

public class IngestTelemetryCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<IngestTelemetryCommand, Guid>
{
    private readonly ITelemetryIngestionRepository _repository;

    public IngestTelemetryCommandHandler(ITelemetryIngestionRepository repository)
    {
        _repository = repository;
    }

    public async Task<Guid> Handle(IngestTelemetryCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var position = new GpsPosition
        {
            TenantId = request.TenantId,
            GpsDeviceId = request.DeviceId,
            Latitude = request.Latitude,
            Longitude = request.Longitude,
            SpeedKph = request.Speed,
            HeadingDegrees = request.Heading,
            TimestampUtc = request.RecordedAt,
            SequenceNumber = request.SequenceNumber
            // request.VehicleId is intentionally not mapped yet: the vehicle is only
            // resolved once the device's active assignment is known, and the position
            // row stores the resolved vehicle reference instead.
        };

        // Logic to update LatestLocationCache (Redis) would go here

        await _repository.AddAsync(position, cancellationToken);

        return position.Id;
    }
}
</file>

<file path="services/gps-telematics/GpsTelematics.Application/Validators/IngestTelemetryCommandValidator.cs">
using FluentValidation;
using GpsTelematics.Application.Commands;

namespace GpsTelematics.Application.Validators;

public class IngestTelemetryCommandValidator : AbstractValidator<IngestTelemetryCommand>
{
    public IngestTelemetryCommandValidator()
    {
        RuleFor(x => x.TenantId).NotEmpty();
        RuleFor(x => x.DeviceId).NotEmpty();

        RuleFor(x => x.Latitude)
            .InclusiveBetween(-90.0, 90.0)
            .WithMessage("Latitude must be between -90 and 90 degrees.");

        RuleFor(x => x.Longitude)
            .InclusiveBetween(-180.0, 180.0)
            .WithMessage("Longitude must be between -180 and 180 degrees.");

        RuleFor(x => x.Speed).GreaterThanOrEqualTo(0).WithMessage("Speed cannot be negative.");
        RuleFor(x => x.RecordedAt).LessThanOrEqualTo(DateTime.UtcNow).WithMessage("RecordedAt cannot be in the future.");
    }
}
</file>

<file path="services/gps-telematics/GpsTelematics.Infrastructure/Persistence/GpsDbContext.cs">
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using GpsTelematics.Domain.Entities;

namespace GpsTelematics.Infrastructure.Persistence;

public class GpsDbContext : DbContext
{
    // PostgreSQL Core Entities
    public DbSet<GpsDevice> Devices { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<TelematicsDevice> TelematicsDevices { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<DeviceAssignment> DeviceAssignments { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<DeviceConnection> DeviceConnections { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<TrackingSession> TrackingSessions { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<RouteTrackingSession> RouteTrackingSessions { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<VehicleLocation> VehicleLocations { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<LocationStatusHistory> LocationStatusHistories { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<GpsPosition> GpsPositions { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<DeviceHealth> DeviceHealths { get; set; } = null!;

    // Geofence & Alert Entities
    public DbSet<Geofence> Geofences { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<GeofenceRule> GeofenceRules { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<GeofenceEvent> GeofenceEvents { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<TrackingAlert> TrackingAlerts { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<DeviceAlert> DeviceAlerts { get; set; } = null!;

    // Command & Integration Entities
    public DbSet<DeviceCommand> DeviceCommands { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<DeviceCommandResult> DeviceCommandResults { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<GpsExternalReference> ExternalReferences { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<GpsIntegrationRecord> IntegrationRecords { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<GpsAuditEntry> AuditEntries { get; set; } = null!;
    
    // Outbox/Inbox
    public DbSet<OutboxMessage> OutboxMessages { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<InboxMessage> InboxMessages { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IdempotencyRecord> IdempotencyRecords { get; set; } = null!;

    // Telemetry Entities (Mapped for SQL queryability, even if high-volume hits MongoDB)
    public DbSet<OdometerReading> OdometerReadings { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<EngineStatus> EngineStatuses { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<FuelReading> FuelReadings { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<SensorReading> SensorReadings { get; set; } = null!;

    public GpsDbContext(DbContextOptions<GpsDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);
        
        // Setup PostGIS extension
        modelBuilder.HasPostgresExtension("postgis");

        // 1. PostgreSQL Core Entities
        modelBuilder.Entity<GpsDevice>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.DeviceReference }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => x.DeviceSerialNumber);
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Status);
            e.HasIndex(x => x.LastSeenAtUtc);
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<TelematicsDevice>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.GpsDeviceId }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<DeviceAssignment>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.GpsDeviceId, x.VehicleReference, x.StartAtUtc, x.EndAtUtc, x.Status });
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<DeviceConnection>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.GpsDeviceId, x.Status });
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<TrackingSession>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.GpsDeviceId, x.VehicleReference, x.Status, x.StartedAtUtc });
            e.Property(x => x.StartPosition).HasColumnType("geography(Point,4326)");
            e.Property(x => x.EndPosition).HasColumnType("geography(Point,4326)");
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<RouteTrackingSession>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.GpsDeviceId, x.VehicleReference, x.Status });
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<VehicleLocation>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.VehicleReference, x.TimestampUtc });
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Position).HasMethod("GIST"); // Spatial Index
            e.Property(x => x.Position).HasColumnType("geography(Point,4326)");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<LocationStatusHistory>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.VehicleReference });
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<GpsPosition>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.VehicleReference, x.GpsDeviceId, x.TimestampUtc, x.TrackingSessionId });
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Position).HasMethod("GIST"); // Spatial Index
            e.Property(x => x.Position).HasColumnType("geography(Point,4326)");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<DeviceHealth>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.GpsDeviceId });
        });

        // 2. Geofence & Alert Entities
        modelBuilder.Entity<Geofence>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.Status });
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Geometry).HasMethod("GIST"); // Spatial Index
            e.Property(x => x.Geometry).HasColumnType("geometry(Geometry,4326)");
            e.HasIndex(x => x.CenterPoint).HasMethod("GIST");
            e.Property(x => x.CenterPoint).HasColumnType("geography(Point,4326)");
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<GeofenceRule>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.GeofenceId });
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<GeofenceEvent>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.VehicleReference, x.GeofenceId, x.OccurredAtUtc });
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Position).HasMethod("GIST"); // Spatial Index
            e.Property(x => x.Position).HasColumnType("geography(Point,4326)");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<TrackingAlert>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.VehicleReference, x.Severity, x.Status, x.OccurredAtUtc });
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Position).HasMethod("GIST"); // Spatial Index
            e.Property(x => x.Position).HasColumnType("geography(Point,4326)");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<DeviceAlert>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.GpsDeviceId, x.Status });
        });

        // 3. Command & Integration Entities
        modelBuilder.Entity<DeviceCommand>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.GpsDeviceId, x.Status });
            e.Property(x => x.CommandPayloadJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<DeviceCommandResult>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.CommandId, x.Status });
            e.Property(x => x.ResultPayloadJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<GpsExternalReference>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.ResourceType, x.ResourceId });
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.ExternalSystem, x.ExternalReference });
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<GpsIntegrationRecord>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.ResourceType, x.ResourceId });
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<GpsAuditEntry>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.ResourceType, x.ResourceId });
            e.Property(x => x.BeforeJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.Property(x => x.AfterJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<IdempotencyRecord>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(i => new { i.TenantId, i.IdempotencyKey, i.Operation }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(i => i.ResponseBodyJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<InboxMessage>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(i => new { i.MessageId, i.Consumer }).IsUnique();
        });
        
        modelBuilder.Entity<OutboxMessage>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(o => o.Status);
            e.HasIndex(o => o.OccurredAtUtc);
            e.Property(o => o.PayloadJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        // 4. Telemetry Entities
        modelBuilder.Entity<OdometerReading>(e => e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.VehicleReference, x.TimestampUtc }));
        modelBuilder.Entity<EngineStatus>(e => e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.VehicleReference, x.TimestampUtc }));
        modelBuilder.Entity<FuelReading>(e => e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.VehicleReference, x.TimestampUtc }));
        modelBuilder.Entity<SensorReading>(e => e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.VehicleReference, x.TimestampUtc }));
    }
}

<file path="services/gps-telematics/GpsTelematics.Infrastructure/Repositories/GpsRepository.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using GpsTelematics.Domain.Entities;
using GpsTelematics.Domain.Repositories;
using GpsTelematics.Infrastructure.Persistence;

namespace GpsTelematics.Infrastructure.Repositories;

public class GpsRepository : IGpsRepository
{
    private readonly GpsDbContext _context;

    public GpsRepository(GpsDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public async Task<GpsPosition> GetPositionByIdAsync(Guid id, Guid tenantId)
    {
        return await _context.Positions.FirstOrDefaultAsync(p => p.Id == id && p.TenantId == tenantId);
    }

    public async Task AddPositionAsync(GpsPosition position)
    {
        await _context.Positions.AddAsync(position);
    }

    public async Task SaveChangesAsync()
    {
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
    }
}
</file>

using System.Threading;

<file path="services/gps-telematics/GpsTelematics.Tests/Api/Controllers/TelemetryIngestionControllerTests.cs">
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using GpsTelematics.Api.Controllers;
using GpsTelematics.Application.Commands;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Moq;

namespace GpsTelematics.Tests.Api.Controllers;

public class TelemetryIngestionControllerTests
{
    private readonly Mock<IMediator> _mediator = new();
    private readonly TelemetryIngestionController _controller;

    public TelemetryIngestionControllerTests()
    {
        _controller = new TelemetryIngestionController(_mediator.Object)
        {
            ControllerContext = new ControllerContext { HttpContext = new DefaultHttpContext() }
        };
    }

    private void SetUser(string? tenantId = null, string? deviceId = null)
    {
        var claims = new List<Claim>();
        if (tenantId is not null) claims.Add(new Claim("tenant_id", tenantId));
        if (deviceId is not null) claims.Add(new Claim("device_id", deviceId));

        _controller.ControllerContext.HttpContext.User =
            new ClaimsPrincipal(new ClaimsIdentity(claims, "TestAuth"));
    }

    private static IngestTelemetryCommand BuildCommand() => new()
    {
        // Deliberately wrong values: the controller must overwrite them from the token
        TenantId = Guid.Empty,
        DeviceId = Guid.Empty,
        Latitude = 11.5919,
        Longitude = 43.1456,
        Speed = 30,
        Heading = 90,
        RecordedAt = new DateTime(2026, 2, 1, 8, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc),
        SequenceNumber = 42
    };

    [Fact]
    public async Task IngestTelemetry_WithValidClaims_ShouldReturnAccepted()
    {
        // Arrange
        var positionId = Guid.NewGuid();
        SetUser(Guid.NewGuid().ToString(), Guid.NewGuid().ToString());
        _mediator
            .Setup(m => m.Send(It.IsAny<IngestTelemetryCommand>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .ReturnsAsync(positionId);

        // Act
        var result = await _controller.IngestTelemetry(BuildCommand());

        // Assert
        var accepted = Assert.IsType<AcceptedResult>(result);
        Assert.Equal(StatusCodes.Status202Accepted, accepted.StatusCode);

        var payload = accepted.Value!;
        var status = payload.GetType().GetProperty("Status")?.GetValue(payload);
        var returnedId = payload.GetType().GetProperty("PositionId")?.GetValue(payload);
        Assert.Equal("Processed", status);
        Assert.Equal(positionId, returnedId);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task IngestTelemetry_ShouldOverrideTenantAndDeviceFromTheToken()
    {
        // Arrange: clients must never be able to claim another tenant's identity
        var tenantId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var deviceId = Guid.NewGuid();
        SetUser(tenantId.ToString(), deviceId.ToString());

        IngestTelemetryCommand? sent = null;
        _mediator
            .Setup(m => m.Send(It.IsAny<IngestTelemetryCommand>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .Callback<IRequest<Guid>, CancellationToken>((c, _) => sent = (IngestTelemetryCommand)c)
            .ReturnsAsync(Guid.NewGuid());

        // Act
        await _controller.IngestTelemetry(BuildCommand());

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(sent);
        Assert.Equal(tenantId, sent!.TenantId);
        Assert.Equal(deviceId, sent.DeviceId);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task IngestTelemetry_WithoutClaims_ShouldForbid_AndNotCallMediator()
    {
        // Arrange
        SetUser();

        // Act
        var result = await _controller.IngestTelemetry(BuildCommand());

        // Assert
        Assert.IsType<ForbidResult>(result);
        _mediator.Verify(m => m.Send(It.IsAny<IngestTelemetryCommand>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()), Times.Never);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task IngestTelemetry_WithOnlyTenantClaim_ShouldForbid()
    {
        // Arrange: both tenant_id and device_id are required for ingestion
        SetUser(tenantId: Guid.NewGuid().ToString(), deviceId: null);

        // Act
        var result = await _controller.IngestTelemetry(BuildCommand());

        // Assert
        Assert.IsType<ForbidResult>(result);
        _mediator.Verify(m => m.Send(It.IsAny<IngestTelemetryCommand>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()), Times.Never);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task IngestTelemetry_WithNonGuidClaims_ShouldForbid()
    {
        // Arrange
        SetUser(tenantId: "not-a-guid", deviceId: Guid.NewGuid().ToString());

        // Act
        var result = await _controller.IngestTelemetry(BuildCommand());

        // Assert
        Assert.IsType<ForbidResult>(result);
        _mediator.Verify(m => m.Send(It.IsAny<IngestTelemetryCommand>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()), Times.Never);

<file path="services/gps-telematics/GpsTelematics.Tests/Application/Commands/IngestTelemetryCommandHandlerTests.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using GpsTelematics.Application.Commands;
using GpsTelematics.Application.Interfaces;
using GpsTelematics.Domain.Entities;
using Moq;

namespace GpsTelematics.Tests.Application.Commands;

public class IngestTelemetryCommandHandlerTests
{
    private readonly Mock<ITelemetryIngestionRepository> _repository = new();
    private readonly IngestTelemetryCommandHandler _handler;

    public IngestTelemetryCommandHandlerTests()
    {
        _handler = new IngestTelemetryCommandHandler(_repository.Object);
    }

    private static IngestTelemetryCommand BuildCommand(
        Guid? tenantId = null,
        Guid? deviceId = null,
        double latitude = 11.5919,
        double longitude = 43.1456,
        double speed = 42.5,
        double heading = 187.3,
        DateTime? recordedAt = null,
        long sequenceNumber = 1001)
    {
        return new IngestTelemetryCommand
        {
            TenantId = tenantId ?? Guid.NewGuid(),
            DeviceId = deviceId ?? Guid.NewGuid(),
            Latitude = latitude,
            Longitude = longitude,
            Speed = speed,
            Heading = heading,
            RecordedAt = recordedAt ?? new DateTime(2026, 1, 15, 10, 30, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc),
            SequenceNumber = sequenceNumber
        };
    }

    private GpsPosition? CapturePersistedPosition()
    {
        GpsPosition? saved = null;
        _repository
            .Setup(r => r.AddAsync(It.IsAny<GpsPosition>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .Callback<GpsPosition, CancellationToken>((position, _) => saved = position)
            .Returns(Task.CompletedTask);
        return saved;
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_ShouldPersistPosition_Once_AndReturnItsId()
    {
        // Arrange
        GpsPosition? saved = null;
        _repository
            .Setup(r => r.AddAsync(It.IsAny<GpsPosition>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .Callback<GpsPosition, CancellationToken>((position, _) => saved = position)
            .Returns(Task.CompletedTask);
        var command = BuildCommand();

        // Act
        var positionId = await _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(saved);
        Assert.Equal(saved!.Id, positionId);
        Assert.NotEqual(Guid.Empty, positionId);
        _repository.Verify(r => r.AddAsync(It.IsAny<GpsPosition>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()), Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_ShouldMapCommandFieldsOntoPosition()
    {
        // Arrange
        GpsPosition? saved = null;
        _repository
            .Setup(r => r.AddAsync(It.IsAny<GpsPosition>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .Callback<GpsPosition, CancellationToken>((position, _) => saved = position)
            .Returns(Task.CompletedTask);
        var command = BuildCommand();

        // Act
        await _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(saved);
        Assert.Equal(command.TenantId, saved!.TenantId);
        Assert.Equal(command.DeviceId, saved.GpsDeviceId);
        Assert.Equal(command.Latitude, saved.Latitude);
        Assert.Equal(command.Longitude, saved.Longitude);
        Assert.Equal(command.Speed, saved.SpeedKph);
        Assert.Equal(command.Heading, saved.HeadingDegrees);
        Assert.Equal(command.RecordedAt, saved.TimestampUtc);
        Assert.Equal(command.SequenceNumber, saved.SequenceNumber);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_ShouldAcceptOutOfOrderSequenceNumbers()
    {
        // Arrange: a device may re-send older frames after a network outage
        GpsPosition? saved = null;
        _repository
            .Setup(r => r.AddAsync(It.IsAny<GpsPosition>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .Callback<GpsPosition, CancellationToken>((position, _) => saved = position)
            .Returns(Task.CompletedTask);
        var command = BuildCommand(sequenceNumber: 7);

        // Act
        var positionId = await _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert: deduplication/validation happens downstream, ingestion itself succeeds
        Assert.NotEqual(Guid.Empty, positionId);
        Assert.Equal(7, saved!.SequenceNumber);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_ShouldForwardTheCancellationToken()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        CancellationToken receivedToken = CancellationToken.None;
        _repository
            .Setup(r => r.AddAsync(It.IsAny<GpsPosition>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .Callback<GpsPosition, CancellationToken>((_, token) => receivedToken = token)
            .Returns(Task.CompletedTask);

        // Act
        await _handler.Handle(BuildCommand(), cts.Token);

        // Assert
        Assert.Equal(cts.Token, receivedToken);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_WithVehicleIdSupplied_ShouldStillIngestThePosition()
    {
        // Arrange: vehicle resolution is deferred, so an unassigned frame must not fail
        GpsPosition? saved = null;
        _repository
            .Setup(r => r.AddAsync(It.IsAny<GpsPosition>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .Callback<GpsPosition, CancellationToken>((position, _) => saved = position)
            .Returns(Task.CompletedTask);
        var command = BuildCommand();
        command.VehicleId = Guid.NewGuid();

        // Act
        var positionId = await _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotEqual(Guid.Empty, positionId);
        Assert.NotNull(saved);
        _repository.Verify(r => r.AddAsync(It.IsAny<GpsPosition>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()), Times.Once);
    }
}

using System;
using System.Linq;
using GpsTelematics.Domain.Enums;

namespace GpsTelematics.Tests.Domain.Enums;

public class EnumsTests
{
    [Theory]
    [InlineData(DeviceStatus.Provisioning)]
    [InlineData(DeviceStatus.Active)]
    [InlineData(DeviceStatus.Online)]
    [InlineData(DeviceStatus.Offline)]
    [InlineData(DeviceStatus.Suspended)]
    [InlineData(DeviceStatus.Retired)]
    public void DeviceStatus_ShouldContainKnownStates(DeviceStatus status)
    {
        Assert.True(Enum.IsDefined(status));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DeviceStatus_Provisioning_ShouldBeTheDefaultZeroValue()
    {
        Assert.Equal(0, (int)DeviceStatus.Provisioning);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(DeviceType.GPS)]
    [InlineData(DeviceType.OBD)]
    [InlineData(DeviceType.CANBus)]
    [InlineData(DeviceType.Telematics)]
    [InlineData(DeviceType.Tracker)]
    [InlineData(DeviceType.Other)]
    public void DeviceType_ShouldContainKnownDeviceKinds(DeviceType deviceType)
    {
        Assert.True(Enum.IsDefined(deviceType));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AlertSeverity_ShouldBeOrderedFromInfoToCritical()
    {
        // Assert: severity ordering matters for alert routing/thresholds
        Assert.Equal(0, (int)AlertSeverity.Info);
        Assert.Equal(1, (int)AlertSeverity.Low);
        Assert.Equal(2, (int)AlertSeverity.Medium);
        Assert.Equal(3, (int)AlertSeverity.High);
        Assert.Equal(4, (int)AlertSeverity.Critical);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TrackingSessionStatus_ShouldCoverTheSessionLifecycle()
    {
        // Assert
        Assert.Equal(0, (int)TrackingSessionStatus.Created);
        Assert.Equal(TrackingSessionStatus.Active, Enum.Parse<TrackingSessionStatus>("Active"));
        Assert.Equal(TrackingSessionStatus.Paused, Enum.Parse<TrackingSessionStatus>("Paused"));
        Assert.Equal(TrackingSessionStatus.Completed, Enum.Parse<TrackingSessionStatus>("Completed"));
        Assert.Equal(TrackingSessionStatus.Cancelled, Enum.Parse<TrackingSessionStatus>("Cancelled"));
        Assert.False(Enum.IsDefined(typeof(TrackingSessionStatus), 99));
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(GeofenceType.Port)]
    [InlineData(GeofenceType.Terminal)]
    [InlineData(GeofenceType.Border)]
    [InlineData(GeofenceType.DryPort)]
    [InlineData(GeofenceType.RestrictedArea)]
    [InlineData(GeofenceType.Custom)]
    public void GeofenceType_ShouldContainKnownZoneKinds(GeofenceType geofenceType)
    {
        Assert.True(Enum.IsDefined(geofenceType));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AllEnums_ShouldHaveNoDuplicateNames()
    {
        // Assert: duplicate names would break string-based persistence/serialization
        AssertNoDuplicateNames<DeviceStatus>();
        AssertNoDuplicateNames<DeviceType>();
        AssertNoDuplicateNames<AlertSeverity>();
        AssertNoDuplicateNames<TrackingSessionStatus>();
        AssertNoDuplicateNames<GeofenceType>();
    }

    private static void AssertNoDuplicateNames<T>() where T : struct, Enum
    {
        var names = Enum.GetNames<T>();
        Assert.Equal(names.Length, names.Distinct().Count());
    }

<file path="services/gps-telematics/GpsTelematics.Tests/Infrastructure/Repositories/TelemetryIngestionRepositoryTests.cs">
using System;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using GpsTelematics.Domain.Entities;
using GpsTelematics.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using GpsTelematics.Infrastructure.Repositories;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using NetTopologySuite.Geometries;

namespace GpsTelematics.Tests.Infrastructure.Repositories;

public class TelemetryIngestionRepositoryTests : IDisposable
{
    private readonly GpsDbContext _context;
    private readonly TelemetryIngestionRepository _repository;

    public TelemetryIngestionRepositoryTests()
    {
        var options = new DbContextOptionsBuilder<GpsDbContext>()
            .UseInMemoryDatabase($"gps-telemetry-tests-{Guid.NewGuid()}")
            .Options;

        _context = new GpsDbContext(options);
        _repository = new TelemetryIngestionRepository(_context);
    }

    public void Dispose() => _context.Dispose();

    private static GpsPosition BuildPosition(
        double latitude = 11.5919,
        double longitude = 43.1456,
        long sequenceNumber = 1001)
    {
        return new GpsPosition
        {
            TenantId = Guid.NewGuid(),
            GpsDeviceId = Guid.NewGuid(),
            VehicleReference = "VEH-42",
            Position = new Point(longitude, latitude),
            Latitude = latitude,
            Longitude = longitude,
            SpeedKph = 42.5,
            HeadingDegrees = 187.3,
            TimestampUtc = new DateTime(2026, 1, 15, 10, 30, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc),
            SequenceNumber = sequenceNumber
        };
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task AddAsync_ShouldPersistThePositionWithoutAnExplicitSaveCall()
    {
        // Arrange: the repository is responsible for calling SaveChanges itself
        var position = BuildPosition();

        // Act
        await _repository.AddAsync(position);

        // Assert: a fresh query hits the store, not the change tracker
        var persisted = await _context.GpsPositions
            .AsNoTracking()
            .SingleAsync(p => p.Id == position.Id);

        Assert.NotNull(persisted);
        Assert.Equal(position.TenantId, persisted.TenantId);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task AddAsync_ShouldPersistAllIngestedFields()
    {
        // Arrange
        var position = BuildPosition(latitude: 11.5919, longitude: 43.1456, sequenceNumber: 777);

        // Act
        await _repository.AddAsync(position);

        // Assert
        var persisted = await _context.GpsPositions.AsNoTracking().SingleAsync(p => p.Id == position.Id);
        Assert.Equal(11.5919, persisted.Latitude);
        Assert.Equal(43.1456, persisted.Longitude);
        Assert.Equal(42.5, persisted.SpeedKph);
        Assert.Equal(187.3, persisted.HeadingDegrees);
        Assert.Equal(777, persisted.SequenceNumber);
        Assert.Equal("VEH-42", persisted.VehicleReference);
        Assert.Equal("Accepted", persisted.ValidationStatus);
        Assert.Equal(new DateTime(2026, 1, 15, 10, 30, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc), persisted.TimestampUtc);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task AddAsync_CalledTwice_ShouldPersistBothPositions()
    {
        // Arrange: a device sends a stream of frames across multiple calls
        var first = BuildPosition(sequenceNumber: 1);
        var second = BuildPosition(sequenceNumber: 2);

        // Act
        await _repository.AddAsync(first);
        await _repository.AddAsync(second);

        // Assert
        Assert.Equal(2, await _context.GpsPositions.AsNoTracking().CountAsync());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task AddAsync_WithAnAlreadyStoredId_ShouldThrow_RatherThanDuplicateTheRow()
    {
        // Arrange: the primary key prevents a second row for the same frame
        var position = BuildPosition();
        await _repository.AddAsync(position);
        _context.ChangeTracker.Clear(); // simulate a brand-new unit of work

        // Act & Assert: re-ingestion of the same Id is rejected by the store
        await Assert.ThrowsAnyAsync<Exception>(() => _repository.AddAsync(position));
        Assert.Equal(1, await _context.GpsPositions.AsNoTracking().CountAsync());
    }
}

<file path="services/identity/Identity.Api/Controllers/AuthController.cs">
using Identity.Application.Commands.Auth;
using Identity.Application.Interfaces;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.RateLimiting;
using BuildingBlocks.Web;

namespace Identity.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/identity/auth")]
// A01: authentication endpoints are the only anonymous surface of this service; every other
// endpoint falls back to "authenticated user required".
[AllowAnonymous]
public sealed class AuthController : ControllerBase
{
    private const string RefreshCookieName = "smarttrade_refresh";
    private const string RefreshCookiePath = "/api/v1/identity/auth";
    private readonly IIdentityAuthService _authService;

    public AuthController(IIdentityAuthService authService) => _authService = authService;

    [HttpPost("login")]
    [EnableRateLimiting("identity-auth")]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(LoginResponse), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status401Unauthorized)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Login([FromBody] LoginCommand command, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var result = await _authService.LoginAsync(command, ClientIpAddress(), Request.Headers["User-Agent"].ToString(), cancellationToken);
        if (result is null) return Unauthorized(new { error = "Invalid credentials or account unavailable." });
        if (result.RequiresMfa)
            return StatusCode(StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden, new { error = "MFA challenge is required.", requiresMfa = true });

        SetRefreshCookie(result.RefreshToken);
        return Ok(ToResponse(result));
    }

    [HttpPost("refresh")]
    [EnableRateLimiting("identity-auth")]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(LoginResponse), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status401Unauthorized)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Refresh(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        if (!Request.Cookies.TryGetValue(RefreshCookieName, out var refreshToken)) return Unauthorized();
        var result = await _authService.RefreshAsync(refreshToken, ClientIpAddress(), Request.Headers["User-Agent"].ToString(), cancellationToken);
        if (result is null)
        {
            ClearRefreshCookie();
            return Unauthorized();
        }
        SetRefreshCookie(result.RefreshToken);
        return Ok(ToResponse(result));
    }

    [HttpPost("logout")]
    [EnableRateLimiting(PlatformSecurityExtensions.SensitiveRateLimitPolicy)]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status204NoContent)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Logout(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        if (Request.Cookies.TryGetValue(RefreshCookieName, out var refreshToken))
            await _authService.RevokeRefreshTokenAsync(refreshToken, cancellationToken);
        ClearRefreshCookie();
        return NoContent();
    }

    [HttpPost("forgot-password")]
    [EnableRateLimiting(PlatformSecurityExtensions.SensitiveRateLimitPolicy)]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status503ServiceUnavailable)]
    public IActionResult ForgotPassword() =>
        StatusCode(StatusCodes.Status503ServiceUnavailable, new { error = "Password recovery is not configured." });

    private static LoginResponse ToResponse(LoginResult result) => new(
        result.AccessToken, result.ExpiresAtUtc, result.TenantType, result.Roles, result.Permissions, result.TenantCode);

    private void SetRefreshCookie(string token) => Response.Cookies.Append(RefreshCookieName, token, new CookieOptions
    {
        HttpOnly = true,
        Secure = true,
        SameSite = SameSiteMode.Strict,
        Path = RefreshCookiePath,
        IsEssential = true,
        MaxAge = TimeSpan.FromDays(30)
    });

    private void ClearRefreshCookie() => Response.Cookies.Delete(RefreshCookieName, new CookieOptions
    {
        HttpOnly = true,
        Secure = true,
        SameSite = SameSiteMode.Strict,
        Path = RefreshCookiePath,
        IsEssential = true
    });

    private string ClientIpAddress() => HttpContext.Connection.RemoteIpAddress?.ToString() ?? "unknown";

    public sealed record LoginResponse(string AccessToken, DateTime ExpiresAtUtc, string TenantType,
        IReadOnlyList<string> Roles, IReadOnlyList<string> Permissions, string TenantCode);
}
</file>

public class TenantResolutionMiddleware

    }

    public async Task InvokeAsync(HttpContext context, ITenantContext tenantContext)
    {
        // Example: Resolve tenant from header or JWT Claims
        if (context.Request.Headers.TryGetValue("X-Tenant-Code", out var tenantCodeHeader))
        {
            var code = tenantCodeHeader.FirstOrDefault();
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(code))
            {
                // In a real implementation, you would validate this code exists
                // and assign it to the scoped ITenantContext.
                // tenantContext.SetTenant(code);
            }
        }
        else if (context.User.Identity?.IsAuthenticated == true)
        {
            // Extract from JWT "tenant_id" claim
            var tenantClaim = context.User.FindFirst("tenant_id");
            if (tenantClaim != null)
            {
                // tenantContext.SetTenant(Guid.Parse(tenantClaim.Value));
            }
        }

        // Call the next delegate/middleware in the pipeline
        await _next(context);
    }
}

<file path="services/identity/Identity.Api/Program.cs">
using Identity.Application.Interfaces;
using Identity.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using Identity.Infrastructure.Security;
using Identity.Infrastructure.Services;
using BuildingBlocks.Web;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.RateLimiting;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.RateLimiting;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

var jwt = builder.Configuration.GetSection(JwtTokenOptions.SectionName).Get<JwtTokenOptions>();
if (jwt == null)
{
    if (builder.Environment.IsEnvironment("Test") || builder.Environment.IsDevelopment())
    {
        jwt = new JwtTokenOptions
        {
            Secret = "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef",
            Issuer = "test",
            Audience = "test",
            AccessTokenLifetimeMinutes = 15
        };
    }
    else
    {
        throw new InvalidOperationException("Jwt configuration is required.");
    }
}
if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(jwt.Secret) || Encoding.UTF8.GetByteCount(jwt.Secret) < 32 ||
    string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(jwt.Issuer) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(jwt.Audience) ||
    jwt.AccessTokenLifetimeMinutes is < 1 or > 60)
    throw new InvalidOperationException("Jwt configuration is invalid; provide a 32-byte secret, issuer, audience, and lifetime from 1 to 60 minutes.");

var connectionString = builder.Configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection");
if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionString))
    throw new InvalidOperationException("ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection is required.");

builder.Services.AddControllers();
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
builder.Services.AddSwaggerGen();
builder.Services.AddDbContext<IdentityDbContext>(options => options.UseNpgsql(connectionString));
builder.Services.Configure<JwtTokenOptions>(builder.Configuration.GetSection(JwtTokenOptions.SectionName));
builder.Services.AddSingleton<IPasswordHasher, Pbkdf2PasswordHasher>();
builder.Services.AddSingleton<IJwtTokenGenerator, JwtTokenGenerator>();
builder.Services.AddScoped<IIdentityAuthService, IdentityAuthService>();

builder.Services.AddPlatformJwtAuthentication(builder.Configuration);

// Platform-wide security defaults: deny-by-default fallback policy (A01), rate limiting (A07),
// config-driven CORS, ProblemDetails exception handling and security headers (A05/A09).
builder.Services.AddPlatformSecurity(builder.Configuration);

builder.Services.AddAuthorization(options =>
{
    options.AddPolicy("identity.users.read", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "identity.users.read"));
    options.AddPolicy("identity.users.manage", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "identity.users.manage"));
    options.AddPolicy("identity.tenants.read", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "identity.tenants.read"));
    options.AddPolicy("identity.tenants.manage", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "identity.tenants.manage"));
});
builder.Services.AddRateLimiter(options =>
{
    options.RejectionStatusCode = StatusCodes.Status429TooManyRequests;
    options.AddPolicy("identity-auth", context => RateLimitPartition.GetFixedWindowLimiter(
        context.Connection.RemoteIpAddress?.ToString() ?? "unknown",
        _ => new FixedWindowRateLimiterOptions
        {
            PermitLimit = 30,
            Window = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5),
            QueueLimit = 0,
            AutoReplenishment = true
        }));
});

var app = builder.Build();
app.UsePlatformSecurity();
if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
{
    app.UseSwagger();
    app.UseSwaggerUI();
}
app.UseHttpsRedirection();
app.UseRouting();
app.UsePlatformCors();
app.UseRateLimiter();
app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseAuthorization();
app.MapControllers();
app.MapGet("/health/live", () => Results.Ok(new { status = "alive" })).AllowAnonymous();
app.MapGet("/health/ready", async (IdentityDbContext db, CancellationToken ct) =>
{
    try
    {
        if (await db.Database.CanConnectAsync(ct)) return (IResult)Results.Ok(new { status = "ready" });
        return Results.Problem(statusCode: StatusCodes.Status503ServiceUnavailable, title: "Database unavailable");
    }
    catch
    {
        return Results.Problem(statusCode: StatusCodes.Status503ServiceUnavailable, title: "Database unavailable");
    }
}).AllowAnonymous();

app.Run();

// Integration tests use WebApplicationFactory<Program>, which requires the
// entry-point class to be public (same pattern as the other API services).
public partial class Program { }

using BuildingBlocks.Persistence; // Ensure SmartDbContext is accessible

namespace Identity.Infrastructure.Persistence;

public class IdentityDbContext : SmartDbContext<IdentityDbContext>
{
    public IdentityDbContext(DbContextOptions<IdentityDbContext> options) : base(options)
    {
    }

    public DbSet<Tenant> Tenants => Set<Tenant>();
    public DbSet<Organization> Organizations => Set<Organization>();
    public DbSet<User> Users => Set<User>();
    public DbSet<Role> Roles => Set<Role>();
    public DbSet<Permission> Permissions => Set<Permission>();
    public DbSet<UserRole> UserRoles => Set<UserRole>();
    public DbSet<RolePermission> RolePermissions => Set<RolePermission>();
    public DbSet<Session> Sessions => Set<Session>();
    public DbSet<RefreshToken> RefreshTokens => Set<RefreshToken>();
    public DbSet<MfaConfiguration> MfaConfigurations => Set<MfaConfiguration>();
    public DbSet<MfaRecoveryCode> MfaRecoveryCodes => Set<MfaRecoveryCode>();
    public DbSet<PasswordHistory> PasswordHistories => Set<PasswordHistory>();
    public DbSet<EmailVerificationToken> EmailVerificationTokens => Set<EmailVerificationToken>();
    public DbSet<PasswordResetToken> PasswordResetTokens => Set<PasswordResetToken>();
    public DbSet<SecurityEvent> SecurityEvents => Set<SecurityEvent>();
    public DbSet<IdentityAuditEntry> IdentityAuditEntries => Set<IdentityAuditEntry>();
    public DbSet<UserSecurityState> UserSecurityStates => Set<UserSecurityState>();

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder builder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(builder);

        // Tenant
        builder.Entity<Tenant>(e => 
        {
            e.HasIndex(t => t.TenantCode).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(t => t.Status);
            e.HasIndex(t => t.TenantType);
            e.Property(t => t.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        // Organization
        builder.Entity<Organization>(e => 
        {
            e.HasIndex(o => new { o.TenantId, o.OrganizationCode }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(o => o.TenantId);
            e.HasIndex(o => new { o.TenantId, o.Status });
            e.HasIndex(o => o.ParentOrganizationId);
            e.Property(o => o.Version).IsRowVersion();
            
            // Self-referencing FK for Parent
            e.HasOne<Organization>().WithMany().HasForeignKey(o => o.ParentOrganizationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
        });

        // User
        builder.Entity<User>(e => 
        {
            e.HasIndex(u => new { u.TenantId, u.NormalizedUsername }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(u => u.TenantId);
            e.HasIndex(u => u.OrganizationId);
            e.HasIndex(u => u.Status);
            e.HasIndex(u => u.NormalizedEmail);
            e.Property(u => u.Version).IsRowVersion();
            
            e.HasOne<Tenant>().WithMany().HasForeignKey(u => u.TenantId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
            e.HasOne<Organization>().WithMany().HasForeignKey(u => u.OrganizationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
        });

        // Role
        builder.Entity<Role>(e => 
        {
            e.HasIndex(r => new { r.NormalizedName, r.TenantId }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(r => r.TenantId);
            e.Property(r => r.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        });

        // UserRole

using System;

public class IdentityRepository : IIdentityRepository

    public IdentityRepository(IdentityDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public async Task<User> GetUserByEmailAsync(string email, Guid tenantId)
    {

    }

    public async Task<User> GetUserByIdAsync(Guid id, Guid tenantId)

        return await _context.Users.FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Id == id && u.TenantId == tenantId);

    {
        await _context.Users.AddAsync(user);

    {
        _context.Users.Update(user);
        await Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    public async Task SaveChangesAsync()
    {
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
    }
}

<file path="services/identity/Identity.Infrastructure/Security/Argon2PasswordHasher.cs">
using Identity.Application.Interfaces;
using System;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using Konscious.Security.Cryptography;

namespace Identity.Infrastructure.Security;

public class Argon2PasswordHasher : IPasswordHasher
{
    private const int SaltSize = 16;
    private const int HashSize = 32;
    private const int Iterations = 3;
    private const int MemorySize = 65536; // 64 MB
    private const int Parallelism = 4;
    private const string Argon2Prefix = "$argon2id$";

    public string HashPassword(string password)
    {
        var salt = new byte[SaltSize];
        using (var rng = RandomNumberGenerator.Create())
        {
            rng.GetBytes(salt);
        }

        var argon2 = new Argon2id(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(password))
        {
            Salt = salt,
            DegreeOfParallelism = Parallelism,
            Iterations = Iterations,
            MemorySize = MemorySize
        };

        var hash = argon2.GetBytes(HashSize);

        // Store as: $argon2id$v=19$m=65536,t=3,p=4$salt$hash
        return $"{Argon2Prefix}m={MemorySize},t={Iterations},p={Parallelism}${Convert.ToBase64String(salt)}${Convert.ToBase64String(hash)}";
    }

    public bool VerifyPassword(string password, string hash)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(hash)) return false;

        // 1. Handle Argon2id Verification
        if (hash.StartsWith(Argon2Prefix, StringComparison.Ordinal))
        {
            var parts = hash.Split('$');
            if (parts.Length != 4) return false;

            try
            {
                var paramsPart = parts[2];
                var salt = Convert.FromBase64String(parts[3]);
                var expectedHash = Convert.FromBase64String(parts[4]);

                var argon2 = new Argon2id(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(password))
                {
                    Salt = salt,
                    DegreeOfParallelism = Parallelism,
                    Iterations = Iterations,
                    MemorySize = MemorySize
                };

                var actualHash = argon2.GetBytes(HashSize);
                return CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals(actualHash, expectedHash);
            }
            catch
            {
                return false;
            }
        }

        // 2. Backward Compatibility: Legacy PBKDF2 Verification
        return VerifyLegacyPbkdf2(password, hash);
    }

    private bool VerifyLegacyPbkdf2(string password, string hash)
    {
        // Handle ASP.NET Core Identity format (starts with AQAAAA)
        if (hash.StartsWith("AQAAAA", StringComparison.Ordinal))
        {
            var legacyHasher = new Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.PasswordHasher<object>();
            var result = legacyHasher.VerifyHashedPassword(new object(), hash, password);
            return result != Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.PasswordVerificationResult.Failed;
        }

        // Handle the older custom PBKDF2 format (salt.hash)
        var parts = hash.Split('.', 2);
        if (parts.Length != 2) return false;
        try
        {
            var salt = Convert.FromBase64String(parts[0]);
            var expected = Convert.FromBase64String(parts[1]);
            var actual = Rfc2898DeriveBytes.Pbkdf2(password, salt, 100_000, HashAlgorithmName.SHA256, expected.Length);
            return CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals(actual, expected);
        }
        catch
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
}

<file path="services/identity/Identity.Infrastructure/Security/JwtTokenGenerator.cs">
using System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt;
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using Identity.Application.Interfaces;
using Identity.Domain.Entities;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;

namespace Identity.Infrastructure.Security;

public class JwtTokenGenerator : IJwtTokenGenerator
{
    private readonly JwtTokenOptions _options;

    public JwtTokenGenerator(IOptions<JwtTokenOptions> options)
    {
        _options = options.Value;
        if (Encoding.UTF8.GetByteCount(_options.Secret) < 32)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("JWT signing key must contain at least 32 UTF-8 bytes.");
        }
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_options.Issuer) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_options.Audience))
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("JWT issuer and audience must be configured.");
        }
        if (_options.AccessTokenLifetimeMinutes is < 1 or > 60)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("JWT access token lifetime must be between 1 and 60 minutes.");
        }
    }

    public string GenerateAccessToken(User user, Tenant tenant, IEnumerable<string> permissions)
    {
        var securityKey = new SymmetricSecurityKey(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(_options.Secret));
        var credentials = new SigningCredentials(securityKey, SecurityAlgorithms.HmacSha256);

        var claims = new List<Claim>
        {
            new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Sub, user.Id.ToString()),
            new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Jti, Guid.NewGuid().ToString()),
            new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Email, user.Email),
            new Claim("tenant_id", tenant.Id.ToString()),
            new Claim("tenant_code", tenant.TenantCode)
        };

        if (user.OrganizationId.HasValue)
        {
            claims.Add(new Claim("organization_id", user.OrganizationId.Value.ToString()));
        }

        foreach (var permission in permissions)
        {
            claims.Add(new Claim("permissions", permission));
        }

        var issuedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;

        var token = new JwtSecurityToken(
            claims: claims,
            notBefore: issuedAt,
            expires: issuedAt.AddMinutes(_options.AccessTokenLifetimeMinutes),
            issuer: _options.Issuer,
            audience: _options.Audience,
            signingCredentials: credentials);

        return new JwtSecurityTokenHandler().WriteToken(token);
    }

    public string GenerateRefreshToken()
    {
        var randomNumber = new byte[32];
        using var rng = RandomNumberGenerator.Create();
        rng.GetBytes(randomNumber);
        return Convert.ToBase64String(randomNumber);
    }

    public string HashToken(string token)
    {
        using var sha256 = SHA256.Create();
        var hashedBytes = sha256.ComputeHash(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(token));
        return Convert.ToBase64String(hashedBytes);
    }
}
