<file path="services/identity/Identity.Infrastructure/Security/Pbkdf2PasswordHasher.cs">
using Identity.Application.Interfaces;
using System.Security.Cryptography;

namespace Identity.Infrastructure.Security;

public sealed class Pbkdf2PasswordHasher : IPasswordHasher
{
    private const int SaltSize = 16;
    private const int HashSize = 32;
    private const int Iterations = 600_000;

    public string HashPassword(string password)
    {
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrEmpty(password);
        var salt = RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(SaltSize);
        var hash = Rfc2898DeriveBytes.Pbkdf2(password, salt, Iterations, HashAlgorithmName.SHA256, HashSize);
        return $"pbkdf2-sha256${Iterations}${Convert.ToBase64String(salt)}${Convert.ToBase64String(hash)}";
    }

    public bool VerifyPassword(string password, string hash)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(password) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(hash)) return false;
        var parts = hash.Split('$');

        // Verify hashes emitted by the previous implementation so existing accounts remain usable.
        if (parts.Length == 1)
        {
            var legacyParts = hash.Split('.');
            if (legacyParts.Length != 2) return false;
            try
            {
                var salt = Convert.FromBase64String(legacyParts[0]);
                var expected = Convert.FromBase64String(legacyParts[1]);
                if (salt.Length < 8 || expected.Length != HashSize) return false;
                var actual = Rfc2898DeriveBytes.Pbkdf2(password, salt, 100_000, HashAlgorithmName.SHA256, expected.Length);
                return CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals(actual, expected);
            }
            catch (FormatException)
            {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if (parts.Length != 4 || parts[0] != "pbkdf2-sha256" ||
            !int.TryParse(parts[1], out var iterations) || iterations < 100_000 || iterations > 2_000_000)
            return false;

        try
        {
            var salt = Convert.FromBase64String(parts[2]);
            var expected = Convert.FromBase64String(parts[3]);
            if (salt.Length < SaltSize || expected.Length != HashSize) return false;
            var actual = Rfc2898DeriveBytes.Pbkdf2(password, salt, iterations, HashAlgorithmName.SHA256, expected.Length);
            return CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals(actual, expected);
        }
        catch (FormatException)
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
}
</file>

<file path="services/identity/Identity.Infrastructure/Services/AuthenticationService.cs">
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using Identity.Application.Commands.Auth;
using Identity.Application.Interfaces;
using Identity.Domain.Entities;
using Identity.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace Identity.Infrastructure.Services;

public sealed class AuthenticationService(
    IdentityDbContext context,
    IPasswordHasher passwordHasher,
    IJwtTokenGenerator tokenGenerator) : IAuthenticationService
{
    private static readonly TimeSpan RefreshLifetime = TimeSpan.FromDays(30);

    public async Task<LoginResult?> LoginAsync(LoginCommand command, string? ipAddress, string? userAgent, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var tenantCode = command.TenantCode.Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
        var tenant = await context.Tenants.SingleOrDefaultAsync(t => t.Code == tenantCode && t.Status == "Active", cancellationToken);
        if (tenant is null) return null;

        var normalizedEmail = command.Email.Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
        var user = await context.Users.IgnoreQueryFilters().SingleOrDefaultAsync(
            u => u.TenantId == tenant.Id && u.NormalizedEmail == normalizedEmail, cancellationToken);
        if (user is null || user.Status != "Active" || user.LockoutEnd > DateTime.UtcNow) return null;

        if (!passwordHasher.VerifyPassword(command.Password, user.PasswordHash))
        {
            user.FailedLoginAttempts++;
            if (user.FailedLoginAttempts >= 5) user.LockoutEnd = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(15);
            user.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
            await context.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
            return null;
        }

        if (user.MfaEnabled) return new LoginResult { RequiresMfa = true };
        if (!user.PasswordHash.StartsWith("AQAAAA", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            user.PasswordHash = passwordHasher.HashPassword(command.Password);

        user.FailedLoginAttempts = 0;
        user.LockoutEnd = null;
        user.LastLoginAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        user.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        var permissions = await (from userRole in context.UserRoles.IgnoreQueryFilters()
                                 join role in context.Roles.IgnoreQueryFilters() on userRole.RoleId equals role.Id
                                 join rolePermission in context.RolePermissions.IgnoreQueryFilters() on role.Id equals rolePermission.RoleId
                                 join permission in context.Permissions on rolePermission.PermissionId equals permission.Id
                                 where userRole.UserId == user.Id && role.TenantId == tenant.Id
                                 select permission.Code).Distinct().ToArrayAsync(cancellationToken);

        var refreshToken = tokenGenerator.GenerateRefreshToken();
        var session = new Session
        {
            UserId = user.Id,
            TenantId = tenant.Id,
            RefreshTokenHash = tokenGenerator.HashToken(refreshToken),
            IPAddress = ipAddress,
            UserAgent = userAgent,
            ExpiresAt = DateTime.UtcNow.Add(RefreshLifetime)
        };
        context.Sessions.Add(session);
        await context.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

        return new LoginResult
        {
            SessionId = session.Id,
            AccessToken = tokenGenerator.GenerateAccessToken(user, tenant, permissions),
            RefreshToken = refreshToken,
            ExpiresAt = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(15)
        };
    }

    public async Task<LoginResult?> RefreshAsync(RefreshTokenCommand command, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var session = await context.Sessions.IgnoreQueryFilters().SingleOrDefaultAsync(
            s => s.Id == command.SessionId, cancellationToken);
        if (session is null || session.RevokedAt != null || session.ExpiresAt <= DateTime.UtcNow) return null;

        var submittedHash = tokenGenerator.HashToken(command.RefreshToken);
        if (!CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals(
                Convert.FromBase64String(submittedHash), Convert.FromBase64String(session.RefreshTokenHash)))
        {
            session.RevokedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
            session.RevocationReason = "Refresh token reuse or invalid token";
            await context.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
            return null;
        }

        var user = await context.Users.IgnoreQueryFilters().SingleOrDefaultAsync(
            u => u.Id == session.UserId && u.TenantId == session.TenantId && u.Status == "Active", cancellationToken);
        var tenant = await context.Tenants.SingleOrDefaultAsync(
            t => t.Id == session.TenantId && t.Status == "Active", cancellationToken);
        if (user is null || tenant is null) return null;

        var permissions = await (from userRole in context.UserRoles.IgnoreQueryFilters()
                                 join role in context.Roles.IgnoreQueryFilters() on userRole.RoleId equals role.Id
                                 join rolePermission in context.RolePermissions.IgnoreQueryFilters() on role.Id equals rolePermission.RoleId
                                 join permission in context.Permissions on rolePermission.PermissionId equals permission.Id
                                 where userRole.UserId == user.Id && role.TenantId == tenant.Id
                                 select permission.Code).Distinct().ToArrayAsync(cancellationToken);
        var newRefreshToken = tokenGenerator.GenerateRefreshToken();
        session.RefreshTokenHash = tokenGenerator.HashToken(newRefreshToken);
        session.LastUsedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        session.ExpiresAt = DateTime.UtcNow.Add(RefreshLifetime);
        await context.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

        return new LoginResult
        {
            SessionId = session.Id,
            AccessToken = tokenGenerator.GenerateAccessToken(user, tenant, permissions),
            RefreshToken = newRefreshToken,
            ExpiresAt = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(15)
        };
    }

    public async Task<bool> RevokeAsync(Guid sessionId, Guid userId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var session = await context.Sessions.SingleOrDefaultAsync(
            s => s.Id == sessionId && s.UserId == userId, cancellationToken);
        if (session is null) return false;
        session.RevokedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        session.RevocationReason = "User signed out";
        await context.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
        return true;
    }
}
</file>

<file path="services/identity/Identity.Infrastructure/Services/IdentityAuthService.cs">
using Identity.Application.Commands.Auth;
using Identity.Application.Interfaces;
using Identity.Domain.Entities;
using Identity.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using Identity.Infrastructure.Security;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using System.Security.Cryptography;

namespace Identity.Infrastructure.Services;

public sealed class IdentityAuthService : IIdentityAuthService
{
    private const int MaximumFailedAttempts = 5;
    private static readonly TimeSpan LockoutDuration = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(15);
    private static readonly string DummyPasswordHash = new Pbkdf2PasswordHasher().HashPassword(Convert.ToBase64String(RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(32)));
    private readonly IdentityDbContext _db;
    private readonly IPasswordHasher _passwordHasher;
    private readonly IJwtTokenGenerator _tokens;
    private readonly JwtTokenOptions _jwtOptions;
    private readonly ILogger<IdentityAuthService> _logger;

    public IdentityAuthService(IdentityDbContext db, IPasswordHasher passwordHasher, IJwtTokenGenerator tokens,
        IOptions<JwtTokenOptions> jwtOptions, ILogger<IdentityAuthService> logger)
    {
        _db = db;
        _passwordHasher = passwordHasher;
        _tokens = tokens;
        _jwtOptions = jwtOptions.Value;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task<LoginResult?> LoginAsync(LoginCommand command, string ipAddress, string userAgent, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var normalizedTenantCode = command.TenantCode.Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
        var normalizedEmail = command.Email.Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
        var tenant = await _db.Tenants.AsNoTracking()
            .SingleOrDefaultAsync(t => t.TenantCode.ToUpper() == normalizedTenantCode, cancellationToken);
        var user = tenant is null ? null : await _db.Users
            .SingleOrDefaultAsync(u => u.TenantId == tenant.Id && u.NormalizedEmail == normalizedEmail, cancellationToken);

        var passwordValid = _passwordHasher.VerifyPassword(command.Password, user?.PasswordHash ?? DummyPasswordHash);
        if (user is null || tenant is null || !passwordValid || tenant.Status != "Active" || user.Status != "Active")
        {
            // A09: every rejected login attempt is a security event (audit trail + brute force detection).
            // Neither the password nor any token material is ever logged.
            _logger.LogWarning(
                "Rejected login for {Email} on tenant {TenantCode} from {IpAddress} ({UserAgent}): {Reason}",
                normalizedEmail, normalizedTenantCode, ipAddress, userAgent,
                user is null ? "unknown user" :
                tenant is null ? "unknown tenant" :
                !passwordValid ? "invalid password" :
                tenant.Status != "Active" ? "tenant inactive" : "user inactive");

            if (user is not null && !passwordValid)
            {
                user.FailedLoginCount++;
                user.LastFailedLoginAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
                if (user.FailedLoginCount >= MaximumFailedAttempts)
                {
                    user.LockedUntilUtc = DateTime.UtcNow.Add(LockoutDuration);
                    _logger.LogWarning(
                        "Locked account {Email} for {Duration} after {Attempts} failed logins from {IpAddress}",
                        normalizedEmail, LockoutDuration, user.FailedLoginCount, ipAddress);
                }
                await _db.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
            }
            return null;
        }

        var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
        if (user.LockedUntilUtc > now)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Login blocked: account {Email} is locked until {LockedUntil} (source {IpAddress})",
                normalizedEmail, user.LockedUntilUtc, ipAddress);
            return null;
        }
        if (!user.EmailVerified)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Rejected login for {Email}: email address not verified (source {IpAddress})",
                normalizedEmail, ipAddress);
            return null;
        }
        if (user.MfaEnabled)
        {
            _logger.LogInformation("MFA challenge issued for {Email} from {IpAddress}", normalizedEmail, ipAddress);
            return new LoginResult { RequiresMfa = true };
        }

        user.FailedLoginCount = 0;
        user.LockedUntilUtc = null;
        user.LastLoginAtUtc = now;
        var authorization = await LoadAuthorizationAsync(user.Id, tenant.Id, cancellationToken);
        var session = await CreateSessionAsync(user, tenant, authorization.Roles, authorization.Permissions, ipAddress, userAgent, now, cancellationToken);
        _logger.LogInformation("Successful login for {Email} on tenant {TenantCode} from {IpAddress} ({UserAgent})",
            normalizedEmail, normalizedTenantCode, ipAddress, userAgent);
        return session;
    }

    public async Task<LoginResult?> RefreshAsync(string refreshToken, string ipAddress, string userAgent, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(refreshToken)) return null;
        var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
        await using var transaction = await _db.Database.BeginTransactionAsync(cancellationToken);
        var tokenHash = _tokens.HashToken(refreshToken);
        var current = await _db.RefreshTokens.Include(t => t.Session)
            .SingleOrDefaultAsync(t => t.TokenHash == tokenHash, cancellationToken);
        if (current is null) return null;

        if (current.Status != "Active" || current.UsedAtUtc is not null || current.RevokedAtUtc is not null)
        {
            if (current.UsedAtUtc is not null)
            {
                // A09: refresh token replay means a stolen token is in circulation - revoke the
                // whole session family and raise a high-severity security event.
                _logger.LogError(
                    "Refresh token reuse detected for user {UserId}; revoking session family {TokenFamilyId} from {IpAddress}",
                    current.UserId, current.TokenFamilyId, ipAddress);
                await RevokeFamilyAsync(current.TokenFamilyId, current.SessionId, now, "Refresh token reuse detected", cancellationToken);
                await _db.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
                await transaction.CommitAsync(cancellationToken);
            }
            return null;
        }
        if (current.ExpiresAtUtc <= now || current.Session.ExpiresAtUtc <= now || current.Session.RevokedAtUtc is not null)
            return null;

        var user = await _db.Users.SingleOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Id == current.UserId, cancellationToken);
        var tenant = user is null ? null : await _db.Tenants.SingleOrDefaultAsync(t => t.Id == user.TenantId, cancellationToken);
        if (user is null || tenant is null || user.Status != "Active" || tenant.Status != "Active" || user.MfaEnabled)
            return null;

        var authorization = await LoadAuthorizationAsync(user.Id, tenant.Id, cancellationToken);
        current.Status = "Used";
        current.UsedAtUtc = now;
        var (next, plainNextToken) = NewRefreshToken(user, current.Session, current.TokenFamilyId, ipAddress, userAgent, now);
        current.ReplacedByTokenId = next.Id;
        _db.RefreshTokens.Add(next);
        current.Session.LastSeenAtUtc = now;
        user.LastLoginAtUtc = now;
        try
        {
            await _db.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
        }
        catch (DbUpdateConcurrencyException)
        {
            return null;
        }
        await transaction.CommitAsync(cancellationToken);

        return new LoginResult
        {
            AccessToken = _tokens.GenerateAccessToken(user, tenant, authorization.Permissions),
            RefreshToken = plainNextToken,
            ExpiresAtUtc = now.AddMinutes(_jwtOptions.AccessTokenLifetimeMinutes),
            TenantCode = tenant.TenantCode,
            TenantType = tenant.TenantType,
            Roles = authorization.Roles,
            Permissions = authorization.Permissions
        };
    }

    public async Task RevokeRefreshTokenAsync(string refreshToken, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(refreshToken)) return;
        var tokenHash = _tokens.HashToken(refreshToken);
        var token = await _db.RefreshTokens.Include(t => t.Session)
            .SingleOrDefaultAsync(t => t.TokenHash == tokenHash, cancellationToken);
        if (token is null || token.RevokedAtUtc is not null) return;
        await RevokeFamilyAsync(token.TokenFamilyId, token.SessionId, DateTime.UtcNow, "User signed out", cancellationToken);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
        _logger.LogInformation("Session family {TokenFamilyId} revoked for user {UserId} (logout)", token.TokenFamilyId, token.UserId);
    }

    private async Task<LoginResult> CreateSessionAsync(User user, Tenant tenant, IReadOnlyList<string> roles,
        IReadOnlyList<string> permissions, string ipAddress, string userAgent, DateTime now, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var expiresAt = now.AddDays(30);
        var session = new Session
        {
            UserId = user.Id,
            TenantId = tenant.Id,
            SessionReference = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"),
            IpAddress = ipAddress,
            UserAgent = userAgent,
            CreatedAtUtc = now,
            LastSeenAtUtc = now,
            ExpiresAtUtc = expiresAt,
            CorrelationId = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")
        };
        var (refreshToken, plainRefreshToken) = NewRefreshToken(user, session, Guid.NewGuid(), ipAddress, userAgent, now);
        _db.Sessions.Add(session);
        _db.RefreshTokens.Add(refreshToken);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
        return new LoginResult
        {
            AccessToken = _tokens.GenerateAccessToken(user, tenant, permissions),
            RefreshToken = plainRefreshToken,
            ExpiresAtUtc = now.AddMinutes(_jwtOptions.AccessTokenLifetimeMinutes),
            TenantCode = tenant.TenantCode,
            TenantType = tenant.TenantType,
            Roles = roles,
            Permissions = permissions
        };
    }

    private (RefreshToken Token, string PlainToken) NewRefreshToken(User user, Session session, Guid familyId, string ipAddress, string userAgent, DateTime now)
    {
        var plainToken = _tokens.GenerateRefreshToken();
        return (new RefreshToken
        {
            SessionId = session.Id,
            UserId = user.Id,
            TokenHash = _tokens.HashToken(plainToken),
            TokenFamilyId = familyId,
            CreatedAtUtc = now,
            ExpiresAtUtc = now.AddDays(30),
            CreatedFromIp = ipAddress,
            CreatedFromUserAgent = userAgent,
            Status = "Active"
        }, plainToken);
    }

    private async Task<(IReadOnlyList<string> Roles, IReadOnlyList<string> Permissions)> LoadAuthorizationAsync(
        Guid userId, Guid tenantId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var assignments = await _db.UserRoles.AsNoTracking()
            .Where(ur => ur.UserId == userId && ur.Status == "Active" && (ur.ExpiresAtUtc == null || ur.ExpiresAtUtc > DateTime.UtcNow)
                && ur.Role.Status == "Active" && (ur.Role.TenantId == null || ur.Role.TenantId == tenantId))
            .Select(ur => new
            {
                ur.Role.Name,
                Permissions = ur.Role.RolePermissions
                    .Where(rp => rp.Status == "Active")
                    .Select(rp => rp.Permission.Code)
            })
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        return (assignments.Select(a => a.Name).Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal).ToArray(),
            assignments.SelectMany(a => a.Permissions).Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal).ToArray());
    }

    private async Task RevokeFamilyAsync(Guid familyId, Guid sessionId, DateTime now, string reason, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var family = await _db.RefreshTokens.Where(t => t.TokenFamilyId == familyId && t.RevokedAtUtc == null)
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);
        foreach (var token in family)
        {
            token.Status = "Revoked";
            token.RevokedAtUtc = now;
            token.RevocationReason = reason;
        }
        var session = await _db.Sessions.SingleOrDefaultAsync(s => s.Id == sessionId, cancellationToken);
        if (session is not null)
        {
            session.Status = "Revoked";
            session.RevokedAtUtc = now;
            session.RevocationReason = reason;
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Identity.Api.Controllers;
using Identity.Application.Commands.Auth;
using Identity.Application.Interfaces;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Identity.Tests.Api.Controllers;

public class AuthControllerTests
{
    private readonly Mock<IIdentityAuthService> _mockAuthService;
    private readonly AuthController _controller;

    public AuthControllerTests()
    {
        _mockAuthService = new Mock<IIdentityAuthService>();
        
        // Setup HttpContext for Request/Response mocking
        var httpContext = new DefaultHttpContext();
        httpContext.Connection.RemoteIpAddress = System.Net.IPAddress.Parse("127.0.0.1");
        
        _controller = new AuthController(_mockAuthService.Object)
        {
            ControllerContext = new ControllerContext
            {
                HttpContext = httpContext
            }
        };
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Login_Should_Return_Ok_With_Tokens_When_Credentials_Valid()
    {
        // Arrange
        var command = new LoginCommand 
        { 
            TenantCode = "T-001", 
            Email = "admin@example.com", 
            Password = "password123" 
        };

        var expectedResult = new LoginResult
        {
            AccessToken = "mock-access-token",
            RefreshToken = "mock-refresh-token",
            RequiresMfa = false,
            TenantCode = "T-001",
            TenantType = "LogisticsCompany"
        };

        _mockAuthService
            .Setup(s => s.LoginAsync(command, It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .ReturnsAsync(expectedResult);

        // Act
        var result = await _controller.Login(command, CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        var okResult = Assert.IsType<OkObjectResult>(result);
        var response = Assert.IsType<AuthController.LoginResponse>(okResult.Value);
        
        Assert.Equal("mock-access-token", response.AccessToken);
        Assert.Equal("LogisticsCompany", response.TenantType);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Login_Should_Return_Unauthorized_When_Credentials_Invalid()
    {
        // Arrange
        var command = new LoginCommand 
        { 
            TenantCode = "T-001", 
            Email = "admin@example.com", 
            Password = "wrongpassword" 
        };

        _mockAuthService
            .Setup(s => s.LoginAsync(command, It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .ReturnsAsync((LoginResult?)null);

        // Act
        var result = await _controller.Login(command, CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        var unauthorizedResult = Assert.IsType<UnauthorizedObjectResult>(result);
        Assert.NotNull(unauthorizedResult.Value);
    }
}

<file path="services/integration/Integration.Api/Controllers/WebhooksController.cs">
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using MediatR;
using Integration.Application.Commands;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.RateLimiting;
using BuildingBlocks.Web;

namespace Integration.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/integration/webhooks")]
// A08: webhooks authenticate with an HMAC signature over the raw payload instead of a JWT, so
// the endpoint is explicitly anonymous - the signature check inside ProcessWebhookCommandHandler
// is the security control, and it fails closed for unknown partners or missing secrets.
[AllowAnonymous]
public class WebhooksController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;

    public WebhooksController(IMediator mediator)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
    }

    [HttpPost("{partnerCode}")]
    [EnableRateLimiting(PlatformSecurityExtensions.SensitiveRateLimitPolicy)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> ReceiveWebhook(string partnerCode)
    {
        // Extract raw body for signature validation - the signature covers the exact bytes received.
        using var reader = new StreamReader(Request.Body, Encoding.UTF8);
        var payload = await reader.ReadToEndAsync();

        // Extract headers
        var signature = Request.Headers["X-Hub-Signature-256"].ToString();
        var timestampHeader = Request.Headers["X-Timestamp"].ToString();

        DateTime? timestamp = null;
        if (long.TryParse(timestampHeader, out var ts))
        {
            timestamp = DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeSeconds(ts).UtcDateTime;
        }

        var command = new ProcessWebhookCommand
        {
            // Resolved from the partner mapping when inbox persistence lands; the shared secret
            // itself is resolved through IWebhookSecretStore inside the handler.
            TenantId = Guid.Empty,
            PartnerCode = partnerCode,
            Payload = payload,
            Signature = signature,
            Timestamp = timestamp
        };

        var accepted = await _mediator.Send(command);

        if (accepted)
        {
            // Always return fast HTTP 202 to the external partner to prevent timeout retries
            return Accepted(new { Status = "Received", Message = "Webhook payload accepted for asynchronous processing." });
        }

        // A generic response: no hint about which check failed (missing partner, bad signature,
        // stale timestamp) so the endpoint cannot be used as a signature oracle.
        return Unauthorized(new { Error = "Webhook verification failed." });
    }
}

<file path="services/integration/Integration.Api/Infrastructure/ConfigurationWebhookSecretStore.cs">
using System;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using Integration.Application.Services;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;

namespace Integration.Api.Infrastructure;

/// <summary>
/// Reads per-partner webhook secrets from configuration
/// (<c>Webhooks:Partners:{partnerCode}:Secret</c>, normally injected from a secret manager).
/// Unknown partners return <c>null</c> so the handler rejects the payload (fail closed).
/// </summary>
public sealed class ConfigurationWebhookSecretStore : IWebhookSecretStore
{
    // A05/A03: the partner code becomes part of a configuration index path, so only a strict
    // token is accepted. This blocks path traversal such as "../../Jwt/Secret".
    private static readonly Regex PartnerCodePattern = new("^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}$", RegexOptions.Compiled);

    private readonly IConfiguration _configuration;

    public ConfigurationWebhookSecretStore(IConfiguration configuration) => _configuration = configuration;

    public string? GetSecret(string partnerCode)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(partnerCode) || !PartnerCodePattern.IsMatch(partnerCode))
            return null;

        return _configuration[$"Webhooks:Partners:{partnerCode}:Secret"];
    }
}

<file path="services/integration/Integration.Api/Integration.Api.csproj">
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net9.0</TargetFramework>
    <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <ProjectReference Include="..\Integration.Application\Integration.Application.csproj" />
    <ProjectReference Include="..\Integration.Infrastructure\Integration.Infrastructure.csproj" />
    <ProjectReference Include="..\..\..\building-blocks\web\BuildingBlocks.Web.csproj" />

<file path="services/integration/Integration.Api/Program.cs">
using BuildingBlocks.Web;
using Integration.Api.Infrastructure;
using Integration.Application.Commands;
using Integration.Application.Services;
using Integration.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

builder.Services.AddControllers();

// A01/A07: the service previously ran with UseAuthorization() but no authentication scheme at all,
// so no endpoint could be authenticated and the [AllowAnonymous] webhook was the only policy in
// play. JWT validation, the deny-by-default fallback policy, rate limiting, config-driven CORS and
// ProblemDetails exception handling now come from the platform building block.
builder.Services.AddPlatformJwtAuthentication(builder.Configuration);
builder.Services.AddPlatformSecurity(builder.Configuration);
builder.Services.AddAuthorization();

// A08: inbound webhooks are authenticated with HMAC-SHA256 over the raw payload.
builder.Services.AddSingleton<IExternalRequestSigner, HmacExternalRequestSigner>();
builder.Services.AddSingleton<IWebhookSecretStore, ConfigurationWebhookSecretStore>();

// Register the MediatR handlers that live in Integration.Application.
builder.Services.AddMediatR(cfg => cfg.RegisterServicesFromAssembly(typeof(ProcessWebhookCommand).Assembly));

// Persistence is only wired when a connection string is supplied
// (e.g. ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection environment variable).
var connectionString = builder.Configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection");
if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionString))
{
    builder.Services.AddDbContext<IntegrationDbContext>(options => options.UseNpgsql(connectionString));
}

var app = builder.Build();

app.UsePlatformSecurity();
app.UseHttpsRedirection();
app.UseRouting();
app.UsePlatformCors();
app.UseRateLimiter();
app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseAuthorization();
app.MapControllers();

app.MapGet("/health/live", () => "Alive").AllowAnonymous();

app.Run();

public partial class Program { }

<file path="services/integration/Integration.Application/Commands/ProcessWebhookCommand.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Integration.Application.Services;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace Integration.Application.Commands;

public class ProcessWebhookCommand : IRequest<bool>
{
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public string PartnerCode { get; set; }
    public string Payload { get; set; }
    public string Signature { get; set; }
    public DateTime? Timestamp { get; set; }
}

/// <summary>
/// A08: verifies the inbound webhook before it is accepted for asynchronous processing.
/// A payload is only accepted when the partner has a configured secret, the signature matches
/// the raw payload (HMAC-SHA256, constant time) and the timestamp is inside the freshness window
/// that makes replay attacks impossible. Everything else is rejected and logged (A09) without ever
/// logging the payload or the secret.
/// </summary>
public class ProcessWebhookCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<ProcessWebhookCommand, bool>
{
    /// <summary>Maximum accepted clock skew for the <c>X-Timestamp</c> header.</summary>
    public static readonly TimeSpan MaximumTimestampSkew = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5);

    private readonly IExternalRequestSigner _signer;
    private readonly IWebhookSecretStore _secretStore;
    private readonly ILogger<ProcessWebhookCommandHandler> _logger;

    public ProcessWebhookCommandHandler(
        IExternalRequestSigner signer,
        IWebhookSecretStore secretStore,
        ILogger<ProcessWebhookCommandHandler> logger)
    {
        _signer = signer;
        _secretStore = secretStore;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public Task<bool> Handle(ProcessWebhookCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        if (request.Timestamp is null)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Rejected webhook from {PartnerCode}: X-Timestamp header is missing", request.PartnerCode);
            return Task.FromResult(false);
        }

        var skew = DateTime.UtcNow - request.Timestamp.Value;
        if (skew > MaximumTimestampSkew || skew < -MaximumTimestampSkew)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning(
                "Rejected webhook from {PartnerCode}: timestamp outside the {Window} replay window (skew {Skew})",
                request.PartnerCode, MaximumTimestampSkew, skew);
            return Task.FromResult(false);
        }

        var secret = _secretStore.GetSecret(request.PartnerCode);
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(secret))
        {
            _logger.LogWarning(
                "Rejected webhook from {PartnerCode}: no signing secret configured for this partner",
                request.PartnerCode);
            return Task.FromResult(false);
        }

        if (!_signer.VerifySignature(request.Payload, secret, request.Signature))
        {
            _logger.LogWarning(
                "Rejected webhook from {PartnerCode}: signature verification failed for {PayloadLength} byte payload",
                request.PartnerCode, request.Payload?.Length ?? 0);
            return Task.FromResult(false);
        }

        // Inbox persistence (outbox pattern backwards) happens through an Application-owned
        // interface implemented by Integration.Infrastructure once it is available.
        return Task.FromResult(true);
    }
}
</file>

<file path="services/integration/Integration.Application/Services/HmacExternalRequestSigner.cs">
using System;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;

namespace Integration.Application.Services;

/// <summary>
/// A08: HMAC-SHA256 webhook authentication using constant-time comparison, so partner payloads
/// cannot be forged and signature checks cannot be brute forced through timing differences.
/// </summary>
public sealed class HmacExternalRequestSigner : IExternalRequestSigner
{
    private const string HmacSha256 = "HMAC-SHA256";

    public string GenerateSignature(string payload, string secret, string algorithm = HmacSha256)
    {
        EnsureSupportedAlgorithm(algorithm);
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(secret)) throw new ArgumentException("A webhook secret is required.", nameof(secret));

        using var hmac = new HMACSHA256(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(secret));
        var hash = hmac.ComputeHash(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(payload ?? string.Empty));
        return "sha256=" + Convert.ToHexString(hash).ToLowerInvariant();
    }

    public bool VerifySignature(string payload, string secret, string signature, string algorithm = HmacSha256)
    {
        EnsureSupportedAlgorithm(algorithm);

        // Fail closed: a missing secret or signature is never a valid webhook.
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(secret) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(signature)) return false;

        var expected = GenerateSignature(payload, secret, algorithm);
        var actual = signature.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();

        if (expected.Length != actual.Length) return false;

        return CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals(
            Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(expected),
            Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(actual));
    }

    private static void EnsureSupportedAlgorithm(string algorithm)
    {
        if (!string.Equals(algorithm, HmacSha256, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            throw new NotSupportedException($"Webhook signature algorithm '{algorithm}' is not supported.");
    }
}
</file>

namespace Integration.Application.Services;

/// <summary>
/// Resolves the shared secret used to authenticate an inbound webhook for a partner.

using System;

namespace Integration.Domain.Entities;

public class WebhookEndpoint
{
    public Guid Id { get; private set; }
    public Guid TenantId { get; private set; }
    public Guid IntegrationId { get; private set; }
    
    public string Path { get; private set; } // e.g., "/api/v1/integration/webhooks/bank-xyz"
    public string SignatureHeader { get; private set; } // e.g., "X-Hub-Signature-256"
    public string ExpectedSecretReference { get; private set; } // Vault Path Reference
    
    public bool RequiresTimestamp { get; private set; }
    public string TimestampHeader { get; private set; }
    public int MaxTimestampDriftSeconds { get; private set; }
    
    public bool Active { get; private set; }
    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; private set; }

    protected WebhookEndpoint() { }

    public WebhookEndpoint(Guid tenantId, Guid integrationId, string path, string signatureHeader, string expectedSecretReference)
    {
        Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        TenantId = tenantId;
        IntegrationId = integrationId;
        Path = path;
        SignatureHeader = signatureHeader;
        ExpectedSecretReference = expectedSecretReference;
        RequiresTimestamp = true;
        MaxTimestampDriftSeconds = 300; // 5 mins
        Active = true;
        CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }
}

<file path="services/integration/Integration.Infrastructure/Persistence/IntegrationDbContext.cs">
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Integration.Domain.Entities;

namespace Integration.Infrastructure.Persistence;

public class IntegrationDbContext : DbContext
{
    // 1. Integration Core
    public DbSet<IntegrationPartner> Partners { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IntegrationSystem> Systems { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IntegrationEndpoint> Endpoints { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IntegrationAuthentication> Authentications { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IntegrationApiVersion> ApiVersions { get; set; } = null!;

    // 2. Events & Contracts
    public DbSet<IntegrationEventContract> EventContracts { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IntegrationEventSubscription> EventSubscriptions { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IntegrationEventDelivery> EventDeliveries { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IntegrationMessage> Messages { get; set; } = null!;

    // 3. API & Webhooks
    public DbSet<IntegrationRequest> Requests { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<WebhookSubscription> WebhookSubscriptions { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<WebhookDelivery> WebhookDeliveries { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<WebhookInboundEvent> WebhookInboundEvents { get; set; } = null!;

    // 4. Resiliency & Policy
    public DbSet<IntegrationMapping> Mappings { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IntegrationRetryPolicy> RetryPolicies { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IntegrationDeadLetter> DeadLetters { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IntegrationIdempotencyRecord> IdempotencyRecords { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IntegrationRateLimitPolicy> RateLimitPolicies { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IntegrationCircuitState> CircuitStates { get; set; } = null!;

    // 5. Operations & Health
    public DbSet<IntegrationHealthRecord> HealthRecords { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IntegrationAlert> Alerts { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IntegrationJob> Jobs { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IntegrationFileExchange> FileExchanges { get; set; } = null!;

    // 6. Verification & Transformation
    public DbSet<IntegrationSchemaValidation> SchemaValidations { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IntegrationTransformationRecord> TransformationRecords { get; set; } = null!;

    // 7. Integrations & Platform Base
    public DbSet<IntegrationExternalReference> ExternalReferences { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IntegrationAuditEntry> AuditEntries { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<OutboxMessage> OutboxMessages { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<InboxMessage> InboxMessages { get; set; } = null!;

    public IntegrationDbContext(DbContextOptions<IntegrationDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);

        // 1. Integration Core
        modelBuilder.Entity<IntegrationPartner>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.PartnerReference }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Status);
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<IntegrationSystem>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.SystemReference }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.PartnerId, x.Status });
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<IntegrationEndpoint>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.SystemId, x.EndpointReference }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Status);
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<IntegrationAuthentication>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.SystemId, x.AuthenticationReference }).IsUnique();
        });

<file path="services/integration/Integration.Infrastructure/Repositories/IntegrationRepository.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Integration.Domain.Entities;
using Integration.Domain.Repositories;
using Integration.Infrastructure.Persistence;

namespace Integration.Infrastructure.Repositories;

public class IntegrationRepository : IIntegrationRepository
{
    private readonly IntegrationDbContext _context;

    public IntegrationRepository(IntegrationDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public async Task<WebhookEndpoint> GetEndpointByPathAsync(string path, Guid tenantId)
    {
        return await _context.WebhookEndpoints.FirstOrDefaultAsync(e => e.Path == path && e.TenantId == tenantId);
    }

    public async Task<Partner> GetPartnerByCodeAsync(string partnerCode, Guid tenantId)
    {
        return await _context.Partners.FirstOrDefaultAsync(p => p.PartnerCode == partnerCode && p.TenantId == tenantId);
    }

    public async Task AddAsync(object entity)
    {
        await _context.AddAsync(entity);
    }

    public async Task SaveChangesAsync()
    {
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
    }
}

<file path="services/integration/Integration.Tests/Application/Commands/ProcessWebhookCommandHandlerTests.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Integration.Application.Commands;
using Integration.Application.Services;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;

namespace Integration.Tests.Application.Commands;

public class ProcessWebhookCommandHandlerTests
{
    private const string PartnerSecret = "whsec_test_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef";
    private const string UnknownPartner = "UNKNOWN-PARTNER";

    private readonly HmacExternalRequestSigner _signer = new();
    private readonly TestSecretStore _secrets = new();
    private readonly ProcessWebhookCommandHandler _handler;

    public ProcessWebhookCommandHandlerTests()
    {
        _secrets.Add("PTR-001", PartnerSecret);
        _secrets.Add("ACME", PartnerSecret);
        _handler = new ProcessWebhookCommandHandler(_signer, _secrets, NullLogger<ProcessWebhookCommandHandler>.Instance);
    }

    private ProcessWebhookCommand BuildCommand(
        string payload = "{\"event\":\"vessel.arrived\",\"reference\":\"VES-1\"}",
        string partnerCode = "PTR-001",
        Guid? tenantId = null,
        DateTime? timestamp = null,
        string signature = null)
    {
        return new ProcessWebhookCommand
        {
            TenantId = tenantId ?? Guid.NewGuid(),
            PartnerCode = partnerCode,
            Payload = payload,
            Signature = signature ?? _signer.GenerateSignature(payload, PartnerSecret),
            Timestamp = timestamp ?? DateTime.UtcNow
        };
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_WithValidSignatureAndFreshTimestamp_ShouldReturnTrue()
    {
        // Arrange
        var command = BuildCommand();

        // Act
        var result = await _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert: a correctly signed webhook is accepted for asynchronous processing (202 semantics)
        Assert.True(result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_WithoutTimestampHeader_ShouldReturnFalse()
    {
        // Arrange: the X-Timestamp header is mandatory so a captured payload cannot be replayed
        var command = BuildCommand(timestamp: null);
        command.Timestamp = null;

        // Act
        var result = await _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        Assert.False(result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_WithTimestampOutsideReplayWindow_ShouldReturnFalse()
    {
        // Arrange: payload captured more than the maximum skew in the past
        var command = BuildCommand(timestamp: DateTime.UtcNow - TimeSpan.FromMinutes(10));

        // Act
        var result = await _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert: replayed webhooks are rejected
        Assert.False(result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_WithEmptyPayload_ShouldReturnTrueWhenCorrectlySigned()
    {
        // Arrange: an empty body is unusual but a correctly signed one is still authentic
        var command = BuildCommand(payload: string.Empty);

        // Act
        var result = await _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        Assert.True(result);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("")]
    [InlineData("sha256=not-the-real-signature")]
    [InlineData("invalid-format")]
    public async Task Handle_WithInvalidSignature_ShouldRejectPayload(string signature)
    {
        // A08: HMAC verification is wired up - bad signatures are rejected instead of accepted.
        var command = BuildCommand(signature: signature);

        // Act
        var result = await _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        Assert.False(result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_WhenPayloadWasTamperedWith_ShouldReturnFalse()
    {
        // Arrange: signature computed over a different body
        var command = BuildCommand();
        command.Payload = "{\"event\":\"vessel.arrived\",\"reference\":\"VES-999\"}";

        // Act
        var result = await _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        Assert.False(result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_WhenPartnerHasNoConfiguredSecret_ShouldReturnFalse()
    {
        // Arrange: fail closed for unknown partners
        var command = BuildCommand(partnerCode: UnknownPartner);

        // Act
        var result = await _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        Assert.False(result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_WhenCalledRepeatedly_ShouldRemainStable()
    {
        // Arrange: webhooks are retried by the partner within a short window
        var command = BuildCommand();

        // Act
        for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++)
        {
            var result = await _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

            // Assert
            Assert.True(result);
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_ShouldNotMutateTheCommand()
    {
        // Arrange
        var command = BuildCommand();
        var originalPayload = command.Payload;
        var originalSignature = command.Signature;
        var originalTenantId = command.TenantId;

        // Act
        await _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert: handlers must not rewrite inbound webhook data
        Assert.Equal(originalPayload, command.Payload);
        Assert.Equal(originalSignature, command.Signature);
        Assert.Equal(originalTenantId, command.TenantId);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ProcessWebhookCommand_ShouldBeAReadableTransportObject()
    {
        // Arrange & Act
        var command = BuildCommand(partnerCode: "ACME", payload: "{}");

        // Assert
        Assert.Equal("ACME", command.PartnerCode);
        Assert.Equal("{}", command.Payload);
        Assert.NotEqual(Guid.Empty, command.TenantId);
    }

    private sealed class TestSecretStore : IWebhookSecretStore
    {
        private readonly System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<string, string> _secrets = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        public void Add(string partnerCode, string secret) => _secrets[partnerCode] = secret;

        public string? GetSecret(string? partnerCode) =>
            partnerCode is not null && _secrets.TryGetValue(partnerCode, out var secret) ? secret : null;
    }
}

using System;
using Integration.Domain.Entities;

namespace Integration.Tests.Domain.Entities;

public class InboxMessageTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void NewInboxMessage_ShouldHaveUniqueId()
    {
        // Arrange & Act
        var first = new InboxMessage();
        var second = new InboxMessage();

        // Assert
        Assert.NotEqual(Guid.Empty, first.Id);
        Assert.NotEqual(first.Id, second.Id);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void NewInboxMessage_ShouldDefaultToPendingStatus()
    {
        // Arrange & Act
        var message = new InboxMessage();

        // Assert: the message waits for a consumer to pick it up
        Assert.Equal("Pending", message.Status);
        Assert.Equal(0, message.RetryCount);
        Assert.Null(message.ProcessedAtUtc);
        Assert.Null(message.LastError);
        Assert.Equal(string.Empty, message.PayloadHash);
        Assert.Null(message.TenantId);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void NewInboxMessage_ShouldStampReceivedAndCreatedAtUtc()
    {
        // Arrange
        var before = DateTime.UtcNow;

        // Act
        var message = new InboxMessage();
        var after = DateTime.UtcNow;

        // Assert
        Assert.InRange(message.ReceivedAtUtc, before, after);
        Assert.InRange(message.CreatedAtUtc, before, after);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void InboxMessage_Properties_ShouldBeSettable()
    {
        // Arrange
        var message = new InboxMessage();

        // Act
        message.Status = "Processed";
        message.RetryCount = 3;
        message.LastError = "consumer timeout";
        message.ProcessedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        message.Consumer = "ectn-consumer";
        message.MessageType = "DeclarationSubmittedIntegrationEvent";

        // Assert
        Assert.Equal("Processed", message.Status);
        Assert.Equal(3, message.RetryCount);
        Assert.Equal("consumer timeout", message.LastError);
        Assert.NotNull(message.ProcessedAtUtc);
        Assert.Equal("ectn-consumer", message.Consumer);
        Assert.Equal("DeclarationSubmittedIntegrationEvent", message.MessageType);
    }
}

using System;
using Integration.Domain.Entities;

namespace Integration.Tests.Domain.Entities;

public class IntegrationPartnerTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void NewPartner_ShouldDefaultToDraftWithStandardTrust()
    {
        // Arrange & Act
        var partner = new IntegrationPartner();

        // Assert: partners start as drafts until they are activated
        Assert.Equal("Draft", partner.Status);
        Assert.Equal("Standard", partner.TrustLevel);
        Assert.Null(partner.TenantId);
        Assert.Null(partner.UpdatedBy);
        Assert.Empty(partner.Version);
        Assert.Empty(partner.Systems);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void NewPartner_ShouldHaveUniqueIdAndTimestamps()
    {
        // Arrange
        var before = DateTime.UtcNow;

        // Act
        var partner = new IntegrationPartner();
        var after = DateTime.UtcNow;

        // Assert
        Assert.NotEqual(Guid.Empty, partner.Id);
        Assert.InRange(partner.CreatedAtUtc, before, after);
        Assert.InRange(partner.UpdatedAtUtc, before, after);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void NewPartner_ShouldAllowLinkingSystems()
    {
        // Arrange
        var partner = new IntegrationPartner
        {
            PartnerReference = "PTR-001",
            Name = "Djibouti Customs",
            PartnerType = "CustomsSystem",
            CountryCode = "DJ"
        };
        var system = new IntegrationSystem
        {
            SystemReference = "SYS-001",
            Name = "ASYCUDA World"
        };

        // Act
        partner.Systems.Add(system);

        // Assert
        Assert.Single(partner.Systems);
        Assert.Same(system, partner.Systems.First());
        Assert.Equal("PTR-001", partner.PartnerReference);
        Assert.Equal("SYS-001", partner.Systems.First().SystemReference);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void PartnerProperties_ShouldBeSettable()
    {
        // Arrange
        var partner = new IntegrationPartner();
        var createdBy = Guid.NewGuid();

        // Act
        partner.CreatedBy = createdBy;
        partner.Status = "Active";
        partner.TrustLevel = "Trusted";
        partner.Description = "National customs authority";

        // Assert
        Assert.Equal(createdBy, partner.CreatedBy);
        Assert.Equal("Active", partner.Status);
        Assert.Equal("Trusted", partner.TrustLevel);
        Assert.Equal("National customs authority", partner.Description);
    }
}

using System;
using Integration.Domain.Entities;

namespace Integration.Tests.Domain.Entities;

public class WebhookInboundEventTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void NewWebhookInboundEvent_ShouldDefaultToReceivedState()
    {
        // Arrange & Act
        var webhook = new WebhookInboundEvent();

        // Assert
        Assert.Equal("Received", webhook.Status);
        Assert.False(webhook.SignatureVerified);
        Assert.Null(webhook.ProcessedAtUtc);
        Assert.Null(webhook.ErrorCode);
        Assert.Null(webhook.OccurredAtUtc);
        Assert.Null(webhook.TenantId);
        Assert.Equal(string.Empty, webhook.PayloadHash);
        Assert.Equal(string.Empty, webhook.EventType);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void NewWebhookInboundEvent_ShouldHaveUniqueIdAndTimestamps()
    {
        // Arrange
        var before = DateTime.UtcNow;

        // Act
        var webhook = new WebhookInboundEvent();
        var after = DateTime.UtcNow;

        // Assert
        Assert.NotEqual(Guid.Empty, webhook.Id);
        Assert.InRange(webhook.ReceivedAtUtc, before, after);
        Assert.InRange(webhook.CreatedAtUtc, before, after);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void WebhookInboundEvent_Lifecycle_ShouldBeTrackable()
    {
        // Arrange
        var webhook = new WebhookInboundEvent
        {
            PartnerId = Guid.NewGuid(),
            ProviderEventId = "evt-12345",
            EventType = "vessel.arrived",
            PayloadHash = "sha256:abc"
        };

        // Act: verification succeeds and the processor finishes the event
        webhook.SignatureVerified = true;
        webhook.Status = "Processed";
        webhook.ProcessedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;

        // Assert
        Assert.True(webhook.SignatureVerified);
        Assert.Equal("Processed", webhook.Status);
        Assert.NotNull(webhook.ProcessedAtUtc);
        Assert.Equal("evt-12345", webhook.ProviderEventId);
        Assert.NotEqual(Guid.Empty, webhook.PartnerId);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void WebhookInboundEvent_RejectedState_ShouldCarryErrorCode()
    {
        // Arrange
        var webhook = new WebhookInboundEvent();

        // Act
        webhook.Status = "Rejected";
        webhook.SignatureVerified = false;
        webhook.ErrorCode = "SIGNATURE_MISMATCH";

        // Assert
        Assert.Equal("Rejected", webhook.Status);
        Assert.Equal("SIGNATURE_MISMATCH", webhook.ErrorCode);
    }
}

<file path="services/integration/Integration.Tests/Domain/Enums/EnumsTests.cs">
using System;
using System.Linq;
using Integration.Domain.Enums;

namespace Integration.Tests.Domain.Enums;

public class EnumsTests
{
    [Theory]
    [InlineData(SystemType.Government)]
    [InlineData(SystemType.Customs)]
    [InlineData(SystemType.Port)]
    [InlineData(SystemType.Bank)]
    [InlineData(SystemType.MobileMoney)]
    [InlineData(SystemType.ECTN)]
    [InlineData(SystemType.GPSProvider)]
    [InlineData(SystemType.ANPRProvider)]
    [InlineData(SystemType.AISProvider)]
    [InlineData(SystemType.Other)]
    public void SystemType_ShouldContainKnownSystemKinds(SystemType systemType)
    {
        Assert.True(Enum.IsDefined(systemType));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SystemType_Government_ShouldBeTheDefaultZeroValue()
    {
        Assert.Equal(0, (int)SystemType.Government);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Direction_ShouldCoverInboundOutboundAndBidirectional()
    {
        // Assert
        Assert.Equal(0, (int)Direction.Inbound);
        Assert.Equal(1, (int)Direction.Outbound);
        Assert.Equal(2, (int)Direction.Bidirectional);
        Assert.True(Enum.IsDefined(Direction.Bidirectional));
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(Protocol.REST)]
    [InlineData(Protocol.Webhook)]
    [InlineData(Protocol.SOAP)]
    [InlineData(Protocol.SFTP)]
    [InlineData(Protocol.AMQP)]
    [InlineData(Protocol.gRPC)]
    [InlineData(Protocol.Other)]
    public void Protocol_ShouldContainSupportedProtocols(Protocol protocol)
    {
        Assert.True(Enum.IsDefined(protocol));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void PartnerStatus_ShouldCoverThePartnerLifecycle()
    {
        // Assert
        Assert.Equal(0, (int)PartnerStatus.Pending);
        Assert.Equal(PartnerStatus.Pending, Enum.Parse<PartnerStatus>("Pending"));
        Assert.Equal(PartnerStatus.Active, Enum.Parse<PartnerStatus>("Active"));
        Assert.Equal(PartnerStatus.Suspended, Enum.Parse<PartnerStatus>("Suspended"));
        Assert.Equal(PartnerStatus.Inactive, Enum.Parse<PartnerStatus>("Inactive"));
        Assert.False(Enum.IsDefined(typeof(PartnerStatus), 99));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void IntegrationStatus_ShouldCoverTheIntegrationLifecycle()
    {
        // Assert
        Assert.Equal(0, (int)IntegrationStatus.Draft);
        Assert.Equal(IntegrationStatus.Draft, Enum.Parse<IntegrationStatus>("Draft"));
        Assert.Equal(IntegrationStatus.Active, Enum.Parse<IntegrationStatus>("Active"));
        Assert.Equal(IntegrationStatus.Deprecated, Enum.Parse<IntegrationStatus>("Deprecated"));
        Assert.Equal(IntegrationStatus.Retired, Enum.Parse<IntegrationStatus>("Retired"));
        Assert.Equal(4, Enum.GetValues<IntegrationStatus>().Length);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AllEnums_ShouldHaveNoDuplicateNames()
    {
        // Assert: duplicate names would break string-based persistence/serialization
        AssertNoDuplicateNames<SystemType>();
        AssertNoDuplicateNames<Direction>();
        AssertNoDuplicateNames<Protocol>();
        AssertNoDuplicateNames<PartnerStatus>();
        AssertNoDuplicateNames<IntegrationStatus>();
    }

    private static void AssertNoDuplicateNames<T>() where T : struct, Enum
    {
        var names = Enum.GetNames<T>();
        Assert.Equal(names.Length, names.Distinct().Count());
    }
}
</file>

<file path="services/notification/Notification.Infrastructure/Persistence/NotificationDbContext.cs">
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Notification.Domain.Entities;

namespace Notification.Infrastructure.Persistence;

public class NotificationDbContext : DbContext
{
    // 1. Notification Core & Recipients
    public DbSet<Domain.Entities.Notification> Notifications { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<NotificationRecipient> Recipients { get; set; } = null!;

    // 2. Channels
    public DbSet<NotificationChannel> Channels { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<EmailNotification> EmailNotifications { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<SmsNotification> SmsNotifications { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<PushNotification> PushNotifications { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<InAppNotification> InAppNotifications { get; set; } = null!;

    // 3. Templates & Rules
    public DbSet<NotificationTemplate> Templates { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<NotificationTemplateVersion> TemplateVersions { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<NotificationTemplateApproval> TemplateApprovals { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<NotificationRule> Rules { get; set; } = null!;

    // 4. Preferences & Quiet Hours
    public DbSet<NotificationPreference> Preferences { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<NotificationChannelPreference> ChannelPreferences { get; set; } = null!;

    // 5. Delivery & Status
    public DbSet<NotificationRequest> Requests { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<NotificationDelivery> Deliveries { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<NotificationDeliveryAttempt> DeliveryAttempts { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<NotificationReadState> ReadStates { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<NotificationStatusHistory> StatusHistories { get; set; } = null!;

    // 6. Provider Integrations
    public DbSet<NotificationProviderCallback> ProviderCallbacks { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<NotificationProviderReference> ProviderReferences { get; set; } = null!;

    // 7. Scheduling & Broadcast
    public DbSet<NotificationSchedule> Schedules { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<NotificationBroadcast> Broadcasts { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<NotificationBroadcastRecipient> BroadcastRecipients { get; set; } = null!;

    // 8. Resiliency & Audit
    public DbSet<NotificationRetryPolicy> RetryPolicies { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<NotificationDeadLetter> DeadLetters { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<NotificationIdempotencyRecord> IdempotencyRecords { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<NotificationAlert> Alerts { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<NotificationAuditEntry> AuditEntries { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<OutboxMessage> OutboxMessages { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<InboxMessage> InboxMessages { get; set; } = null!;

    // 9. Attachments & Escalation
    public DbSet<NotificationEscalation> Escalations { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<NotificationAttachment> Attachments { get; set; } = null!;

    public NotificationDbContext(DbContextOptions<NotificationDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);

        // 1. Notification
        modelBuilder.Entity<Domain.Entities.Notification>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.NotificationReference }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.Status });
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.NotificationType });
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.Priority });
            e.HasIndex(x => x.CreatedAtUtc);
            e.HasIndex(x => x.ScheduledAtUtc);
            e.HasIndex(x => x.ExpiresAtUtc);
            e.HasIndex(x => x.SourceService);
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationRecipient>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.NotificationId, x.UserReference });
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.UserReference, x.ReadAtUtc });
        });

        // 2. Channels
        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationChannel>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.NotificationId, x.RecipientId, x.ChannelType });
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<EmailNotification>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.NotificationId });
        });
        
        modelBuilder.Entity<SmsNotification>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.NotificationId });
        });
        
        modelBuilder.Entity<PushNotification>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.NotificationId });
            e.Property(x => x.PayloadJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });
        
        modelBuilder.Entity<InAppNotification>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.NotificationId, x.RecipientId, x.IsRead });
        });

        // 3. Templates & Rules
        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationTemplate>(e =>
        {
            // Note: TenantId can be null for global templates, so we don't index as composite unique trivially unless we handle nulls.
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TemplateReference, x.TenantId }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.NotificationType, x.ChannelType, x.LanguageCode, x.Status });
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationTemplateVersion>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TemplateId, x.VersionNumber }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(x => x.VariablesSchemaJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationRule>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.RuleReference }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(x => x.ConditionsJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        // 4. Preferences
        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationPreference>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.UserReference, x.NotificationType }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationChannelPreference>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.UserReference, x.NotificationType, x.ChannelType }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        // 5. Delivery
        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationRequest>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.RequestReference }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.IdempotencyKey });
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationDelivery>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.NotificationId, x.ChannelId });
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.Status });
            e.HasIndex(x => x.CreatedAtUtc);
            e.HasIndex(x => x.LastAttemptAtUtc);
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationDeliveryAttempt>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.DeliveryId, x.AttemptNumber }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => x.AttemptedAtUtc);
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationReadState>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.NotificationId, x.UserReference }).IsUnique();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationStatusHistory>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.NotificationId, x.OccurredAtUtc });
        });

        // 6. Providers
        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationProviderCallback>(e =>

        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationProviderReference>(e =>

        });

        // 7. Scheduling & Broadcast
        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationSchedule>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.NotificationId }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.Status, x.NextRunAtUtc });
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationBroadcast>(e =>

        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationBroadcastRecipient>(e =>

        // 8. Resiliency & Audit
        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationIdempotencyRecord>(e =>

        modelBuilder.Entity<InboxMessage>(e =>

        // 9. Attachments & Escalation
        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationEscalation>(e =>

using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using MediatR;
using Payment.Application.Commands;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;

namespace Payment.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/intents")]
[Authorize]
public class PaymentIntentsController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;

    public PaymentIntentsController(IMediator mediator)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
    }

    [HttpPost]
    [Authorize(Policy = "payment.intent.create")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> CreateIntent([FromBody] CreatePaymentIntentCommand command)
    {
        if (!Guid.TryParse(User.FindFirst("tenant_id")?.Value, out var tenantId)) return Forbid();
        command.TenantId = tenantId;

        var intentId = await _mediator.Send(command);
        return CreatedAtAction(nameof(GetIntent), new { id = intentId }, new { IntentId = intentId });
    }

    [HttpGet("{id}")]
    [Authorize(Policy = "payment.intent.read")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetIntent(Guid id)
    {
        return Problem(statusCode: StatusCodes.Status501NotImplemented, title: "Payment intent lookup is not implemented.");
    }
}

using BuildingBlocks.Web;
using FluentValidation;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Payment.Application.Commands;
using Payment.Infrastructure.Persistence;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

builder.Services.AddControllers();
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
builder.Services.AddSwaggerGen();

builder.Services.AddMediatR(cfg => cfg.RegisterServicesFromAssembly(typeof(CreatePaymentIntentCommand).Assembly));
builder.Services.AddValidatorsFromAssembly(typeof(CreatePaymentIntentCommand).Assembly);

// A01/A07: this service had no host, no authentication scheme and no authorization middleware.
builder.Services.AddPlatformJwtAuthentication(builder.Configuration);
builder.Services.AddPlatformSecurity(builder.Configuration);

builder.Services.AddAuthorization(options =>
{
    options.AddPolicy("payment.intent.create", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "payment.intent.create"));
    options.AddPolicy("payment.intent.read", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "payment.intent.read"));
});

var connectionString = builder.Configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection");
if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionString))
    throw new InvalidOperationException("ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection is required.");

builder.Services.AddDbContext<PaymentDbContext>(options => options.UseNpgsql(connectionString));
builder.Services.AddScoped<IPaymentDbContext>(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<PaymentDbContext>());

var app = builder.Build();

app.UsePlatformSecurity();
if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
{
    app.UseSwagger();
    app.UseSwaggerUI();
}

app.UseHttpsRedirection();
app.UseRouting();
app.UsePlatformCors();
app.UseRateLimiter();
app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseAuthorization();
app.MapControllers();

app.MapGet("/health/live", () => Results.Ok(new { status = "alive" })).AllowAnonymous();

app.Run();

public partial class Program { }

<file path="services/payment/Payment.Application/Commands/CreatePaymentIntentCommand.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using MediatR;
using FluentValidation;
using Payment.Domain.Entities;
using Payment.Domain.ValueObjects;

namespace Payment.Application.Commands;

public class CreatePaymentIntentCommand : IRequest<Guid>
{
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public string ExternalReference { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string SourceSystem { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string SourceAggregateId { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public Guid CustomsCaseId { get; set; }
    public string DeclarationNumber { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string ECTNNumber { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public decimal Amount { get; set; }
    public string Currency { get; set; } = "USD";
    public DateTime? DueDate { get; set; }
}

public class CreatePaymentIntentCommandValidator : AbstractValidator<CreatePaymentIntentCommand>
{
    public CreatePaymentIntentCommandValidator()
    {
        RuleFor(x => x.TenantId).NotEmpty().WithMessage("TenantId is required.");
        RuleFor(x => x.Amount).GreaterThan(0).WithMessage("Amount must be greater than zero.");
        RuleFor(x => x.Currency).NotEmpty().Length(3).WithMessage("Currency must be a 3-letter code.");
        RuleFor(x => x.SourceSystem).NotEmpty().WithMessage("SourceSystem is required.");
    }
}

public interface IPaymentDbContext
{
    void AddPaymentIntent(PaymentIntent intent);
    Task<int> SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken);
}

public class CreatePaymentIntentCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<CreatePaymentIntentCommand, Guid>
{
    private readonly IPaymentDbContext _context;

    public CreatePaymentIntentCommandHandler(IPaymentDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public async Task<Guid> Handle(CreatePaymentIntentCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var paymentReference = $"PAY-{DateTime.UtcNow:yyyyMMdd}-{Guid.NewGuid().ToString().Substring(0, 8).ToUpper()}";
        
        var money = new Money(request.Amount, request.Currency);

        var intent = new PaymentIntent(
            request.TenantId,
            paymentReference,
            request.SourceSystem,
            request.SourceAggregateId,
            request.CustomsCaseId,
            request.DeclarationNumber,
            request.ECTNNumber,
            money,
            request.DueDate
        );

        _context.AddPaymentIntent(intent);
        
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

        return intent.Id;
    }
}

namespace Payment.Domain.Entities.Billing;

public class CustomerAccount
{

<file path="services/payment/Payment.Domain/Entities/PaymentIntent.cs">
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Payment.Domain.ValueObjects;

namespace Payment.Domain.Entities;

public class PaymentIntent
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; } = Guid.NewGuid();
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public Guid? CustomerAccountId { get; set; }
    
    public string IntentReference { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string SourceSystem { get; set; } = string.Empty; // Declaration, Customs, ECTN
    public string SourceReferenceId { get; set; } = string.Empty; // e.g. CustomsAssessmentId
    public Guid? CustomsCaseId { get; set; }
    public string DeclarationNumber { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string ECTNNumber { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    
    public decimal AmountRequested { get; set; }
    public string CurrencyCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    
    public string Status { get; set; } = "Created"; // Created, RequiresPaymentMethod, Processing, Succeeded, Canceled, Failed
    
    public Guid? GatewayConfigurationId { get; set; }
    public string GatewayIntentId { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    
    public DateTime CreatedAtUtc { get; set; } = DateTime.UtcNow;
    public DateTime UpdatedAtUtc { get; set; } = DateTime.UtcNow;
    public DateTime? ExpiresAtUtc { get; set; }
    public DateTime? DueDate { get; set; }
    
    public string MetadataJson { get; set; } = "{}"; // JSONB
    
    public byte[] Version { get; set; } = Array.Empty<byte>();

    public ICollection<PaymentTransaction> Transactions { get; set; } = new List<PaymentTransaction>();

    public PaymentIntent() { }

    public PaymentIntent(
        Guid tenantId,
        string intentReference,
        string sourceSystem,
        string sourceReferenceId,
        Guid customsCaseId,
        string declarationNumber,
        string ectnNumber,
        Money money,
        DateTime? dueDate = null)
    {
        TenantId = tenantId;
        IntentReference = intentReference;
        SourceSystem = sourceSystem;
        SourceReferenceId = sourceReferenceId;
        CustomsCaseId = customsCaseId;
        DeclarationNumber = declarationNumber ?? string.Empty;
        ECTNNumber = ectnNumber ?? string.Empty;
        AmountRequested = money.Amount;
        CurrencyCode = money.Currency;
        Status = "Created";
        DueDate = dueDate;
        CreatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        UpdatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

    public void Process()
    {
        if (Status != "Created" && Status != "RequiresPaymentMethod")
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Cannot process payment intent in state '{Status}'.");
        Status = "Processing";
        UpdatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

    public void MarkSucceeded(PaymentTransaction transaction)
    {
        if (Status == "Succeeded") return;
        if (Status == "Canceled") throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot succeed a canceled payment intent.");

        Status = "Succeeded";
        UpdatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        if (transaction != null && !Transactions.Contains(transaction))
        {
            Transactions.Add(transaction);
        }
    }

    public void MarkFailed(string reason)
    {
        Status = "Failed";
        UpdatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

    public void Cancel()
    {
        if (Status == "Succeeded") throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot cancel an already succeeded payment.");
        Status = "Canceled";
        UpdatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }
}
