<file path="services/payment/Payment.Domain/ValueObjects/Money.cs">
using System;

namespace Payment.Domain.ValueObjects;

public class Money : IEquatable<Money>
{
    public decimal Amount { get; private set; }
    public string Currency { get; private set; }

    protected Money() { }

    public Money(decimal amount, string currency)
    {
        if (amount < 0) throw new ArgumentException("Amount cannot be negative", nameof(amount));
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(currency)) throw new ArgumentException("Currency must be specified", nameof(currency));

        Amount = Math.Round(amount, 2, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero); // Default rounding policy for now
        Currency = currency.ToUpperInvariant();
    }

    public static Money Zero(string currency) => new Money(0, currency);

    public Money Add(Money other)
    {
        if (Currency != other.Currency)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot add different currencies");
        return new Money(Amount + other.Amount, Currency);
    }

    public Money Subtract(Money other)
    {
        if (Currency != other.Currency)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot subtract different currencies");
        if (Amount < other.Amount)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot subtract to a negative amount");
        return new Money(Amount - other.Amount, Currency);
    }

    public bool Equals(Money other)
    {
        if (other is null) return false;
        return Amount == other.Amount && Currency == other.Currency;
    }

    public override bool Equals(object obj) => Equals(obj as Money);

    public override int GetHashCode() => HashCode.Combine(Amount, Currency);
}

<file path="services/payment/Payment.Infrastructure/Persistence/PaymentDbContext.cs">
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Payment.Domain.Entities;
using Payment.Domain.Entities.Billing;
using Payment.Domain.Entities.Configuration;
using Payment.Domain.Entities.Integration;
using Payment.Application.Commands;
using BuildingBlocks.Persistence; // Base SmartDbContext

namespace Payment.Infrastructure.Persistence;

public class PaymentDbContext : SmartDbContext<PaymentDbContext>, IPaymentDbContext
{
    public PaymentDbContext(DbContextOptions<PaymentDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

    // Core
    public DbSet<PaymentIntent> PaymentIntents => Set<PaymentIntent>();
    public DbSet<PaymentTransaction> PaymentTransactions => Set<PaymentTransaction>();
    public DbSet<LedgerEntry> LedgerEntries => Set<LedgerEntry>();

    // ── IPaymentDbContext (Application-layer abstraction) ────────────────────
    public void AddPaymentIntent(PaymentIntent intent) => PaymentIntents.Add(intent);
    
    // Billing
    public DbSet<Invoice> Invoices => Set<Invoice>();
    public DbSet<InvoiceLineItem> InvoiceLineItems => Set<InvoiceLineItem>();
    public DbSet<Receipt> Receipts => Set<Receipt>();
    public DbSet<CustomerAccount> CustomerAccounts => Set<CustomerAccount>();
    
    // Configuration
    public DbSet<PaymentGatewayConfiguration> PaymentGatewayConfigurations => Set<PaymentGatewayConfiguration>();
    public DbSet<PaymentMethodConfiguration> PaymentMethodConfigurations => Set<PaymentMethodConfiguration>();
    
    // Integration
    public DbSet<OutboxMessage> OutboxMessages => Set<OutboxMessage>();
    public DbSet<InboxMessage> InboxMessages => Set<InboxMessage>();
    public DbSet<IdempotencyRecord> IdempotencyRecords => Set<IdempotencyRecord>();

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder builder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(builder);

        // Payment Intent
        builder.Entity<PaymentIntent>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(pi => new { pi.TenantId, pi.IntentReference }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(pi => new { pi.SourceSystem, pi.SourceReferenceId });
            e.HasIndex(pi => pi.Status);
            e.HasIndex(pi => pi.CreatedAtUtc);
            
            e.Property(pi => pi.AmountRequested).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(pi => pi.MetadataJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.Property(pi => pi.Version).IsRowVersion();
            
            e.HasMany(pi => pi.Transactions)
             .WithOne(t => t.PaymentIntent)
             .HasForeignKey(t => t.PaymentIntentId)
             .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        // Payment Transaction
        builder.Entity<PaymentTransaction>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(pt => pt.GatewayTransactionId);
            e.HasIndex(pt => pt.Status);
            
            e.Property(pt => pt.Amount).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(pt => pt.PaymentMethodDetailsJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.Property(pt => pt.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        // Ledger Entry (Immutable)
        builder.Entity<LedgerEntry>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(le => new { le.TenantId, le.CustomerAccountId });
            e.HasIndex(le => le.PostedAtUtc);
            e.HasIndex(le => le.Hash).IsUnique();
            
            e.Property(le => le.Amount).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            // Ledger entries should never be updated or cascade deleted
        });

        // Billing
        builder.Entity<CustomerAccount>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(ca => new { ca.TenantId, ca.AccountNumber }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(ca => ca.OrganizationId);
            
            e.Property(ca => ca.CreditLimit).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(ca => ca.AvailableCredit).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(ca => ca.CurrentBalance).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(ca => ca.Version).IsRowVersion();
            
            e.HasMany(ca => ca.Invoices)
             .WithOne(i => i.CustomerAccount)
             .HasForeignKey(i => i.CustomerAccountId)
             .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
        });

        builder.Entity<Invoice>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(i => new { i.TenantId, i.InvoiceNumber }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(i => new { i.SourceSystem, i.SourceReferenceId });
            e.HasIndex(i => i.Status);
            
            e.Property(i => i.SubtotalAmount).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(i => i.TaxAmount).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(i => i.TotalAmount).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(i => i.AmountPaid).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(i => i.AmountDue).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(i => i.Version).IsRowVersion();
            
            e.HasMany(i => i.LineItems)
             .WithOne(li => li.Invoice)
             .HasForeignKey(li => li.InvoiceId)
             .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        builder.Entity<InvoiceLineItem>(e =>
        {
            e.Property(li => li.Quantity).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(li => li.UnitPrice).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(li => li.TaxRate).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(li => li.TaxAmount).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(li => li.TotalAmount).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
        });

        builder.Entity<Receipt>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(r => new { r.TenantId, r.ReceiptNumber }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(r => r.PaymentTransactionId);
            
            e.Property(r => r.Amount).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(r => r.MetadataJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            
            e.HasOne(r => r.Invoice)
             .WithMany()
             .HasForeignKey(r => r.InvoiceId)
             .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
        });

        // Configuration
        builder.Entity<PaymentGatewayConfiguration>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(pg => new { pg.TenantId, pg.GatewayName });
            
            e.Property(pg => pg.SupportedCurrenciesJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.Property(pg => pg.AdditionalSettingsJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.Property(pg => pg.Version).IsRowVersion();
            
            e.HasMany(pg => pg.SupportedMethods)
             .WithOne(pm => pm.Gateway)
             .HasForeignKey(pm => pm.PaymentGatewayConfigurationId)
             .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        builder.Entity<PaymentMethodConfiguration>(e =>
        {
            e.Property(pm => pm.ProcessingFeePercentage).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(pm => pm.FixedProcessingFee).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(pm => pm.MinimumAmount).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(pm => pm.MaximumAmount).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
        });

        // Idempotency
        builder.Entity<IdempotencyRecord>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(i => new { i.TenantId, i.IdempotencyKey, i.Operation }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(i => i.ResponseBodyJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        // Inbox / Outbox
        builder.Entity<InboxMessage>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(i => new { i.MessageId, i.Consumer }).IsUnique();
        });
        
        builder.Entity<OutboxMessage>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(o => o.Status);
            e.HasIndex(o => o.OccurredAtUtc);
            e.Property(o => o.PayloadJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });
    }
}

using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Shipping.Infrastructure.Persistence;

namespace Shipping.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/[controller]")]
[Authorize]
public class ShipmentsController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;
    private readonly IShippingQueryContext _query;

    public ShipmentsController(IMediator mediator, IShippingQueryContext query)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
        _query = query;
    }

    // ── POST /api/v1/shipments ────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /// <summary>Create a new shipment in Draft status.</summary>
    [HttpPost]
    [Authorize(Policy = "shipping.create")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> CreateShipment([FromBody] CreateShipmentCommand command)
    {
        if (!Guid.TryParse(User.FindFirst("tenant_id")?.Value, out var tenantId))
            return Forbid();

        command.TenantId = tenantId;

        if (User.HasClaim(c => c.Type == "sub"))
            command.UserId = Guid.Parse(User.FindFirst("sub")!.Value);

        var shipmentId = await _mediator.Send(command);
        return CreatedAtAction(nameof(GetShipment), new { id = shipmentId }, new { ShipmentId = shipmentId });
    }

    // ── GET /api/v1/shipments/{id} ────────────────────────────────────────────

    /// <summary>Get shipment details by ID.</summary>
    [HttpGet("{id:guid}")]
    [Authorize(Policy = "shipping.read")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetShipment(Guid id)
    {
        if (!Guid.TryParse(User.FindFirst("tenant_id")?.Value, out var tenantId))
            return Forbid();

        var shipment = await _query.ShipmentsQuery
            .Include(s => s.Lines)
            .Include(s => s.Containers)
            .Include(s => s.Documents)
            .Where(s => s.Id == id && s.TenantId == tenantId)
            .Select(s => new
            {
                s.Id,
                s.ShipmentNumber,
                s.ExternalReference,
                s.CarrierBookingReference,
                s.MasterBillNumber,
                s.HouseBillNumber,
                s.ShipperName,
                s.ShipperReference,
                s.ConsigneeName,
                s.ConsigneeReference,
                s.CarrierCode,
                s.CarrierName,
                s.FreightForwarderCode,
                Origin = new { s.OriginCountryCode, s.OriginPortCode, s.OriginPortName },
                Destination = new { s.DestinationCountryCode, s.DestinationPortCode, s.DestinationPortName },
                TransportMode = s.TransportMode.ToString(),
                CargoType = s.CargoType.ToString(),
                Incoterm = s.Incoterm.ToString(),
                s.GrossWeightKg,
                s.NetWeightKg,
                s.VolumeM3,
                s.PackageCount,
                s.HsCode,
                s.GoodsDescription,
                s.Currency,
                s.FreightValue,
                s.InsuranceValue,
                s.DeclaredValue,
                s.EstimatedDepartureUtc,
                s.EstimatedArrivalUtc,
                s.ActualDepartureUtc,
                s.ActualArrivalUtc,
                s.DeliveredAtUtc,
                Status = s.Status.ToString(),
                s.StatusReason,
                Customs = new
                {
                    s.CustomsCaseId,
                    s.CustomsCaseNumber,
                    s.IsCustomsCleared,
                    s.CustomsClearedAtUtc
                },
                Lines = s.Lines.Select(l => new
                {
                    l.LineNumber,
                    l.Description,
                    l.HsCode,
                    l.CountryOfOrigin,
                    l.Quantity,
                    l.UnitOfMeasure,
                    l.GrossWeightKg,
                    l.TotalValue,
                    l.Currency
                }),
                Containers = s.Containers.Select(c => new
                {
                    c.ContainerNumber,
                    c.ContainerType,
                    c.SealNumber,
                    c.CargoWeightKg,
                    c.IsHazardous,
                    c.IsReeferActive
                }),
                s.CreatedAtUtc,
                s.UpdatedAtUtc
            })
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync();

        if (shipment is null)
            return NotFound(new { Message = $"Shipment {id} not found." });

        return Ok(shipment);
    }

    // ── GET /api/v1/shipments ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /// <summary>List shipments for the tenant with optional status filter and pagination.</summary>
    [HttpGet]
    [Authorize(Policy = "shipping.read")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> ListShipments(
        [FromQuery] string? status,
        [FromQuery] int page = 1,
        [FromQuery] int pageSize = 20)
    {
        if (!Guid.TryParse(User.FindFirst("tenant_id")?.Value, out var tenantId))
            return Forbid();

        pageSize = Math.Clamp(pageSize, 1, 100);
        page = Math.Max(1, page);

        var query = _query.ShipmentsQuery.Where(s => s.TenantId == tenantId);

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(status) &&
            Enum.TryParse<ShipmentStatus>(status, ignoreCase: true, out var parsedStatus))
        {
            query = query.Where(s => s.Status == parsedStatus);
        }

        var total = await query.CountAsync();
        var items = await query
            .OrderByDescending(s => s.CreatedAtUtc)
            .Skip((page - 1) * pageSize)
            .Take(pageSize)
            .Select(s => new
            {
                s.Id,
                s.ShipmentNumber,
                s.ShipperReference,
                s.ConsigneeReference,
                Origin = s.OriginPortCode,
                Destination = s.DestinationPortCode,
                Status = s.Status.ToString(),
                TransportMode = s.TransportMode.ToString(),
                s.EstimatedArrivalUtc,
                s.CreatedAtUtc
            })
            .ToListAsync();

        return Ok(new
        {
            Total = total,
            Page = page,
            PageSize = pageSize,
            Items = items
        });
    }

    // ── PATCH /api/v1/shipments/{id}/status ──────────────────────────────────

    /// <summary>Update the status of a shipment.</summary>
    [HttpPatch("{id:guid}/status")]
    [Authorize(Policy = "shipping.status.update")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> UpdateStatus(Guid id, [FromBody] UpdateShipmentStatusCommand command)
    {
        if (!Guid.TryParse(User.FindFirst("tenant_id")?.Value, out var tenantId))
            return Forbid();

        command.TenantId = tenantId;
        command.ShipmentId = id;

        if (User.HasClaim(c => c.Type == "sub"))
            command.UserId = Guid.Parse(User.FindFirst("sub")!.Value);

        await _mediator.Send(command);
        return NoContent();
    }

    // ── POST /api/v1/shipments/{id}/customs-clearance ─────────────────────────

    /// <summary>Confirm customs clearance for a shipment — links to a customs case.</summary>
    [HttpPost("{id:guid}/customs-clearance")]
    [Authorize(Policy = "shipping.customs.confirm")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> ConfirmCustomsClearance(
        Guid id,
        [FromBody] ConfirmCustomsClearanceCommand command)
    {
        if (!Guid.TryParse(User.FindFirst("tenant_id")?.Value, out var tenantId))
            return Forbid();

        command.TenantId = tenantId;
        command.ShipmentId = id;

        if (User.HasClaim(c => c.Type == "sub"))
            command.UserId = Guid.Parse(User.FindFirst("sub")!.Value);

        await _mediator.Send(command);
        return NoContent();
    }
}

<file path="services/shipping/Shipping.Api/Controllers/TrackingController.cs">
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using MediatR;
using Shipping.Application.Commands;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Shipping.Infrastructure.Persistence;

namespace Shipping.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/shipments/{shipmentId:guid}/tracking")]
[Authorize]
public class TrackingController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;
    private readonly IShippingQueryContext _query;

    public TrackingController(IMediator mediator, IShippingQueryContext query)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
        _query = query;
    }

    // ── POST /api/v1/shipments/{shipmentId}/tracking ──────────────────────────

    /// <summary>Record a new tracking event (GPS ping, milestone scan, carrier message).</summary>
    [HttpPost]
    [Authorize(Policy = "shipping.tracking.record")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> RecordTrackingEvent(
        Guid shipmentId,
        [FromBody] RecordTrackingEventCommand command)
    {
        if (!Guid.TryParse(User.FindFirst("tenant_id")?.Value, out var tenantId))
            return Forbid();

        command.TenantId = tenantId;
        command.ShipmentId = shipmentId;

        if (User.HasClaim(c => c.Type == "sub"))
            command.UserId = Guid.Parse(User.FindFirst("sub")!.Value);

        var eventId = await _mediator.Send(command);
        return Created($"api/v1/shipments/{shipmentId}/tracking/{eventId}", new { EventId = eventId });
    }

    // ── GET /api/v1/shipments/{shipmentId}/tracking ───────────────────────────

    /// <summary>Get the full tracking timeline for a shipment, ordered chronologically.</summary>
    [HttpGet]
    [Authorize(Policy = "shipping.read")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetTrackingTimeline(Guid shipmentId)
    {
        if (!Guid.TryParse(User.FindFirst("tenant_id")?.Value, out var tenantId))
            return Forbid();

        // Verify shipment belongs to tenant
        var shipmentExists = await _query.ShipmentsQuery
            .AnyAsync(s => s.Id == shipmentId && s.TenantId == tenantId);

        if (!shipmentExists)
            return NotFound(new { Message = $"Shipment {shipmentId} not found." });

        var events = await _query.ShipmentsQuery
            .Where(s => s.Id == shipmentId)
            .SelectMany(s => s.TrackingEvents)
            .OrderBy(e => e.OccurredAtUtc)
            .Select(e => new
            {
                e.Id,
                EventType = e.EventType.ToString(),
                e.Location,
                e.Description,
                e.Latitude,
                e.Longitude,
                e.VehicleIdentifier,
                e.CarrierEventCode,
                e.OccurredAtUtc
            })
            .ToListAsync();

        return Ok(events);
    }
}

using Shipping.Application.Commands;
using Shipping.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using BuildingBlocks.Web;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Serilog;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

// ── Logging ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
builder.Host.UseSerilog((ctx, cfg) =>
    cfg.ReadFrom.Configuration(ctx.Configuration));

// ── MVC / API ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
builder.Services.AddControllers();
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
builder.Services.AddSwaggerGen(c =>
{
    c.SwaggerDoc("v1", new() { Title = "Smart Trade — Shipping API", Version = "v1" });
});

// ── MediatR (CQRS) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
builder.Services.AddMediatR(cfg =>
    cfg.RegisterServicesFromAssembly(typeof(CreateShipmentCommand).Assembly));

// ── Database ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
builder.Services.AddDbContext<ShippingDbContext>(opts =>
    opts.UseNpgsql(builder.Configuration.GetConnectionString("ShippingDb")));

builder.Services.AddScoped<IShippingDbContext>(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<ShippingDbContext>());
builder.Services.AddScoped<IShippingQueryContext>(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<ShippingDbContext>());
builder.Services.AddScoped<IShipmentNumberGenerator, ShipmentNumberGenerator>();

// ── Auth & Security ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// A05/A07: shared JWT validation through platform building block
// (32-byte HS256 key, issuer/audience/lifetime checks).
builder.Services.AddPlatformJwtAuthentication(builder.Configuration);

// Platform-wide security defaults: deny-by-default fallback policy (A01),
// rate limiting (A07), config-driven CORS, ProblemDetails and security headers (A05/A09).
builder.Services.AddPlatformSecurity(builder.Configuration);

builder.Services.AddAuthorization(opts =>
{
    opts.AddPolicy("shipping.create",          p => p.RequireClaim("permissions", "shipping.create"));
    opts.AddPolicy("shipping.read",            p => p.RequireClaim("permissions", "shipping.read"));
    opts.AddPolicy("shipping.status.update",   p => p.RequireClaim("permissions", "shipping.status.update"));
    opts.AddPolicy("shipping.tracking.record", p => p.RequireClaim("permissions", "shipping.tracking.record"));
    opts.AddPolicy("shipping.customs.confirm", p => p.RequireClaim("permissions", "shipping.customs.confirm"));
});

// ── Build ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
var app = builder.Build();

app.UsePlatformSecurity();

if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
{
    app.UseSwagger();
    app.UseSwaggerUI();
}

app.UseHttpsRedirection();
app.UseRouting();
app.UsePlatformCors();
app.UseRateLimiter();
app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseAuthorization();

app.MapControllers();
app.MapGet("/health/live", () => Results.Ok(new { status = "alive" })).AllowAnonymous();

app.Run();

// Integration tests use WebApplicationFactory<Program>, which requires the
// entry-point class to be public (same pattern as the other API services).
public partial class Program { }

<file path="services/shipping/Shipping.Application/Commands/ConfirmCustomsClearanceCommand.cs">
using MediatR;
using FluentValidation;
using Shipping.Domain.Entities;
using Shipping.Domain.Enums;

namespace Shipping.Application.Commands;

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Command
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

public class ConfirmCustomsClearanceCommand : IRequest
{
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public Guid ShipmentId { get; set; }
    public Guid CustomsCaseId { get; set; }
    public string CustomsCaseNumber { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public Guid UserId { get; set; }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Validator
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

public class ConfirmCustomsClearanceCommandValidator : AbstractValidator<ConfirmCustomsClearanceCommand>
{
    public ConfirmCustomsClearanceCommandValidator()
    {
        RuleFor(x => x.TenantId).NotEmpty();
        RuleFor(x => x.ShipmentId).NotEmpty();
        RuleFor(x => x.CustomsCaseId).NotEmpty();
        RuleFor(x => x.CustomsCaseNumber).NotEmpty();
        RuleFor(x => x.UserId).NotEmpty();
    }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Handler
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

public class ConfirmCustomsClearanceCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<ConfirmCustomsClearanceCommand>
{
    private readonly IShippingQueryContext _context;

    public ConfirmCustomsClearanceCommandHandler(IShippingQueryContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public async Task Handle(ConfirmCustomsClearanceCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var shipment = await _context.GetShipmentWithTrackingAsync(request.ShipmentId, request.TenantId, cancellationToken)
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"Shipment {request.ShipmentId} not found.");

        if (shipment.IsCustomsCleared)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Shipment {request.ShipmentId} is already customs cleared.");

        shipment.CustomsCaseId = request.CustomsCaseId;
        shipment.CustomsCaseNumber = request.CustomsCaseNumber;
        shipment.IsCustomsCleared = true;
        shipment.CustomsClearedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        shipment.UpdatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        shipment.UpdatedBy = request.UserId;

        shipment.TransitionStatus(
            ShipmentStatus.CustomsCleared,
            $"Customs cleared — Case: {request.CustomsCaseNumber}",
            request.UserId);

        shipment.AddTrackingEvent(
            TrackingEventType.CustomsCleared,
            "Customs Authority",
            $"Customs clearance confirmed. Case: {request.CustomsCaseNumber}",
            request.UserId);

        // TODO: Publish ShipmentCustomsClearedEvent to outbox

        await _context.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
    }
}

using MediatR;
using FluentValidation;
using Shipping.Domain.Entities;
using Shipping.Domain.Enums;

namespace Shipping.Application.Commands;

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Command
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

public class CreateShipmentCommand : IRequest<Guid>
{
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public Guid? OrganizationId { get; set; }

    // Parties
    public string ShipperName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string ShipperReference { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string ConsigneeName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string ConsigneeReference { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string? CarrierCode { get; set; }
    public string? FreightForwarderCode { get; set; }

    // Route
    public string OriginCountryCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string OriginPortCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string OriginPortName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string DestinationCountryCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string DestinationPortCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string DestinationPortName { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    // Cargo
    public TransportMode TransportMode { get; set; }
    public CargoType CargoType { get; set; }
    public Incoterm Incoterm { get; set; }
    public string Currency { get; set; } = "USD";
    public string? HsCode { get; set; }
    public string? GoodsDescription { get; set; }
    public decimal GrossWeightKg { get; set; }
    public decimal NetWeightKg { get; set; }
    public decimal VolumeM3 { get; set; }
    public int PackageCount { get; set; }
    public decimal? DeclaredValue { get; set; }

    // Dates
    public DateTime? EstimatedDepartureUtc { get; set; }
    public DateTime? EstimatedArrivalUtc { get; set; }

    // Line items
    public List<CreateShipmentLineDto> Lines { get; set; } = new();

    // Created by
    public Guid UserId { get; set; }
}

public class CreateShipmentLineDto
{
    public int LineNumber { get; set; }
    public string Description { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string? HsCode { get; set; }
    public string? CountryOfOrigin { get; set; }
    public decimal Quantity { get; set; }
    public string UnitOfMeasure { get; set; } = "PCS";
    public decimal GrossWeightKg { get; set; }
    public decimal NetWeightKg { get; set; }
    public decimal UnitValue { get; set; }
    public decimal TotalValue { get; set; }
    public string Currency { get; set; } = "USD";
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Validator
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

public class CreateShipmentCommandValidator : AbstractValidator<CreateShipmentCommand>
{
    public CreateShipmentCommandValidator()
    {
        RuleFor(x => x.TenantId).NotEmpty();
        RuleFor(x => x.ShipperName).NotEmpty().MaximumLength(200);
        RuleFor(x => x.ShipperReference).NotEmpty().MaximumLength(100);
        RuleFor(x => x.ConsigneeName).NotEmpty().MaximumLength(200);
        RuleFor(x => x.ConsigneeReference).NotEmpty().MaximumLength(100);
        RuleFor(x => x.OriginCountryCode).NotEmpty().Length(2, 3);
        RuleFor(x => x.OriginPortCode).NotEmpty().MaximumLength(10);
        RuleFor(x => x.DestinationCountryCode).NotEmpty().Length(2, 3);
        RuleFor(x => x.DestinationPortCode).NotEmpty().MaximumLength(10);
        RuleFor(x => x.GrossWeightKg).GreaterThan(0);
        RuleFor(x => x.PackageCount).GreaterThan(0);
        RuleFor(x => x.Currency).NotEmpty().Length(3);
        RuleFor(x => x.UserId).NotEmpty();
    }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// DB Context Interface
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

public interface IShippingDbContext
{
    Task<int> SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken);
    void AddShipment(Shipment shipment);
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Shipment Number Generator
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

public interface IShipmentNumberGenerator
{
    string Generate(Guid tenantId);
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Handler
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

public class CreateShipmentCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<CreateShipmentCommand, Guid>
{
    private readonly IShippingDbContext _context;
    private readonly IShipmentNumberGenerator _numberGenerator;

    public CreateShipmentCommandHandler(
        IShippingDbContext context,
        IShipmentNumberGenerator numberGenerator)
    {
        _context = context;
        _numberGenerator = numberGenerator;
    }

    public async Task<Guid> Handle(CreateShipmentCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var shipmentNumber = _numberGenerator.Generate(request.TenantId);

        var shipment = new Shipment(
            tenantId: request.TenantId,
            shipmentNumber: shipmentNumber,
            shipperName: request.ShipperName,
            shipperReference: request.ShipperReference,
            consigneeName: request.ConsigneeName,
            consigneeReference: request.ConsigneeReference,
            originCountryCode: request.OriginCountryCode,
            originPortCode: request.OriginPortCode,
            originPortName: request.OriginPortName,
            destinationCountryCode: request.DestinationCountryCode,
            destinationPortCode: request.DestinationPortCode,
            destinationPortName: request.DestinationPortName,
            transportMode: request.TransportMode,
            cargoType: request.CargoType,
            incoterm: request.Incoterm,
            currency: request.Currency,
            createdBy: request.UserId
        );

        shipment.OrganizationId = request.OrganizationId;
        shipment.CarrierCode = request.CarrierCode;
        shipment.FreightForwarderCode = request.FreightForwarderCode;
        shipment.HsCode = request.HsCode;
        shipment.GoodsDescription = request.GoodsDescription;
        shipment.GrossWeightKg = request.GrossWeightKg;
        shipment.NetWeightKg = request.NetWeightKg;
        shipment.VolumeM3 = request.VolumeM3;
        shipment.PackageCount = request.PackageCount;
        shipment.DeclaredValue = request.DeclaredValue;
        shipment.EstimatedDepartureUtc = request.EstimatedDepartureUtc;
        shipment.EstimatedArrivalUtc = request.EstimatedArrivalUtc;

        // Add cargo lines
        foreach (var lineDto in request.Lines)
        {
            shipment.Lines.Add(new ShipmentLine
            {
                ShipmentId = shipment.Id,
                LineNumber = lineDto.LineNumber,
                Description = lineDto.Description,
                HsCode = lineDto.HsCode,
                CountryOfOrigin = lineDto.CountryOfOrigin,
                Quantity = lineDto.Quantity,
                UnitOfMeasure = lineDto.UnitOfMeasure,
                GrossWeightKg = lineDto.GrossWeightKg,
                NetWeightKg = lineDto.NetWeightKg,
                UnitValue = lineDto.UnitValue,
                TotalValue = lineDto.TotalValue,
                Currency = lineDto.Currency
            });
        }

        _context.AddShipment(shipment);

        // TODO: Publish ShipmentCreatedEvent to outbox

        await _context.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

        return shipment.Id;
    }
}

<file path="services/shipping/Shipping.Application/Commands/RecordTrackingEventCommand.cs">
using MediatR;
using FluentValidation;
using Shipping.Domain.Entities;
using Shipping.Domain.Enums;

namespace Shipping.Application.Commands;

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Command
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

public class RecordTrackingEventCommand : IRequest<Guid>
{
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public Guid ShipmentId { get; set; }
    public TrackingEventType EventType { get; set; }
    public string Location { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string? Description { get; set; }
    public double? Latitude { get; set; }
    public double? Longitude { get; set; }
    public string? VehicleIdentifier { get; set; }
    public string? CarrierEventCode { get; set; }
    public Guid UserId { get; set; }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Validator
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

public class RecordTrackingEventCommandValidator : AbstractValidator<RecordTrackingEventCommand>
{
    public RecordTrackingEventCommandValidator()
    {
        RuleFor(x => x.TenantId).NotEmpty();
        RuleFor(x => x.ShipmentId).NotEmpty();
        RuleFor(x => x.Location).NotEmpty().MaximumLength(200);
        RuleFor(x => x.UserId).NotEmpty();
        RuleFor(x => x.Latitude).InclusiveBetween(-90, 90).When(x => x.Latitude.HasValue);
        RuleFor(x => x.Longitude).InclusiveBetween(-180, 180).When(x => x.Longitude.HasValue);
    }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Handler
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

public class RecordTrackingEventCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<RecordTrackingEventCommand, Guid>
{
    private readonly IShippingQueryContext _context;

    public RecordTrackingEventCommandHandler(IShippingQueryContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public async Task<Guid> Handle(RecordTrackingEventCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var shipment = await _context.GetShipmentWithTrackingAsync(request.ShipmentId, request.TenantId, cancellationToken)
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"Shipment {request.ShipmentId} not found.");

        shipment.AddTrackingEvent(request.EventType, request.Location, request.Description, request.UserId);

        // Enrich the last tracking event with extra metadata
        var evt = shipment.TrackingEvents.Last();
        evt.Latitude = request.Latitude;
        evt.Longitude = request.Longitude;
        evt.VehicleIdentifier = request.VehicleIdentifier;
        evt.CarrierEventCode = request.CarrierEventCode;

        // Auto-transition status based on tracking event type
        AutoTransitionStatus(shipment, request.EventType, request.UserId);

        // TODO: Publish ShipmentTrackingEventRecordedEvent to outbox

        await _context.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

        return evt.Id;
    }

    private static void AutoTransitionStatus(Shipment shipment, TrackingEventType eventType, Guid userId)
    {
        var targetStatus = eventType switch
        {
            TrackingEventType.BookingConfirmed    => ShipmentStatus.Booked,
            TrackingEventType.CargoPickedUp       => ShipmentStatus.PickedUp,
            TrackingEventType.ArrivedAtOriginTerminal => ShipmentStatus.AtOriginTerminal,
            TrackingEventType.DepartedOrigin      => ShipmentStatus.Loaded,
            TrackingEventType.ArrivedAtDestination => ShipmentStatus.AtDestinationTerminal,
            TrackingEventType.Discharged          => ShipmentStatus.Discharged,
            TrackingEventType.CustomsCleared      => ShipmentStatus.CustomsCleared,
            TrackingEventType.OutForDelivery      => ShipmentStatus.OutForDelivery,
            TrackingEventType.Delivered           => ShipmentStatus.Delivered,
            TrackingEventType.HoldPlaced          => ShipmentStatus.OnHold,
            TrackingEventType.ReturnInitiated     => ShipmentStatus.Returning,
            TrackingEventType.ReturnedToOrigin    => ShipmentStatus.Returned,
            _ => (ShipmentStatus?)null
        };

        if (targetStatus.HasValue && shipment.Status != targetStatus.Value)
            shipment.TransitionStatus(targetStatus.Value, $"Auto-transitioned by tracking event: {eventType}", userId);
    }
}

using MediatR;
using FluentValidation;
using Shipping.Domain.Entities;
using Shipping.Domain.Enums;

namespace Shipping.Application.Commands;

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Command
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

public class UpdateShipmentStatusCommand : IRequest
{
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public Guid ShipmentId { get; set; }
    public ShipmentStatus NewStatus { get; set; }
    public string? Reason { get; set; }
    public Guid UserId { get; set; }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Validator
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

public class UpdateShipmentStatusCommandValidator : AbstractValidator<UpdateShipmentStatusCommand>
{
    public UpdateShipmentStatusCommandValidator()
    {
        RuleFor(x => x.TenantId).NotEmpty();
        RuleFor(x => x.ShipmentId).NotEmpty();
        RuleFor(x => x.UserId).NotEmpty();
        RuleFor(x => x.Reason).MaximumLength(500).When(x => x.Reason != null);
    }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Query Context Interface
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

public interface IShippingQueryContext
{
    IQueryable<Shipment> ShipmentsQuery { get; }
    Task<Shipment?> GetShipmentWithHistoryAsync(Guid shipmentId, Guid tenantId, CancellationToken cancellationToken);
    Task<Shipment?> GetShipmentWithTrackingAsync(Guid shipmentId, Guid tenantId, CancellationToken cancellationToken);
    Task<bool> ShipmentExistsAsync(Guid shipmentId, Guid tenantId, CancellationToken cancellationToken);
    Task<int> SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken);
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Handler
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

public class UpdateShipmentStatusCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<UpdateShipmentStatusCommand>
{
    private readonly IShippingQueryContext _context;

    public UpdateShipmentStatusCommandHandler(IShippingQueryContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public async Task Handle(UpdateShipmentStatusCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var shipment = await _context.GetShipmentWithHistoryAsync(request.ShipmentId, request.TenantId, cancellationToken)
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"Shipment {request.ShipmentId} not found.");

        if (shipment.Status == ShipmentStatus.Cancelled || shipment.Status == ShipmentStatus.Delivered)
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                $"Cannot transition a shipment in status '{shipment.Status}' to '{request.NewStatus}'.");

        shipment.TransitionStatus(request.NewStatus, request.Reason, request.UserId);

        // TODO: Publish ShipmentStatusChangedEvent to outbox

        await _context.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
    }
}

<file path="services/shipping/Shipping.Domain/Entities/Shipment.cs">
using Shipping.Domain.Enums;

namespace Shipping.Domain.Entities;

/// <summary>
/// Root aggregate for a shipment — tracks a cargo movement from origin to destination.
/// </summary>
public class Shipment
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; } = Guid.NewGuid();
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public Guid? OrganizationId { get; set; }

    // ── Reference numbers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    /// <summary>Platform-generated unique shipment reference (e.g. SHP-2024-000001).</summary>
    public string ShipmentNumber { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    /// <summary>External reference from shipper/ERP system.</summary>
    public string? ExternalReference { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Bill of Lading / Airway Bill number issued by the carrier.</summary>
    public string? CarrierBookingReference { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Master Bill of Lading number.</summary>
    public string? MasterBillNumber { get; set; }

    /// <summary>House Bill of Lading number (for consolidations).</summary>
    public string? HouseBillNumber { get; set; }

    // ── Parties ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    public string ShipperName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string ShipperReference { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string ConsigneeName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string ConsigneeReference { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string? NotifyPartyName { get; set; }
    public string? CarrierCode { get; set; }
    public string? CarrierName { get; set; }
    public string? FreightForwarderCode { get; set; }

    // ── Route ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    public string OriginCountryCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string OriginPortCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string OriginPortName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string DestinationCountryCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string DestinationPortCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string DestinationPortName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string? TransshipmentPortCode { get; set; }

    // ── Cargo & Mode ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    public TransportMode TransportMode { get; set; }
    public CargoType CargoType { get; set; }
    public Incoterm Incoterm { get; set; }

    public decimal GrossWeightKg { get; set; }
    public decimal NetWeightKg { get; set; }
    public decimal VolumeM3 { get; set; }
    public int PackageCount { get; set; }
    public string? PackagingType { get; set; }
    public string? HsCode { get; set; }
    public string? GoodsDescription { get; set; }

    // ── Dates ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    public DateTime? EstimatedDepartureUtc { get; set; }
    public DateTime? EstimatedArrivalUtc { get; set; }
    public DateTime? ActualDepartureUtc { get; set; }
    public DateTime? ActualArrivalUtc { get; set; }
    public DateTime? DeliveredAtUtc { get; set; }

    // ── Status ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    public ShipmentStatus Status { get; set; } = ShipmentStatus.Draft;
    public string? StatusReason { get; set; }

    // ── Financial ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    public string Currency { get; set; } = "USD";
    public decimal? FreightValue { get; set; }
    public decimal? InsuranceValue { get; set; }
    public decimal? DeclaredValue { get; set; }

    // ── Customs link ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    public Guid? CustomsCaseId { get; set; }
    public string? CustomsCaseNumber { get; set; }
    public bool IsCustomsCleared { get; set; }
    public DateTime? CustomsClearedAtUtc { get; set; }

    // ── Audit ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    public DateTime CreatedAtUtc { get; set; } = DateTime.UtcNow;
    public DateTime UpdatedAtUtc { get; set; } = DateTime.UtcNow;
    public Guid CreatedBy { get; set; }
    public Guid? UpdatedBy { get; set; }
    public byte[] Version { get; set; } = Array.Empty<byte>();

    // ── Navigation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    public ICollection<ShipmentLine> Lines { get; set; } = new List<ShipmentLine>();
    public ICollection<ShipmentContainer> Containers { get; set; } = new List<ShipmentContainer>();
    public ICollection<TrackingEvent> TrackingEvents { get; set; } = new List<TrackingEvent>();
    public ICollection<ShipmentDocument> Documents { get; set; } = new List<ShipmentDocument>();
    public ICollection<ShipmentStatusHistory> StatusHistories { get; set; } = new List<ShipmentStatusHistory>();

    public Shipment() { }

    public Shipment(
        Guid tenantId,
        string shipmentNumber,
        string shipperName,
        string shipperReference,
        string consigneeName,
        string consigneeReference,
        string originCountryCode,
        string originPortCode,
        string originPortName,
        string destinationCountryCode,
        string destinationPortCode,
        string destinationPortName,
        TransportMode transportMode,
        CargoType cargoType,
        Incoterm incoterm,
        string currency,
        Guid createdBy)
    {
        TenantId = tenantId;
        ShipmentNumber = shipmentNumber;
        ShipperName = shipperName ?? string.Empty;
        ShipperReference = shipperReference ?? string.Empty;
        ConsigneeName = consigneeName ?? string.Empty;
        ConsigneeReference = consigneeReference ?? string.Empty;
        OriginCountryCode = originCountryCode ?? string.Empty;
        OriginPortCode = originPortCode ?? string.Empty;
        OriginPortName = originPortName ?? string.Empty;
        DestinationCountryCode = destinationCountryCode ?? string.Empty;
        DestinationPortCode = destinationPortCode ?? string.Empty;
        DestinationPortName = destinationPortName ?? string.Empty;
        TransportMode = transportMode;
        CargoType = cargoType;
        Incoterm = incoterm;
        Currency = currency ?? "USD";
        CreatedBy = createdBy;
        Status = ShipmentStatus.Draft;
        CreatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        UpdatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

    // ── Domain methods ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /// <summary>Transitions the shipment to a new status and records history.</summary>
    public void TransitionStatus(ShipmentStatus newStatus, string? reason, Guid changedBy)
    {
        StatusHistories.Add(new ShipmentStatusHistory
        {
            ShipmentId = Id,
            FromStatus = Status.ToString(),
            ToStatus = newStatus.ToString(),
            Reason = reason,
            ChangedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow,
            ChangedBy = changedBy
        });

        Status = newStatus;
        StatusReason = reason;
        UpdatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        UpdatedBy = changedBy;
    }

    /// <summary>Records a tracking event (GPS ping, milestone scan, etc.).</summary>
    public void AddTrackingEvent(TrackingEventType eventType, string location, string? description, Guid recordedBy)
    {
        TrackingEvents.Add(new TrackingEvent
        {
            ShipmentId = Id,
            EventType = eventType,
            Location = location,
            Description = description,
            OccurredAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow,
            RecordedBy = recordedBy
        });
        UpdatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }
}

namespace Shipping.Domain.Enums;

/// <summary>
/// Status of a tracking event recorded against a shipment leg.
/// </summary>
public enum TrackingEventType
{
    /// <summary>Shipment order created in the system.</summary>
    OrderCreated,

    /// <summary>Booking confirmed with carrier.</summary>
    BookingConfirmed,

    /// <summary>Documents (B/L, AWB) issued by carrier.</summary>
    DocumentsIssued,

    /// <summary>Cargo picked up from shipper premises.</summary>
    CargoPickedUp,

    /// <summary>Cargo delivered to origin terminal / port.</summary>
    ArrivedAtOriginTerminal,

    /// <summary>Cargo loaded onto vessel / aircraft / truck.</summary>
    DepartedOrigin,

    /// <summary>Transshipment — cargo transferred at intermediate port.</summary>
    Transshipped,

    /// <summary>Cargo arrived at destination terminal / port.</summary>
    ArrivedAtDestination,

    /// <summary>Cargo unloaded (discharged) from vessel.</summary>
    Discharged,

    /// <summary>Customs inspection initiated.</summary>
    CustomsInspectionStarted,

    /// <summary>Customs clearance granted.</summary>
    CustomsCleared,

    /// <summary>Cargo released from terminal and in transit to consignee.</summary>
    OutForDelivery,

    /// <summary>Cargo successfully delivered to consignee.</summary>
    Delivered,

    /// <summary>Delivery attempt failed.</summary>
    DeliveryAttemptFailed,

    /// <summary>Shipment placed on hold.</summary>
    HoldPlaced,

    /// <summary>Hold released and shipment resumed.</summary>
    HoldReleased,

    /// <summary>Shipment exception — damage, loss, delay, etc.</summary>
    Exception,

    /// <summary>Return initiated.</summary>
    ReturnInitiated,

    /// <summary>Returned to origin.</summary>
    ReturnedToOrigin
}

<file path="services/shipping/Shipping.Infrastructure/Persistence/ShipmentNumberGenerator.cs">
using Shipping.Application.Commands;

namespace Shipping.Infrastructure.Persistence;

/// <summary>
/// Generates unique, tenant-scoped shipment reference numbers.
/// Format: SHP-{TenantPrefix}-{YYYYMMDD}-{Sequence}
/// e.g.  SHP-A1B2-20241015-000042
/// </summary>
public class ShipmentNumberGenerator : IShipmentNumberGenerator
{
    private static int _sequence = 0;

    public string Generate(Guid tenantId)
    {
        var tenantPrefix = tenantId.ToString("N")[..4].ToUpperInvariant();
        var datePart = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyyMMdd");
        var seq = Interlocked.Increment(ref _sequence);
        return $"SHP-{tenantPrefix}-{datePart}-{seq:D6}";
    }
}
</file>

<file path="services/shipping/Shipping.Infrastructure/Persistence/ShippingDbContext.cs">
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Shipping.Application.Commands;
using BuildingBlocks.Persistence;
using Shipping.Domain.Entities;
using Shipping.Domain.Enums;

namespace Shipping.Infrastructure.Persistence;

/// <summary>
/// EF Core DbContext for the Shipping bounded context.
/// Inherits SmartDbContext from BuildingBlocks.Persistence for
/// multi-tenancy, soft-delete, audit, and concurrency conventions.
/// </summary>
public class ShippingDbContext : SmartDbContext<ShippingDbContext>,
    IShippingDbContext,
    IShippingQueryContext
{
    public ShippingDbContext(DbContextOptions<ShippingDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

    // ── Core ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    public DbSet<Shipment> Shipments => Set<Shipment>();
    public DbSet<ShipmentLine> ShipmentLines => Set<ShipmentLine>();
    public DbSet<ShipmentContainer> ShipmentContainers => Set<ShipmentContainer>();
    public DbSet<ShipmentDocument> ShipmentDocuments => Set<ShipmentDocument>();

    // ── Tracking ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    public DbSet<TrackingEvent> TrackingEvents => Set<TrackingEvent>();
    public DbSet<ShipmentStatusHistory> ShipmentStatusHistories => Set<ShipmentStatusHistory>();

    // ── Integration ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    public DbSet<ShippingOutboxMessage> OutboxMessages => Set<ShippingOutboxMessage>();
    public DbSet<ShippingInboxMessage> InboxMessages => Set<ShippingInboxMessage>();
    public DbSet<ShippingIdempotencyRecord> IdempotencyRecords => Set<ShippingIdempotencyRecord>();

    // ── IShippingDbContext ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    public void AddShipment(Shipment shipment) => Shipments.Add(shipment);

    // ── IShippingQueryContext ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    public async Task<Shipment?> GetShipmentWithHistoryAsync(
        Guid shipmentId, Guid tenantId, CancellationToken cancellationToken) =>
        await Shipments
            .Include(s => s.StatusHistories)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(s => s.Id == shipmentId && s.TenantId == tenantId, cancellationToken);

    public async Task<Shipment?> GetShipmentWithTrackingAsync(
        Guid shipmentId, Guid tenantId, CancellationToken cancellationToken) =>
        await Shipments
            .Include(s => s.StatusHistories)
            .Include(s => s.TrackingEvents)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(s => s.Id == shipmentId && s.TenantId == tenantId, cancellationToken);

    public async Task<bool> ShipmentExistsAsync(
        Guid shipmentId, Guid tenantId, CancellationToken cancellationToken) =>
        await Shipments.AnyAsync(s => s.Id == shipmentId && s.TenantId == tenantId, cancellationToken);

    // ── Queryable (for controllers/read projections) ───────────────────────────
    public IQueryable<Shipment> ShipmentsQuery => Shipments;

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder builder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(builder);

        // ── Shipment ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        builder.Entity<Shipment>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(s => new { s.TenantId, s.ShipmentNumber }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(s => s.OrganizationId);
            e.HasIndex(s => new { s.TenantId, s.Status });
            e.HasIndex(s => new { s.TenantId, s.CreatedAtUtc });
            e.HasIndex(s => s.CarrierBookingReference);
            e.HasIndex(s => s.MasterBillNumber);
            e.HasIndex(s => s.HouseBillNumber);
            e.HasIndex(s => s.CustomsCaseId);

            e.Property(s => s.GrossWeightKg).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(s => s.NetWeightKg).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(s => s.VolumeM3).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(s => s.FreightValue).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(s => s.InsuranceValue).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(s => s.DeclaredValue).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(s => s.Version).IsRowVersion();

            e.Property(s => s.TransportMode).HasConversion<string>();
            e.Property(s => s.CargoType).HasConversion<string>();
            e.Property(s => s.Incoterm).HasConversion<string>();
            e.Property(s => s.Status).HasConversion<string>();

            e.HasMany(s => s.Lines)
                .WithOne(l => l.Shipment)
                .HasForeignKey(l => l.ShipmentId)
                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);

            e.HasMany(s => s.Containers)
                .WithOne(c => c.Shipment)
                .HasForeignKey(c => c.ShipmentId)
                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);

            e.HasMany(s => s.TrackingEvents)
                .WithOne(t => t.Shipment)
                .HasForeignKey(t => t.ShipmentId)
                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);

            e.HasMany(s => s.Documents)
                .WithOne(d => d.Shipment)
                .HasForeignKey(d => d.ShipmentId)
                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);

            e.HasMany(s => s.StatusHistories)
                .WithOne(h => h.Shipment)
                .HasForeignKey(h => h.ShipmentId)
                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
        });

        // ── ShipmentLine ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        builder.Entity<ShipmentLine>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(l => new { l.ShipmentId, l.LineNumber }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(l => l.Quantity).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(l => l.GrossWeightKg).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(l => l.NetWeightKg).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(l => l.VolumeM3).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(l => l.UnitValue).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(l => l.TotalValue).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
        });

        // ── ShipmentContainer ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
        builder.Entity<ShipmentContainer>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(c => c.ContainerNumber);
            e.Property(c => c.TareWeightKg).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(c => c.CargoWeightKg).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(c => c.VerifiedGrossMassKg).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(c => c.SetTemperatureCelsius).HasColumnType("numeric(5,2)");
        });

        // ── TrackingEvent ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        builder.Entity<TrackingEvent>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(t => new { t.ShipmentId, t.OccurredAtUtc });
            e.HasIndex(t => t.EventType);
            e.Property(t => t.EventType).HasConversion<string>();
        });

        // ── ShipmentStatusHistory ─────────────────────────────────────────────
        builder.Entity<ShipmentStatusHistory>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(h => new { h.ShipmentId, h.ChangedAtUtc });
        });

        // ── ShipmentDocument ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
        builder.Entity<ShipmentDocument>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(d => new { d.ShipmentId, d.DocumentType });
            e.HasIndex(d => d.DocumentNumber);
        });

        // ── Outbox ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        builder.Entity<ShippingOutboxMessage>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(o => o.Status);
            e.HasIndex(o => o.OccurredAtUtc);
            e.Property(o => o.PayloadJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        // ── Inbox ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        builder.Entity<ShippingInboxMessage>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(i => new { i.MessageId, i.Consumer }).IsUnique();
        });

        // ── Idempotency ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        builder.Entity<ShippingIdempotencyRecord>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(i => new { i.TenantId, i.IdempotencyKey, i.Operation }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(i => i.ResponseBodyJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });
    }
}

using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Shipping.Application.Commands;
using Shipping.Domain.Enums;
using Shipping.Infrastructure.Persistence;

namespace Shipping.Tests;

public class ConfirmCustomsClearanceCommandTests
{
    private static async Task<(ShippingDbContext ctx, Guid shipmentId, Guid tenantId, Guid userId)> SeedShipmentAsync()
    {
        var options = new DbContextOptionsBuilder<ShippingDbContext>()
            .UseInMemoryDatabase(Guid.NewGuid().ToString())
            .Options;
        var ctx = new ShippingDbContext(options);

        var tenantId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var userId = Guid.NewGuid();

        var createHandler = new CreateShipmentCommandHandler(ctx, new ShipmentNumberGenerator());
        var shipmentId = await createHandler.Handle(new CreateShipmentCommand
        {
            TenantId = tenantId,
            ShipperName = "Test Shipper",
            ShipperReference = "REF-001",
            ConsigneeName = "Test Consignee",
            ConsigneeReference = "CON-001",
            OriginCountryCode = "SO",
            OriginPortCode = "SOBER",
            OriginPortName = "Berbera",
            DestinationCountryCode = "AE",
            DestinationPortCode = "AEJEA",
            DestinationPortName = "Jebel Ali",
            TransportMode = TransportMode.Sea,
            CargoType = CargoType.FCL,
            Incoterm = Incoterm.CIF,
            Currency = "USD",
            GrossWeightKg = 10000,
            PackageCount = 200,
            UserId = userId
        }, CancellationToken.None);

        return (ctx, shipmentId, tenantId, userId);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_ValidCommand_ClearsCustomsAndTransitionsStatus()
    {
        var (ctx, shipmentId, tenantId, userId) = await SeedShipmentAsync();
        var handler = new ConfirmCustomsClearanceCommandHandler(ctx);
        var customsCaseId = Guid.NewGuid();

        await handler.Handle(new ConfirmCustomsClearanceCommand
        {
            TenantId = tenantId,
            ShipmentId = shipmentId,
            CustomsCaseId = customsCaseId,
            CustomsCaseNumber = "CUS-2024-0001",
            UserId = userId
        }, CancellationToken.None);

        var shipment = await ctx.Shipments
            .Include(s => s.StatusHistories)
            .Include(s => s.TrackingEvents)
            .FirstAsync(s => s.Id == shipmentId);

        Assert.True(shipment.IsCustomsCleared);
        Assert.Equal(customsCaseId, shipment.CustomsCaseId);
        Assert.Equal("CUS-2024-0001", shipment.CustomsCaseNumber);
        Assert.NotNull(shipment.CustomsClearedAtUtc);
        Assert.Equal(ShipmentStatus.CustomsCleared, shipment.Status);

        var history = Assert.Single(shipment.StatusHistories);
        Assert.Equal("Draft", history.FromStatus);
        Assert.Equal("CustomsCleared", history.ToStatus);

        var trackingEvent = Assert.Single(shipment.TrackingEvents);
        Assert.Equal(TrackingEventType.CustomsCleared, trackingEvent.EventType);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_AlreadyCleared_ThrowsInvalidOperation()
    {
        var (ctx, shipmentId, tenantId, userId) = await SeedShipmentAsync();
        var handler = new ConfirmCustomsClearanceCommandHandler(ctx);

        await handler.Handle(new ConfirmCustomsClearanceCommand
        {
            TenantId = tenantId,
            ShipmentId = shipmentId,
            CustomsCaseId = Guid.NewGuid(),
            CustomsCaseNumber = "CUS-2024-0001",
            UserId = userId
        }, CancellationToken.None);

        await Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(() =>
            handler.Handle(new ConfirmCustomsClearanceCommand
            {
                TenantId = tenantId,
                ShipmentId = shipmentId,
                CustomsCaseId = Guid.NewGuid(),
                CustomsCaseNumber = "CUS-2024-0002",
                UserId = userId
            }, CancellationToken.None));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_UnknownShipment_ThrowsInvalidOperation()
    {
        var (ctx, _, tenantId, userId) = await SeedShipmentAsync();
        var handler = new ConfirmCustomsClearanceCommandHandler(ctx);

        await Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(() =>
            handler.Handle(new ConfirmCustomsClearanceCommand
            {
                TenantId = tenantId,
                ShipmentId = Guid.NewGuid(),
                CustomsCaseId = Guid.NewGuid(),
                CustomsCaseNumber = "CUS-2024-0001",
                UserId = userId
            }, CancellationToken.None));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_WrongTenant_ThrowsInvalidOperation()
    {
        var (ctx, shipmentId, _, userId) = await SeedShipmentAsync();
        var handler = new ConfirmCustomsClearanceCommandHandler(ctx);

        await Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(() =>
            handler.Handle(new ConfirmCustomsClearanceCommand
            {
                TenantId = Guid.NewGuid(),
                ShipmentId = shipmentId,
                CustomsCaseId = Guid.NewGuid(),
                CustomsCaseNumber = "CUS-2024-0001",
                UserId = userId
            }, CancellationToken.None));
    }
}

using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Shipping.Application.Commands;
using Shipping.Domain.Enums;
using Shipping.Infrastructure.Persistence;

namespace Shipping.Tests;

public class CreateShipmentCommandTests
{
    private ShippingDbContext CreateInMemoryContext()
    {
        var options = new DbContextOptionsBuilder<ShippingDbContext>()
            .UseInMemoryDatabase(Guid.NewGuid().ToString())
            .Options;
        return new ShippingDbContext(options);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_ValidCommand_CreatesShipmentAndReturnsId()
    {
        // Arrange
        await using var ctx = CreateInMemoryContext();
        var handler = new CreateShipmentCommandHandler(ctx, new ShipmentNumberGenerator());

        var command = new CreateShipmentCommand
        {
            TenantId = Guid.NewGuid(),
            ShipperName = "Acme Exports Ltd",
            ShipperReference = "ACME-2024-001",
            ConsigneeName = "Global Imports Co",
            ConsigneeReference = "GI-2024-555",
            OriginCountryCode = "SO",
            OriginPortCode = "SOBER",
            OriginPortName = "Berbera",
            DestinationCountryCode = "AE",

                    GrossWeightKg = 24000,
                    NetWeightKg = 22500,
                    UnitValue = 260.42m,
                    TotalValue = 125000,

        var saved = await ctx.Shipments
            .Include(s => s.Lines)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(s => s.Id == shipmentId);

        Assert.NotNull(saved);
        Assert.Equal("Acme Exports Ltd", saved.ShipperName);
        Assert.Equal(TransportMode.Sea, saved.TransportMode);
        Assert.Equal(Domain.Enums.ShipmentStatus.Draft, saved.Status);
        Assert.Single(saved.Lines);
        Assert.Equal("1207.40", saved.Lines.First().HsCode);
        Assert.StartsWith("SHP-", saved.ShipmentNumber);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_ValidCommand_ShipmentNumberIsUnique()
    {
        // Arrange
        await using var ctx = CreateInMemoryContext();
        var generator = new ShipmentNumberGenerator();
        var handler = new CreateShipmentCommandHandler(ctx, generator);
        var tenantId = Guid.NewGuid();

        var command = new CreateShipmentCommand
        {
            TenantId = tenantId,
            ShipperName = "Test Shipper",
            ShipperReference = "REF-001",
            ConsigneeName = "Test Consignee",
            ConsigneeReference = "CON-001",
            OriginCountryCode = "SO",
            OriginPortCode = "SOBER",
            OriginPortName = "Berbera",
            DestinationCountryCode = "AE",
            DestinationPortCode = "AEJEA",
            DestinationPortName = "Jebel Ali",
            TransportMode = TransportMode.Sea,
            CargoType = CargoType.FCL,
            Incoterm = Incoterm.CIF,
            Currency = "USD",
            GrossWeightKg = 5000,
            PackageCount = 100,
            UserId = Guid.NewGuid()
        };

        // Act
        var id1 = await handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);
        command.ShipperReference = "REF-002"; // change to avoid unique constraint
        var id2 = await handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        var s1 = await ctx.Shipments.FindAsync(id1);
        var s2 = await ctx.Shipments.FindAsync(id2);

        Assert.NotEqual(s1!.ShipmentNumber, s2!.ShipmentNumber);
    }

        Assert.Equal(TrackingEventType.DocumentsIssued, evt.EventType);

        Assert.Equal("Bill of Lading issued", evt.Description);
        Assert.Equal(userId, evt.RecordedBy);
    }

    {

using Shipping.Domain.Entities;
using Shipping.Domain.Enums;
using System.Linq;
using Xunit;

namespace Shipping.Tests;

public class ShipmentDomainTests
{
    private static Shipment CreateShipment() => new(
        tenantId: Guid.NewGuid(),
        shipmentNumber: "SHP-TEST-000001",
        shipperName: "Acme Exports",
        shipperReference: "ACME-001",
        consigneeName: "Global Imports",
        consigneeReference: "GI-001",
        originCountryCode: "SO",
        originPortCode: "SOBER",
        originPortName: "Berbera",
        destinationCountryCode: "AE",
        destinationPortCode: "AEJEA",
        destinationPortName: "Jebel Ali",
        transportMode: TransportMode.Sea,
        cargoType: CargoType.FCL,
        incoterm: Incoterm.FOB,
        currency: "USD",
        createdBy: Guid.NewGuid());

    [Fact]
    public void Constructor_SetsDraftStatusAndAuditFields()
    {
        var shipment = CreateShipment();

        Assert.Equal(ShipmentStatus.Draft, shipment.Status);
        Assert.NotEqual(Guid.Empty, shipment.Id);
        Assert.NotEqual(Guid.Empty, shipment.CreatedBy);
        Assert.NotEqual(default, shipment.CreatedAtUtc);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TransitionStatus_RecordsHistoryAndUpdatesStatus()
    {
        var shipment = CreateShipment();
        var userId = Guid.NewGuid();

        shipment.TransitionStatus(ShipmentStatus.Booked, "Booking confirmed", userId);

        Assert.Equal(ShipmentStatus.Booked, shipment.Status);
        Assert.Equal("Booking confirmed", shipment.StatusReason);

        var history = Assert.Single(shipment.StatusHistories);
        Assert.Equal("Draft", history.FromStatus);
        Assert.Equal("Booked", history.ToStatus);
        Assert.Equal("Booking confirmed", history.Reason);
        Assert.Equal(userId, history.ChangedBy);
        Assert.NotEqual(default, history.ChangedAtUtc);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TransitionStatus_ChainsMultipleTransitions()
    {
        var shipment = CreateShipment();
        var userId = Guid.NewGuid();

        shipment.TransitionStatus(ShipmentStatus.Booked, null, userId);
        shipment.TransitionStatus(ShipmentStatus.PickedUp, "Collected", userId);

        Assert.Equal(ShipmentStatus.PickedUp, shipment.Status);
        Assert.Equal(2, shipment.StatusHistories.Count);

        var first = shipment.StatusHistories.First();
        var second = shipment.StatusHistories.Skip(1).First();

        Assert.Equal("Draft", first.FromStatus);
        Assert.Equal("Booked", first.ToStatus);

        Assert.Equal("Booked", second.FromStatus);
        Assert.Equal("PickedUp", second.ToStatus);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddTrackingEvent_AddsEventWithDetails()
    {
        var shipment = CreateShipment();
        var userId = Guid.NewGuid();

        shipment.AddTrackingEvent(
            TrackingEventType.ArrivedAtOriginTerminal,
            "Berbera Port",
            "Cargo received at terminal",
            userId);

        var evt = Assert.Single(shipment.TrackingEvents);
        Assert.Equal(shipment.Id, evt.ShipmentId);
        Assert.Equal(TrackingEventType.ArrivedAtOriginTerminal, evt.EventType);
        Assert.Equal("Berbera Port", evt.Location);
        Assert.Equal("Cargo received at terminal", evt.Description);
        Assert.Equal(userId, evt.RecordedBy);
        Assert.NotEqual(default, evt.OccurredAtUtc);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DomainMethods_SetUpdatedAtAndUpdatedBy()
    {
        var shipment = CreateShipment();
        var createdAt = shipment.CreatedAtUtc;
        var userId = Guid.NewGuid();

        shipment.TransitionStatus(ShipmentStatus.Booked, null, userId);

        Assert.Equal(userId, shipment.UpdatedBy);
        Assert.True(shipment.UpdatedAtUtc >= createdAt);
    }
}

<file path="services/shipping/Shipping.Tests/ShipmentNumberGeneratorTests.cs">
using Shipping.Infrastructure.Persistence;

namespace Shipping.Tests;

public class ShipmentNumberGeneratorTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void Generate_ReturnsExpectedFormat()
    {
        var generator = new ShipmentNumberGenerator();
        var tenantId = Guid.Parse("aaaaaaaa-0000-0000-0000-000000000001");

        var number = generator.Generate(tenantId);

        // Format: SHP-{TenantPrefix}-{yyyyMMdd}-{Sequence}
        Assert.StartsWith("SHP-AAAA-", number);
        var datePart = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyyMMdd");
        Assert.Contains($"-{datePart}-", number);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Generate_UsesFirstFourHexCharsOfTenantIdAsPrefix()
    {
        var generator = new ShipmentNumberGenerator();
        var tenantId = Guid.Parse("12345678-0000-0000-0000-000000000001");

        var number = generator.Generate(tenantId);

        Assert.StartsWith("SHP-1234-", number);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Generate_IsUniqueAcrossCalls()
    {
        var generator = new ShipmentNumberGenerator();
        var tenantId = Guid.NewGuid();

        var first = generator.Generate(tenantId);
        var second = generator.Generate(tenantId);
        var third = generator.Generate(tenantId);

        Assert.NotEqual(first, second);
        Assert.NotEqual(second, third);
        Assert.NotEqual(first, third);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Generate_EmbedsIncrementalSequence()
    {
        var generator = new ShipmentNumberGenerator();
        var tenantId = Guid.NewGuid();

        var first = generator.Generate(tenantId);
        var second = generator.Generate(tenantId);

        var firstSeq = long.Parse(first.Split('-').Last());
        var secondSeq = long.Parse(second.Split('-').Last());

        Assert.Equal(firstSeq + 1, secondSeq);
    }
}

public class UpdateShipmentStatusCommandTests

            .UseInMemoryDatabase(Guid.NewGuid().ToString())
            .Options;
        var ctx = new ShippingDbContext(options);

        var createHandler = new CreateShipmentCommandHandler(ctx, new ShipmentNumberGenerator());
        var shipmentId = await createHandler.Handle(new CreateShipmentCommand

            ShipperName = "Test Shipper",
            ShipperReference = "REF-001",
            ConsigneeName = "Test Consignee",
            ConsigneeReference = "CON-001",
            OriginCountryCode = "SO",
            OriginPortCode = "SOBER",
            OriginPortName = "Berbera",
            DestinationCountryCode = "AE",
            DestinationPortCode = "AEJEA",
            DestinationPortName = "Jebel Ali",
            TransportMode = TransportMode.Sea,
            CargoType = CargoType.FCL,
            Incoterm = Incoterm.FOB,
            Currency = "USD",
            GrossWeightKg = 10000,

            UserId = Guid.NewGuid()
        }, CancellationToken.None);

    {
        var (ctx, shipmentId) = await SeedShipmentAsync();
        var handler = new UpdateShipmentStatusCommandHandler(ctx);

        await handler.Handle(new UpdateShipmentStatusCommand
        {
            TenantId = Guid.Parse("aaaaaaaa-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"),
            ShipmentId = shipmentId,
            NewStatus = ShipmentStatus.Booked,
            Reason = "Booking confirmed by carrier",
            UserId = Guid.NewGuid()
        }, CancellationToken.None);

        var shipment = await ctx.Shipments
            .Include(s => s.StatusHistories)
            .FirstAsync(s => s.Id == shipmentId);

        Assert.Equal(ShipmentStatus.Booked, shipment.Status);
        Assert.Single(shipment.StatusHistories);
        Assert.Equal("Draft", shipment.StatusHistories.First().FromStatus);
        Assert.Equal("Booked", shipment.StatusHistories.First().ToStatus);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_TransitionFromDelivered_ThrowsInvalidOperation()
    {
        var (ctx, shipmentId) = await SeedShipmentAsync();
        var handler = new UpdateShipmentStatusCommandHandler(ctx);

        // First move to Delivered
        await handler.Handle(new UpdateShipmentStatusCommand
        {
            TenantId = Guid.Parse("aaaaaaaa-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"),
            ShipmentId = shipmentId,
            NewStatus = ShipmentStatus.Delivered,
            UserId = Guid.NewGuid()
        }, CancellationToken.None);

        // Then try to move again — should fail
        await Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(() =>
            handler.Handle(new UpdateShipmentStatusCommand
            {
                TenantId = Guid.Parse("aaaaaaaa-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"),
                ShipmentId = shipmentId,
                NewStatus = ShipmentStatus.InTransit,
                UserId = Guid.NewGuid()
            }, CancellationToken.None));
    }

<file path="services/Dockerfile.dotnet.example">
# Tusaalaha Dockerfile ee loogu talagalay adeegyada C# / .NET (Sida: Customs, Ectn, Identity)

# 1. Qaybta Dhismaha (Build Stage)
FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:8.0-alpine AS build
WORKDIR /src

# Nuqul ka samee faylalka mashruuca si aad u soo celiso dependencies-ka
COPY ["services/customs/Customs.API/Customs.API.csproj", "services/customs/Customs.API/"]
# Haddii aad leedahay mashaariic kale oo ku xiran (sida Customs.Domain), halkan ku dar:
# COPY ["services/customs/Customs.Domain/Customs.Domain.csproj", "services/customs/Customs.Domain/"]

RUN dotnet restore "services/customs/Customs.API/Customs.API.csproj"

# Hada nuqul ka samee koodhka haray oo dhameystir dhisidda
COPY . .
WORKDIR "/src/services/customs/Customs.API"
RUN dotnet build "Customs.API.csproj" -c Release -o /app/build

# 2. Qaybta Daabacaada (Publish Stage) - Waxaan ku darnay Trimming si loo yareeyo size-ka
FROM build AS publish
RUN dotnet publish "Customs.API.csproj" -c Release -o /app/publish \
    /p:UseAppHost=false \
    /p:PublishTrimmed=true \
    /p:TrimMode=partial

# 3. Qaybta Orodka (Run Stage - Production - Waxaan u bedelnay Alpine)
FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:8.0-alpine AS final
WORKDIR /app
EXPOSE 80
EXPOSE 443

# Siyaado Ammaan (Non-root user)
RUN adduser -D -u 1000 appuser
USER appuser

# Soo koobi koodhka la daabacay ee ka yimid qaybta publish
COPY --chown=appuser:appuser --from=publish /app/publish .

# U deji barta bilawga (Entry point)
ENTRYPOINT ["dotnet", "Customs.API.dll"]
</file>

using System;

namespace BuildingBlocks.Contracts.Events;

public interface IIntegrationEvent
{
    Guid EventId { get; }
    string EventType { get; }
    int EventVersion { get; }
    DateTime OccurredAtUtc { get; }
    DateTime PublishedAtUtc { get; }
    Guid CorrelationId { get; }
    Guid? CausationId { get; }
    string TraceId { get; }
    Guid TenantId { get; }
    Guid ActorId { get; }
    string SourceService { get; }
    string AggregateType { get; }
    string AggregateId { get; }
    string SchemaVersion { get; }
}

public abstract record IntegrationEvent(
    Guid EventId,
    string EventType,
    int EventVersion,
    DateTime OccurredAtUtc,
    DateTime PublishedAtUtc,
    Guid CorrelationId,
    Guid? CausationId,
    string TraceId,
    Guid TenantId,
    Guid ActorId,
    string SourceService,
    string AggregateType,
    string AggregateId,
    string SchemaVersion
) : IIntegrationEvent;
