<file path="src/building-blocks/Infrastructure/Messaging/OutboxMessage.cs">
using System;

namespace BuildingBlocks.Infrastructure.Messaging;

public enum OutboxMessageStatus
{
    Pending,
    Processing,
    Published,
    Failed,
    DeadLetter
}

public class OutboxMessage
{
    public Guid Id { get; private set; }
    public string EventType { get; private set; } = string.Empty;
    public int EventVersion { get; private set; }
    public string AggregateId { get; private set; } = string.Empty;
    public string Payload { get; private set; } = string.Empty;
    public DateTime OccurredAtUtc { get; private set; }
    public DateTime CreatedAtUtc { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? PublishedAtUtc { get; private set; }
    public int RetryCount { get; private set; }
    public OutboxMessageStatus Status { get; private set; }
    public string? LastError { get; private set; }
    public Guid CorrelationId { get; private set; }
    public Guid TenantId { get; private set; }

    protected OutboxMessage() { } // EF Core

    public OutboxMessage(Guid id, string eventType, int eventVersion, string aggregateId, string payload, Guid correlationId, Guid tenantId)
    {
        Id = id;
        EventType = eventType;
        EventVersion = eventVersion;
        AggregateId = aggregateId;
        Payload = payload;
        OccurredAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        CreatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        Status = OutboxMessageStatus.Pending;
        RetryCount = 0;
        CorrelationId = correlationId;
        TenantId = tenantId;
    }
}

<file path="src/building-blocks/Security/PlatformSecurity.cs">
using System.Security.Claims;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Filters;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;

namespace SmartTrade.Security;

public static class PlatformClaimTypes
{
    public const string TenantId = "tenant_id";
    public const string Subject = "sub";
    public const string Permission = "permissions";
    public const string DeviceId = "device_id";
}

public interface ITenantContext
{
    Guid? TenantId { get; }
    Guid? UserId { get; }
    Guid? DeviceId { get; }
}

public sealed class HttpTenantContext(IHttpContextAccessor accessor) : ITenantContext
{
    public Guid? TenantId => ReadGuid(PlatformClaimTypes.TenantId);
    public Guid? UserId => ReadGuid(PlatformClaimTypes.Subject);
    public Guid? DeviceId => ReadGuid(PlatformClaimTypes.DeviceId);

    private Guid? ReadGuid(string claimType) =>
        Guid.TryParse(accessor.HttpContext?.User.FindFirstValue(claimType), out var value) ? value : null;
}

public sealed class PlatformAuthenticationOptions
{
    public string Issuer { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string Audience { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string SigningKey { get; set; } = string.Empty;
}

public static class PlatformSecurityRegistration
{
    public static IServiceCollection AddPlatformSecurity(this IServiceCollection services, IConfiguration configuration)
    {
        var settings = configuration.GetSection("Authentication").Get<PlatformAuthenticationOptions>()
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Authentication configuration is required.");
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(settings.Issuer) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(settings.Audience) ||
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(settings.SigningKey) || System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetByteCount(settings.SigningKey) < 32)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Authentication requires Issuer, Audience, and a SigningKey of at least 32 bytes.");

        services.Configure<PlatformAuthenticationOptions>(configuration.GetSection("Authentication"));
        services.AddHttpContextAccessor();
        services.AddScoped<ITenantContext, HttpTenantContext>();
        services.AddScoped<TenantRequiredFilter>();
        services.AddAuthentication(JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme).AddJwtBearer(options =>
        {
            options.MapInboundClaims = false;
            options.TokenValidationParameters = new TokenValidationParameters
            {
                ValidateIssuerSigningKey = true,
                IssuerSigningKey = new SymmetricSecurityKey(System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(settings.SigningKey)),
                ValidateIssuer = true,
                ValidIssuer = settings.Issuer,
                ValidateAudience = true,
                ValidAudience = settings.Audience,
                ValidateLifetime = true,
                ClockSkew = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30),
                NameClaimType = PlatformClaimTypes.Subject,
                RoleClaimType = ClaimTypes.Role
            };
        });
        services.AddAuthorization(options =>
        {
            options.FallbackPolicy = new AuthorizationPolicyBuilder().RequireAuthenticatedUser().Build();
        });
        services.Configure<MvcOptions>(options => options.Filters.AddService<TenantRequiredFilter>());
        services.AddSingleton<IAuthorizationPolicyProvider, PermissionPolicyProvider>();
        services.Configure<ApiBehaviorOptions>(options => options.SuppressModelStateInvalidFilter = false);
        return services;
    }
}

public sealed class TenantRequiredFilter : IAsyncAuthorizationFilter
{
    public Task OnAuthorizationAsync(AuthorizationFilterContext context)
    {
        var user = context.HttpContext.User;
        if (user.Identity?.IsAuthenticated == true &&
            !user.IsInRole("platform_admin") &&
            !Guid.TryParse(user.FindFirstValue(PlatformClaimTypes.TenantId), out _))
        {
            context.Result = new ForbidResult();
        }
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }
}

public sealed class PlatformExceptionMiddleware(RequestDelegate next, ILogger<PlatformExceptionMiddleware> logger)
{
    public async Task InvokeAsync(HttpContext context)
    {
        try
        {
            await next(context);
        }
        catch (UnauthorizedAccessException exception)
        {
            logger.LogWarning(exception, "Request rejected by authorization or tenant boundary.");
            context.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden;
        }
        catch (KeyNotFoundException exception)
        {
            logger.LogInformation(exception, "Requested record was not found.");
            context.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status404NotFound;
        }
        catch (ArgumentException exception)
        {
            logger.LogInformation(exception, "Request validation failed.");
            context.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest;
        }
    }
}

public static class PlatformExceptionHandling
{
    public static IApplicationBuilder UsePlatformExceptionHandling(this IApplicationBuilder app) =>
        app.UseMiddleware<PlatformExceptionMiddleware>();
}

public sealed class PermissionPolicyProvider(IOptions<AuthorizationOptions> options) : IAuthorizationPolicyProvider
{
    private readonly DefaultAuthorizationPolicyProvider _fallback = new(options);

    public Task<AuthorizationPolicy> GetDefaultPolicyAsync() => _fallback.GetDefaultPolicyAsync();
    public Task<AuthorizationPolicy?> GetFallbackPolicyAsync() => _fallback.GetFallbackPolicyAsync();

    public Task<AuthorizationPolicy?> GetPolicyAsync(string policyName) =>
        Task.FromResult<AuthorizationPolicy?>(new AuthorizationPolicyBuilder(JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme)
            .RequireAuthenticatedUser()
            .RequireClaim(PlatformClaimTypes.Permission, policyName)
            .Build());
}

public static class TenantControllerExtensions
{
    public static Guid GetRequiredTenantId(this ControllerBase controller) =>
        Guid.TryParse(controller.User.FindFirstValue(PlatformClaimTypes.TenantId), out var tenantId)
            ? tenantId
            : throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("A valid tenant_id claim is required.");

    public static Guid GetRequiredUserId(this ControllerBase controller) =>
        Guid.TryParse(controller.User.FindFirstValue(PlatformClaimTypes.Subject), out var userId)
            ? userId
            : throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("A valid sub claim is required.");
}

<file path="tests/01-unit/Identity.UnitTests/Controllers/AuthControllerTests.cs">
using Identity.Application.Commands.Auth;
using Identity.Application.Interfaces;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Moq;
using FluentAssertions;

namespace Identity.UnitTests.Controllers;

/// <summary>
/// Unit tests for <see cref="Identity.Api.Controllers.AuthController"/>.
/// Covers Login, Refresh, and Logout endpoints in isolation using mocked dependencies.
/// </summary>
public sealed class AuthControllerTests
{
    // ─── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private static LoginResult ValidLoginResult(bool requiresMfa = false) => new()
    {
        AccessToken  = "eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiJ9.test",
        RefreshToken = "refresh_opaque_token_xyz",
        ExpiresAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(15),
        RequiresMfa  = requiresMfa,
        TenantCode   = "ACME",
        TenantType   = "Importer",
        Roles        = new[] { "Admin" },
        Permissions  = new[] { "declarations.read", "declarations.write" }
    };

    private static LoginCommand ValidLoginCommand() => new()
    {
        TenantCode = "ACME",
        Email      = "admin@acme.com",
        Password   = "S3cur3!Pass"
    };

    private static (Mock<IIdentityAuthService> svc, HttpContext ctx) BuildContext(
        string? refreshCookieValue = null)
    {
        var svc = new Mock<IIdentityAuthService>();

        var responseCookies = new Mock<IResponseCookies>();
        var requestCookies  = new Mock<IRequestCookieCollection>();

        if (refreshCookieValue is not null)
        {
            requestCookies.Setup(c => c.TryGetValue("smarttrade_refresh", out refreshCookieValue))
                          .Returns(true);
        }
        else
        {
            var nullValue = (string?)null;
            requestCookies.Setup(c => c.TryGetValue("smarttrade_refresh", out nullValue))
                          .Returns(false);
        }

        var request = new Mock<HttpRequest>();
        request.Setup(r => r.Cookies).Returns(requestCookies.Object);
        request.Setup(r => r.Headers).Returns(new HeaderDictionary
        {
            ["User-Agent"] = "xunit-test-agent/1.0"
        });

        var response = new Mock<HttpResponse>();
        response.Setup(r => r.Cookies).Returns(responseCookies.Object);

        var connection = new Mock<ConnectionInfo>();
        connection.Setup(c => c.RemoteIpAddress).Returns(System.Net.IPAddress.Loopback);

        var ctx = new Mock<HttpContext>();
        ctx.Setup(c => c.Request).Returns(request.Object);
        ctx.Setup(c => c.Response).Returns(response.Object);
        ctx.Setup(c => c.Connection).Returns(connection.Object);

        return (svc, ctx.Object);
    }

    // ─── Login ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public async Task Login_ValidCredentials_Returns200WithTokenResponse()
    {
        // Arrange
        var (svc, ctx) = BuildContext();
        svc.Setup(s => s.LoginAsync(It.IsAny<LoginCommand>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
           .ReturnsAsync(ValidLoginResult());

        var controller = new Identity.Api.Controllers.AuthController(svc.Object)
        {
            ControllerContext = new ControllerContext { HttpContext = ctx }
        };

        // Act
        var result = await controller.Login(ValidLoginCommand(), CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        var ok = result.Should().BeOfType<OkObjectResult>().Subject;
        ok.StatusCode.Should().Be(200);
        ok.Value.Should().NotBeNull();
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Login_InvalidCredentials_Returns401()
    {
        // Arrange
        var (svc, ctx) = BuildContext();
        svc.Setup(s => s.LoginAsync(It.IsAny<LoginCommand>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
           .ReturnsAsync((LoginResult?)null);

        var controller = new Identity.Api.Controllers.AuthController(svc.Object)
        {
            ControllerContext = new ControllerContext { HttpContext = ctx }
        };

        // Act
        var result = await controller.Login(ValidLoginCommand(), CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        result.Should().BeOfType<UnauthorizedObjectResult>()
              .Which.StatusCode.Should().Be(401);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Login_MfaRequired_Returns403WithMfaFlag()
    {
        // Arrange
        var (svc, ctx) = BuildContext();
        svc.Setup(s => s.LoginAsync(It.IsAny<LoginCommand>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
           .ReturnsAsync(ValidLoginResult(requiresMfa: true));

        var controller = new Identity.Api.Controllers.AuthController(svc.Object)
        {
            ControllerContext = new ControllerContext { HttpContext = ctx }
        };

        // Act
        var result = await controller.Login(ValidLoginCommand(), CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        var objResult = result.Should().BeOfType<ObjectResult>().Subject;
        objResult.StatusCode.Should().Be(403);
    }

    // ─── Refresh ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public async Task Refresh_ValidCookie_Returns200WithNewTokens()
    {
        // Arrange
        var (svc, ctx) = BuildContext(refreshCookieValue: "valid_refresh_token");
        svc.Setup(s => s.RefreshAsync("valid_refresh_token", It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
           .ReturnsAsync(ValidLoginResult());

        var controller = new Identity.Api.Controllers.AuthController(svc.Object)
        {
            ControllerContext = new ControllerContext { HttpContext = ctx }
        };

        // Act
        var result = await controller.Refresh(CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        result.Should().BeOfType<OkObjectResult>()
              .Which.StatusCode.Should().Be(200);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Refresh_NoCookie_Returns401()
    {
        // Arrange
        var (svc, ctx) = BuildContext(refreshCookieValue: null);

        var controller = new Identity.Api.Controllers.AuthController(svc.Object)
        {
            ControllerContext = new ControllerContext { HttpContext = ctx }
        };

        // Act
        var result = await controller.Refresh(CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        result.Should().BeOfType<UnauthorizedResult>()
              .Which.StatusCode.Should().Be(401);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Refresh_ExpiredToken_Returns401AndClearsCookie()
    {
        // Arrange
        var (svc, ctx) = BuildContext(refreshCookieValue: "expired_token");
        svc.Setup(s => s.RefreshAsync("expired_token", It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
           .ReturnsAsync((LoginResult?)null);

        var controller = new Identity.Api.Controllers.AuthController(svc.Object)
        {
            ControllerContext = new ControllerContext { HttpContext = ctx }
        };

        // Act
        var result = await controller.Refresh(CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        result.Should().BeOfType<UnauthorizedResult>();
    }

    // ─── Logout ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public async Task Logout_WithRefreshCookie_RevokesTokenAndReturns204()
    {
        // Arrange
        var (svc, ctx) = BuildContext(refreshCookieValue: "refresh_token_abc");
        svc.Setup(s => s.RevokeRefreshTokenAsync("refresh_token_abc", It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
           .Returns(Task.CompletedTask);

        var controller = new Identity.Api.Controllers.AuthController(svc.Object)
        {
            ControllerContext = new ControllerContext { HttpContext = ctx }
        };

        // Act
        var result = await controller.Logout(CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        result.Should().BeOfType<NoContentResult>()
              .Which.StatusCode.Should().Be(204);

        svc.Verify(s => s.RevokeRefreshTokenAsync("refresh_token_abc", It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()), Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Logout_NoCookie_Returns204WithoutRevoke()
    {
        // Arrange
        var (svc, ctx) = BuildContext(refreshCookieValue: null);

        var controller = new Identity.Api.Controllers.AuthController(svc.Object)
        {
            ControllerContext = new ControllerContext { HttpContext = ctx }
        };

        // Act
        var result = await controller.Logout(CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        result.Should().BeOfType<NoContentResult>()
              .Which.StatusCode.Should().Be(204);

        svc.Verify(s => s.RevokeRefreshTokenAsync(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()), Times.Never);
    }
}

using Identity.Application.Commands.Auth;
using Identity.Application.Interfaces;
using Moq;
using FluentAssertions;

namespace Identity.UnitTests.Services;

/// <summary>
/// Unit tests for <see cref="IIdentityAuthService"/> contract validation.
/// These tests verify the interface contract and any concrete implementation
/// behaviour that can be tested without a real database.
/// </summary>
public sealed class IdentityAuthServiceTests
{
    private readonly Mock<IIdentityAuthService> _svc = new();

    // ─── LoginAsync ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]

    {
        // Arrange
        var expected = BuildLoginResult();
        _svc.Setup(s => s.LoginAsync(It.IsAny<LoginCommand>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<string>(), default))
            .ReturnsAsync(expected);

        // Act
        var result = await _svc.Object.LoginAsync(new LoginCommand
        {
            TenantCode = "ACME",
            Email      = "admin@acme.com",
            Password   = "Valid@123"
        }, "127.0.0.1", "Test/1.0", default);

        // Assert
        result.Should().NotBeNull();
        result!.AccessToken.Should().NotBeNullOrEmpty();
        result.RefreshToken.Should().NotBeNullOrEmpty();
        result.ExpiresAtUtc.Should().BeAfter(DateTime.UtcNow);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task LoginAsync_ReturnsNull_WhenCredentialsAreInvalid()
    {
        // Arrange
        _svc.Setup(s => s.LoginAsync(It.IsAny<LoginCommand>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<string>(), default))
            .ReturnsAsync((LoginResult?)null);

        // Act

        {
            TenantCode = "ACME",
            Email      = "wrong@acme.com",
            Password   = "wrong"
        }, "127.0.0.1", "Test/1.0", default);

        // Assert

        {
            TenantCode = "ACME",
            Email      = "mfa@acme.com",

        // Assert

        result!.RequiresMfa.Should().BeTrue();

            .ReturnsAsync(expected);

    [Fact]

            .Returns(Task.CompletedTask);

        // Act
        var act = async () => await _svc.Object.RevokeRefreshTokenAsync("token_to_revoke", default);

        // Assert
        await act.Should().NotThrowAsync();
        _svc.Verify(s => s.RevokeRefreshTokenAsync("token_to_revoke", default), Times.Once);
    }

    // ─── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private static LoginResult BuildLoginResult(
        bool requiresMfa = false,
        string[]? roles = null,
        string[]? permissions = null) => new()
    {
        AccessToken  = requiresMfa ? string.Empty : "eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiJ9.test_payload",
        RefreshToken = requiresMfa ? string.Empty : "opaque_refresh_token_abc123",
        ExpiresAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(15),
        RequiresMfa  = requiresMfa,
        TenantCode   = "ACME",
        TenantType   = "Importer",
        Roles        = roles        ?? new[] { "Admin" },
        Permissions  = permissions  ?? new[] { "declarations.read" }
    };
}
</file>

<file path="tests/05-performance/k6/load/auth-load.js">
/**
 * k6 Load Test – Identity Auth API
 * Simulates realistic concurrent load over a ramp-up/steady/ramp-down cycle.
 *
 * Run:
 *   k6 run tests/05-performance/k6/load/auth-load.js \
 *       -e API_URL=http://localhost:5000
 */
import http from 'k6/http';
import { check, sleep } from 'k6';
import { Rate, Trend } from 'k6/metrics';

const errorRate      = new Rate('errors');
const loginDuration  = new Trend('login_duration', true);

export const options = {
  stages: [
    { duration: '2m',  target: 50  },   // ramp up  → 50 VUs
    { duration: '5m',  target: 50  },   // hold      @ 50 VUs
    { duration: '2m',  target: 100 },   // ramp up  → 100 VUs
    { duration: '5m',  target: 100 },   // hold      @ 100 VUs
    { duration: '2m',  target: 0   },   // ramp down → 0 VUs
  ],
  thresholds: {
    http_req_duration: ['p(95)<800', 'p(99)<1500'],
    http_req_failed:   ['rate<0.02'],
    errors:            ['rate<0.02'],
    login_duration:    ['p(95)<800'],
  },
};

const BASE_URL = __ENV.API_URL ?? 'http://localhost:5000';

export default function () {
  const payload = JSON.stringify({
    tenantCode: 'ACME',
    email:      `user${Math.floor(Math.random() * 100)}@acme.com`,
    password:   'Admin@123456!',
  });

  const params = { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } };

  const res = http.post(`${BASE_URL}/api/v1/identity/auth/login`, payload, params);
  loginDuration.add(res.timings.duration);

  const ok = check(res, {
    'status 200 or 401': (r) => r.status === 200 || r.status === 401,
    'response time < 1s': (r) => r.timings.duration < 1000,
  });

  errorRate.add(!ok);
  sleep(Math.random() * 2 + 1); // think time 1–3 s
}
</file>

<file path="tests/05-performance/k6/smoke/auth-smoke.js">
/**
 * k6 Smoke Test – Identity Auth API
 * Validates the /login endpoint returns 200 with fewer than 5 VUs.
 * Purpose: quick sanity check that the service is alive before heavier runs.
 *
 * Run:
 *   k6 run tests/05-performance/k6/smoke/auth-smoke.js \
 *       -e API_URL=http://localhost:5000
 */
import http from 'k6/http';
import { check, sleep } from 'k6';
import { Rate } from 'k6/metrics';

const errorRate = new Rate('errors');

export const options = {
  vus: 3,
  duration: '30s',
  thresholds: {
    http_req_duration: ['p(95)<500'],   // 95th percentile < 500 ms
    http_req_failed:   ['rate<0.01'],   // error rate < 1 %
    errors:            ['rate<0.01'],
  },
};

const BASE_URL = __ENV.API_URL ?? 'http://localhost:5000';

export default function () {
  const payload = JSON.stringify({
    tenantCode: 'ACME',
    email:      'admin@acme.com',
    password:   'Admin@123456!',
  });

  const params = {
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  };

  const res = http.post(`${BASE_URL}/api/v1/identity/auth/login`, payload, params);

  const ok = check(res, {
    'status is 200':           (r) => r.status === 200,
    'has accessToken':         (r) => JSON.parse(r.body)?.accessToken !== undefined,
    'response time < 500ms':   (r) => r.timings.duration < 500,
  });

  errorRate.add(!ok);
  sleep(1);
}
</file>

<file path="tests/05-performance/k6/soak/auth-soak.js">
/**
 * k6 Soak Test – Identity Auth API
 * Runs at moderate load for an extended period to surface memory leaks
 * and connection pool exhaustion.
 *
 * Run:
 *   k6 run tests/05-performance/k6/soak/auth-soak.js \
 *       -e API_URL=http://localhost:5000
 */
import http from 'k6/http';
import { check, sleep } from 'k6';
import { Rate, Trend } from 'k6/metrics';

const errorRate     = new Rate('errors');
const loginDuration = new Trend('login_duration', true);

export const options = {
  stages: [
    { duration: '5m',  target: 50 },   // ramp up
    { duration: '4h',  target: 50 },   // soak
    { duration: '5m',  target: 0  },   // ramp down
  ],
  thresholds: {
    http_req_duration: ['p(95)<1000'],
    http_req_failed:   ['rate<0.01'],
    errors:            ['rate<0.01'],
    login_duration:    ['p(95)<1000'],
  },
};

const BASE_URL = __ENV.API_URL ?? 'http://localhost:5000';

export default function () {
  const res = http.post(`${BASE_URL}/api/v1/identity/auth/login`,
    JSON.stringify({ tenantCode: 'ACME', email: 'admin@acme.com', password: 'Admin@123456!' }),
    { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });

  loginDuration.add(res.timings.duration);
  errorRate.add(!check(res, { 'status 200': (r) => r.status === 200 }));
  sleep(2);
}
</file>

<file path="tests/05-performance/k6/spike/auth-spike.js">
/**
 * k6 Spike Test – Identity Auth API
 * Simulates a sudden burst of traffic (e.g. a viral event or DDoS probe).
 */
import http from 'k6/http';
import { check, sleep } from 'k6';
import { Rate } from 'k6/metrics';

const errorRate = new Rate('errors');

export const options = {
  stages: [
    { duration: '10s', target: 10  },   // warm-up
    { duration: '30s', target: 500 },   // spike!
    { duration: '1m',  target: 500 },   // sustain spike
    { duration: '30s', target: 10  },   // recover
    { duration: '30s', target: 0   },   // ramp down
  ],
  thresholds: {
    http_req_failed: ['rate<0.15'],
    errors:          ['rate<0.15'],
  },
};

const BASE_URL = __ENV.API_URL ?? 'http://localhost:5000';

export default function () {
  const res = http.post(`${BASE_URL}/api/v1/identity/auth/login`,
    JSON.stringify({ tenantCode: 'ACME', email: 'admin@acme.com', password: 'Admin@123456!' }),
    { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });

  errorRate.add(!check(res, { 'not 5xx': (r) => r.status < 500 }));
  sleep(0.1);
}
</file>

/**
 * k6 Stress Test – Identity Auth API
 * Pushes load beyond normal capacity to find the breaking point.
 *
 * Run:
 *   k6 run tests/05-performance/k6/stress/auth-stress.js \
 *       -e API_URL=http://localhost:5000
 */
import http from 'k6/http';
import { check, sleep } from 'k6';
import { Rate } from 'k6/metrics';

const errorRate = new Rate('errors');

export const options = {
  stages: [
    { duration: '2m',  target: 100 },
    { duration: '5m',  target: 200 },
    { duration: '2m',  target: 300 },
    { duration: '5m',  target: 300 },
    { duration: '2m',  target: 0   },
  ],
  thresholds: {
    http_req_duration: ['p(95)<2000'],
    http_req_failed:   ['rate<0.10'],
    errors:            ['rate<0.10'],
  },
};

const BASE_URL = __ENV.API_URL ?? 'http://localhost:5000';

export default function () {
  const payload = JSON.stringify({
    tenantCode: 'ACME',
    email:      'admin@acme.com',
    password:   'Admin@123456!',
  });

  const res = http.post(`${BASE_URL}/api/v1/identity/auth/login`, payload, {
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  });

  const ok = check(res, { 'not server error': (r) => r.status < 500 });
  errorRate.add(!ok);
  sleep(0.5);
}

/**

 * Import and spread these into any k6 options.thresholds object to
 * enforce consistent SLOs across all performance test suites.

export const DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS = {
  // HTTP
  http_req_duration:   ['p(95)<800', 'p(99)<1500', 'max<5000'],
  http_req_failed:     ['rate<0.02'],
  http_req_connecting: ['p(95)<200'],
  http_req_tls_handshaking: ['p(95)<300'],

  // Custom error rate metric used in all scripts
  errors:              ['rate<0.02'],
};

# Smart Trade Logistics Platform - Test Suite

Halkan waxa ku yaal qaab-dhismeedka tijaabooyinka (testing architecture) ee mashruuca:

```
tests/
├── 01-unit/                     # Unit Tests (Controllers, Services, Domain, Repositories)
├── 02-integration/              # Integration & Database/API Tests
├── 03-e2e/                      # End-to-End Tests (Cypress Web, Mobile & Multi-service Scenarios)
├── 04-security/                 # Security Tests (Auth, RBAC, Tenant Isolation, DAST)
├── 05-performance/              # Performance Tests (k6 smoke, load, stress, spike, soak)
├── 06-chaos/                    # Chaos Engineering & Resilience (Failures, Recovery)
├── 07-contract/                 # Consumer-Driven Contracts (Pact / OpenAPI)
├── 08-test-infrastructure/      # Test Containers, Fixtures, Builders & Mock Data
└── 09-reports/                  # Test Results, Code Coverage & Audit Reports
```

## How to Run Tests

### Unit Tests
```bash
dotnet test tests/01-unit/Identity.UnitTests/Identity.UnitTests.csproj
```

### All Tests
```bash
dotnet test tests/
```

# 🚚 Smart Trade Logistics Platform

<div align="center">

![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-.NET%208%20%7C%20TypeScript-blueviolet?style=for-the-badge)
![Docker](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docker-Compose-2496ED?style=for-the-badge&logo=docker)
![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green?style=for-the-badge)
![CI](https://img.shields.io/badge/CI-GitHub%20Actions-181717?style=for-the-badge&logo=github-actions)

**An enterprise-grade, cloud-native trade logistics platform built on a distributed micro-service architecture.**

[Features](#-features) • [Tech Stack](#-tech-stack) • [Getting Started](#-getting-started) • [Services](#-micro-services) • [Infrastructure](#-infrastructure) • [Testing](#-testing) • [Contributing](#-contributing)

---

## 🌍 Overview

Smart Trade Logistics Platform provides a unified, end-to-end solution for managing international trade operations. It covers the full logistics lifecycle — from shipment declaration and customs clearance, to real-time GPS tracking, fleet management, ANPR gate control, vessel AIS monitoring, and payment processing.

The system is designed for **scalability**, **resilience**, and **observability**, with full Kubernetes support via Helm and ArgoCD.

---

## ✨ Features

| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| 🛰️ **GPS Telematics** | Real-time vehicle telemetry ingestion and tracking |
| 🚢 **AIS Vessel Tracking** | Automatic Identification System integration for maritime logistics |
| 🛃 **Customs Management** | Full lifecycle customs case processing and declarations |
| 📦 **ECTN Management** | Electronic Cargo Tracking Note generation and validation |
| 🚗 **ANPR Gate Control** | Automatic Number Plate Recognition for gate entry/exit |
| 🚛 **Fleet Management** | Driver and vehicle fleet operations |
| 💳 **Payment Processing** | Secure payment intent creation and management |
| 🔔 **Notifications** | Multi-channel notification dispatch (email, SMS, push) |
| 📊 **Analytics** | Business intelligence and reporting service |
| 🔐 **Identity & Auth** | Centralized authentication and authorization (JWT + HashiCorp Vault) |
| 🔗 **Corridor Management** | Trade corridor routing and logistics lane tracking |
| 🔄 **Integration Hub** | External third-party system integrations |
| 📝 **Audit Log** | Immutable audit trail for all platform actions |

---

## 🛠️ Tech Stack

### Backend
- **.NET 8 / C#** — ASP.NET Core Web API, minimal APIs
- **Entity Framework Core** — ORM & database migrations
- **MediatR** — CQRS pattern (Commands / Queries / Handlers)
- **FluentValidation** — Request validation
- **gRPC / HTTP** — Service-to-service communication

### Frontend & Mobile
- **Web App** (`apps/web`) — TypeScript-based web client
- **Admin Tools** (`apps/admin-tools`) — Back-office management portal
- **Driver Mobile** (`apps/driver-mobile`) — Mobile app for drivers

### Infrastructure & DevOps
- **Docker / Docker Compose** — Local dev environment
- **Kubernetes + Helm** — Production-grade container orchestration
- **ArgoCD** — GitOps continuous delivery
- **Terraform** — Infrastructure as Code
- **Ansible** — Configuration management
- **Jenkins / GitHub Actions** — CI/CD pipelines
- **HashiCorp Vault** — Secrets management
- **Prometheus + Grafana** — Metrics and monitoring
- **Jaeger / OpenTelemetry** — Distributed tracing
- **Elasticsearch** — Centralized logging

---

## 🚀 Getting Started

### Prerequisites

| Tool | Version |
|---|---|
| [Docker Desktop](https://www.docker.com/products/docker-desktop) | Latest |
| [.NET SDK](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download) | 8.0+ |
| [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) | 20+ |
| [PowerShell](https://github.com/PowerShell/PowerShell) | 7+ (Windows) |

### Installation

```bash
# 1. Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/your-org/smart-trade-logistics-platform.git
cd smart-trade-logistics-platform

# 2. Copy environment config
cp .env.example .env   # edit values as needed

# 3. Build all Docker images
docker compose build
```

### Running the Application

```bash
# Start all core services
docker compose up -d

# Start with observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger)
docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.observability.yml up -d

# Check service health
curl http://localhost:5000/health
```

### Database Migrations

```powershell
# Windows
./run-migrations.ps1

# Linux / macOS
./run-migrations.sh
```

## 📦 Micro-Services

```
services/
├── ais/              # AIS maritime vessel tracking
├── ais-vessel/       # Vessel data enrichment
├── analytics/        # Reporting & business intelligence
├── anpr/             # ANPR plate recognition engine
├── anpr-gate/        # Gate entry/exit controller
├── audit/            # Audit log service
├── corridor/         # Trade corridor management
├── customs/          # Customs cases & declarations
├── declaration/      # Shipment declaration service
├── ectn/             # ECTN generation & validation
├── fleet/            # Fleet & driver management
├── gps/              # GPS data processor
├── gps-telematics/   # Real-time telemetry ingestion
├── identity/         # Auth, JWT, user management
├── integration/      # External integration hub
├── notification/     # Multi-channel notifications
├── payment/          # Payment intent & transactions
└── shipping/         # Shipping order management
```

Each service follows a **Clean Architecture** pattern:

```
ServiceName/
├── ServiceName.Api/           # HTTP controllers, gRPC endpoints
├── ServiceName.Application/   # CQRS handlers, commands, queries
├── ServiceName.Domain/        # Entities, value objects, domain events
├── ServiceName.Infrastructure/# DB, external integrations
└── ServiceName.Tests/         # Unit & integration tests
```

```
├── tracing/      # Jaeger / OpenTelemetry config
└── vault/        # HashiCorp Vault Helm values
```

## 🧪 Testing

### .NET Services

```bash
# Run every test project (unit + integration) in one pass
find . -name '*.csproj' -not -path '*/obj/*' -not -path '*/bin/*' \
  | grep -Ei 'Tests\.csproj$' \
  | xargs -I {} dotnet test {} --nologo

# Run a single service's tests
dotnet test services/gps-telematics/GpsTelematics.Tests
dotnet test tests/Ectn.UnitTests

# Run with coverage
dotnet test --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage"
```

### TypeScript / Frontend

```bash
cd tests/unit
npm install
npm test
```

### Integration Tests

```bash
docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up --abort-on-container-exit
```

## 🔒 Security

The backend is hardened against the **OWASP Top 10 (2021)**. All 12 API services share the same
building blocks in `building-blocks/web/` — deny-by-default authorization, strict JWT validation,
rate limiting, opt-in CORS, security headers and generic error responses.

See **[docs/security/OWASP-TOP-10-REMEDIATION.md](docs/security/OWASP-TOP-10-REMEDIATION.md)** for
the full finding-by-finding breakdown, plus `docs/security/PHASE-15.6-SECURITY-BASELINE.md` for the
Zero Trust architecture.

CI enforces this with a NuGet vulnerability gate, Trivy, Checkov, SonarQube and an OWASP ZAP
baseline scan.

## 🤝 Contributing

Contributions are welcome and encouraged! To get started:

1. **Fork** the repository
2. **Create** a feature branch
   ```bash
   git checkout -b feature/your-feature-name
   ```
3. **Write** tests for your changes
4. **Ensure** all tests pass
   ```bash
   dotnet test
   ```
5. **Commit** using [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
   ```bash
   git commit -m "feat(customs): add case status workflow"
   ```
6. **Open** a Pull Request with a clear description

### Code Style
- C# follows the `.editorconfig` rules in the root
- TypeScript follows ESLint/Prettier config
- All PRs must include unit tests

<file path="run-migrations.ps1">
$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

$services = @(
    "identity", "payment", "customs", "fleet", "declaration", 
    "ectn", "corridor", "gps-telematics", "ais-vessel", "anpr-gate", 
    "audit", "notification", "integration", "analytics"
)

foreach ($svc in $services) {
    Write-Host "========================================="
    Write-Host "Processing Service: $svc"
    
    # Capitalize first letter to match project naming conventions usually
    $SvcCapital = (Get-Culture).TextInfo.ToTitleCase($svc)
    
    if ($svc -eq "gps-telematics") { $SvcCapital = "GpsTelematics" }
    if ($svc -eq "ais-vessel") { $SvcCapital = "AisVessel" }
    if ($svc -eq "anpr-gate") { $SvcCapital = "AnprGate" }
    
    $apiProject = "services/$svc/$SvcCapital.Api"
    $infraProject = "services/$svc/$SvcCapital.Infrastructure"
    
    if ((Test-Path $apiProject) -and (Test-Path $infraProject)) {
        Write-Host "Adding Migration for $svc..."
        dotnet ef migrations add InitialCreate --project $infraProject --startup-project $apiProject --output-dir Persistence/Migrations
        
        Write-Host "Updating Database for $svc..."
        dotnet ef database update --project $infraProject --startup-project $apiProject
    } else {
        Write-Host "Skipping $svc - Project paths not found"
    }
}
Write-Host "Done!"
</file>

<file path="run-migrations.sh">
#!/bin/bash
set -e

services=("identity" "payment" "customs" "fleet" "declaration" "ectn" "corridor" "gps-telematics" "ais-vessel" "anpr-gate" "audit" "notification" "integration" "analytics")

for svc in "${services[@]}"; do
    echo "========================================="
    echo "Processing Service: $svc"
    
    # Capitalize the service name to match folder names (e.g., identity -> Identity)
    if [ "$svc" == "gps-telematics" ]; then
        svc_capital="GpsTelematics"
    elif [ "$svc" == "ais-vessel" ]; then
        svc_capital="AisVessel"
    elif [ "$svc" == "anpr-gate" ]; then
        svc_capital="AnprGate"
    else
        # Capitalize first letter
        svc_capital="$(tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]' <<< ${svc:0:1})${svc:1}"
    fi

    apiProject="services/$svc/$svc_capital.Api"
    infraProject="services/$svc/$svc_capital.Infrastructure"
    
    if [ -d "$apiProject" ] && [ -d "$infraProject" ]; then
        echo "Adding Migration for $svc..."
        dotnet ef migrations add InitialCreate --project $infraProject --startup-project $apiProject --output-dir Persistence/Migrations || true
        
        echo "Updating Database for $svc..."
        dotnet ef database update --project $infraProject --startup-project $apiProject || true
    else
        echo "Skipping $svc - Project paths not found"
    fi
done

echo "Done!"
</file>
